israel.title: Account Executive, Mid Market
israel.description:
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online.

Our unique data and solutions empower over 6,000 customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies. In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange and continue reaching new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.

We’re looking for an Account Executive to drive growth in our Mid-Market book of business. This role will report to the VP of Commercial Sales.

Why is this role so important at Similarweb?

Similarweb’s digital intelligence solutions serve thousands of customers across many different industries and use cases around the world, and we’ve just scratched the surface of our addressable market.

With recognizable customers who love our product, strong brand recognition, and an incredible team, you’ll have the power of a well-established company behind you with the flexibility to help us develop a blueprint for success in the Mid-Market. You’ll control the entire sales cycle, develop critical relationships with mid-sized enterprise accounts, and partner closely with leadership to help us refine our approach and scale up the team.

So, what will you be doing all day?

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and client needs to effectively position our solutions

- Sales Strategy: Collaborate with the Marketing and Sales Development teams to create and execute effective sales programs

- Opportunity Generation: Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through various channels; including inbound leads and outbound prospecting

- Sales Presentations: Conduct product walkthroughs and presentations tailored to the unique needs of your customers and our value proposition

- Proposal Development: Prepare and present customized proposals and contracts to potential clients.

- Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within target accounts

- Sales Reporting: Maintain accurate records of sales activities, pipeline, and forecasts in Salesforce

This Is The Perfect Job For Someone Who:

- Has a minimum of three years of experience in managing consultative sales processes with mid-sized enterprise accounts

- Has a demonstrated history of exceeding sales targets for high-end Saas sales

- Can confidently present in front of important clients and stakeholders

- Is highly collaborative, and uses a direct and honest approach to deliver customer success

- Brings a high level of energy and activity every day to keep their pipeline full

A PLUS: Has a clear understanding of current digital marketing trends, including SEO, content marketing, PPC, social and display advertising.

**At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in-office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**

The base salary range for this position in the Burlington, Massachusetts area is $70,000 to $90,000, plus benefits, including: medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K plan, potential equity, employee stock purchase plan, and paid sick and parental leave.

In addition, this position is eligible to participate in the company’s sales incentive plan, with a maximum target OTE of up to $180,000, depending upon the final terms of employment and achievement of established targets.
Individual compensation is based upon a number of factors, including qualifications and relevant experience.

The base salary range above is for the Burlington, Massachusetts area, and could vary for candidates in other locations.

Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

You’ll get to sell a product you actually believe in: Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.

You’ll find a home for your big ideas:  We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.

We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously, and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also put a strong emphasis on community, with regular team outings and happy hours.

You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.

Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to inclusivity across race, gender, ethnicity, culture, sexual orientation, age, religion, spirituality, identity and experience. We believe our culture of equality and mutual respect also helps us better understand and serve our customers in a world that is becoming more global, more diverse, and more digital every day.

israel.description:
At Similarweb, we’re not just another data company - we’re the leading digital intelligence platform used by global giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas. 🌍 Our insights power the digital strategies of over 4,300 companies worldwide, and we’re growing fast. After going public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021, we continue to break new ground, and now we’re expanding our dynamic team in Prague! 🇨🇿

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the Data Enablement team and help build the crucial bridge between our data and our customer-facing organization. As the sole engineering role on the team, you will own the technical work end-to-end - from a rough sketch to something stable and running in production.

Why is this role crucial?

As the most trusted platform for measuring online behavior, our data is only as powerful as our ability to communicate it. Engineering here is in service of analysis. By right-sizing your engineering to the problem - knowing when to ship a quick fix in a day and when to architect a quarter-long project - you will empower our analysts to work faster and help our customer-facing teams communicate our data effectively. Your independence, reliability, and technical judgement will directly impact how Similarweb’s insights are delivered to the world.

What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

- End-to-End Ownership: Own the Databricks development environment and project structure for the team.

- Tool Building: Build practical internal tools (including AI-assisted and automated tools) that speed up data investigation and help customer-facing teams communicate data.

- Productionizing tooling: Work directly with analysts to turn their analytical tools into reliable automated solutions.

- Infrastructure & Automation: Set up and maintain Git workflows, code reviews, and deployments in GitLab, while managing automated ETLs and agents.

- Efficiency: Identify repetitive manual work across the team and automate it.

- Hands-on Analysis: Dive directly into the data when a project calls for it, balancing your time between building and analyzing. Understand the analytics you are building solutions for.

- AI Integration: Use AI coding assistants (like Cursor or Claude) as a normal, everyday part of your workflow.

- Collaboration: Work closely with infrastructure teams to build and scale new solutions.

- Having lots of fun!

This is the perfect job for someone who:

- Has strong proficiency in Python, PySpark, and advanced SQL.

- Can take a vague, messy problem and drive it to a working solution by planning, designing, and delivering independently.

- Has a solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals (Git, continuous integration, and the discipline to maintain a mostly one-person codebase).

- Demonstrates great judgement on how much engineering a problem deserves, always keeping analytical correctness as non-negotiable.

- Is comfortable working with our AWS stack (or has a background in GCP/Azure with a genuine willingness to learn AWS).

- Is quick to pick up new tools and can build across a wide variety of infrastructures, rather than leaning on just one familiar stack.

- Communicates clearly, particularly when translating technical concepts to non-engineers.

- Has analytics at heart and cares about the question behind the code and digs into why a number looks off before moving on.

- Bonus: Has experience or curiosity in building AI-powered applications.

Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

- Impact : Work with the world’s leading digital intelligence platform and make a real difference.

- Innovation : Bring your ideas forward - we empower you to drive change.

- Hybrid work model: 3 days in our office and 2 days working from home.

- Our Office: Modern space in Prague’s DOCK IN area, stocked with snacks, drinks (we're big fans of kombucha), fruit and lunches on Tuedays.

- Benefits: 5 weeks of vacation, birthday day off, 3 sick days, or Multisport

israel.title: Data Scientist – Ad Intelligence
israel.description:
The Role

As a Data Scientist on our Ad Intelligence team, you’ll build the models and algorithms that estimate how advertisers spend money and reach audiences across the web.

This role demands a genuine understanding of the business logic behind our numbers, combined with the technical range to solve problems at any scale: sometimes the right answer is a carefully tuned heuristic shipped in a day, sometimes it’s a full ML pipeline that takes weeks to get right. Whichever approach is the right one, you will own the algorithm end-to-end.

What You’ll Do

- Build a deep understanding of the business logic behind our metrics, and encode it into model assumptions, features, and validation rules.

- Design, build, and sometimes productionize models that estimate ad intelligence metrics.

- Apply modern ML techniques where they earn their complexity; and use simpler heuristics where they don’t.

- Own tasks end-to-end: from exploration and proof of concept through a full research cycle including careful model selection and evaluation. In some cases you will also create the production implementation in collaboration with engineers.

- Closely collaborate with data analysts to uncover and solve data quality issues.

- Document and communicate the assumptions and limitations behind each model, so stakeholders know exactly what the numbers do and don't capture.

- Use modern AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Cursor, and similar) as a core part of your daily workflow to move faster.



The mindset that will help you succeed

- Analytical Thinking: Using analytical and statistical rigor to solve ambiguous problems and translate them into business value.

- Strategic Thinking: Weighing complexity against time available, and picking the modeling approach that best serves the timeline and the business need with respect to future sustainability and maintainability.

- Ownership: Taking a problem from raw data to a validated, production model without needing to be chased.

- Learning Agility: Comfortable picking up new tools, data sources, and techniques quickly, including AI-assisted development workflows.

- Collaboration: Working effectively with others within and across teams.

What You’ll Bring

- MSc in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (preferred); strong practical experience can substitute a degree with knowledge in relevant fields (statistics, machine learning, advanced mathematics).

- 2-4 years of experience building and deploying machine learning models or statistical algorithms in production.

- Strong Python skills, and hands-on experience with modern ML algorithms.

- PySpark experience, or the ability and willingness to learn it quickly (with our support!). Our existing solutions run on Spark, and you’ll need to read, use, and build on that code effectively.

- Experience with big data in a cloud environment is an advantage; we use Databricks daily.

- Comfort using AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar) as part of your everyday workflow.

- A genuine drive to understand the business logic behind the numbers, not just optimize a metric in isolation.

- Pragmatism: the judgment to know when a simple heuristic beats a complex model, and the discipline to build the complex one when it’s actually needed.

In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights. Work alongside Similarwebbers from around the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and genuinely good people.

We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to join our Client Services Team.

This role will report to Team Manager, Customer Success.

Why is this role so important at Similarweb?

The CSM's ability to create relationships with the clients, and help them extract real business value, using Similarweb’s platform, is essential to keeping clients engaged with Similarweb for years.

- The CSM is in the front line, bringing our platform and data to life for the client

- The CSM drives user engagement, adoption of our platform and helps identify growth opportunities by addressing the client's pain points

So, what will you be doing all day?

Your role as part of the Client Services Team means your daily responsibilities may include:

- Lead, manage, and expand long-term customer relationships; focus on understanding the client’s KPIs to ultimately drive positive business outcomes

- Act as a trusted partner and advisor to customers by providing actionable insights that will help clients achieve their business goals using our cutting-edge data

- Identify and mitigate churn risks, implementing proactive measures to retain customers and enhance their experience

- Ensure our users are engaged with the platform and understand the value (“the so what?”) it brings them towards achieving their goals

- Develop strong subject matter expertise across Similarweb’s entire product portfolio

This is the perfect job for someone with:

- Solid understanding of the digital marketing space and trends

- Client facing experience

- Strong relationship-building skills –the ability to quickly build rapport and establish trust (both internally and with clients)

- Analytical and consulting mindset with the ability to turn data into a story

- Experience producing high-quality decks and decks and client-facing materials

- Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

- Team player who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and business partners

- 5-6 years’ experience as a CSM

**At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in the office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**

The base salary range for this position in the Burlington, Massachusetts area is $101,000 to $115,000, plus benefits, including: medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K plan, potential equity, employee stock purchase plan, and paid sick and parental leave.

In addition, this position is eligible to participate in the company’s sales incentive plan, with a maximum target OTE of up to $165,000, depending upon the final terms of employment and achievement of established targets. Individual compensation is based upon a number of factors, including qualifications and relevant experience. The base salary range above is for the Burlington, Massachusetts area, and could vary for candidates in other locations.

Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

You’ll actually love the product you work with: Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.

You’ll find a home for your big ideas: We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take the initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.

We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also strongly emphasize community, with regular team outings and happy hours.

You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.

Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We're looking for a Solution Business Manager, Search & Ads Intelligence to bring their performance marketing expertise to the next level. This is not a generalist role. Why This Role, Why Now

The search and paid media landscape is going through its biggest shift in years:

-   Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are creating entirely new strategies for organic and paid visibility that most clients are still figuring out.

-   Paid search, social, display, and affiliate channels are increasingly interconnected, and marketers need unified intelligence to allocate budgets effectively.

-   AI tools are changing how campaigns are built, optimized, and reported on, and the practitioners who know how to work with them are already pulling ahead.

-   Our clients need someone who can speak their language, understand their challenges, and show them how Similarweb solves problems they deal with every day.

israel.description:

Work alongside Similarwebbers from around the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and genuinely good people.

About the Role

Search is changing fast. AI-powered answers, generative results, and new ad formats are reshaping how people find information and how brands compete for attention. Similarweb sits at the center of that shift, giving marketers the intelligence they need to stay ahead.

We're looking for a Solution Business Manager, Search & Ads Intelligence to bring their performance marketing expertise to the next level. This is not a generalist role. We want someone who has lived inside a performance marketing agency or large retailers or eCommerce with hands-on experience managing campaigns across organic and paid channels and can translate that real-world experience into value for our clients.

You will partner with sales, account management, and customer success to win deals, deepen adoption, and position Similarweb as the go-to platform for marketers navigating today's complex search and paid media landscape. Also, you will also help shape our product roadmap by feeding market intelligence, your knowledge and client insights back to the product and data teams.

If you get excited by keyword gaps, AI-generated search results, messy URLs, bidding strategy, audience overlap, and building custom workflows with AI tools, this role is for you.

Why This Role, Why Now

The search and paid media landscape is going through its biggest shift in years:

-   Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are creating entirely new strategies for organic and paid visibility that most clients are still figuring out.

-   Paid search, social, display, and affiliate channels are increasingly interconnected, and marketers need unified intelligence to allocate budgets effectively.

-   AI tools are changing how campaigns are built, optimized, and reported on, and the practitioners who know how to work with them are already pulling ahead.

-   Our clients need someone who can speak their language, understand their challenges, and show them how Similarweb solves problems they deal with every day.

What You'll Do

Your core focus is being the subject matter expert that clients and internal teams turn to when they need a real practitioner's perspective on search and paid media.

Client & Revenue Impact

-   Partner with sales and account management to support deal cycles, RFPs, and renewal conversations, bringing hands-on practitioner credibility to every client interaction.

-   Run discovery sessions to understand clients' channel mix, budget allocation, and competitive challenges across SEO, AEO/GEO, Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, and Affiliate.

-   Build tailored use case demos and data stories that speak directly to performance marketers, media planners, and agency strategists.

-   Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts by surfacing unmet needs across the client's full marketing stack.

Search, AEO & GEO Strategy

-   Guide clients on organic search strategy, including AEO and GEO, helping them understand how AI-generated results, featured snippets, and answer boxes are affecting their visibility and what to do about it.

-   Help clients optimize for new search paradigms: LLM-referenced content, structured data, entity optimization, and topic-aligned content strategies.

-   Apply keyword research, content gap analysis, technical SEO insights, and competitor benchmarking using Similarweb's suite alongside other tools.

-   Monitor how SERP landscapes evolve, track shifts in organic click-through rates driven by AI overviews, and translate those findings into actionable client recommendations.

Paid Media Intelligence

-   Advise clients on competitive paid media strategy across Paid Search (SEM/PPC), Paid Social, Programmatic Display, AEO advertising, and Affiliate channels using Similarweb data.

-   Help clients benchmark ad spend, identify competitor keyword bidding patterns, analyze share-of-voice, and uncover channel gaps across the competitive landscape.

-   Connect organic and paid search insights to help clients make smarter cross-channel budget decisions and reduce wasted spend.

-   Support client and internal teams in suggesting or building client-facing reports and competitive audits powered by Similarweb data.

AI-Driven Workflows & Innovation

-   Actively use AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, prompt engineering) to build workflows and agents that increase your output and the quality of deliverables.

-   Prototype custom analyses and solutions by combining Similarweb data with AI tools, giving clients a preview of what is possible beyond the standard product.

-   Stay current on how AI is changing search, advertising, and marketing analytics, and bring that knowledge into client conversations proactively.

Product Feedback & Market Intelligence

-   Evaluate the competitive landscape, emerging tools, and industry trends, sharing structured feedback with product and data teams. Such feedback should be curated and made applicable to various core industries we service.

-   Facilitate client feedback sessions and user research to inform the product roadmap for Search and Ads Intelligence.

-   Monitor and report on product KPIs, adoption trends, and solution health across the book of business.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

-   6+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, with deep expertise in both SEO and paid media, ideally at a performance marketing agency managing multiple accounts.

-   Practical experience across at least three of the following channels: Organic Search (SEO), Paid Search (PPC/SEM), Paid Social, Programmatic Display, Affiliate.

-   Solid understanding of AEO and GEO: what it means to optimize for AI-generated answers, how LLMs surface content, and what marketers need to do differently now.

-   Comfortable building with AI. You use AI tools regularly to do your work faster and better, and you can clearly explain how you do it.

-   Strong analytical mindset, you dig into data, spot the story, and communicate it in a way that drives decisions.

-   Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable in front of clients, execs, and internal teams alike.

-   Bias toward action, able to work across ambiguity, prioritize fast, and build things from scratch when needed.

Nice to Have

-   Experience working with B2B SaaS companies or marketing technology platforms.

-   Familiarity with competitive intelligence tools or market research platforms.

-   Experience presenting at industry events, writing thought leadership content, or building training programs.

-   Existing network within the performance marketing agency world.

The Application Security team at Riskified ensures the security of Riskified’s products. In this role you will evaluate security architecture, design and implement technology, processes, and procedures by collaborating closely with developers, product managers, and other members of the security team.



What You'll Be Doing



- Initiate and improve processes, tools, and documentation that will support application security requirements

- Identify security design gaps in existing and proposed architectures, services and products

- Evaluate architecture, design, and code to identify and resolve potential vulnerabilities and security risks

- Work closely with development teams to prioritise and resolve application security issues and implement security best practices, frameworks, etc.

- Assist in identifying and responding to security issues in Riskified’s environment



Qualifications



- 5+ years application security hands-on experience

- Experience performing security design and code reviews, threat modeling and customizing application security solutions

- Strong understanding of common security attacks and their remediation

- Hands-on experience with AI tools and AI-based security solutions

- Experience performing security design reviews and security testing for AI systems, LLM-based applications, and AI agents

- Experience with programming languages: Ruby, Scala, Python, JavaScript, etc. (Advantage)

- Ability to work well with developers and product management

- Experience working in high scale SaaS environment (Advantage)

- Knowledge of microservice architecture, web technologies and APIs (Advantage)

- Ability to explain complex security problems

- Excellent problem solving skills

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.



About the Role

The Connect Team enables seamless integrations between external vendor ecosystems and Riskified’s comprehensive product portfolio - including Chargeback Guarantee, Dispute Resolve, and Policy Engine.

We build high-performance connectors, apps, and APIs that bridge third-party services (Payment Gateways, Return Vendors, eCommerce Platforms, and CRMs) directly into our platform. By extending our platformic integration layers and introducing cutting-edge AI and agentic solutions, our team drastically simplifies merchant onboarding and accelerates integration velocity across thousands of global eCommerce merchants.

This role requires strong technical execution paired with a deep understanding of our business domain to deliver frictionless, highly reliable onboarding experiences.

What You'll Be Doing

- Build Integration Infrastructure: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable APIs, connectors, and integration layers connecting third-party platforms to Riskified's product suite.

- Drive AI & Automation: Introduce and implement AI and agentic solutions into product onboarding flows to maximize speed, accuracy, and automation for merchants.

- Embrace Modern Workflows: Actively utilize agentic coding tools and AI-assisted workflows to boost team development velocity and code quality.

- Bridge Tech & Business: Partner with Product, Design, and Domain experts to translate complex risk, dispute, and policy business logic into elegant software architecture.

- Ship to Production Daily: Maintain modern CI/CD pipelines, deploying high-quality code daily and taking strong end-to-end ownership of service reliability and performance.

- Active part in planning the team roadmap and products

Qualifications

- B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent certifications

- 3+ years of proven experience in hands-on server-side coding

- Proven experience with server-side development languages, such as TypeScript, Scala, Java, C#, or Kotlin

- Hands-on experience in a recent frontend framework (React, Vue, etc.) - advantage

- Proven experience in full-stack development, with proficiency in both frontend and backend technologies

- Strong business context orientation with the capacity to understand domain workflows in risk, fintech, or eCommerce

- Demonstrated experience building APIs, microservices, and integration layers with databases (SQL/NoSQL) and cloud services (AWS/GCP)

- Passionate about leveraging AI coding assistants and agentic tools in daily development workflows

- Experience incorporating LLMs or agentic frameworks directly into customer-facing products - advantage

- Independent self-learner, proactive problem solver, and strong team player



We include transparent salary ranges to support fairness, clarity, and informed decision-making early in the process. The base salary range for this position is €50,000 - €75,000 gross annually for candidates based in Lisbon. Your actual salary will be determined based on your unique skills, experience, and competencies. If your expectations differ, please let us know - we’re always open to a conversation.
The base salary is one part of the total compensation package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees.

We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking.

We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.

israel.description:
About Us



Riskified is the AI platform powering the eCommerce revolution. We use cutting-edge technology, machine-learning algorithms, and behavioral analytics to identify legitimate customers and keep them moving toward checkout. Merchants use Riskified to increase revenue, prevent fraud, and eliminate customer friction. Riskified has reviewed hundreds of millions of transactions and approved billions of dollars of revenue for merchants across virtually all industries, including a number of Fortune 500 companies.



About the Role



Our Product Management Team plays a pivotal role in our company, driving product success by working collaboratively with Riskified’s engineering, data science, design, marketing, analytics and Application teams. Product Managers at Riskified are required to solve complex problems, using a varied and multi-disciplinary skillset. We continue to grow fast, so we are looking for people who can learn and adjust quickly as the company and our product suite expand.

Being part of our team means working alongside smart and motivated colleagues who consistently work hard and execute. Our philosophy centers around end-to-end ownership, which means that every team member is empowered and accountable. We hold ourselves to high standards, have ambitious goals, and are not afraid of trying new things.

As an Fraud AI Applications Product Manager at Riskified, you will lead a broad and complex product domain at the core of Riskified’s business - the analytical delivery of our ML-based Fraud management offering. You will work with senior stakeholders to define our vision and build the strategy to achieve it. You will design products and processes to execute that strategy, work to automate and optimize complex analytical processes and develop Riskified’s next generation analytical performance platform. You will work with data scientists in order to solve optimization problems. You will envision and define the approaches  and tactics in which operations teams - fraud experts and analysts  deliver best-in-class analytical performance for some of the world’s largest eCommerce companies. You will engage directly with users - internal and external - to identify challenges and opportunities to increase the solution value. israel.title: B2B Demand Generation Manager
israel.description:
AI is moving fast. Most people are watching it happen. We’re building what comes next.
At LTX, we’re creating cutting-edge open-world models that help AI understand, simulate, and generate the world around us. We’re laying the groundwork for AI systems that can model how reality looks, moves, and behaves.

These world models will power the next generation of creative tools, physical AI, product simulation, and entirely new ways to build and interact with technology.

We’re not just training models. We’re helping define a new category.

About the role

The Demand Generation team drives Lightricks’ B2B growth by turning awareness into measurable revenue. They manage large-scale paid campaigns across search and social, experiment continuously to optimize performance, and partner closely with Creative, Sales, and Analytics. Their work fuels the sales pipeline, expands global reach, and reinforces Lightricks’ position as an AI-powered marketing leader. As our B2B Demand Generation Manager you’ll scale paid social and search with meaningful budgets. You’ll reach decision-makers in various markets and convert attention into revenue.

What you will be doing

- Own full-funnel demand gen across SEM (Google/YouTube) and paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, X & Reddit) to hit MQL, SQL, pipeline and revenue targets.

- Lead ABM motions while collaborating with SDR/BDRs and RevOps.

- Manage high budgets at scale across multiple geographies, plan, forecast, and pace spend for impact and efficiency.

- Collaborate with the organic growth team to achieve the right balance between paid and organic acquisition.

- Run continues experimentation: audience and keyword strategy, creative/messaging tests, bidding, landing pages, and conversion flows.

Your skills and experience

- 2+ years experience of proven success in Demand Generation at a B2B company.

- Hands on experience in LinkedIn Ads, Meta, X, Google Ads/YouTube. Proven track record building pipeline from paid social and search.

- ABM experience using intent/enrichment platforms (Apollo, Clay) and collaborating with Sales.

- Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to speed up campaign ideation, creation, and optimization.

- Strong analytical skills, comfortable using BI tools (thoughtspot/Looker/Tableau), able to translate data into action.

- Growth mindset, able to thrive in a fast paced, AI first, environment.

- Fluent English (written and spoken).

Why Join Us:

Some opportunities let you work on AI. This one lets you shape its future.

We’re a team of builders, researchers, and creatives who thrive on solving hard problems and pushing beyond what’s considered possible. Curiosity is encouraged. Experimentation is expected. Today we know that great ideas can come from anywhere.

Every breakthrough we make reaches millions of creators and developers worldwide. This can only happen in an environment where you are encouraged to think, push boundaries, create, and explore. Real impact happens when we, as a team, are empowered to experiment, evolve, and elevate together.

We got you covered!

We empower employees with cutting-edge tools and learning opportunities to grow and succeed through workshops, access and training on platforms, subscriptions, and clear guidelines for responsible AI use.

We offer Car-to-go subscriptions and run daily door-to-door shuttles from several locations in central Israel, plus free parking and train-station pickups.

israel.title: AI Solutions Specialist
israel.description:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevSecOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate. Our team of industry-leading software security experts is a true pioneer, constantly pushing the boundaries with original research and technological innovation. JFrog is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit, and just all-around great people. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production – a concept we call “liquid software”. Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us on our journey?

Join JFrog's CIO Architect team and shape the future of AI! We're seeking a hands-on AI Solutions Specialist to lead the development and implementation of enterprise-wide AI applications. In this pivotal role, you'll evaluate and deliver cutting-edge AI solutions to JFrog employees and teams across the organization. You'll spearhead AI solution projects from initial concept and gathering requirements through execution and widespread adoption, serving as the central point of contact between business, IT, and data teams. You'll also be at the forefront of the latest AI technologies.

As an AI Solutions Specialist at JFrog you will…

- Partner directly with cross-functional and non-R&D teams to understand workflows, pain points, decision-making processes, manual tasks, and operational bottlenecks - diagnosing where GenAI and AI Agents can provide real, measurable value.

- Translate ambiguous business problems into clear AI use cases, MVP definitions, solution designs, success metrics, and rollout plans.

- Lead the lifecycle of GenAI-driven applications and Agents, transitioning rapidly from initial concept and technical feasibility to full enterprise-grade production rollouts.

- Build and configure AI-powered solutions, including agentic workflows, workflow automations, RAG-based tools, decision-support tools, and integrations with internal systems.

- Conduct technical audits of emerging AI technologies, leading "Build vs. Buy" analyses to ensure global scalability, security, and measurable value to the organization.

- Run training and enablement sessions for both technical and non-technical teams, fostering a culture of AI literacy and ensuring the organization can leverage new tools effectively.

- Build and evolve the Enterprise AI technology stack, continuously scouting and integrating next-generation platforms, LLM orchestration tools, and agentic frameworks.

- Serve as the primary technical liaison between IS, IT, Legal, and Data teams to ensure AI solutions are securely integrated and compliant with enterprise standards.

- Be a product owner of enterprise AI platforms, driving continuous solution adoption, impact measurement, and performance optimization across the organization.

To be an AI Solutions Specialist at JFrog you need...

- 5+ years in a technical role such as software engineering, solutions engineering, automation engineering, AI engineering, business application implementation, or a similar hands-on role, including 1+ years delivering AI, GenAI, agentic, or automation solutions for business or operational users.

- A clear builder track record: you have shipped tools, automations, workflows, internal products, or prototypes that people actually used.

- Deep, hands-on understanding of the LLM lifecycle, including Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), fine-tuning strategies, AI agents, tool use, human-in-the-loop workflows, evaluations, and responsible AI patterns.

- Proven experience in implementing Enterprise GenAI platforms (e.g., Gemini Enterprise, Claude Chat).

- Hands-on experience developing agentic workflows on top of agentic framework tools like Google ADK, AgentCore, and low-code platforms (Workato)

- Proven experience developing GTM-related projects, mainly around sales and marketing.

- Proven knowledge of GTM best practices and technology.

- Proven project management skills and a demonstrated product management mindset, including the ability to define MVPs, prioritize, separate nice-to-have ideas from high-value use cases, and measure outcomes.

- Strong discovery skills with non-technical stakeholders: you can map how work happens today and redesign it around AI, automation, and human accountability.

- Excellent communication skills: able to explain technical tradeoffs to business stakeholders and business context to technical teams, and to run training and enablement sessions.

- Strong ownership and execution, with creative, out-of-the-box thinking: comfortable moving from ambiguous problems to working solutions, with a focus on business impact and the ability to run and react fast.

- Full-stack Web development experience, along with proven mastery of coding agent tools and vibe coding best practices — an advantage.

israel.description:

This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

We are looking for a meticulous, proactive, and collaborative teammate to join our Renewals team.

As an Associate Account Manager, Revenue Retention in JFrog you will be a key driver of the “Liquid Software” vision by ensuring our customers' journey with JFrog remains seamless and uninterrupted. By mastering the renewals lifecycle, you enable the world's leading organizations to maintain their continuous delivery pipelines with confidence and speed. Your technical precision in account management ensures that the flow of innovation never stops, making you a vital architect of our customer retention and long-term success.

As an Associate Account Manager, Revenue Retention, in JFrog you will...

- Scale the renewals process by architecting accurate quotes and opportunities across a targeted global portfolio.

- Drive operational excellence by collaborating with Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to ensure 100% contract accuracy and compliance.

- Maximize customer retention by proactively managing the end-to-end renewal lifecycle within your assigned territory, including tracking pending signatures through to close and understanding the downstream consequences of a lapsed renewal (especially on usage-based and cloud products) well enough to create urgency with the customer without being prompted.

- Optimize Salesforce data integrity to provide real-time visibility into renewal health and territory performance, recognizing that clean, current data is the direct input to the AI-driven renewal risk scoring this team runs on.

- Accelerate business growth by identifying expansion opportunities and providing actionable insights during the renewal cycle using AI-assisted signal review (Gong call analysis, renewal risk scoring) to surface expansion opportunities before they show up in a standard pipeline review.

- Recognize strategic deal signals and streamline the customer experience by orchestrating high-touch communications and owning contract and legal-adjacent processes end-to-end.

- Approach the renewal motion as something actively evolving with AI-assisted tooling, ready to take on higher-complexity, higher-touch accounts as routine tiers become more automated.

To be an Associate Account Manager, Revenue Retention in JFrog you need...

- A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in account management, renewals, or sales operations within a SaaS environment.

- Proven track record of managing high-volume portfolios and meeting tight deadlines with exceptional attention to detail.

- Advanced proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) and the MS Office Suite, particularly Excel, including working deal math independently: discount deltas, co-term pricing across tiers, and monthly-vs-annual savings comparisons.

- Demonstrated problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex internal processes and cross-functional dependencies, including contract and legal workflow literacy (JSA, DPA, NDA, compliance routing).

- Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively engage with both internal stakeholders and external customer liaisons.

- Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technical environment where adaptability and a “Froggy” spirit are essential, with working depth on the JFrog platform itself (Xray, edge nodes, tiering) enough to handle a technical objection without a one-line script.

- AI fluency for non-technical, customer-facing work: using AI to accelerate research and drafting, then verifying the output before treating it as finished.

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

- At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.

- This position has a base salary range between $90,000 to $115,000.  Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.

- Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.

- This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

- JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!

- JFrog embraces hybrid work: 3 days in office / 2 days remote.

JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

israel.title: Technical Product Marketing Manager
israel.description:

This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

JFrog is looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager who brings hands-on knowledge of both AI infrastructure and application security and knows how to turn that technical depth into content, tools, and narratives that win with the most demanding technical audiences. This role sits at the intersection of our AI products (AI Catalog, MCP Registry) and our security solutions, and requires someone who can operate credibly across both domains.

This role will take the GTM strategy and market narrative built by PMMs and extend it to technical proof, domain authority, and the practitioner-level credibility that makes our positioning defensible in front of security architects, ML engineers, and CISOs.

As a Technical Product Marketing Manager in JFrog you will...

- Accelerate market intelligence by tracking the latest developments in the AI infrastructure landscape (agent skills, MCP frameworks, agentic architectures, model deployment patterns) and the security threat landscape (emerging attack vectors, regulatory shifts, new standards) to provide actionable insights for product and field teams.

- Scale technical authority by building and maintaining high-impact content, including architecture guides, threat model analyses, security framework mappings (NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS), reference architectures, and hands-on product walkthroughs that practitioners trust.

- Amplify brand presence by representing JFrog at global technical conferences and producing deep-dive blogs and webinars that establish domain leadership.

- Drive competitive differentiation by partnering with CI teams to develop architectural teardowns and capability-level comparisons that win technical evaluations.

- Enable field success by creating security-focused battle cards, PoC guides, and technical objection handling, and demos that resonate with CISOs and architects.

- Drive sales success by serving as the technical resource for strategic deals, supporting RFP responses and security questionnaires, and helping the field articulate our AI and security capabilities to the buyers who scrutinize them most.

- Influence product evolution by translating practitioner feedback and market signals into technical requirements for the Product and Engineering roadmaps.

To be a Technical Product Marketing Manager in JFrog you need...

- 2–3 years of experience in a technical, market-facing role such as Solutions Engineering, Security Research, or Technical Product Management.

- Hands-on experience in AI/ML infrastructure such as model development, building agents, running AI apps, etc.

- Deep technical knowledge of application security such as threat modeling, access governance, software supply chain risk, security controls, and how enterprises evaluate and procure security products.

- Proven ability to produce engaging technical content like architecture briefs, security mappings, and demo scripts.

- Exceptional communication skills with the ability to present and defend technical material to security architects and ML engineers.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

- At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.

- This position has a base salary range between $125,000 to $160,000.  Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.

- This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

- JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!

- JFrog embraces hybrid work: 3 days in office / 2 days remote.

As we continue our expansion in APAC, we're hiring an Account Executive to drive new business across India. This role is based in Singapore, with travel to India required. This role sits within our Upper Mid Market segment, and we're looking to have someone in seat within the next quarter.

This is an Expression of Interest, not a live job posting yet. We're moving quickly to identify the right person, so if this sounds like you, we'd rather hear from you now than after the role goes public.

Who we're looking for

We need a true hunter — someone energized by unproven territory, not someone waiting for warm leads or an established book of business. This means you'll be prospecting into a market where we have little to no brand recognition yet, and turning cold conversations into signed Mid Market logos — often while managing the added complexity of building a business remotely and closing the gap through frequent travel.

You should be someone who gets a charge out of being first — first rep, first customer, first win in a new market — and who's comfortable defining the approach rather than inheriting one. Given our timeline, we're looking for someone who can hit the ground running with minimal ramp time.

What you'll do

- Own the entire sales cycle end-to-end — from first cold outreach to signed contract — with no existing account base to fall back on

- Build the India go-to-market playbook from scratch: territory strategy, prospecting cadence, messaging, positioning

- Generate your own pipeline aggressively — this is a self-sourced, self-hunted number, not a hand-off from marketing or SDRs

- Travel regularly into India to run in-person meetings, build local relationships, and represent the company on the ground

- Run sharp discovery to uncover real business pain in a market that may not yet know our category

- Articulate our value proposition to buyers with no prior context on who we are

- Act as the face of the company for India — building initial brand credibility deal by deal

- Forecast accurately in a market with limited historical data, and hit quota despite the added ambiguity

What we look for

- Proven closing experience in B2B SaaS, specifically within Upper Mid Market, ideally including new-market, new-logo, or greenfield territory building

- A demonstrated track record of winning business without inbound support — true hunter DNA

- Comfort operating with zero playbook, minimal brand awareness, and high ambiguity

- Comfort with a travel-heavy role — willing and able to travel to India on a regular, recurring basis

- Strong discovery, qualification, and objection-handling skills against sophisticated, sometimes skeptical buyers

- Experience selling platform or transformation solutions is a plus

- Fluency in English required

- Entrepreneurial mindset — you think like a founder of your own territory, not an employee inheriting one

- Curiosity, grit, resilience, and genuine hunger for the chase — this role will have real headwinds early on, and we need someone who wants that challenge

- Based in or willing to relocate to Singapore

- Available to start within the next quarter

What happens next

- You submit your expression of interest (about 5 minutes)

- Our Talent team reviews submissions on a rolling basis, given our timeline

- Strong-fit candidates are contacted directly for an initial conversation, ahead of any public posting

- If there's mutual fit, we move quickly into a full interview process, including conversations about your approach to opening new markets

Given the timeline, we'll be moving fast — but we'll always respect your time and won't string you along without real intent to hire.

- Shape product and GTM strategy — bring structured buyer, competitive, and analyst insights into product planning; develop a deep POV on how enterprise IT and revenue operations teams evaluate, adopt, and govern agentic AI; be the team’s expert on how this market is evolving and how enterprises are making platform decisions.

- Designing scalable protections for endpoints, identity, SaaS, and collaboration systems used across a global workforce.

In a market where nearly every product now claims to be “AI-powered,” your job is to establish what makes Gong defensibly different — grounded in a deep understanding of our products and technology, and mapped tightly to the value our customers care about. You’ll have the platform, people, and purpose to make an impact — on our market, our customers, and our brand.

You MUST be located in one of our hub locations (San Francisco, Salt Lake City, Austin, New York City Metro, Chicago) due to our hybrid work model.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Deep Product & Customer Understanding

- Develop deep product and technical fluency. Build a hands-on, first-principles understanding of Gong’s products, AI, ecosystem, and underlying technology so you can tease out the true, defensible differentiation that generic “AI wrappers” can’t replicate. Partner with Product leadership to align roadmaps with customer needs and market trends, and ensure GTM plans are grounded in real product depth.

- Champion the customer POV and value. Immerse yourself in the customer’s world, including pain points, buying journey, and decision criteria, and translate Gong’s product value proposition into quantifiable customer value and business outcomes. Use the customer’s own language, drawn from win-loss analysis, customer interviews, and sales conversations in Gong, as the raw material for positioning and messaging.

Positioning & Differentiation

- Own Gong’s strategic narrative and positioning. Craft clear, differentiated messaging and positioning across the platform, products, and competitive landscape, and codify it in a messaging architecture and assets that the GTM and Marketing teams can carry across every marketing channel.

- Establish true differentiation in a crowded AI market. GTM Execution Support

- Lead product launches that drive growth. Own launch narrative, enablement, and execution across every customer touchpoint so new products and capabilities land with the GTM team and drive customer engagement, adoption, and growth.

- Leverage AI to scale knowledge sharing. Deliver the messaging, playbooks, demos, and more that improve close rates, win rates, and deal velocity, and close the “last-mile” gap between what marketing produces and what reps actually use.

Solution Marketing

- Tailor the value proposition by industry and persona. Develop differentiated value propositions, messaging, use cases, and proof points for Gong's priority industries and buyer personas, translating each segment's specific business challenges into measurable, role-relevant outcomes.

israel.title: Associate General Counsel, Crypto Services
israel.description:
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.

About the Team

The Fireblocks Legal team is a strategic partner across the company, operating at the intersection of law, technology, and financial regulation. We support the development and launch of cutting-edge digital asset products in highly regulated environments, enabling business growth while managing legal and regulatory risk. Working closely with product, engineering, compliance, and senior leadership and C-suite, Legal plays a central role in shaping Fireblocks’ global strategy in the rapidly evolving digital assets ecosystem.

About the Role

As Associate General Counsel, you will serve as a trusted legal advisor to Fireblocks’ product, engineering, and senior leadership and C-suite. You will support the development, launch, and scaling of crypto and financial services products across multiple jurisdictions. This role blends deep regulatory expertise with practical, business-oriented judgment, and requires close collaboration across Legal, Product, Compliance, Risk, and Commercial teams.

You will have a direct impact on product strategy, regulatory readiness, and go-to-market execution, bringing a strong commercial mindset while acting as a strategic partner to senior leadership in a fast-paced, global environment.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as the primary legal advisor to product teams, supporting the design, launch, and scaling of new products and features across global markets

- Identify, assess, and advise on regulatory and legal considerations affecting product design, functionality, distribution, and user experience

- Provide strategic guidance on regulatory readiness, go-to-market planning, and jurisdictional expansion

- Draft, review, and maintain global and localized product terms, disclosures, and other customer-facing legal documentation

- Advise on product positioning, marketing, and platform presentation in light of regulatory, licensing, and consumer protection requirements

- Monitor and interpret global regulatory developments related to digital assets, custody, payments, stablecoins, and financial services, and translate them into actionable business guidance

Required Skills

- Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school and admission to the bar

- 10+ years of legal experience with significant focus on regulated financial technology companies

- Extensive expertise in payments regulation, digital asset custody, and related frameworks

- In-house experience at a fintech or digital asset company

- Track record of successfully launching regulated financial products in multiple jurisdictions

- Exceptional drafting, negotiation, and communication skills

- Ability to thrive in a high-pressure environment with limited resources

- Demonstrated experience working with financial institutions and structuring legal partnerships.

- Familiarity with corporate governance best practices on a global scale.

It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is $202,000 to $312,000. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits.

While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of you deciding to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are.
Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

Welcome to Fireblocks, the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions!

Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Our next-generation multi-layer technology protects Digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale

Here’s the bit about the opportunity:

At Fireblocks, we're replatforming financial services onto a new blockchain-based tech stack. We invite you to be a cornerstone in this journey as our Business Solutions Director for APAC. In this high-impact role, you will join forces with our Enterprise Accounts team to guide leading Payment institutions through transformative digital infrastructure solutions.

You’ll be:

Strategic Consulting & Advisory

- Serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives and business leaders in the Payments sector.

- Collaboratively develop business cases for early-stage digital initiatives, securing executive buy-in for transformative projects in the digital asset space.

- Manage large, cross-organizational business solutions and consulting assignments.

- Partner with our Enterprise Accounts team to close large strategic accounts

Product Strategy

- Interfacing with the Product Strategy and Go-to-Market teams to contribute actionable insights that shape our future product development.

Thought Leadership & Research

- Engaging in groundbreaking market research and thought leadership to bolster Fireblocks’ reputation as an industry innovator.

- Creating internal market research reports and external thought leadership materials to share valuable insights and promote dialogue within the industry.

- Contribute to Fireblocks' intellectual capital through the development of digital asset solution frameworks, tools, and templates

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Fostering close relationships with our business leads, product, sales, marketing, and R&D teams to deliver holistic, best-in-class solutions to our clients.

- Significant experience in top-tier management consulting or financial services, particularly in payments or financial services strategy.

- Proficient in PowerPoint/Google Slides and adept at crafting persuasive executive presentations.

- Exceptional organizational abilities with a track record of managing multiple concurrent projects.

- Passion for client success and driven to optimize business impact.

About the Team

Wallets are no longer limited to crypto-native products, they are becoming foundational infrastructure for payroll, remittances, and global payments. Dynamic powers wallet-based experiences for leading crypto and fintech teams including Kraken, zerohash, Magic Eden, and more.

Dynamic builds and maintains developer-first SDKs that enable teams to seamlessly integrate embedded wallet functionality directly into their applications. These embedded wallets allow end users to create, manage, and use wallets without leaving the product experience, making wallets feel like a native part of modern fintech and crypto apps.

As part of Fireblocks, the Dynamic team continues to build and scale the infrastructure and developer tooling that has onboarded 50M+ wallets across crypto and fintech applications. In this context, Dynamic powers the application-layer wallet experience and developer tooling, complementing Fireblocks’ core custody, security, and transaction infrastructure. The team operates with a strong product mindset and deep focus on security, reliability, scalability, and exceptional developer experience. Engineers at Dynamic build secure-by-default systems and approach their work with a strong customer focus, balancing technical excellence with real-world user needs. You will be joining a passionate group that moves fast, works with the biggest names in payments and fintech, and is defining how the next generation of financial applications are built.

What You’ll Do

- Design and implement high-quality native mobile SDKs that enable developers to integrate embedded wallet functionality into their applications, with a strong focus on API ergonomics, performance, and reliability.

- Own SDK features end-to-end: from API design and architecture, through implementation and testing, to release, versioning, and developer documentation.

- Build and maintain secure, reliable SDK components for wallet operations, including cryptographic operations, blockchain interactions, and security-sensitive flows.

- Define and evolve the SDK architecture to support long-term maintainability, backward compatibility, and adoption across diverse customer applications.

- Build sample applications and demos that showcase SDK capabilities and serve as integration references for customers.

- Create clear, comprehensive SDK documentation and integration guides.

- Work with developer relations and support teams to address customer integration challenges.

- Raise the bar for quality and operational excellence by establishing best practices around testing, observability, releases, and code health.

- Contribute to a culture of ownership and execution, leading by example through hands-on work, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep focus on mobile development and shipping production-grade SDKs.

- Demonstrated track record of building and shipping high-quality code, with work you can point to and discuss in depth.

- Strong hands-on experience with iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin); experience with React Native or other cross-platform frameworks, and familiarity with all.

- Experience building mobile SDKs or shared libraries, including API design, versioning, packaging, and long-term maintenance across platforms.

- Experience with blockchain-enabled mobile systems, including wallet flows, signing, and on-chain interactions.

- Experience working on security-sensitive mobile software, such as key management, secure storage, cryptography, or financial products.

- Strong grasp of mobile engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and observability.

- A get-things-done mindset with the ability to independently own problems and deliver end-to-end solutions.

- Comfortable making long-term architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic and adaptable.

- B.Sc. in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

- Remote role in a distributed team; preference for candidates in the Americas time zone.

Big Advantages

- Rust and/or WebAssembly (Wasm) experience, particularly building cross-platform SDKs consumed by mobile apps.

- Experience designing shared core logic used across iOS and Android.

- Experience with advanced mobile security primitives (secure hardware, MPC, low-level crypto).

- Prior experience owning or founding a mobile platform or SDK from scratch.



For employees hired to work from our NYC HQ, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range is specific to New York City, and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs.

It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is $177,000 to $230,000. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. This is a strategic enterprise sales role for a seasoned seller who knows how to win complex, high-stakes deals. You'll own full-cycle sales into Tier 1, 2, and 3 US banks and financial institutions, building relationships with C-suite executives, navigating multi-threaded buying committees, and closing deals that fundamentally transform how these institutions build with digital assets.

You're selling the future of financial infrastructure. This isn't incremental technology; you're helping banks build their digital asset strategies from the ground up. You'll work with forward-thinking executives who understand that blockchain and digital assets represent a paradigm shift in how financial services will operate over the coming decades. If you're someone who gets energized by problem-solving and building deep strategic relationships, this role will challenge you in the best way. You'll navigate sophisticated stakeholder landscapes, work through rigorous vendor assessments, and ultimately close transformational deals that reshape how banks operate. If you're motivated by big wins that require strategy, persistence, and executive presence, you'll thrive here.

You'll partner with world-class talent. You'll work alongside elite Sales Engineers who can go deep technically, collaborate with a best-in-class marketing and BDR team, and have direct access to our executive team. This is a team-selling environment where everyone is committed to winning together.

What you'll do:

- Own and execute full-cycle sales into US banks and financial institutions

- Build and manage a robust pipeline through strategic prospecting, executive networking, and thoughtful account planning

- Navigate multi-stakeholder sales processes involving Treasury, Custody, Global Markets, Compliance, Legal, Risk, InfoSec, and Technology teams

- Partner with Sales Engineers to deliver compelling technical discovery and demos

- Leverage our partner ecosystem (cloud providers, systems integrators) to accelerate deals and expand your reach

- Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting and represent your business with precision

- Consistently deliver against annual quota

What you bring:

- Enterprise sales mastery. You have 5+ years selling complex SaaS or institutional solutions into banks, financial institutions, or highly regulated industries.

- Deep financial services acumen. You understand how banks work; not just the org chart, but how Treasury, Custody, Payments, and Capital Markets functions operate. You know how to speak the language of banking executives and understand their strategic priorities.

- Hunter DNA. You're energized by prospecting and building your own pipeline. You don't wait for leads to come to you; you identify target accounts, craft strategic outreach, build executive relationships, and create opportunities where others see closed doors.

- Technical curiosity and aptitude. You can learn technical products quickly and translate infrastructure capabilities into business outcomes. You're comfortable partnering with technical teams and holding your own in conversations about security, compliance, and architecture.

- Strategic persistence. You understand that the best deals take time. You know how to maintain momentum through long cycles, navigate setbacks, and keep multiple stakeholders engaged.

- Genuine passion for this market. You're intellectually curious about blockchain, digital assets, and the future of financial services. You don't need to be a crypto native, but you're genuinely excited to be at the forefront of how this technology will reshape banking over the next decade.

Ideal background includes:

- Track record of overachievement (110%+ to quota consistently)

- Experience selling cybersecurity, infrastructure, fintech, or payments solutions

- Familiarity with co-sell motions through technology partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft)

- Experience working with Sales Engineers in technical sales environments

You'll love this role if:

- You're energized by strategic, high-stakes sales where your ability to orchestrate complex deals directly determines your success

- You want significant autonomy to build and execute your territory strategy

- You thrive in team-selling environments where collaboration drives bigger wins

- You're excited to sell cutting-edge technology in an emerging, high-growth market

- You're motivated by building long-term strategic relationships with senior executives

israel.description:

Fireblocks Trust Company (TrustCo) is the regulated, Qualified Custody division within Fireblocks Financial Services. We are seeking a Sales Director – Fireblocks Trust to serve as a dedicated subject-matter expert (SME) embedded within the Fireblocks sales organization. This is an overlay role: rather than owning a standalone book, you will partner with platform account executives to bring Qualified Custody expertise into their deals, helping them win and expand institutional and high-net-worth relationships. You will work closely with TrustCo leadership, sales, partnerships, product, legal and compliance to ensure clients understand and adopt TrustCo’s qualified-custody solution and to drive assets under custody (AUC).

Key Responsibilities

-     Act as the qualified-custody SME embedded with the platform sales team, supporting account executives in advancing and closing deals where custody is a decision driver.

-     Position and sell qualified custody to institutional clients and high-net-worth individuals, including funds, registered investment advisers, exchanges, miners, token issuers, fintechs, and family offices.

-     Educate and consult clients on the value of a qualified custodian — asset segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, TrustCo’s regulatory standing, and on how those protections map to their fiduciary and regulatory obligations.

-     Assist in deal structuring by tailoring custody arrangements to each client’s mandate and risk profile.

-     Support qualified-custody offerings such as staking where clients can earn rewards on assets held in custody, positioning these as a complement to — not a substitute for — the core custody value proposition.

-     Work cross-functionally with product, operations, legal, and compliance to refine custody positioning, support diligence, and ensure seamless onboarding and continued engagement.

-     Provide competitive and market intelligence on custodian offerings, regulatory developments, and client feedback to sharpen TrustCo’s positioning and inform product priorities.

-     Develop sales enablement materials — decks, FAQs, diligence responses, and case studies — that equip the platform sales team to communicate the qualified-custody value proposition with confidence.

-     Track and optimize custody adoption across the pipeline, identifying opportunities to grow AUC and deepen client engagement.

Qualifications

-     Proven track record of supporting and closing institutional sales, ideally in custody, digital assets, crypto, fintech, or financial services.

-     Strong understanding of Qualified Custody and digital assets — including custodial structures, the regulatory framework for custodians, and the obligations of institutional and fiduciary clients.

-     Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex regulatory and custody concepts clearly to sophisticated buyers.

-     Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret pipeline and adoption data and translate it into actionable sales motions.

-     Comfortable operating as an overlay resource in a fast-paced, evolving industry, with a proactive, collaborative, solution-oriented approach.

Nice-to-Have

-     5–7 years of experience in digital asset custody, institutional crypto, or regulated financial services.

-     Familiarity with the regulatory landscape for Qualified Custodians (e.g., NYDFS-chartered trust companies, national trust bank charters, and adviser custody requirements).

-     Existing relationships across institutional and high-net-worth crypto market participants.

How We Work

We operate on a hybrid work model three days per week in-office, enabling our teams to benefit from face-to-face collaboration while maintaining flexibility.
