Staff Engineer, AI Platform

The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways of leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks' platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets, and it's trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.

Founded in 2018 and already valued at over $8 billion, Fireblocks is a SaaS platform that helps companies create innovative products on the blockchain and manage day-to-day crypto operations. We have offices in New York, London, Tel Aviv, and Singapore, and we are continuing to expand our teams to reach new customers globally.

What You'll Do

You'll own our internal AI platform — the shared foundation teams across the company rely on to build and run AI-powered tools securely and at scale. This is a hands-on Staff-level role: you'll architect and write production code, own the roadmap, and keep the platform reliable, secure, and easy to build on as it serves the entire organization.

Beyond the platform itself, you'll help drive an AI mindset across the company — spotting where AI creates real leverage, setting technical direction, and raising the bar for how teams build with it. Doing that well means working like a product owner as much as an engineer: proactively engaging stakeholders across engineering, product, go-to-market, and operations, turning what they need into a clear plan, and communicating it credibly all the way up to the executive level.

What You'll Bring

- Vast, Staff-level engineering experience. A long track record building and running high-scale systems, still deeply hands-on with the code.

- Real AI experience and mindset. Genuine command of how modern AI systems are built — frontier-model APIs, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and the surfaces developers build against, from CLIs to MCP — plus the instinct for where AI creates leverage.

- Product sense and proactive communication. You work like a product owner as much as an engineer — finding stakeholders, shaping what they need into a roadmap, and communicating it clearly from whiteboard to executive level.

- Model routing and gateway experience. You've built or run a gateway that routes inference across providers on cost, latency, capability, and data sensitivity.

- Measuring and improving AI systems. Comfort with unpredictable outputs — telling whether a change helped, catching regressions, and keeping quality, cost, and safety in check.

- Security-first by design. You treat a high security bar as a design principle, not an afterthought — guardrails, least-privilege access, human-in-the-loop escalation, monitoring, and audit for autonomous systems.

- Solid DevOps foundation. Comfortable owning the infra too — cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and IaC — with a healthy security posture.

- Cross-functional influence. You lead through ownership, partnering closely with security, legal, and finance.

Advantages

- Background in a high-trust, regulated environment (fintech, security, or custody) where data sensitivity, auditability, and reliability are first-order concerns.

- A feel for how large organizations work — navigating many stakeholders, competing priorities, and cross-team dependencies to get a platform adopted at scale.

- Experience with digital assets, blockchain, or Web3 — familiarity with the domain Fireblocks operates in.

If you're an experienced engineer and a genuine AI expert who wants to shape how an entire company builds with AI — come and join us.

israel.title: Customer Success Engineer
israel.description:
Location: East Coast, US (Remote)

Big Ideas. Real People.

At Orca, in the right environment and with the right team, talent has no boundaries. This team spirit, together with our drive to always aim high, has quickly earned us unicorn status and turned us into a global cloud security innovation leader. So if you’re ready to join an amazing team of people who inspire each other every day, now is the time to find your place in our pod.

We’re looking for driven and talented people like you to join our CS team and our mission to change the future of cloud security. Ready to dive in and swim with our pod?

Highlights:

- High-growth: Over the past seven years, we’ve consistently achieved milestones that take other companies a decade or more. During this time, we’ve significantly grown our employee base, expanded our customer reach, and rapidly advanced our product capabilities.

- Disruptive innovation: Our founders saw that traditional security didn’t work for the cloud, so they set out to carve a new path. We’re relentless pioneers who invented agentless technology and continue to be the most comprehensive and innovative cloud security company.

- Well-capitalized: With a valuation of $1.8 billion, Orca is a cybersecurity unicorn dominating the cloud security space. We’re backed by an impressive team of investors such as Capital G, ICONIQ, GGV, and SVCI, a syndicate of CISOs who invest their own money after conducting their due diligence.

- Respectful and transparent culture: Our executives pride themselves on being accessible to everyone and believe in sharing knowledge with the employees. Each employee has a place in shaping the future of our industry.

About the Role:

As a Customer Success Engineer for Strategic Accounts, you’ll be the technical quarterback for Orca’s largest and most complex customers. You’ll partner closely with executives, architects, and security teams to ensure they unlock the full value of the Orca Platform, driving adoption, expanding use cases, and shaping long-term cloud security strategies.

You’ll combine deep technical expertise with strategic relationship management, serving as the bridge between our customers and Orca’s product, engineering, and go-to-market teams. From on-site visits to executive workshops, you’ll ensure customers achieve measurable outcomes and see Orca as a critical part of their cloud security transformation.

What You'll Do:

- Serve as the trusted technical advisor for Orca’s most strategic customers.

- Lead customer visits, executive briefings, and technical workshops to accelerate adoption and strengthen relationships.

- Drive deployment, expansion, and operational excellence through architecture reviews and best practice guidance.

- Collaborate with customer stakeholders to align cloud security goals, compliance initiatives, and risk reduction strategies.

- Partner with Customer Success Managers to design and execute tailored success plans tied to business outcomes.

- Identify and remove technical blockers while advocating for customer needs across Product, Support, and Engineering.

- Present platform value and innovation in executive-level business reviews.

- Collaborate with Sales on renewals, expansions, and long-term strategic growth.

- Provide insights and feedback to influence Orca’s product roadmap and customer experience.

What We're Looking For:

- 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (CSE, TAM, Solutions Architect, or DevOps/Security Engineer).

- Proven experience with enterprise cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

- Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong understanding of cloud security architecture and the CNAPP ecosystem.

- Proficiency in scripting, automation, and API integrations.

- Exceptional communication and consulting skills—able to engage both technical teams and C-level executives.

- A passion for helping customers operationalize security at scale and deliver measurable value.

- Bonus: Experience with IaC (Terraform) or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD/CKS).

What We Offer:

- Competitive salary, commission, and equity package.

- Discounted medical, dental, and vision benefits with significant employer contribution.

- Benefits coverage starting on your first day of employment.

- Generous PTO with U.S. holidays observed and flexible hybrid & remote work environments.

- Your choice of Mac or Windows laptop.

- Work-from-home stipend to be used in your first month of employment.

- Monthly reimbursement for cell phone and for home internet.

- The chance to collaborate with a team of talented global colleagues all around the world.

Annual Salary range: $110,000-$130,000 base salary and $30,000-$40,000 performance-based commissions. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

This position is open until filled. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

Orca Security is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

About the Role:

The DevOps Lead (FedRAMP) will own Orca's FedRAMP environment. All of it. The infrastructure, the authorization, and the relationships with the agencies and assessors who depend on it.

This is a builder's role with real authority. You will be the most senior Orca engineer in our federal environment and the person everyone comes to for anything that touches it, from a Terraform change to an agency security review. You will set the technical direction, and you will implement it yourself. Over time you will grow a small US based team around you while keeping your own hands on the system.

The timing is good. FedRAMP is moving to 20x, with machine readable OSCAL packages, Key Security Indicators, and continuous validation replacing point in time assessment. Most companies are treating that as a compliance problem. We want to treat it as an automation problem, and you will be the one who designs how Orca does it.

If you like being the definitive expert on a system that matters, and you want the ownership without giving up the engineering, this is a rare shape of role.

What You'll Do:

Build and operate the federal environment

- Own and evolve Orca's FedRAMP environment in AWS GovCloud, AWS East/West, Azure Government, Azure Commercial, and GCP, including EKS, Terraform, Helm, CI/CD, FIPS validated endpoints, hardened images, secrets management, and centralized logging.

- Write the infrastructure code yourself and set the standards for how it is written.

- Design the automation that makes compliance a byproduct of how the system runs, covering continuous configuration validation, drift detection, evidence collection, and inventory accuracy.

- Decide how new platform capabilities land in the federal environment, and bring them in cleanly.

- Own production health, monitoring, and incident response for the environment.

Own the FedRAMP program

- Run continuous monitoring end to end, including scanning, POA&M, inventory, and reporting.

- Own the authorization artifacts, from the SSP and boundary diagrams through control implementation, and lead their move to OSCAL.

- Assess and categorize changes to the boundary, and own the notification process that goes with them.

- Lead annual assessment and 3PAO engagements, from scoping through evidence to closing findings.

- Be Orca's interface to the FedRAMP PMO, our agency sponsor, and our assessors.

- Track where the program is heading and tell us what it means for us early.

Represent Orca to federal customers

- Be the technical voice of our federal environment in front of agency security teams, prime contractors, and prospects, across security reviews, architecture deep dives, and audit responses.

- Work directly with our federal sales, sales engineering, and customer success teams. You will be in the rooms where a credible technical answer wins the account.

- Translate between an agency ISSO and an R&D team in Tel Aviv, in both directions, so requirements arrive as something buildable.

Who You Are:

- You are hands on today and you want to stay that way. You are writing infrastructure code and operating production systems now, and you would be doing roughly two thirds of that in this role alongside the ownership and customer work.

- Real experience inside a FedRAMP authorized system. You can talk about an authorization boundary, a significant change, or what a 3PAO will ask for, from having done it.

- 5 or more years in DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure, with genuine production ownership.

- Deep AWS experience, including hands on AWS GovCloud and a clear understanding of how it differs from commercial.

- Kubernetes in production. Operating it, debugging it, and upgrading it.

- Terraform and infrastructure as code at scale, 3 or more years.

- Automation in Python or an equivalent language, with an instinct to script what others do by hand.

- Fluency in NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5. You can move between a control and its real technical implementation in either direction.

- Vulnerability management experience in a regulated environment.

- The presence to hold a technical conversation with a federal customer's security team and be the reason they trust the answer. Excellent written and spoken English.

- Based in the United States, with access to the authorized environment subject to our federal personnel screening requirements.

- Comfortable working with an Israel based R&D organization, with meaningful overlap with Israel hours.

Bonus Points:

- Experience with the FedRAMP 20x pathway, OSCAL tooling, or KSI based validation.

- Exposure to DoD IL4 or IL5, StateRAMP, CMMC, or IRAP.

- Experience growing a small infrastructure team.

- Compliance automation tooling such as Xacta, Paramify, RegScale, or Vanta.

- Background at a security product company or with a cloud native security platform.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands on experience.

About the role:

Cloud Security Researcher - Runtime & Threat Research
We're looking for a Cloud Security Researcher to drive runtime threat research for Orca's Cloud Detection and Response (CDR) capabilities - understanding how attackers behave inside live cloud workloads and turning that into detections that protect our customers. As a senior member of the team, you'll also mentor our junior researcher.

On a typical day you'll:

- Research attacker tradecraft against live cloud workloads - compute, containers, Kubernetes, serverless - covering execution, privilege escalation, persistence, lateral movement, and evasion

- Analyze telemetry from AWS CloudTrail, GCP Audit Logs, Azure Activity Logs, and runtime/sensor data to investigate threats and translate findings into detection logic

- Partner with sensor and detection engineers on feasibility, coverage, and signal quality

- Run threat simulations and attack emulation to validate coverage and surface gaps

- Track emerging threats and CVEs across AWS, Azure, and GCP, feeding them into detection priorities

- Produce externally publishable research - blog posts, whitepapers, threat reports - and represent Orca at conferences and webinars

- Mentor our junior researcher in detection engineering, runtime analysis, and research rigor

About you:

- 4+ years in security research, threat research, or detection engineering, ideally in cloud/cloud-native environments

- Strong Linux and cloud infrastructure foundation, with an attacker-oriented mindset

- Deep familiarity with attacker TTPs (MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud/Containers)

- Hands-on experience turning runtime, host, and network security events into detections

- Proficiency in Python (Go a plus)

- Track record of, or clear appetite for, mentoring

- Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly

Nice to have:

- eBPF/runtime sensor experience, Linux kernel internals

- Kubernetes/container, API, or application security background

- Offensive security, red teaming, or vulnerability research experience

- Large-scale telemetry analysis (SQL/Elastic)

- AI/ML-assisted security research experience

At Orca, in the right environment and with the right team, talent has no boundaries. This team spirit, together with our drive to always aim high, has quickly earned us unicorn status and turned us into a global cloud security innovation leader. So if you’re ready to join an amazing team of people who inspire each other every day, now is the time to find your place in our pod.

We’re looking for driven and talented people like you to join our R&D team and our mission to change the future of cloud security. Ready to dive in and swim with our pod?

Highlights:

- High-growth: Over the past seven years, we’ve consistently achieved milestones that take other companies a decade or more. During this time, we’ve significantly grown our employee base, expanded our customer reach, and rapidly advanced our product capabilities.

- Disruptive innovation: Our founders saw that traditional security didn’t work for the cloud, so they set out to carve a new path. We’re relentless pioneers who invented agentless technology and continue to be the most comprehensive and innovative cloud security company.

- Well-capitalized: With a valuation of $1.8 billion, Orca is a cybersecurity unicorn dominating the cloud security space. We’re backed by an impressive team of investors such as Capital G, ICONIQ, GGV, and SVCI, a syndicate of CISOs who invest their own money after conducting their due diligence.

- Respectful and transparent culture: Our executives pride themselves on being accessible to everyone and believe in sharing knowledge with the employees. Each employee has a place in shaping the future of our industry.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the KSPM team at Orca Security, you will join a mission-critical group building and scaling one of the company’s core and fastest-growing security products. Our team enables customers to secure their Kubernetes environments across every major cloud provider, delivering deep visibility into cluster misconfigs, RBAC risk, admission control, compliance drift and container vulnerabilities.

In this role you will design the backend services and data models that discover, onboard, scan, and represent K8s workloads, APIs, and configurations at scale. You will own core services end-to-end, drive architectural improvements and partner with security researchers to turn complex threat vectors into actionable insights.

We are looking for backend engineers who care deeply about software design, cloud-native infrastructure, and container security. This is a high-impact role with real ownership - lead features end-to-end, mentor teammates, and help shape the technical direction of Orca’s KSPM offering.

Our Stack: Python, Go, K8s APIs, K8s ecosystem tooling (OPA/Gatekeeper, admission controllers), Docker & container runtimes, SingleStore, Postgres, Redis, Kafka, SQS, ElasticSearch, AWS, GCP, Azure.

What You'll Do:

- Design & build at scale: Design, implement, and maintain scalable backend services that discover, onboard, scan, and analyze Kubernetes environments across multi-cloud and managed clusters.

- Model K8s security: Map and represent Kubernetes resources as clean data models that surface misconfigurations, exposure risks, and compliance violations.

- Integrate detection engines: Integrate and evolve detection engines for container vulnerabilities, secrets, RBAC risks, misconfigurations, and compliance frameworks.

- Collaborate on research & product: Partner with security researchers and product managers to translate novel findings and complex requirements into impactful features.

- Design for quality: Write clean, well-tested code in Python or Go, with thoughtful abstractions and APIs that keep the system correct and maintainable as it grows.

- Lead & mentor: Lead design discussions and code reviews that uphold high engineering and security standards across the team.

- Own it end-to-end: Own features through their full lifecycle - from technical specification and design through implementation, testing, and release.

What You Bring:

- Education & experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience, with 5+ years of professional software development experience.

- Backend & distributed systems: Strong background building microservices, cloud-native services, and distributed systems that handle large-scale workloads.

- Languages: Solid, hands-on experience with Python or Go.

- Engineering fundamentals: Deep understanding of software design principles, concurrency models, data structures, and algorithms.

- Cloud & containers: Solid familiarity with public cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized workflows (Docker, container runtimes).

- Mindset & ownership: Self-driven and proactive, comfortable taking a complex technical challenge e2e.

- Collaboration & communication: Excellent communicator with a team-first mindset that thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Bonus Points if You Have:

- Kubernetes expertise: Practical experience with Kubernetes internals, API primitives, custom controllers/operators, and managed services (EKS, GKE, AKS).

- Cloud engineering: Experience with major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

- Security domain background: Prior domain knowledge in cloud security, KSPM, CSPM, or vulnerability management.

You'll own and grow executive relationships at C-suite, EVP and SVP—engaging trading desk leads, programmatic heads, and department leadership—to champion Taboola's value and work hand-in-hand with our sales teams to make agencies true believers in performance advertising beyond search and social.

This is a high-impact, externally facing role for someone who thrives on building influential relationships and turning them into measurable business outcomes.

To thrive in this role, you'll need:

- 12+ years of experience in digital advertising at a top-tier technology or media company, with a strong focus on holding company agency development

- Established executive relationships (C-suite, EVP, SVP)at major US agency holding companies and their subsidiaries, spanning multiple practice areas

- Deep knowledge of the agency ecosystem — how holding companies, trading desks, and agency brands operate, plan, and buy media

- A track record of driving revenue growth and business impact through strategic agency partnerships, rather than direct account-level selling

- An ambitious entrepreneurial mindset. A love of building relationships and executing strategy with minimal oversight

- Demonstrated experience negotiating or structuring JBPs, MSAs, or similar enterprise-level commercial agreements

- Comfort with frequent travel (typically 2+ domestic trips per month for 1-2 nights, with occasional longer trips)

Bonus points if you have:

- Experience working closely with programmatic or performance-focused agency buyers at major US holding companies

- Experience repositioning a platform or product that faced a legacy perception challenge in market

How you'll make an impact:

- Own and grow Taboola's relationships with your assigned US agency holding company portfolio, trading desks, and key agency subsidiaries, serving as the primary strategic partner and lead relationship owner

- Map and engage agency organizations at executive level—building relationships across trading desk leadership, programmatic heads, and key decision-makers within your portfolio

- Drive agency enablement through trainings, workshops, and strategic roadshows—educating stakeholders on Taboola's platform capabilities and positioning Taboola as a core partner across the agency ecosystem

- Partner with agencies on cobranded marketing, thought leadership, tentpole activation, and event activations within your portfolio

- Collaborate closely with Taboola's sales teams to connect agency relationships to the right opportunities, helping convert agency enthusiasm into measurable revenue outcomes

- Lead commercial agreements (e.g., trading agreements, incentive structures, rate cards) from concept to signature, where they meaningfully advance strategic partnerships and revenue growth

- Gather market intelligence and relay agency feedback to internal teams — including product, marketing, and GTM — to continuously sharpen Taboola's agency offering

Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Marketing Manager on the Geo Marketing Team in our Beijing or Shenzhen Office, you’ll play a vital role in scaling Taboola and Realize’s brand presence across the China market. You will be the strategic lead for partner engagement and event marketing, transforming complex business goals into high-impact regional initiatives. By bridging the gap between sales needs and innovative marketing execution, you will directly drive lead generation and solidify our position within the dynamic China advertising ecosystem.

To thrive in this role, you’ll need:

- 3+ years of experience leading B2B marketing or event strategies, either within a corporate marketing department or a high-paced agency environment.

- Expertise in the China digital advertising and e-commerce landscape, with a deep understanding of the local agency ecosystem and partner marketing dynamics.

- Native or fluent proficiency in Mandarin and English, featuring the ability to localize global product narratives into impactful Simplified Chinese sales materials and case studies.

- Comprehensive knowledge of multi-channel marketing, specifically in executing offline "tentpole" events (e.g., ChinaJoy, GTC), account-based marketing (ABM), and partner-led initiatives.

- Exceptional project management skills, with the autonomy to lead complex, multi-stakeholder events from logistics to content creation while maintaining strategic alignment.

Bonus points if you have

- A proven track record in Influencer Marketing or KOL management, specifically in leveraging industry voices to build B2B brand authority.

- Experience in "Realize" brand positioning, helping to differentiate our offerings in a highly competitive market through creative and innovative campaigns.

How you’ll make an impact

- Architect China Growth Strategy: Collaborate with Sales Leadership to develop and execute a localized marketing roadmap that maximizes long-term ROI and business growth.

- Drive Advertiser-Centric Joint Events: Lead the strategic planning and end-to-end execution of high-impact joint events with agencies and industry partners. You will own our presence at major summits (e.g., ChinaJoy, GTC) while curating bespoke partner-led initiatives designed to capture advertiser interest and accelerate lead generation.

- Innovate Partner Engagement: Build and maintain strategic relationships with third-party industry partners and KOLs to facilitate high-value co-marketing activities.

- Drive Realize Brand Awareness: Develop creative marketing initiatives, including influencer collaborations, to strengthen the market presence of the Realize brand.

- Cultivate Client Loyalty: Design and execute bespoke customer retention programs, ranging from exclusive client entertainment events to strategic gifting initiatives.

- Adapt Global Insights: Localize and optimize sales presentations, vertical-specific content, and market insights to resonate with the unique needs of the Chinese market.



Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they'll tell you that they've been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They'll also share more about:

- Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; "You can copy anything from another business but you can't copy a company's culture.

- Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.

israel.description:

We have exclusive and long-term partnerships with leading publishers including The Chosun, The JoongAng, and Maekyung Media Group, and our advertisers include major brand names like Samsung, LG, Hyundai Motor Group, and Kakao Pay.

The Role

The Senior Marketing Manager role is a full-time position sitting within the APAC Marketing Team. In this elevated role, you will hold strategic responsibility for both the Korea and Japan markets. While you will not have direct reports, you will act as the strategic lead for Japan, working collaboratively with a Japan Marketing Coordinator who will assist in executing the local strategy you create.

This role requires a candidate who can balance high-level regional planning with hands-on collaboration across different teams, including Korea and Japan Sales, Marketing Operations, Content Marketing, and Design. This position offers the creativity and flexibility to define Taboola’s growth trajectory in two of our most important markets.

Key Responsibilities

- Regional Strategy: Collaborate with Sales leadership in Seoul and Tokyo to develop quarterly marketing strategies and plans for Korea and Japan to drive business growth and maximize long-term ROI.

- Japan Market Oversight: Design the marketing roadmap for Japan and work closely with the Japan Marketing Coordinator to ensure the successful execution of your strategy.

- Budget Management: Build and manage the marketing budgets for both regions, finding resourceful ways to optimize impact and efficiency.

- Event Leadership: Own both sponsored (e.g., Digital Marketing Summit, other industry events) and hosted (e.g., agency roadshows) events across both markets, from coordinating operations to creating impactful content that drives leads.

- Retention & Advocacy: Plan and execute customer retention activities, including high-touch client entertainment events and bespoke gifting strategies.

- Data-Driven Reporting: Translate regional activities into meaningful data and reports using platforms like Salesforce and QlikSense to demonstrate marketing impact.

- PR & Communications: Drive PR efforts in collaboration with local agencies, turning Taboola’s proprietary data into compelling stories for press pick-up in both Korea and Japan.

- Localization: Oversee the localization of global content into Korean and Japanese, ensuring messaging is culturally relevant and fits the specific needs of each market.

- Product Representation: Maintain a deep understanding of Taboola’s product positioning and unique offering to effectively represent the company to diverse external audiences.

Requirements

- Bilingual Skills: Native or fluent in Korean and English. Proficiency in Japanese is a strong plus but not required, as you will be supported by a local coordinator in Japan.

- Experience: 8+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 1+ years in a senior or lead strategic capacity within the AdTech, SaaS, or Digital Media space.

- Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to create comprehensive marketing plans and lead the "dotted-line" execution of those plans through partners or coordinators.

- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Korean and English.

- Problem Solver: Creative self-starter with a solution-oriented mindset and high attention to detail.

- Autonomy: Comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy and managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- Global Collaboration: Experienced in working with remote, international teams and managing stakeholders across different cultures and time zones. Working closely with the sales organisation as their main stakeholder to drive commercial outcomes will be essential.

Working at Taboola gives you the chance to be part of building something unique. We are a company that embraces diversity and change, with enormous potential for growth and that offers a challenging yet collaborative working environment, where you will always feel valued and be given every opportunity to make a name for yourself.

responsible for independently leading product data analytics and proactively guiding business growth

large volume data sets and generating conclusions and actionable recommendations; (2) Developing data

stakeholders including business and product decisions.

The VP of Global Sales Strategy plays the lead role in shaping how Taboola’s Global Sales & Partnerships (GSP) organization drives revenue growth, operates and scales. This leader will be responsible for developing the long-term growth strategy as well as defining the structure, go-to-market approach, and operating model that enables consistent revenue growth across the company’s $2B+ global advertising business.

With increasing adoption of Taboola’s industry-leading performance marketing platform Realize, continued expansion across key international markets (North America, LATAM, EMEA, APAC and Greater China), and a growing portfolio of strategic partnerships (incl., Yahoo, Microsoft, Apple) — this role will direct initiatives to grow Taboola’s enterprise and growth advertiser base and share of wallet, category level GTM strategies, agency partnerships as well as new demand channels to accelerate growth.

Reporting to the Chief Business Officer, the VP, Global Sales & Partnerships Strategy will serve as a key partner to GSP leadership including Global Enterprise Sales, Global Growth Sales, Programmatic and new demand channels as well as Strategic and Publisher Partnerships.  This role will also act as the key liaison to GSP’s business partner teams, including Product Marketing, Product, Professional Services, Marketing, Finance, Corp Dev. This leader will ensure the organization is set up for success through effective coverage models, clear goal-setting, and scalable execution frameworks that drive consistent quarter-over-quarter performance and long-term growth.

The VP, Global Sales Strategy role will be supported by a team of managers and individual contributors, who will be aligned with GSP’s business segments across several core competencies including sales strategy, agency strategy, product, supply & yield strategy, insights and other functions.

To thrive in this role, you'll need:

- 12+ years of progressive experience in sales strategy, revenue strategy, commercial operations, or sales excellence — with deep roots in the ad tech, digital media, or performance advertising industry.

- A verifiable track record of driving material revenue growth through the design and deployment of sales strategy, coverage models, and go-to-market frameworks.

- Proven experience leading managers and senior individual contributors; ability to set direction, develop talent, and deliver impact through a team of high-caliber specialists.

- Fluency in the digital advertising ecosystem — advertiser buying behavior, publisher monetization, programmatic infrastructure, and the open-web performance landscape.

- Exceptional commercial judgment: the ability to size opportunities accurately, prioritize ruthlessly, and make high-quality decisions under uncertainty.

- Strong quantitative and analytical skills — comfortable with revenue modeling, quota math, pipeline analytics, and ROI frameworks.

- Experience driving change across complex, global, matrixed sales organizations — building credibility with senior sellers and regional leaders through substance and track record, not authority alone.

Nice to haves include:

- Prior experience in a strategy consulting or revenue transformation role, with direct application to a sales organization.

- Familiarity with Taboola's competitive landscape: The Trade Desk, Google Display & Video 360, Outbrain, and other open-web performance platforms.

- Experience building or closely partnering with a Revenue Operations function in a high-growth environment.

- MBA or equivalent advanced degree

How you'll make an impact:

As the VP of Global Sales Strategy you will:

- Develop Taboola's long-term global ad sales growth strategy across all demand and supply channels — in close partnership with the CBO and sales leadership, while leading and partnering with regional teams to execute and continuously evolve these strategies across the global org.

- Translate company strategy into annual and quarterly revenue plans, cascading company-level targets into seller-level accountability across teams, regions, and segments.

- Serve as the central point for Sales into the product development roadmap, synthesizing and translating customer needs and business priorities  into product strategy, partnering closely with PMM on roadmap planning and GTM timing.

- Design scalable sales coverage models across advertiser, publisher, and partner lines of business, and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing and Product to define the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), tiering logic, and account prioritization frameworks that ensure the sales organization focuses its time on the highest-value opportunities.

- Build and maintain the sales playbooks, deal frameworks, and incentive structures that guide how the global sales team pursues, advances, and closes business — and champion the adoption of new tools and methodologies that improve seller effectiveness and revenue predictability.

- Partner with Sales Operations to embed pipeline management, forecasting mechanisms, and CRM discipline into daily sales behavior, and own the operating rhythm — weekly pipeline reviews, monthly performance assessments, and quarterly strategic recalibrations — that keeps the organization focused and accountable.

- Oversee and develop Taboola’s supply strategy & yield management competency to shape global demand motions and supply acquisition strategies

- Diagnose performance gaps at the team, region, and segment level and work directly with sales leaders to close them through targeted enablement, process improvements, or structural changes.

- Partner with Product Marketing to ensure sales messaging, positioning, and collateral stay current with Taboola's evolving product portfolio — and that new product launches are met with a sales org that is briefed, enabled, and ready to sell from day one.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to the CBO and regional sales leaders on commercial structure, performance, and growth strategy, while cultivating senior cross-functional partnerships with Finance, Revenue Operations, and Partnerships to ensure strategy translates directly into seller behavior and revenue outcomes.

Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

- Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.

- Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401k matching), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a fully stocked kitchen.

- Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.

- Work with some of the biggest names: Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, and Expedia.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

israel.title: Account Engagement Manager
israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Hybrid

Full-time

We’re looking for a highly motivated Account Engagement Manager based in Mexico City. You will be tasked with enabling SMBs and professional businesses in the region to pay and get paid globally with Payoneer’ s fast, flexible, secure, and low-cost solutions. Your responsibilities will include working with our mid size customers to co-build their growth strategy, increasing market penetration and Payoneer’ s product and services portfolio adaption. You will also be responsible for implementing innovative initiatives for the longtail growth within the leading online verticals in the world. You will be working in a very dynamic, challenging and multidisciplinary environment, very close to Product, Marketing and Operations teams to successfully build and implement our Growth strategy in the region.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high energy and entrepreneur environment. Candidate should possess Account Management experience, as well as outstanding analytical and communicational skills. Project management skills will be a must. Is this you?

What you’ll do:

This role operates in a 1-to-many, outbound-led model, managing a large customer portfolio through a combination of automation, lifecycle triggers, and targeted commercial engagement.

- Manage and grow large pool of existing client relationships of 350 accounts, building long-term partnerships with top and mid-tail customers to identify emerging business needs and opportunities.

- Proactively strengthen and expand relationships to maximize/protect retention, cross-sell, and upsell across the portfolio, increasing customer value and revenue through tailored engagement strategies.

- Design and execute multi-channel strategies to reach large customer segments at the right moment in their lifecycle, creating and qualifying opportunities effectively.

- Own and manage the growth pipeline, from proactive outreach and opportunity creation through deal execution.

- Identify high-potential customers and coordinate the handoff of qualified accounts to up-grade customer success teams.

-  Act as the primary customer advocate, coordinating with internal operational, risk, compliance, and support teams to resolve issues and ensure a seamless customer experience.

- Monitor regional market and competitive trends to inform local execution and customer engagement strategies.

- Continuously provide feedback on product gaps and critical features, influencing the product roadmap in partnership with Product and Marketing teams.

- Be analytical and data-driven, understanding business performance, key drivers, and interdependencies to identify profitable growth opportunities.

- Act entrepreneurially, developing new approaches, processes, or solutions needed to capture identified opportunities.

- Maintain accurate and complete customer information in CRM, ensuring visibility of activity, pipeline, and outcomes.

- Build success stories, case studies, and business reports to showcase impact and support internal and external alignment.

- Lead educational initiatives, including webinars and workshops, to drive ongoing engagement within the portfolio.

- Represent the company externally, driving events, below-the-line activities, industry forums, and ecosystem partnerships to increase awareness and reach.

- Own the end-to-end commercial process, including demos, proposals, negotiations, and closing long-term agreements.

Success in this Role:

Success as a Customer Relations Associate will be measured by:

- Customer Satisfaction: Achieving high satisfaction scores in customer feedback and surveys.

- Revenue Retention: Maintaining and protecting the revenue generated by your assigned portfolio of mid-tier clients.

- Client Engagement: Increasing engagement scores through regular communication, product adoption, and relationship-building activities.

What we’re looking for:

- Bachelor's degree, preferably in business or industrial engineering

- Fluent in English + Spanish

- 2-3 years of experience in a commercial, sales, marketing or customer-facing role, with strong communication, analytical, and relationship-building skills. Strong understanding of the financial services and digital payments ecosystem.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Excellent relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills.

- Proven success working with mid-tier or growth segment clients.

- Data oriented, possesses a high level of attention to detail with strong analytical and business reasoning skills

- Record of accomplishment in meeting and exceeding business targets

- Ability to make decisions in a changing environment, anticipate future needs and drive results

- High level of organization, focus, and ability to work under pressure.

- Strategic thinker with a hands-on, customer-first approach.

- Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, sales, and product teams.

- Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).

- Highly organized, independent, and able to prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment.

Extra Points we need from you:

Experience with CRM platforms like Sales Force and expertise in sales reporting.

- Familiarity with payment industry, ERP; invoicing, reconciliation tools and data-driven platforms.

- Proven track record in working with international clients across diverse industries.

- Experience selling B2B solutions in a highly consultative manner.

- Fluent (Other Portuguese) (written and spoken).

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Location: Buenos Aires, São Paulo

Reports To: SVP Growth, Latin America



Role Summery

As a Partnerships Director – LATAM, you will architect, build, and scale Payoneer’s regional partner ecosystem — with a strong emphasis on aggressive partner acquisition and measurable customer generation through partners.


This is a builder role.

- Identify and secure high-impact strategic partners

- Drive measurable customer acquisition through these partnerships

- Become a recognized industry referent in the markets we operate in

- Lead executive-level negotiations with founders and C-level stakeholders

- Shape ecosystem strategy across key verticals and trade corridors

You will operate at the intersection of Sales, Business Development, Market Development, and Strategic Alliances, with full accountability for performance, pipeline impact, and long-term strategic value creation.



What You’ll Do

1. Partner Acquisition & Ecosystem Expansion

- Identify, prioritize, and close high-value strategic partners across LATAM.

- Build a diversified pipeline including ISPs, marketplaces, logistics, incorporation agencies, BPOs, fintechs, banks, and industry players.

- Structure partnerships that drive both immediate revenue and long-term strategic leverage.

- Represent Payoneer at industry events and ecosystem forums.

2. Revenue & Customer Acquisition Through Partners

- Own acquisition and revenue targets sourced via partnerships.

- Design joint GTM and co-selling strategies.

- Implement full-funnel tracking (Leads → SQL → Wins → Revenue).

- Optimize conversion efficiency and forecast partner contribution to regional growth.

3. Build & Lead a High-Performance Partnerships Organization

- Hire, coach, and develop a top-performing regional team.

- Set clear targets and accountability frameworks tied to revenue impact.

- Design incentive structures that reward customer generation, not just signed agreements.

- Establish strong operating rhythms, pipeline discipline, and forecasting.

- Implement a structured acquisition funnel (Targeting → Negotiation → Activation → Revenue).

- Partner with RevOps to ensure full visibility of performance metrics.

- Elevate commercial excellence and role model Payoneer’s Ways of Working.

4. Executive-Level Negotiation & Strategic Relationship Management

- Lead complex negotiations with strategic partners and C-level stakeholders.

- Structure commercial agreements balancing speed, revenue, and long-term positioning.

- Build executive relationships that unlock scalable growth opportunities.

5. Strategic Market Development

- Identify white spaces, new verticals, and emerging trade corridors.

- Develop ecosystem strategies for priority markets (Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia).

- Act as an industry referent in cross-border commerce and payments.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership & Alignment

- Align closely with Sales, SDRs, Marketing, Product, Compliance, Risk, and Operations to ensure smooth partner activation.

- Work with Revenue Operations to track funnel performance and ROI.

- Contribute ecosystem insights to inform regional strategy and Voice of Customer initiatives.



Who you are

- 10+ years in Business Development, Partnerships, or Sales leadership within fintech, payments, SaaS, ecommerce ecosystems, or cross-border industries.

- Proven track record of aggressive partner acquisition, B2B customer acquisition, revenue delivery, and complex executive-level deal negotiation.

- Proven experience building high-potential teams and leading or collaborating with distributed teams across multiple LATAM markets.

- Strong hunter mentality combined with disciplined pipeline management and data-driven decision making.

- Executive presence, strong professional network across LATAM (highly desirable), and ability to negotiate at C-level.

- Entrepreneurial mindset, comfort operating in ambiguity, and fluency in English and Spanish and/or Portuguese.

- Strong alignment with Payoneer’s Ways of Working: Customer Obsession, Extreme Ownership, Data-Driven Decision Making, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Continuous Improvement, and Bias for Execution.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

We’re looking for an Architect who is a tech-enthusiast with a drive for excellence, and an out-of-the-box mindset to satisfy business needs in a complex payment solution environment.

Location: Gurgaon-India

Hybrid - Full-time

What You’ll Do

- You will be a core member of the Cloud Modernization initiative, a high-impact engineering function responsible for transforming our technology backbone into a modern, cloud-native platform, while also accelerating how we use AI to improve engineering velocity, reliability, and customer outcomes by enabling safe, governed adoption of GenAI, building agentic systems, and embedding AI-assisted capabilities into our platforms and workflows.

- You will operate at the intersection of cloud architecture and enterprise modernization, leading critical initiatives to migrate, modernize, and re-architect legacy platforms into scalable, secure, and highly automated cloud-native systems.

- You will introduce AI-enabled capabilities to solve engineering and business problems by identifying high-value use cases, enabling AI adoption and AI-led development practices across teams, and delivering measurable outcomes.

- You will build and ship agentic systems that can plan, execute, and collaborate with humans safely with robust controls, and help build core AI capabilities to scale adoption.

- You will lead initiatives from a technical front, defining target architectures, establishing modernization patterns, and driving execution across engineering teams. You will design and implement cloud-native solutions, modern infrastructure platforms, and secure cloud environments that can support global-scale workloads.

- This role operates in a mission-driven model, where you will engage with multiple teams to accelerate modernization, unblock critical initiatives, and establish patterns and platforms that can be adopted broadly across the organization.

- You will work closely with architecture, platform, infrastructure, security, and product teams to modernize legacy systems, migrate databases and applications to the cloud, introduce modern DevOps and platform engineering practices, and raise the overall cloud maturity of the organization.

- Your work will directly shape the company’s future cloud platform and engineering velocity.

Who You Are

- You are a seasoned Cloud and Modernization Architect with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. You are comfortable operating in complex enterprise environments and driving large-scale transformation initiatives.

- You also have a strong point of view on practical AI adoption. You can translate real engineering pain points into AI-enabled solutions, select the right patterns and ship systems with strong evaluation, observability, and governance.

- You bring deep expertise across cloud platforms, infrastructure, databases, and DevOps, and can translate legacy architectures into modern, scalable, and cloud-native systems.

- You balance long-term architectural vision with pragmatic execution and understand how to modernize systems safely and incrementally.

- You embrace change and continuously adapt to evolving technologies, architectures, and organizational needs. You are proactive, curious, and comfortable making architectural decisions in ambiguous environments.

- You thrive in cross-team environments and influence teams through technical leadership, clarity, and strong execution.

- You are impact-driven, not territory-driven, and measure success by how effectively you modernize systems, enable teams, and improve the organization’s overall cloud maturity.

Key skills and competencies

- 10+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, or platform engineering

- Deep hands-on experience with public cloud platforms, preferably AWS

- Proven experience leading cloud migration and modernization of enterprise systems

- Strong experience designing cloud architecture including compute, storage, networking, and security

- Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform or CloudFormation

- Experience with cloud networking, VPC design, private connectivity, and secure architectures

- Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Aurora

- Experience with NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, or similar

- Experience with containers and Kubernetes, preferably EKS

- Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices

- Experience modernizing legacy systems into microservices or cloud-native architectures

- Experience with high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery design

- Experience working in enterprise environments with strong security and compliance requirements

- B.S. in computer science or equivalent

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

About Payoneer WFM (Formerly Skuad)

Imagine a world without borders, where businesses can effortlessly hire and manage top talent across the globe. Payoneer WFM, formerly known as Skuad, is making this vision a reality.

As part of Payoneer, a leading NASDAQ-listed global payments platform, we empower businesses to seamlessly hire, onboard, pay, and manage talent worldwide—handling the complexities of international payroll, compliance, and taxation so companies can focus on growth. Payoneer has been revolutionizing cross-border business for over a decade, supporting millions of businesses in 190+ countries with trusted payment and financial solutions.

With the acquisition of Skuad in August 2024, Payoneer expanded its capabilities in global workforce management, strengthening its position in the $6 trillion B2B market. As Payoneer WFM, we continue our mission to democratize global talent while providing businesses with seamless solutions to manage distributed teams.

Role Summary

To achieve our mission to enable remote employment globally, we need to build a world-class product experience backed by our core Payments platform that is seamless, convenient, and reliable for our customers. We face new and exciting challenges every day and need your help to solve them. We are looking for a results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) who is actively seeking new business opportunities, to engage and build relationships with potential customers around the globe.

Note: This is an Australia & New Zealand (ANZ) focused role.

Manila | Hybrid | Full-time

What you’ll do

- Actively seek new business opportunities to engage and build relationships with potential customers globally

- Research, identity, and prospect for new customers, including collecting relevant information about prospects, their companies, industries, and compelling events to facilitate effective and meaningful conversations

- Nurture and qualify leads who have shown interest in our company's product or solution and have already engaged with our company through its marketing channels (inbound sales prospecting)

- Reach out to potential customers who have never engaged with our company's product or solution through cold calling via phone, email, and social media (outbound sales prospecting)

- Present our company to potential prospects, identify their needs, and suggest appropriate products/services.

- Set up quality lead meetings for Account Executives

- Provide Account Executives with detailed notes on prospect interactions and deal insights to ensure the opportunity is understood and the next steps are clearly defined

- Consistently achieve assigned lead generation quotas and performance goals

Who you are

- 0-2 years of experience in Sales or Sales Development roles

- Self-starter with proven success in competitive and results-driven environment

- Ability to articulate value propositions of the product to prospective clients and build relationships

- Passionate about all aspects of lead generation, including cold-calling and social selling

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Experience working in a fast-growth/startup environment is preferred

- Ability to collaborate effectively with all levels of the organization, including sales, marketing, product, and engineering

- Passion for sales and ambition to excel at the highest level

- Prior experience selling to HR Leaders globally is preferred

- Ability to build rapport and relationships with prospects across multiple geographies and cultures

- Willingness to work at flexible timings

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

📍  Bangalore, India

🏢  Enterprise

About the Role

Payoneer's enterprise business spans a large and diverse portfolio of accounts — from a broad base of commercial relationships to a set of deeply integrated strategic partnerships. As that portfolio has grown, so has the need for dedicated program management to keep it running with the rigour it deserves.

This is a program management role at the heart of the enterprise business. You will be responsible for building and running the structures, processes, and operating rhythms that allow two distinct account portfolios to be managed effectively at scale. For the tier 3 enterprise portfolio, that means designing and owning the programs that govern renewals, contract obligations, pricing reviews, commercial risk, and upsell opportunities. For a small set of highly complex strategic accounts, it means establishing the cadence infrastructure, cross-functional coordination and commercial governance that allow those relationships to operate smoothly.

This role suits someone who is energized by building systems and bringing order to complexity. You will work closely with Legal, Finance, Product, Operations, Growth and Compliance, and your impact will be felt directly in the health and predictability of the accounts you manage.

What You Will Own

Tier 3 portfolio program management

- Design and own the program management infrastructure for the tier 3 enterprise portfolio — the systems, processes, and automations that allow the segment to be managed proactively and at scale

- Build and maintain visibility across the full portfolio: renewal timelines, contract obligations, pricing review cycles, commercial risk indicators, and upsell opportunities

- Establish clear processes for intake, triage, and resolution of commercial matters — renewals, amendments, pricing changes, and client-initiated requests — so they are handled consistently and on time

- Identify opportunities to automate or systematize recurring workflows across the portfolio, reducing manual effort and improving response times

- Partner with Legal, Finance, and commercial teams to ensure the right stakeholders are engaged at the right time on contractual and pricing matters

- Spot and surface upsell and optimization opportunities across the portfolio, flagging them to the relevant commercial owners with supporting context

Strategic account program management

- Build and maintain the program management infrastructure for a small portfolio of highly complex strategic accounts — including consolidated trackers, issue logs, and initiative roadmaps for each relationship

- Design and run the operating cadence for each account: monthly health reports, MBRs, QBRs, and executive touchpoints — ensuring meetings are well-prepared, outputs are documented, and actions are tracked to completion

- Maintain a real-time view of all active topics per account, tracking ownership and progress across concurrent workstreams so the account team can focus on the relationship rather than the coordination

- Act as the connective tissue between internal teams (Product, Legal, Finance, Operations) and the account team, ensuring cross-functional commitments are clear, assigned, and delivered

What You Bring

Experience

- 5–8 years in program management, commercial operations, or enterprise account operations — ideally within fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS

- Demonstrated experience building and running programs that manage a portfolio of accounts or initiatives — not reacting to issues one at a time, but designing the systems that surface them in advance

- Experience with commercial workflows: renewals, contract management, pricing reviews, and amendments — comfortable coordinating these end to end across Legal, Finance, and business teams

- Prior experience supporting or working alongside enterprise account teams, with an understanding of how complex customer relationships operate

- Track record of driving cross-functional work to completion through influence rather than authority

Technical skills

- Program and project management: fluent in at least one structured PM tool (Asana, Jira, Monday, Notion, or equivalent) and able to design tracking systems that stakeholders will actually use and trust

- Process design: experience mapping, documenting, and systematizing recurring workflows; comfortable identifying where automation can reduce manual effort

- Data and reporting: proficient in Excel or Google Sheets for portfolio-level tracking; experience building dashboards or status views for commercial or operational audiences

- Commercial literacy: comfortable reading contracts, amendments, and pricing structures at a working level — not as a lawyer, but as someone who understands what matters and knows when to escalate

Capabilities and behaviors

You build systems, not workarounds. When you encounter a recurring problem, your instinct is to design a process that solves it permanently — not manage it manually each time. Structural thinking

You stay ahead of the portfolio, not behind it. You know what is coming before it arrives — renewals, obligations, risks, and opportunities — because you have built the infrastructure to see it. Proactive ownership

You move things forward without being the decision-maker. You drive Legal, Finance, and Product through a process without formal authority, because you are organized, clear on the ask, and consistent on the follow-up. Cross-functional influence

You are clear and precise in how you communicate. You can distill a complex, multi-party situation into a crisp summary for a senior stakeholder or a client-facing update without losing the important detail. Communication clarity



Why This Role, Why Now

Payoneer operates at significant scale — serving enterprise customers across every major geography, with a portfolio that spans hundreds of commercial relationships and a set of deeply integrated strategic partnerships. Program management discipline is what allows a portfolio at that scale to run predictably rather than reactively.



This is a newly created role, which means you will be building the infrastructure rather than inheriting it. The processes you design, the systems you build, and the cadences you establish will define how these portfolios are managed for the long term. That is an unusual opportunity for someone who wants to do more than execute — they want to build.



If you want a role where the scope is real, the mandate is clear, and your fingerprints are on how a major enterprise portfolio operates, this is it.

The Financial Planning and Analysis Manager will serve as a key member of the FP&A GTM team, combining advanced financial modeling, finance business partnering, and hands-on data analytics to influence the strategic direction of the global business. This role will report to our FP&A Senior Manager, in Hong Kong

Are you someone who can turn complex business drivers into advanced financial models, transform raw operational data into reliable datasets, and build dashboards that help leaders act? This role is a unique blend of corporate finance partner, advanced financial modeler, and data analytics builder. You won’t just analyze financial outcomes; you will work hands-on with data pipelines, transform source data into decision-ready datasets, and build the reporting infrastructure needed to drive smarter decisions. You’ll partner closely with our global sales organization, dive deep into meaningful analysis, and help sharpen our financial policies by bridging raw data, business intelligence, and high-level financial strategy

Is this you?

The Payoneers are:

Accountable | Adaptable | Collaborative | Communicative | Fast Learners | Independent | Motivated | Problem Solvers | Resilient | Technically Proficient

For this role you are also:

- A technical & financial hybrid: Possess a business-savvy mindset with the confidence to operate independently, while bringing strong technical capabilities to manipulate data directly from its source.

- Detail-driven and hands-on: Comfortable writing code to get the data you need, while still maintaining a broad, strategic, and global business perspective.

- Strong analytical connector: Able to trace how one business decision or operational metric influences financial results across different global functions.

- Proactive self-starter: Takes initiative, identifies opportunities, and drives automation and efficiency forward.

- Collaborative communicator: Strong interpersonal skills to partner effectively with both non-financial cross-functional teams and core data/engineering teams.

- Able to simplify complexity: Highly capable of translating intricate business models and unstructured data pipelines into clear, actionable financial insights.

What you’ll bring:

- Experience: 7–10 years of relevant experience across FP&A, finance business partnering, advanced financial modeling, and data analytics, ideally within a global public company or high-growth international environment. Experience in fintech, e-commerce, payments, SaaS, marketplaces, or other high-volume transaction businesses is a strong advantage.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

The Opportunity

This is a strategic programs role at the center of Global Sales HQ. You own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic sales initiatives that turn strategy into repeatable, measurable motions across regions — and you are the connective tissue between Sales and Product, between demand generation and closure, and between global standards and on-the-ground execution.

In a matrixed organization where regional heads own their reps and delivery, you own the standard, the operating rhythm, and the cross-functional programs that make the whole sales engine more effective. It is a builder-strategist role: you design the programs, orchestrate the launches, instrument them, and scale what works.

What You'll Own

SALES DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS & STRATEGIC SALES INITIATIVES

- Own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic initiatives that raise the productivity and consistency of the global sales organization, from skills and plays to new sales motions.

- Translate the annual sales strategy into a sequenced program roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.

- Stand up initiatives as time-boxed programs with scale / iterate / kill decision gates, plus the governance rhythm — interlocks, exception desks, QBR cadences — that keeps regions on one standard.

SALES – PRODUCT INTERLOCK

- Own the operating interlock between Sales and Product: a structured, two-way loop that turns field signal into roadmap input and turns roadmap into sales readiness.

- Represent the voice of the field in prioritization, packaging, and pricing discussions, and carry product context back into the field.

- Ensure every material product change lands with the sales org through readiness, positioning, and enablement — nothing ships to market unsold internally.

CAMPAIGNS — DEMAND & CLOSURE ALIGNMENT

- Orchestrate integrated GTM campaigns that align top-of-funnel demand generation with the sales closure motion, so demand converts to pipeline and pipeline to revenue.

- Partner with Marketing and RevOps to define targeting, messaging, and the handoff and follow-up SLAs that connect demand to closure.

- Instrument campaigns end to end (demand → qualified pipeline → closed revenue) and drive continuous, data-led improvement.

NEW PRODUCT INTRODUCTION (NPI) INTO MARKETS

- Own the sales side of new-product introductions: the launch playbook, market-readiness criteria, and sequencing for introducing products into markets, countries, and corridors.

- Coordinate the cross-functional launch (Product, Marketing, Enablement, regional sales) so each introduction has clear ownership, ramp targets, and measurement.

- Define go / no-go gates and post-launch review so the organization scales winners and retires what doesn't land.

COUNTRY & CORRIDOR SALES STRATEGY

- Define where-to-play / how-to-win by country and corridor — grounded in market, revenue, and account data.

- Build and maintain the market and corridor tiering and prioritization that focuses sales investment on the highest-value opportunities.

- Partner with regional Sales heads to translate corridor strategy into coverage, targeting, and sequenced motions on the ground.

What Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months

- A published, sequenced program roadmap tied to the sales strategy, with governance live and adopted across regions.

- A functioning Sales–Product interlock running on a regular cadence, with measurable roadmap and readiness outcomes.

- Integrated demand-to-closure campaigns live, with clean end-to-end metrics leadership uses to steer.

- A repeatable NPI launch model and an active country / corridor sales strategy directing prioritized investment.

What You Bring

REQUIRED

- 8+ years in GTM strategy, sales programs, sales enablement / excellence, or strategic sales initiatives, including running cross-functional programs at scale.

- Proven experience owning a Sales–Product interlock or equivalent alignment between the field and the product roadmap.

- A track record designing and launching go-to-market campaigns that connect demand generation to sales closure.

- Experience leading new-product introductions and / or market and corridor launch strategy.

- Strong analytical foundation — comfortable in the data, building market / corridor prioritization, and instrumenting funnels end to end.

- A record of operating in a matrixed, multi-region organization and driving alignment without direct authority; excellent executive communication.

PREFERRED

- Hands-on fluency with the modern sales stack — Salesforce, Gong, BI / SQL (BigQuery a plus), and campaign tooling.

- Familiarity with corridor-based, multi-currency GTM and with SMB / marketplace / platform segments.

- Experience standing up governance rhythms — interlocks, QBRs, and forecast operating models — across regions.



Fintech / payments experience strongly preferred

- Background in fintech, payments, or cross-border B2B financial services.

- Understanding of how compliance, trust, long sales cycles, and multi-stakeholder buying committees shape GTM in regulated financial services.

- Comfort translating product complexity (multi-currency, FX, working capital, stablecoin rails) into simple, sellable, market-ready motions.

Who You'll Work With

Product, Marketing, RevOps, regional sales heads (EMEA, APAC, LATAM), Sales Enablement & Excellence, Customer Retention & Expansion, and Strategic Accounts. You'll be a core member of the Global Sales HQ leadership team, reporting to the VP of Global Sales.

Why Join

You'll own the programs and cross-functional interlocks that a global sales organization runs on — the layer where strategy, product, demand, and execution meet. You'll build, not just maintain, in a company at the frontier of cross-border payments, with the data, tooling, and executive support to make GTM measurably better across three regions.
