israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

What’s the job?

We are looking for a detail-oriented Comms Builder to join Payoneer’s AI Growth & Business Technology organisation. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role: you will build the operational and transactional communications that keep our customers informed, compliant, and engaged — covering critical moments like compliance notices, risk alerts, account actions, and product updates.

You will work inside Braze, Payoneer’s customer engagement platform, building campaigns and multi-step journeys across email, push, WhatsApp, SMS, and in-app channels. As part of our BizTech Ops team You will partner closely with Life Cycle Marketing team, who define strategy

What You’ll Do

Campaign & Canvas Build

- Build end-to-end campaigns and multi-step Canvas journeys in Braze across email, push, WhatsApp, SMS, and in-app channels.

- Configure message variants, apply entry and exit rules, and set up audience targeting and trigger conditions based on briefs provided by the strategy team.

- Apply Liquid personalization, conditional logic, and Connected Content to create dynamic, compliance-driven messages that respond to user attributes and real-time data.

- Work within approved email base layouts and design templates maintained by the BizTech Ops team.

- Apply and enforce Braze naming conventions, tagging standards, and asset categorization on every campaign and Canvas - mandatory for governance and reporting.

- Work with AI in Braze to ensure efficiency and accuracy.

Data & Audience Validation

- Validate audience segment logic - including include/exclude filters and test vs control splits - before every handoff.

- Confirm segment sizes match expected populations and flag anomalies before build completion.

- Verify all required user attributes are correctly mapped and present in the data layer - including identifiers, locale, product flags, and cohort assignments.

Content Quality & Localisation

- Verify that all copy is approved, Liquid variables render correctly, and fallback values are set for every personalisation token.

- Confirm localisation is complete across all required markets and validate special characters, encoding, and formatting for each locale.

- Run device, dark mode, and RTL rendering checks where applicable before handoff.

- Confirm UTM parameters and tracking links are consistent and correctly formatted.

Handoff & Collaboration

- Complete the full pre-handoff build checklist - covering naming, content, data, rendering, and channel-specific items - before submitting campaigns for QA.

- Respond promptly to QA feedback from BizTech Ops and rework builds in Braze.

- Collaborate with LCM Planners to understand brief intent and translate strategy into accurate Braze builds.

- Flag ambiguities, data issues, or template gaps to the relevant owner early — don’t wait for QA to surface them.

Who You Are

Required

- 2+ year of hands-on experience building customer communications in Braze.

- Braze certificate L3 · Technical Expert + L2 · Mktg Specialist+ L1 · Practitioner

- Practical experience building multi-step journeys or Canvas flows, not just single-send campaigns.

- Working knowledge of Liquid templating for personalization, conditionals, and fallback logic.

- Solid understanding of audience segmentation, entry/exit criteria, and user attribute mapping.

- Experience building across multiple channels - email is the baseline; experience with push, WhatsApp, SMS, or in-app is a strong plus.

- High attention to detail: you complete checklists, follow naming conventions, and catch errors before they reach QA.

- Clear written communication in English - you will work daily with remote colleagues across multiple time zones.

- Ability to manage your own workload, meet deadlines, and flag blockers proactively.

- Working knowledge of subscription management and frequency capping — subscription groups and states - to keep operational and compliance messaging opt-in compliant.

- Familiarity with the Braze data model - standard and custom attributes, custom events, and event properties -and how they drive segmentation and personalization.

Advantage

- Experience specifically with operational, transactional, or compliance-driven communications — not just marketing or promotional messages.

- Familiarity with Connected Content or dynamic content pulled from external APIs or data sources.

- Experience setting up A/B or multivariate test variants within campaigns or Canvases.

- Understanding of email deliverability best practices (sender reputation, suppression lists, bounce handling).

- Background in fintech, payments, or a regulated industry where accuracy and compliance carry real consequences.

- Working knowledge of the Braze REST API and API-triggered campaigns.

- Familiarity with Braze data ingestion and export methods - SDK, Cloud Data Ingestion, and Currents.

- Develop and execute proactive intervention and win-back plays for customers showing signs of disengagement or churn risk.

- Partner with the commercial team to identify and close expansion opportunities (e.g., multi-currency, faster settlement) within the existing customer base, directly contributing to net revenue retention (NRR) growth.



- Customer Service& Experience, Financial Ops Ownership

- Lead and develop the Customer Service team and Financial Ops team of Checkout, ensuring clarity of roles, continuous skill growth, and high engagement.

- Set and monitor FinOps monitoring metrics, service quality standards, SLAs (first response time, resolution rate), and CSAT targets. Drive weekly case reviews and voice-of-customer calibration sessions to continuously raise the bar.

- Identify recurring pain points in the customer journey by analyzing ticket drivers and complaints, then champion cross-functional fixes that improve the end-to-end experience.



- Voice of the Customer & Product Advocacy

- Build a structured, scalable VOC program that transforms raw feedback from tickets, NPS surveys, and customer interviews into actionable insights.

- Produce monthly Voice of the Customer & Product Improvement reports, complete with quantified business impact and clear prioritization recommendations.

- Establish a recurring rhythm with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs, influence roadmaps, and track delivery of committed improvements back to customers, closing the feedback loop.



- 4. Automation & Continuous Improvement

- Lead post-incident retrospectives, ensuring root causes are identified and preventative actions are implemented. Convert lessons learned into permanent improvements in monitoring, processes, or product behavior.

- Strong analytical skills: you are comfortable building simple customer health models, reading operational dashboards, and using data to tell a story and drive decisions.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Principal Mobile Engineer
AI-Native Cloud Platform

Team: Mobile Platform Team

Reports to: Sr. Director of R&D, Cloud Platform

Location: [Gurgaon / Hybrid]

About the role

Payoneer is investing in the next generation of its mobile application: lightweight, high-performance, and designed as a platform that lets product teams contribute features independently while the app remains coherent, fast, and stable as a whole. The host application will provide the common foundations — observability, logging, navigation, identity, networking, feature flags, release tooling, automation — and product teams will plug into it through a clear contribution model.

We are hiring two Principal Mobile Engineers to define and build this foundation alongside the existing mobile team. Together you will own the tech stack decision — native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native or a hybrid — and you will shape the platform every product team at Payoneer ships mobile features on top of. The two-Principal structure gives us the capacity to build the platform properly, and the optionality to specialize one Principal per native platform if we go that route.

What you’ll own

You will own the tech stack decision and the rationale behind it. You will run the evaluation — native (Swift / Kotlin) vs Flutter vs React Native vs hybrid — against real constraints: performance, binary size, hiring market, team contribution model, build and release velocity, long-term maintenance cost. You will make the call jointly with your peer Principal and you will be expected to defend it under scrutiny from engineering, product, and executive leadership.

You will build the host application foundation. The architecture, the module boundaries, the navigation and lifecycle model, the dependency injection approach, the state management patterns, the threading and concurrency model, the network stack, the persistence layer, the observability and logging backbone, the release and rollout machinery, the testing strategy at every level of the pyramid. Every product team’s first impression of mobile at Payoneer will be the abstractions you ship.

You will define the contribution model that product teams use to deliver features into the host app. Module boundaries, public API surface, lifecycle hooks, dependency policy, build and integration patterns, version compatibility, and the developer experience that makes contributing a feature fast and contributing a bad one hard. You will own the standards every contributing team writes against.

You will own performance, binary size, startup time, frame rate, memory, and battery as first-class engineering disciplines with measured budgets and gates. You will own crash-free rate and stability as platform commitments. You will own the CI/CD, signing, release, and rollout pipeline for the app, and the observability that makes a production issue debuggable in minutes rather than days.

You will partner with the Application Foundations Crew and the Cloud Platform Base, DevEx, and Network and Security teams to make sure mobile integrates cleanly with the platform — APIs, events, identity, secrets, automation and the shift-left controls that apply on the mobile side as much as the server side. You will partner with product engineering across the company to bring contributing teams into the platform and keep them productive in it.

What we’re looking for

You have ten or more years of mobile engineering experience and you have built mobile applications from the ground up — not joined them, not iterated on them, but defined the foundation and shipped it to production at scale. You have an honest, scarred view of what mobile platform decisions cost three years after you make them.

You are deeply expert in at least one of iOS or Android, and seriously fluent in the other. On iOS that means Swift, the Swift concurrency model, UIKit and SwiftUI, the Apple toolchain and release process, and the parts of the ecosystem most engineers learn the hard way. On Android that means Kotlin, coroutines and Flow, the Android lifecycle, Jetpack and Compose, Gradle in earnest, RxJava where it still lives, and the same hard-won understanding of the ecosystem.

You understand the cross-platform landscape with the same honesty. You have an opinion on Flutter, KMP, and React Native that goes beyond preference — performance characteristics, ceiling, where each shines, where each fails — and you can defend the recommendation you would make for a fintech app at Payoneer’s scale.

You have built and operated a modular mobile platform before, or something close enough that you understand the trade-offs: how to define module boundaries that survive ten product teams contributing in parallel, how to keep the host app coherent when contributors disagree, how to version a contribution model without breaking everyone, and how to keep the binary lean as the surface grows.

You think in budgets and measurements. You have driven startup time, frame rate, binary size, and crash-free rate as numbers on a dashboard. You understand mobile observability at a level beyond crash reporting, and you have shipped the instrumentation needed to debug productio.

You communicate clearly with engineers, product partners, and executives. You can write a one-page architecture proposal, run an RFC that actually converges, demo what you built so other engineers want to use it, and explain a stack decision to a CPO in language they care about. You handle disagreement well — including with your peer Principal — and you know how to land a joint decision.

Nice to have

Experience integrating AI capabilities into mobile applications — on-device models, conversational and agent UI patterns, latency-sensitive AI features, and the privacy and offline considerations that come with them — is a strong plus, given Payoneer’s AI-native platform direction.

Why this role matters

The mobile app is the surface Payoneer customers touch after Web. The foundation you build will compound for years. You will have unusual scope to define what good looks like for Payoneer, and credibly for the industry, at the point where regulated payments, mobile engineering at scale, and AI-native development converge.

Latin America is one of Payoneer's highest-priority growth regions. We are looking for an exceptional Principal Product Manager to own Payoneer's product strategy for LATAM, the bridge between central Product and the regional go-to-market engine.

Reporting to the Product leadership for the region, you will be the voice of the LATAM customer inside Product and the single product point-of-contact for the LATAM GTM team. You will translate regional strategy into concrete roadmaps and partner deeply with central Product, Engineering, Banking & Treasury, Compliance, Operations, and GTM to grow Payoneer across the region.

This role is ideal for a senior, hands-on product manager with deep cross-border payments expertise who combines market intuition, data fluency, execution excellence, and the ability to drive outcomes through influence across a complex matrix organization.





What you'll do

- Own LATAM product strategy end-to-end and the regional roadmap, prioritizing across a portfolio of initiatives to deliver the greatest impact for the region.

- Translate ambiguous regional customer, regulatory, and GTM needs into clear requirements, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

- Run discovery directly with customers, through interviews and pilots, and convert it into product requirements and pilot decisions.

- Partner hands-on with central Product, Engineering, Banking & Treasury, Compliance, and Operations to make practical build, integrate, and partner calls for regional rails (PIX, SPEI/TEF, virtual accounts, FX, reconciliation).

- Be the single product point-of-contact for LATAM GTM: source pilot customers, coordinate comms, and unblock enablement.

- Use funnel, activation, and revenue data to build the argument for prioritization and defend LATAM priorities inside the central product org.





Who you are

- 7+ years of Product Management experience, the majority in fintech / cross-border payments.

- Deep understanding of money movement: collections, payouts, virtual accounts, FX, reconciliation, and the bank/partner integrations behind them.

- Strong command of LATAM market dynamics: local rails (PIX, SPEI/TEF, boletos), capital controls, and tax/regulatory context (e.g. IOF/IRRF, KYC/AML doc bars), and how they shape product.

- Proven ability to drive outcomes through influence across a matrix (product, banking, compliance, ops, GTM) rather than direct authority.

- Data-driven: comfortable pulling and reasoning over funnel / activation / revenue data to build the case for prioritization (SQL / BI fluency a strong plus).

- A senior individual contributor who can lead complex product domains from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.

- A systems thinker who connects technology, product, regulation, user experience, and business outcomes.

- Able to influence senior stakeholders and technical teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

- Execution-oriented and structured, comfortable moving between strategy, detailed requirements, prioritization, delivery, and GTM.

- Strong executive communication, turning regional complexity into decision-ready narratives.





Advantagious if you have:

- AI product experience

Program Manager, Stablecoin and PAYO Digital Bank

Location: New York/Washington DC/Miami

Position Summary

Cross-border payments are about to be rebuilt. Help us build the version that wins.

Payoneer is building a stablecoin-powered payments platform and a regulated national

trust bank, leveraging new technology to deliver the next generation of payment infrastructure for global commerce.

This role serves as the operating backbone for the initiative, orchestrating product delivery,

go-to-market execution, trust bank launch, and board-level governance into a single

coherent program. The Program Manager will partner with senior leadership to translate

strategy into milestones, milestones into action, and action into outcomes.

This is a high-visibility role for a versatile program manager who can hold complexity across

commercial, product, and regulatory workstreams. If you want a tidy lane, this is not the

role. If you want to help build something that does not yet exist in U.S. financial services,

sitting next to the executive driving it, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Strategy Operations

• Maintain the integrated plan across product, GTM, regulatory, and bank stand-up workstreams

• Establish and run the program's governance model — steering committees, working groups, decision logs, risk registers, and reporting cadences

• Translate strategy into milestones and milestones into weekly action across a cross- functional team

• Drive disciplined prioritization across competing demands on a small, senior team Product Launch

• Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to maintain an integrated roadmap for stablecoin and bank capabilities, including wallet functionality, issuance, custody, reserve management, and cross-border payments use cases.

• Track milestones, dependencies, and launch readiness across discovery, build, pilot, and general availability.

• Run program rituals that keep product delivery synchronized with commercial commitments and regulatory constraints.Go-to-Market Execution

• Drive the program plan for stablecoin GTM including segmentation, pricing, packaging, partnership pipeline, sales enablement, and launch sequencing

• Coordinate across Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Product Marketing to ensure messaging, collateral, training, and commercial readiness are in place ahead of each launch

• Maintain visibility into pipeline, pilots, and early commercial KPIs — surface what is working, what is not, and what needs leadership attention Bank Stand-Up

• Own the integrated plan for PDB across the path to charter approval and opening

• Coordinate workstreams spanning executive hiring, governance and policy buildout, technology and operations readiness, risk and compliance program design, and external advisor management

• Ensure commercial and product plans are sequenced realistically against charter and regulatory dependencies Board & Executive Governance

• Own the operating cadence and content pipeline for PDB board and committee engagement

• Manage agendas, pre-reads, and follow-ups; partner with executive leadership to shape narrative and decisions sought

• Track board commitments and ensure timely, high-quality close-out

• Produce executive-grade communications for CCO, CEO, board, and partner audiences, translating technical, regulatory, and commercial complexity into clear narratives on progress, risk, and decisions needed

Required Qualifications

• 7–10 years of experience spanning consulting, project/program management and operational roles inside a company building something new, with at least 3 years managing complex cross-functional programs across product, commercial, and operational workstreams

• Track record of delivering programs spanning product launches, GTM execution, and operational stand-up in a fast-moving environment

• Strong working knowledge of program management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid) and the judgment to apply the right approach for the work• Excellent written and verbal communication skills — equally comfortable with a board pre-read and a one-page exec update, including experience preparing executive and board-level materials

• Proficiency with program management and collaboration tooling (Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalents)

• Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, finance, or a related field

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, or another regulated industry

• Exposure to digital assets, stablecoins, or cross-border payments

• Prior experience supporting board or committee operations

• PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent certification

• MBA or advanced degree in a relevant field

• Experience supporting a new business, product line, or regulated entity stand-up

Who You Are

• Structured thinker who moves fast and documents well — comfortable holding both the long arc of the program and the details of next week

• Executive presence and ability to influence without formal authority across product, commercial, and regulatory stakeholders

• Commercial instincts paired with operational rigor — you spot the real issue and track it to resolution

• Moves fluidly between strategy and execution, between a board pre-read and a sprint review

• Bias to action balanced with the discipline a regulated initiative demands

• No ego about the work — willing to do what the program needs

Why This Role

• Stablecoin is a strategic priority at Payoneer and next chapter in cross-border payments.

• The Program Manager will work directly with the Chief Commercial Officer and the broader executive team, with end-to-end visibility from product and GTM through bank stand-up and board engagement, and a meaningful seat in shaping how the program comes to market.

About the Role

This is a hybrid, hands-on leadership role that sits at the intersection of strategic quality ownership and technical depth. You will own the go/no-go decision for production releases, lead quality strategy for complex, cross-team features, and build AI-assisted workflows that transform how your team works.

Equal parts: 50% Strategic Leadership and 50% Hands-on Technical

What You Will Own

- Quality Gatekeeping: Make the go/no-go decision for production releases. Assess quality readiness, test execution status, and risk posture. Communicate your recommendation clearly to stakeholders. Own the decision under pressure.

- End-to-End Quality Strategy: Lead quality planning for large, multi-team features—from design review through production validation. Define test scope, coverage models, risk areas, quality KPIs, and rollout strategies. Influence product design and system architecture from a testability perspective.

- Hands-on Testing & Technical Investigation: Execute E2E, regression, exploratory, and API testing across web applications, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Use SQL for defect investigation, data validation, and production analysis. Debug complex interactions between microservices in a fintech environment.

- Test Plan Review & AI Audit: Review and approve developer-written test plans; ensure comprehensive coverage across positive, negative, edge, integration, and failure scenarios. Audit AI-generated test coverage and correct it when it misses business logic or fintech-specific risks.

- AI-Assisted Workflow Building: Use AI daily to accelerate test design, scenario generation, defect triage, and regression scoping. Build repeatable QA workflows and automations with AI assistance. Establish when AI-generated coverage is sufficient and when it needs human review.

- Mentorship & Quality Culture: Elevate the testing and quality mindset across engineering teams. Mentor QA engineers and developers on testing strategy, automation, and quality best practices. Standardize QA methodologies, tools, and processes across teams.

- Production Monitoring & Multi-Region Validation: Own post-production quality validation and monitor for unexpected behaviors or regressions. Understand how product variations, regional regulations, and local infrastructure affect quality. Plan testing for features that must comply with RBI, GST, FEMA, and other India-specific requirements.

- What You Bring

Required (6+ Years of QA/Quality Engineering Experience)

Core Competencies

- Minimum 5+ years of QA/Quality Engineering experience, with meaningful experience as a QA Lead, Senior QA Engineer, or Test Manager.

- Hands-on testing expertise in E2E, regression, exploratory, and API testing across web applications, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

- Strong SQL skills: You use SQL for defect investigation, data validation, and production analysis—not just basic queries.

- Production release experience: You have made go/no-go decisions under pressure and owned those decisions.

- Tool proficiency: Postman, Swagger, mock tools, and test management systems (TestRail, Jira, etc.).

- Agile & CI/CD: Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint cycles, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Post-production monitoring: You validate quality after features go live and know how to identify issues using production data.

AI & Automation

- Daily AI tool usage: You use AI to accelerate test design, scenario generation, and regression scoping. You have sound judgment on when AI-generated coverage is sufficient and when it requires human review.

- AI-assisted workflow building: You have built repeatable QA workflows and automations using AI—not just one-off prompts.

Communication & Leadership

- Clear communication in English: You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, both locally and globally.

- Business acumen: You communicate in terms of risk and business impact, not just test metrics.

- Collaboration: You work effectively across teams and influence without formal authority.

Nice to Have

- Automation framework experience (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, etc.)

- Cloud infrastructure knowledge (AWS, GCP, Azure)

- MongoDB and RabbitMQ / Kafka experience

- Fintech, payments, or regulated environment experience

- Understanding of Indian regulatory requirements (RBI, FEMA, GST implications for fintech)

- Multi-region product deployment experience

- Certifications (ISTQB, QAI) — valued but not require

Sanctions Investigations Analyst

We're looking for a Sanctions Investigations Analyst to join Payoneer's Global Sanctions and Screening team ("GSS"). In this role, you will support the review and investigation of sanctions-related alerts, escalations, and other potentially high-risk matters under the guidance of the Sanctions Compliance Investigations Lead. You will help strengthen Payoneer's global sanctions compliance framework through timely research, accurate analysis, and clear, audit-ready documentation.

GSS supports compliance with sanctions requirements administered by the U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI), the European Union, and other relevant sanctions authorities globally.

This role is ideal for an analytical and detail-oriented professional seeking to develop deeper expertise in sanctions compliance and financial crime investigations. You will work within established procedures, collaborate with colleagues across Compliance, Operations, business, and technology teams, and escalate matters requiring senior review or judgment.

Responsibilities

• Review and investigate sanctions alerts, escalations, and other potentially high-risk matters in accordance with established procedures and under appropriate supervision.

• Conduct research on customers, counterparties, transactions, ownership structures, and related parties to identify relevant facts and potential sanctions risk indicators.

• Analyze available information, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and make appropriate requests for additional information to support case resolution.

• Document investigative steps, factual findings, and supporting rationale clearly, accurately, and in an audit-ready manner.

• Prepare concise case summaries and proposed dispositions for review by the Sanctions Compliance Investigations Lead or other senior team members.

• Promptly escalate potential sanctions concerns, complex ownership structures, ambiguous findings, and matters outside established procedures.

• Collaborate with Compliance, Operations, business, and technology teams to obtain information and support timely case resolution.

• Manage assigned cases and priorities while meeting applicable service-level, quality, and recordkeeping expectations.

• Support reporting, trend analysis, quality assurance reviews, and process improvement initiatives, as requested.

• Stay informed of relevant sanctions developments, regulatory changes, and internal policy and procedural updates.

Qualifications

• 1-3 years of experience in sanctions compliance, financial crime compliance, investigations, KYC, AML, risk management, or a related field.

• Experience reviewing alerts, conducting research, and documenting investigative findings in a regulated environment is preferred.

• Working knowledge of sanctions regulations and regimes, particularly U.S. (OFAC), EU, and UK sanctions frameworks.

• Strong analytical and research skills, including the ability to assess customer, transactional, ownership, and related-party information.

• Sound judgment and the ability to recognize when a matter requires escalation or further guidance.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize facts and document findings accurately.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple assigned priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn new systems and investigative tools quickly.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Hybrid

Full-time

We are looking for a Senior Content Manager to be responsible for the regional content strategy in the LATAM region for Payoneer. This position is hybrid from Buenos Aires, Argentina and will report into the Senior Director of Regional Marketing.

What you'll do:

- Own the regional content strategy — and defend it commercially. Define how content builds awareness, positioning and pipeline across personas and markets. Connect content output to business KPIs — not just impressions, but pipeline contribution, activation rates and retention signals in priority countries (Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile)

- Write and produce content that converts. Blogs, thought-leadership, web and landing-page copy, campaign assets, email nurtures, testimonials, case studies and social. The bar is quality and business impact — not volume.

- Build positioning that addresses real LATAM pain points. SMBs, freelancers and marketplace sellers in the region face FX volatility, USD access constraints, cross-border payment friction and informal economy dynamics. Your positioning and messaging should speak to these realities — not just translate global

- Lead localization as a revenue lever, not a compliance task. Adapt web, blog, email, campaign, product and registration content into Spanish and Portuguese so it reads natively — and converts. Flag funnel drop-off points where content quality is costing activation or onboarding rates.

- Drive awareness and search visibility in a competitive landscape. Run SEO/AEO strategies adapted to LATAM search behavior (Spanish and Portuguese queries diverge more than most assume). Build earned media presence — local fintech press, business media, influencer relationships — to earn trust in markets where brand awareness is still developing.

- Manage the agency and partner ecosystem. Brief, coordinate, monitor and QA content, PR and social agencies across markets. Hold them to outcomes, not just outputs — delivery against brief and measurable channel performance.

- Be the intelligence layer between LATAM and global. Surface local trends, competitive moves, regulatory shifts and ICP behavior to central teams. Ensure global campaigns land with regional relevance — and push back when they don't.

- Navigate economic volatility without losing momentum. In markets with high inflation, currency controls or macro uncertainty (Argentina, Brazil), adapt content cadence, messaging tone and channel mix in response to business conditions. Know when to lean in and when to pause.

- Track, learn and optimize with discipline. Own a content performance dashboard. Report on what's working, what isn't and what you're changing — not just outputs.

Who you are:

- 6+ years in content, editorial or growth marketing with multi-market scope — ideally in B2B fintech, payments, SaaS or professional services targeting SMBs or freelancers.

- An exceptional writer and editor in Spanish and English. You write for outcomes — not for content calendars. Portuguese is a meaningful advantage in this role, not a bonus.

- Strong positioning instincts in complex B2B landscapes. You know the difference between translating copy and building narrative from local insight.

- Fluent in localization as a discipline — not just translation, but cultural adaptation, regulatory language, and market-specific tone calibration across Spanish-speaking markets and Brazil.

- Comfortable connecting content to commercial outcomes. You can map content to pipeline stages, onboarding drop-off and activation metrics — and use that data to prioritize.

- Experienced managing agencies across markets and holding them to performance, not just delivery.

- Strong project manager: organized, deadline-driven, able to juggle multiple priorities across a cross-functional, distributed team.

- Familiar with the LATAM business and fintech landscape — awareness of key players, local media, regulatory context, and the economic realities your ICPs face day-to-day.

Not a must, but a great advantage:

- Native or near-native Portuguese with editorial experience in Brazilian markets.

- Established network across LATAM media, fintech influencers, agencies and vendors.

- Hands-on experience with WordPress, localization tooling (Phrase, Lokalise or similar) and Salesforce.

- Working knowledge of HTML and UI/UX fundamentals — enough to QA content in product flows without a developer.

- Experience with AI-assisted content workflows (LLM-assisted drafting, translation QA, content repurposing at scale).

Experience

6 to 10+ years in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, enterprise platforms, or adjacent global infrastructure products

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Copywriter who can shape how Payoneer communicates its value across a complex, multi-product platform that serves SMBs, enterprises, marketplaces, platforms, and global workforces.

This is a senior, high-judgment role. You will not be writing at volume. You will be expected to bring clarity to complexity, make strategic tradeoffs in messaging, and help users understand Payoneer’s value within seconds.

You will work closely with Product Marketing, Web, Growth, Design, Analytics, Legal and senior stakeholders to define how Payoneer sounds across its most critical website surfaces.

If you enjoy turning global payments, pricing models, compliance workflows, and platform capabilities into sharp, confident, human messaging, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Website and Platform Messaging

- Own and evolve core website messaging across homepage, product pages, corridor pages, pricing, and conversion flows

- Translate complex fintech and payments workflows into clear, benefit-led narratives without oversimplifying

- Help users quickly understand what Payoneer does, who it is for, and why it is different

Product Positioning and ICP Clarity

- Partner with Product Marketing to define positioning for Payoneer’s key offerings including global payments, Workforce Management, mass payouts, merchant services, and platform solutions

- Tailor messaging for different ICPs such as SMBs, enterprises, platforms, marketplaces, and finance leaders

- Ensure clarity across regions and hiring or payment corridors

Conversion and CRO-Led Copy

- Write and refine homepage narratives, hero copy, section hierarchy, and CTAs with conversion intent

- Balance trust, credibility, and conversion without sounding salesy or generic

- Collaborate with CRO and analytics teams to iterate copy based on real user behavior

Launches and Website-Led Campaigns

- Lead website copy for product launches, feature releases, and pricing or packaging updates

- Write landing pages, supporting email copy, and sales narratives aligned to GTM priorities

- Ensure consistency across website, campaigns, and sales surfaces

Brand Voice and Thought Leadership

- Help shape Payoneer’s brand voice for senior decision-makers including CFOs, founders, and operations leaders

- Support executive thought leadership, long-form content, and strategic narratives when required

- Act as a guardian of tone, clarity, and credibility across website content

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with designers so copy and visual hierarchy function as one system

- Partner with sales, customer success, and regional teams to reflect real objections, proof points, and use cases

- Review and elevate copy written by other teams when it impacts the website

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have

- Proven experience writing for B2B SaaS or fintech products with complex workflows

- Strong understanding of SaaS and fintech buying journeys and decision-maker psychology

- Ability to write crisp conversion copy and long-form explanatory content with equal confidence

- Experience working closely with designers, product marketers, and senior stakeholders

- Exceptional clarity of thought and structured writing skills

Nice to Have

- Experience with payments, payroll, global hiring, compliance, or financial infrastructure products

- Exposure to CRO, experimentation, or SEO for large-scale websites

- Experience mentoring or reviewing work of junior writers

- Stakeholders trust you with high-visibility, high-impact website narratives

About the Role:

We’re looking for a team player with excellent interpersonal skills & service oriented. Creative & out of the box thinker. An autodidact, quick, effective and versatile who’s able to change directions in midstream. Independent & Accountable.

What you’ll be spending your time on

- Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines for the company's products

- Building and maintaining high-performance, fault tolerant, scalable ALM system, from Version control, Builds and Deployments to Monitoring and configuration management

- Maintain the application layer of our public cloud and private cloud

About Payoneer

Role summary -

Payoneer is looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to lead paid acquisition across multiple regions and markets. Based in the Bangalore, this person will work closely with regional marketing, sales, web, analytics, product marketing, lifecycle, and external partners to drive high-quality acquisition and measurable revenue growth.

This is a hands-on strategic role for someone who understands how to manage paid campaigns at scale, but also knows how to connect media performance to business outcomes. The right candidate should be comfortable going deep into campaign data, reading funnel performance, identifying where spend is working or not working, and clearly articulating the impact on CAC, ROAS, registrations, approvals, FFT, and revenue.

We are looking for someone with strong performance marketing experience across both agency and client-side environments, preferably within fintech, banking, payments, SaaS, or another performance-led business.

What you’ll do

Paid Acquisition Strategy & Execution

- Lead the planning, execution, and optimization of paid acquisition campaigns across global and regional markets.

- Manage campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, programmatic/display, Performance Max, Demand Gen, and relevant local channels.

- Build market-level campaign strategies aligned to business goals, ICP/TICP segments, funnel quality, and revenue targets.

- Partner with regional marketing teams to define campaign priorities, budgets, audiences, messaging, and testing plans.

- Ensure campaigns are optimized not only for registrations, but for quality outcomes such as company registrations, A-leads, approvals, FFT, and revenue.

Performance, CAC & ROAS Management

- Analyze campaign performance across markets, channels, audiences, cohorts, and funnel stages.

- Track and improve key metrics including cost per registration, cost per approval, cost per FFT, CAC, ROAS, payback, and revenue contribution.

- Turn campaign data into clear insights, recommendations, and action plans.

- Identify inefficient spend, funnel leakage, and opportunities to improve quality or scale.

- Prepare performance updates and business narratives for senior stakeholders.

Funnel Quality & Conversion

- Work with web, analytics, lifecycle, and sales teams to improve conversion from click to registration, approval, FFT, and revenue.

- Improve traffic and lead quality by using first-party data, lead scoring, ICP/TICP signals, and platform optimization.

- Partner with web/CRO teams on landing pages, user journeys, messaging, and conversion experiments.

- Collaborate with lifecycle and CRM teams to improve nurture journeys for paid leads.

- Support testing across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, landing pages, and conversion signals.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

- Act as a key performance marketing partner for regional teams across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and other priority markets.

- Balance global best practices with local market needs and opportunities.

- Work closely with sales and onboarding teams to improve lead follow-up, activation, and FFT outcomes.

- Manage agency, vendor, and platform relationships where required.

- Ensure clear reporting, governance, and accountability across all paid acquisition activity.

Data, Measurement & Budget Ownership

- Work with analytics, BI, and marketing operations teams to improve tracking, attribution, reporting, and data quality.

- Ensure campaign setup, tagging, conversion tracking, and reporting are accurate and consistent.

- Use offline conversion data, CDP audiences, lead scoring, and value-based bidding to improve campaign outcomes.

- Manage paid media budgets and recommend shifts based on performance, CAC efficiency, and revenue potential.

- Build business cases for new market tests, platform expansion, and additional investment.

Who you are

- 10+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital acquisition, or paid media.

- Experience across both agency and client-side environments is strongly preferred.

- Experience in fintech, banking, payments, SaaS, B2B, or high-consideration acquisition businesses is preferred.

- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen, programmatic/display, and related platforms.

- Strong understanding of full-funnel acquisition metrics including registrations, qualified leads, approvals, FFT, CAC, ROAS, payback, and revenue.

- Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to read campaign data and translate it into business action.

- Strong commercial mindset and ability to connect media investment to business growth.

- Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, attribution, and BI platforms.

- Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to work across regions and functions.

- Clear communication style, with the ability to present performance insights to both technical and senior business audiences.

- High ownership, strong attention to detail, and ability to operate in a fast-moving global environment.

What Success Looks Like

- Growth in high-quality paid acquisition across priority markets.

- Improved contribution of A-leads, company registrations, approvals, FFT, and revenue from paid channels.

- Stronger CAC and ROAS performance across markets and campaigns.

- Better use of data, lead scoring, and first-party signals in campaign optimization.

- Improved collaboration between paid media, web, lifecycle, sales, and onboarding teams.

- Clearer reporting, stronger governance, and more confident investment decisions.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a strong performance marketer with a commercial mindset. They should be hands-on enough to understand campaign setup and optimization, but senior enough to step back, read the business impact, and guide the right investment decisions.

They should be analytical, collaborative, and comfortable working across multiple regions, stakeholders, and priorities. Most importantly, they should be able to help Payoneer build a more scalable, efficient, and revenue-focused paid acquisition engine globally.

We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

The Role

Make every Payoneer capability accessible programmatically — through self-serve APIs and AI-native MCP interfaces — so customers and their AI agents can work with Payoneer wherever they operate, without opening the app.

This is a new, high-ownership area with no prior product owner — strategy, vision, and roadmap are yours to define. Payoneer already exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks, capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. As Senior Product Manager, Platform Integrations, you’ll own the strategy to close that gap, turn API access into a growth and retention lever, and take our MCP / AI-native layer from proof-of-concept to production. You’ll work across Product, R&D, Risk, Security, Legal, and GTM, and report into the Platform Product leadership team.

What you’ll do

- Take the MCP to production. Take Payoneer’s MCP work from proof-of-concept to production – exposing capabilities such as balance, transactions, payouts, and FX as tools that AI agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) can call. Partner with Account Security and Core Foundations on auth, governance, and a secure read-first rollout.

- Turn API access into a growth lever. Payoneer exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks — capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. Own the strategy to close that gap end-to-end, with self-serve onboarding, developer experience, and API governance as the execution threads.

- Turn demand into a roadmap. Synthesize signals from CSM, Sales, and regional GTM teams (EMEA, LATAM, APAC) into a prioritized, evidence-backed roadmap, and prove the business case – including the retention impact of API-integrated customers.

- Lead cross-functionally. Coordinate Risk (eligibility), Security (MCP/API risk model), Legal (data sharing and LLM integrations), Pricing, and Engineering to unblock launches and land outcomes, not just features.

Who you are

- 6+ years in product management, including significant experience owning API, platform, developer-facing, or integration products.

- Strong technical fluency: comfortable discussing REST APIs, webhooks/events, authentication (OAuth), SDKs, and integration architecture directly with engineers.

- Proven ability to take an ambiguous, unowned area and create clarity – strategy, roadmap, and shipped product – with a high degree of independence.

- Track record of building self-serve or developer experiences, and of driving measurable adoption and time-to-value improvements.

- Excellent cross-functional leadership: you align Risk, Security, Legal, GTM, and Engineering around shared outcomes and keep them moving.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; you frame decisions with data and are comfortable defining metrics where none exist.

- Fluent English, written and verbal. Based in India with the ability to work in a hybrid model and collaborate across global time zones.

What could set you apart

- Hands-on exposure to AI-native interfaces – Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tooling, or LLM integrations – and a point of view on where agent-driven finance is heading.

- Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated environment, and fluency working within compliance, risk, and security constraints.

- Familiarity with API aggregators and ERP/accounting ecosystems (e.g. Codat, Rutter, Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite).

- Experience productizing an existing internal API surface – governance, standardization, and developer adoption at scale.

- A builder’s bias: you’ve turned a first customer or first use case into a repeatable, scalable product.

About Payoneer

Role Summary

As a Senior Tax Manager at Payoneer, you will play a key role in overseeing the company’s global tax compliance and reporting obligations across a multi-jurisdictional environment. You will support Finance, Accounting, Legal, and external advisors by ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant tax reporting. You will act as a strong tax partner, owning tax provision and compliance processes while providing guidance on risk management, planning, and process improvements.



What You’ll Do

- Lead the worldwide income tax provision process (quarterly and annually) in accordance with ASC 740, including ETR analysis, deferred tax calculations, uncertain tax positions, and financial statement disclosures.

- Maintain controls documentation in compliance with SOX requirements.

- Partner with Accounting and FP&A teams to understand financial results, forecasts, and key drivers impacting the tax provision.

- Prepare and review technical tax memoranda related to tax positions and reserves (FIN 48 / FAS 5), including monitoring changes in tax law.

- Manage the accurate and timely filing of U.S. federal, state, and local income tax returns, coordinating with internal stakeholders and external advisors.

- Oversee transfer pricing documentation updates and collaborate with internal teams and external advisors.

- Support Pillar 2 / global minimum tax analysis and implementation.

- Coordinate Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) requirements with internal stakeholders and external advisors.

- Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams (Finance, Legal) and external advisors on tax compliance and reporting matters.

- Support local controllers with country-specific income tax compliance as needed.

- Drive continuous improvement of tax provision and compliance processes, including documentation, templates, and timelines.

- Mentor and review work prepared by junior team members where applicable.



Who You Are

- You have 7+ years of progressive tax experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or top national firm) and/or multinational corporate tax.

- CPA certification is required; MST or equivalent advanced degree is preferred.

- Strong expertise in ASC 740 tax accounting and U.S. international tax; public company experience is preferred.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

Role Summary



Location: London

Hybrid

Full-Time



The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.



What You'll Do



- Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers.

- Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound — direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them.

- Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact.

- Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer.

- Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation.

- Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) — maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential.

- Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology — Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification — to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals.

- Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed.

- Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.

- Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.





Who You Are

- 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.

- Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.

- Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.

- Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.

- Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.

- Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.

- Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.



Preferred

- Background in payments, fintech, banking, treasury, FX, or cross-border commerce.

- Track record of competitive displacement against incumbent banks or specialist fintechs.

- Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.

- Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).

- Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).

- Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).

You'll work on highly available, distributed systems that serve millions of customers across 190+ markets, partnering with engineering teams to deliver shared frameworks, libraries, and cloud-native services. This is a role for someone who genuinely loves technology, is energized by AI's impact on how we build software and wants to shape the foundation that the rest of engineering builds on.

Location: Gurugram, India Hybrid

What you’ll do

- Provide technical leadership and architectural direction for backend systems serving Payoneer scale, scalability, performance, security, reliability, and cost.

- Lead by example in hands-on development, own critical code paths, tackle the hardest problems, and set the standard for code quality on the team.

- Own technical design decisions for your domain, lead design reviews, author and review ADRs/RFCs, and design data models and high-performance access layers across SQL and NoSQL stores with explicit attention to schema evolution, query patterns, and scale.

- Partner across Product, Architecture, Security, SRE, and DevOps to define APIs, contracts, and shared platform capabilities that other engineering teams depend on every day.

- Own backend reliability and performance outcomes, define and uphold SLOs, lead incident response on critical paths, treat observability as a design property (golden signals, structured logging, tracing, actionable alerts), and drive measurable improvements in latency, error-budget burn, and infrastructure cost.

- Champion a security-first and compliance-aware engineering posture, PCI DSS, PII handling, multi-tenant isolation, secrets management, and secure-by-default patterns are non-negotiable.

- Set and uphold the organisation's standards for AI-assisted development, context engineering, prompt and instruction patterns, AI code review protocols, and safe-use boundaries (what can be AI-generated, what requires human design, what must never leave our boundary, and how AI-assisted changes are reviewed, attributed, and audited).

- Own and evolve the internal AI tooling playbook, Cursor IDE, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and the next wave, including evaluation of emerging AI coding tools with adoption recommendations grounded in measured trade-offs across developer velocity, code quality, security posture, cost, and lock-in risk.

- Measure the impact of AI-augmented engineering, establish baselines and track outcomes so adoption decisions are evidence-based, not anecdotal.

- Raise the engineering bar across the team, contribute to hiring and calibration, and drive improvements in engineering processes, tooling, and quality standards (CI/CD, testing strategy, developer experience).



Who you are

- 10+ years of professional backend software development experience, with a track record of leading technical direction across complex, distributed systems serving production scale.

- Demonstrated experience leading platform-building efforts end-to-end, from design through production rollout.

- Track record of driving tooling, process, or technical-standard adoption at team or org scale, with measurable productivity or quality outcomes.

- Strong proficiency in a strictly typed language, here, primarily C# and .NET.

- Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS (preferred) or Azure, including production use of Docker and Kubernetes.

- Proven experience with both SQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL stores (MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, or Cosmos DB), schema design, query optimization, and scaling.

- Solid grounding in distributed systems patterns, microservices, asynchronous messaging, caching, resiliency, idempotency, and REST/event-driven API design, and comfortable owning reliability, performance, and cost outcomes.

- Hands-on experience building AI-based products or features, integrating LLMs, AI APIs, or AI coding assistants into real software, with genuine curiosity about applying AI to platform and infrastructure problems.

- Demonstrated fluency with modern AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot, or equivalents).

- Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design trade-offs; test-oriented approach to engineering.

- Decisive leader and strong communicator, drives clarity, makes informed decisions, and produces crisp design docs, RFCs, and postmortems for both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Builder's mindset and team player, curious, pragmatic, transparent, and invested in the growth of the engineers around you.

israel.title: Customer Success Manager
israel.description:
Customer Success Manager
Location: Hybrid in New York City (3 day in-office requirement)

Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or any client facing role.

- 1+ years experience utilizing a CRM software system, Salesforce preferred.

- Experience in a scaled customer success environment, maximizing impact for a large range of clients through scalable motions executed at key moments in a customer’s journey.

- Proven ability to adopt new technologies and teach others effectively.

- Strong communication and sales acumen, with the ability to understand the true needs of the customer, helping them tap into the full value of Melio’s platform for their unique business.

- Takes an analytical, strategic approach to our customers’ success, constantly iterating to improve the whole customer experience.

- Excited to bring new processes and procedures to continue to develop the customer journey at Melio.

- Enjoys working cross-functionally with other teams across the organization on a diverse range of internal and customer-facing initiatives.

- Excellent time-management skills, as well as the ability to remain flexible as the company and role evolves.

- Passionate about speaking with and building relationships with small business owners, helping their businesses succeed with Melio.

- Has a track record of taking on additional responsibilities outside of their direct scope, showing a natural curiosity.

Bonus Points:

- Experience working with small businesses in an account management or customer success capacity.

- Prior experience working in a SaaS environment and/or in the financial technology space

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

- Own all strategic actions associated with customer engagement and retention efforts.

- Build dynamic relationships with your customers through meaningful interactions and comprehensive engagements, developing a deep understanding of their business needs to drive retention.

- Lead customers through early adoption and proactively guide them through lifecycle stages, educating on best practices, removing friction, and accelerating time-to-value.

- Continuously evaluate customer health signals and feedback to surface churn risks and growth pathways across the customer lifecycle.

- Execute proven sales methodologies to guide strategic customer conversations, deepen discovery, and influence outcomes for the customer and the business.

- Share ownership of “one-to-many” motions (e.g. webinars), when required, to support customer education at scale

- Work collaboratively alongside relevant Melio departments to ensure the voice of the customer is constantly elevated in a digestible, actionable format, and that the customer is receiving the utmost support and satisfaction.

- Proactively evaluate best practices when it comes to processes and procedures within the Customer Success role; suggest changes or enhancements to existing procedures to ensure the team’s motions are aligned with the goals of customers and the business.

- Leverage internal tools, such as Salesforce,Tableau, Outreach, and Gong to ensure effective communication and impact assessment.

About the team:

As a Customer Success Manager, you will manage Melio’s most valuable customers, overseeing the strategic growth and retention of top-tier accounts. You will act as a consultant at key milestones to ensure long-term success, drive deeper platform usage, and identify new avenues for  expansion. Additionally, you will regularly surface customer feedback to internal stakeholders, including leadership, Product, Voice of the Customer, and Strategy teams to continue to enhance the platform. You will own the consolidation of this feedback as well as the packaging and presentation of the insights.

About Melio USA:

- Competitive compensation packages: We strive to make each and every employee feel valued and appreciated.

- The annual base salary range for this position is $70,000 - $85,000 with an with an additional bonus component

- Medical, Dental, and Vision: We offer generous and highly competitive plans with up to 100% employer-paid coverage, FSA and HSA.

- 401K matching and stock options: Feel the investment of working at a hyper-growth startup.

- Wellness: We take a holistic approach to wellness at Melio with a focus on providing financial, physical, emotional, social, and community support for our employees.

- Time Off: Time to rest and recharge is a priority for us. We offer competitive vacation time, sick days, holidays, parental leave and wedding days to allow you to take the time you need, when you need it.

- Food perks: Enjoy our fully stocked kitchens, along with a weekly Seamless stipend and plenty of catered meals each week.

- Office culture: Thrive in our collaborative offices in New York City or Denver, in a hybrid working environment. We are dog friendly as well!

- Growth and development: Lean on the diverse team to foster professional and personal growth through workshops, mentorship programs, and team building activities.

Melio builds business-to-business (B2B) payment tools so small business owners can spend less time in the back office and more time on their craft. As the fastest-growing B2B payment platform in the US, Melio is working hard to find new and better ways to help small businesses succeed in the ways that work best for them.

Melio's diversity, equity and inclusion efforts have always been a top priority within our team. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all of our employees encompass different strengths, experiences and backgrounds. DEI within Melio prioritizes race, gender, age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts that make up one's identity. Having a diverse team across all offices is key to our success, and inclusion is each #TeaMelio member's responsibility. Melio accepts job applications on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. If you are interested in applying for this job opportunity, please do so directly on our careers page (or if you’re here already, scroll down and apply now!). This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

- Background with big companies working on large scales

Designing the next generation of cutting edge methods that will:

-  Help small businesses manage their finance in a better way using Melio

-  Help Melio grow the customer base by the built-in product network effect

israel.description:
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a tight-knit, dynamic team of engineers who take pride in high coding standards and modern development practices. You will own one of Melio's impactful, user-facing product areas, making strategic decisions, enhancing workflows, and supporting your team members.

Using technologies such as React, Node.js, AWS, and scalable databases, you will build a unique experience in the world of B2B payments.

Each team member is an all-around player who influences the product from the overall experience to development, and you will be no different. You should be passionate about building a product end-to-end, overseeing the UX, design, coding, testing, and deployment phases.

Qualifications to apply for this role:

- 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer with frontend and backend development.

- 3+ years experience managing a team of 4+ engineers.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with React.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with NodeJS.

- Experience in continuous delivery including automated tests.

- A deep understanding of production systems and the architecture of web products.

- Proactive team player with a desire to impact our engineering team, our product and our customers.

- An eye for UX/UI and details.

- Independent, resourceful and creative.

Bonus Points

- Experience with AWS infrastructure

How your day is going to look, what you will be doing?

- Lead a team of full stack engineers while doing hands-on technical work.

- Set goals, define tasks and manage timelines to execute a roadmap.

- Work closely with Product and Design on new user-facing features.

- Take an active role in hiring for your team and Melio in general.

Melio builds business-to-business (B2B) payment tools so small business owners can spend less time in the back office and more time on their craft. If you are a driven and passionate team player, you will fit right in. About the Engineering department:

The Engineering department is the backbone of Melio. We provide consultation, support and designs for technical solutions—supporting our customers and the entire organization. We get involved from the early stage of a project, making the connection between customer needs, our product design, and then translating these into solutions.

What’s our stack?

In Melio, we are all in with AWS Serverless. Meaning all our services are managed by AWS and our infrastructure is deployed using SAM CLI built over CloudFormation.

Serverless gives us the freedom to build, scale and deploy applications faster than ever. We combine the usage of relational and document DBS, write mainly in Node, TypeScript and Python for consistency and ability to share resources.

israel.description:

Location: Hybrid in New York City (3 day in-office requirement)

Qualifications:

- 4+ years of sales or partnership experience, ideally in a role where you had to build a book of business from scratch.

- A "Hunter-Farmer" Hybrid: You are fearless when cold calling potential partners to pitch a revenue-share opportunity, but you also possess the empathy and organization to nurture those relationships into a productive community over time.

- Thrives in Ambiguity: You don’t need a playbook—you want to write it. You are comfortable testing new pitches, identifying new vertical targets (e.g., insurance, logistics consultants), and pivoting quickly based on what works.

- Creative & Scrappy: You can see the angle that others miss. You understand how to frame a value proposition not just to a user, but to a partner looking to monetize their influence.

- Community Builder Mindset: You understand that signing a partner is just day one. You know how to keep affiliates engaged, excited, and producing leads through constant communication and value-add interactions.

- Genuinely Curious about Business Models: You need to understand how our partners make money (e.g., how a Credit Card Points Consultant operates) to effectively pitch how Melio fits into their ecosystem.

- Proficiency in SalesForce, Outreach.io, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

Identify & Recruit (The Hunt)

- Prospect and Cold Call: You will aggressively hunt for high-leverage affiliates—think Credit Card Points Consultants, Insurance Brokers who don't accept cards, or Industry-Specific Consultants.

- Pitch the "Business in a Box": You aren't just selling software; you are selling a revenue stream. You will convince these partners that referring their high-spend clients to Melio is a lucrative way to monetize their existing relationships through our Gross Profit revenue share model.

- Creative Sourcing: You will experiment with different verticals to find the "hidden gems"—partners who have trusted access to UHV companies but haven't monetized that influence yet.

Onboard & Enable (The Setup)

- White-Glove Onboarding: Once a partner says "yes," you ensure they (and their clients) are set up for success. You will help them identify the low-hanging fruit in their book of business to get their first wins on the board quickly.

- Technical & Sales Enablement: Teach partners how to spot a Melio opportunity and how to pitch it to their clients.

Community Management & Nurture (The Flywheel)

- Drive Portfolio Adoption: You will manage your book of affiliates like a community manager. Your goal is to keep them active, sending leads, and viewing Melio as a significant revenue driver for their business.

- Relationship Moats: Build deep, personal relationships with your partners so that Melio remains their exclusive referral of choice.

Feedback Loop: Since this is a new motion, you will constantly feed insights back to growth and marketing teams. What segments provide deep opportunities for UHV? What incentives drive the most behavior?

israel.title: Senior Backend Engineer
israel.description:
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our team.

Qualifications:

- Tech Enthusiasts - more important than experience is to have the passion to learn and get out of the comfort zone

- +7 years of professional experience as a software engineer in software engineering, architecture, and design

- Experience with micro-services architecture and running cloud-based production environments

- Team player who prefers collaboration over working solo

Bonus points:

- Independent, fast learner, and excited about learning new technologies.

- Looking to improve a strong and open culture

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

- Each member of our team is an all-around player who influences the product from the overall experience to the development.

- You’ll be using top technologies like Typescript, Node.js, AWS and scalable databases to build a unique experience in the world of B2B payments.

- You should be passionate about engineering and building a product end-to-end, through the design, coding, testing, and deployment phases.

About the Engineering department:

The Engineering department is the backbone of Melio. We build, scale, and maintain the technical infrastructure that processes over $100B in annual payments for small businesses nationwide.

Following our acquisition by Xero, we're tackling an even more exciting challenge: integrating Melio's payment platform with Xero's accounting software to create a unified financial ecosystem. This means building robust, scalable systems that seamlessly connect two powerful platforms while maintaining the security and reliability that financial services demand.

Our Stack:

We're all-in on AWS Serverless—meaning fully managed infrastructure that lets us build and scale faster than ever. We use TypeScript and Python for consistency, combining relational and document databases, and deploy via SAM CLI built on CloudFormation. Serverless gives us the agility to innovate rapidly while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability.

As part of our engineering team, you'll work on problems that matter: real-time payment processing, fraud prevention, API integrations, data synchronization, and user experience optimization. You'll have the autonomy to make architectural decisions, the support of a world-class team, and the satisfaction of seeing your code impact millions of small businesses.

If you're ready to build systems that scale, solve hard problems, and help small businesses thrive, we want to talk to you.

Read more about our Engineering department on our tech blog.

About Melio:

Melio, a Xero company, is revolutionizing how small businesses handle payments. By combining Melio's best-in-class bill pay platform with Xero's global accounting expertise, we're building the ultimate financial command center for American small businesses. We're the fastest-growing B2B payment solution in the US—but we're still small enough that you can make real, visible impact as we scale to reach millions more businesses.
