- 7+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, with a proven track record of applying advanced statistical and machine learning methods on real-world problems (or 3+ years with a PhD).

- Strong background and practical experience leading the end-to-end execution of complex Machine Learning projects.

- Comfort with the realities of risk modeling: highly imbalanced and adversarial data, delayed/noisy labels, and the precision-vs-recall tradeoffs of acting on legitimate users.

- Full ownership of projects from initial idea through production deployment, working closely with engineering to get there.

- Experience in Generative AI, defining, building and evaluating AI-agents and leveraging foundational language models for introducing advanced new capabilities within existing products and systems.

- Experience in working with large-scale data processing pipelines, Cloud Computing and Machine Learning Operations.

- Demonstrated habit of working with AI: actively use LLMs/agentic tooling in your day-to-day workflow, and you instinctively turn recurring problems into reusable automation.

- B.Sc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

Bonus points:

- Experience developing models in the Risk domain (such as Fraud Detection, Anomaly Detection, Anti-Money Laundering) or Fintech.

- M.Sc/PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

How is your day going to look, what will you be doing?

As a Senior Data Scientist for Risk, you will be responsible for:

- Hands-on Development: Actively leading the design, building, and deployment of critical Machine Learning and Gen-AI models for identifying, classifying, and preventing risks and fraud.

- Technical Leadership & Strategy: Contributing to the Data Science strategy for the Risk domain, identifying critical business and technological opportunities, and setting high technical standards.

- AI Agents Innovation: Driving the team's efforts in the field of AI Agents within Risk, build and evaluate agentic workflows that triage and explain risk decisions, with eval harnesses you can trust to gate releases and ensure reliability and accuracy in production.

- Production Ownership: Ensuring Data Science solutions transition reliably, scalably, and efficiently from concept to production, making a significant impact on the business.

How You'll Make an Impact?

This role is critical to Melio's ability to continue scaling securely. In this position, you will drive the development of the next generation of cutting-edge methods that will:

- Help small businesses manage their finances in a better, safer way using Melio.

- Help Melio grow its customer base while maintaining a low-risk profile.

- Drive impact by leveraging LLMs and Agentic Workflows to proactively identify sophisticated fraud patterns, mitigating financial risk while maintaining a seamless and secure experience for legitimate users.

About Us

Melio builds business-to-business (B2B) payment tools so small business owners can spend less time in the back office and more time on their craft. As the fastest-growing B2B payment platform in the US, Melio is working hard to find new and better ways to help small businesses succeed in the ways that work best for them. With offices in New York, Denver, and Tel Aviv, and a vibrant work culture, Melio is expanding every single day. We are a diverse group of people who love what we do and do what we love. If you are a driven and passionate team player, you will fit right in.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and are always on the lookout for top-notch talent. Please reach out if you would like to join us on this exciting journey!

About the Hiring Department

The Risk, Compliance & Policy Group plays a critical role in protecting the company from regulatory, financial, and reputational risk. We are an engineering group comprising five specialized teams, one of which is the Data Science team (which you will be a part of). We enforce company policies, compliance obligations, and prevent fraudulent events by evaluating payments and customers based on internal and external data.

israel.title: Associate, Payment Integrity IBR
israel.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring an Associate, Itemized Bill Review to join our Payment Integrity team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Associate, Payment Integrity, Itemized Bill Review (IBR) will be responsible for executing internal payment integrity solutions requiring billing and coding expertise with and continual improvement and development of the solutions. You will ensure claims are paid accurately and timely with the highest quality. This is accomplished by leveraging a deep understanding of Oscar's claim infrastructure, workflows, workflow tooling, platform logic, data models, etc., to work cross-functionally to understand and translate friction from stakeholders into actionable opportunities for improvement.

You will report into the Manager, Payment Integrity (Pre-Pay).

Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Atlanta, Georgia; Chicago, Illinois; Dallas, Texas; Louisville, Kentucky; Minneapolis, Minnesota; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania; Salt Lake City, Utah. You will be fully remote; however, our approach to work may adapt over time. Future models could potentially involve a hybrid presence at the hub office associated with your metro area. #LI-Remote

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $82,717 - $108,566 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

- Perform line-by-line review of high-dollar facility itemized bills and corresponding claim forms (e.g., UB-04s)

- Proactively identify and document potential billing errors, including duplicate billing of items, services, or procedures as improper unbundling of services (e.g., separating components that should be billed together) and charges for non-covered or non-rendered services

- Compare billed charges against both payor-specific contracts and industry guidelines to confirm appropriate billing practices.

- Apply working knowledge of national coding systems (e.g., CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, MS-DRGs) to validate the accuracy of codes used for services billed.

- Review claims eligible under specific reimbursement scenarios: a percentage of charges or those exceeding stop-loss levels, ensuring the claim exceeds the minimum dollar threshold set by the payor

- Prepare clear, concise, and professional documentation of all findings, including savings identified, policy violations, and recommended claim adjustments

- Contribute to the refinement of internal audit processes and tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy in identifying claim inaccuracies

- Serve as a subject matter expert for internal and external stakeholders regarding complex billing issues, coding guidelines, and payor policies

- Provide subject matter expertise and in-depth understanding of Payment Integrity internal claims processing edits, external vendor edits and Oscar reimbursement policies

- Identify claims payment issues from data mining, process monitoring, etc., provide scoping and action steps needed to remediate the issue

- Respond to internal and external inquiries and disputes regarding policies and edits.

- Document industry standard coding rules and provide recommendations on reimbursement policy language and scope

- Ideate payment integrity opportunities based on a deep knowledge of industry standard coding rules. Translate into business requirements; submit to and collaborate with internal partners to effectuate change

- Provide training and education to team members when necessary

- Perpetuate a culture of transparency and collaboration by keeping stakeholders well informed of progress, status changes, blockers, completion, etc.; field questions as appropriate

- Support Oscar run state objectives by providing speedy research, root cause analysis, training, etc. whenever issues are escalated and assigned by leadership

- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations

- Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

- A bachelor's degree or 4+ years of commensurate experience

- 2+ years of bill / coding audit experience with a focus on hospital or facility billing (UB-04)

- 4+ years experience in medical coding

- Medical coding certification through AAPC (CPC, COC) or AHIMA (CCS, RHIT, RHIA)

- Experience with reimbursement methodologies, provider contract concepts and common claims processing/resolution practices

Bonus points:

- 3+ years of experience working with large data sets using excel or a database language

- Knowledge management, training, or content development in operational settings

- Process Improvement or Lean Six Sigma training

- Experience using SQL

Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring an Associate to join our Provider Success team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Associate, Provider Success drives solutions to acute and systemic issues within Oscar's operations. The Associate owns end-to-end solutioning of provider escalations, orchestrating efforts cross-functionally with multiple internal partners, while building strong relationships through effectiveness and trust.

You will report into the Manager, Provider Success.

Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Dallas, Texas. You will be fully remote; however, our approach to work may adapt over time. Future models could potentially involve a hybrid presence at the hub office associated with your metro area. #LI-Remote

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $87,188 - $114,434 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

- Leads and cross collaborates on problem definition, acute error remediation, and root cause solution development

- Utilizes data to drive business decisions to impact cross-functional strategy

- Develops trusting relationships with relevant internal/external stakeholders through effective communication, collaboration and positive outcomes.

- Supports Oscar team members through knowledge sharing, process documentation, and tooling development

- Other duties as assigned

- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations

Requirements:

- 3+ years of relevant technical experience in operations, data analysis, and/or consulting within healthcare

- 3+ years experience cooperatively developing project plans with internal and external stakeholders

- 3+ years experience designing and improving workflows, including development of accompanying operating and technical procedures and tooling

- Experience managing complicated business challenges: developing understanding, distilling and communicating that understanding to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Healthcare experience

Bonus points:

- Knowledge management, training, or content development in operational settings

- 2+ years experience using SQL to manipulate and analyze large data sets to solve business problems

- Process Improvement or Lean Six Sigma certification

- Structured, systematic, and critical thinking

- Strong verbal and written communications

This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity. Learn more about how you can safeguard yourself from recruitment fraud here.

At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives.

Pay Transparency:  Final offer amounts, within the base pay set forth above, are determined by factors including your relevant skills, education, and experience. Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, paid sick time, paid parental leave, 401(k) plan participation, life and disability insurance, and paid wellness time and reimbursements.

Artificial Intelligence (AI): Our AI Guidelines outline the acceptable use of artificial intelligence for candidates and detail how we use AI to support our recruiting efforts.

Reasonable Accommodation: Oscar applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to applicant’s disability or need for accommodation. Any Oscar applicant who requires reasonable accommodations during the application process should contact the Oscar Benefits Team (accommodations@hioscar.com) to make the need for an accommodation known.

California Residents: For information about our collection, use, and disclosure of applicants’ personal information as well as applicants’ rights over their personal information, please see our Privacy Policy.

israel.title: Associate, Sales Enablement
israel.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring an Associate, Sales Enablement to join our Product Marketing Team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

This role drives the development, scaling, and execution of our sales enablement strategy and marketing collateral across our key distribution channels. You will serve as the critical bridge between our growth strategy and field execution, ensuring external partners and internal teams have the high-impact resources and deep subject matter expertise needed to confidently evangelize Oscar and accelerate membership acquisition.

You will report into the Associate Director, Product Marketing.

Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Atlanta, GA. You will be fully remote; however, our approach to work may adapt over time. Future models could potentially involve a hybrid presence at the hub office associated with your metro area. #LI-Remote

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $91,659 - $120,303 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

- Develop Multi-Audience Collateral: Design and deliver a high volume of targeted enablement resources that clearly translate Oscar's distinct market advantages

- Build B2B2C and Localized Toolkits: Create state-specific market materials and comprehensive downstream enrollment guides that effectively advocate for Oscar

- Architect Internal Training Programs: Design, build, and facilitate a comprehensive curriculum to establish deep subject matter expertise across our growth teams and the broader organization.

- Support Strategic Event Execution: Partner closely with the Growth and Marketing teams to manage asset readiness and collateral delivery for high-stakes industry events, regional rollouts, and the critical Open Enrollment calendar.

- Optimize the Resource Repository: Gather continuous feedback from sales loops and distribution partners to proactively iterate, update, and maintain a centralized, high-impact library of market-facing resources.

- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations

- Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

- Bachelors degree or 4+ years commensurate experience

- Experience: 1–3 years of experience in sales enablement, broker relations, account management, or corporate training

- Demonstrated success building clear, scannable sales assets, training decks, and playbooks that simplify complex insurance products for broker audiences.

- Proven track record navigating CRM platforms (like Salesforce) and digital enrollment tools to track broker engagement metrics and pull actionable sales insights.

- Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with a history of collaborating directly with Product Marketing, Legal, and Sales operations to manage tight compliance and rollout deadlines.

Bonus points:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Healthcare Management, or a related field.

- Direct experience supporting individual ACA sales models, with a solid understanding of how brokers build and scale their books of business.

- Advanced proficiency with design and enablement software (such as Figma, Canva, or Highspot) to independently build modern, high-end visual assets.

- Familiarity with agile product launches or tech-forward healthcare ecosystems, showing an ability to quickly translate rolling product updates into simple broker messaging.



Travel required - Up to 10%

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Senior Analyst, SIU Clinical Investigator detects and audits aberrant billing patterns within claims and clinical documentation, using forensic clinical expertise to protect the integrity of healthcare spend. You will perform comprehensive pre-payment and post-payment reviews of medical records to ensure billed services align with established clinical guidelines, CMS regulations, and contractual obligations. Beyond individual claim accuracy, you will analyze provider behavior to identify schemes such as record cloning, upcoding, and unbundling that may be invisible to automated systems. As a clinical subject matter expert, you will act to translate audit findings into relevant education. You will facilitate professional discussions with colleagues and providers to correct billing behaviors and promote long-term compliance. You will partner with clinical and non-clinical investigators to build evidentiary files for potential recovery, legal action, or referrals to appropriate outside agencies.

You will report into the Investigations Manager, SIU.

Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas and Virginia. israel.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Data Scientist I to join our Data team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves - one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

Oscar's Data team is focused on pushing our understanding of this complex landscape of health care and insurance business. Insurance companies sit on a trove of data that is both broad and deep, spanning financial claims, clinical medical records, and rich product interaction data from our members. Connecting the dots across these datasets gives us unique insight into how the healthcare system functions and allows us to improve care coordination, better manage risk, build higher-performing provider networks, and create a standout consumer experience in our product.

We’re hiring several Data Scientists to support data science initiatives across multiple teams. In this role, you’ll contribute to the development and maintenance of data pipelines, analytical models, and validation processes that power business decision-making.

This position is well-suited for early-career data scientists who have strong technical foundations and are excited to grow their skills while working on real-world data problems in a collaborative environment.
You will report into a leader on the Data team (Senior Data Scientist and above). This posting is representative of multiple roles, and final team placement will be determined during the interview process.

Work Location: This position is a hybrid role based in our New York City office, Los Angeles Office, or Tempe Office requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $119,200- $156,450 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants, and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

- Build, maintain, and support data pipelines to ensure reliable, accurate, and timely data delivery.

- Assist with the testing, validation, and refinement of statistical or analytical models.

- Perform advanced analytical work and validation checks on datasets and model outputs.

- Identify data quality issues, anomalies, or inconsistencies and help implement corrective solutions.

- Collaborate with data leaders and cross-functional business partners to understand data needs and improve processes.

- Partner closely with business, engineering, product and data stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.

- Write clear, maintainable analytical code and documentation.

- Follow established data science standards, best practices, and compliance requirements.

Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field or 1+ year of relevant professional experience

- 1+ years of experience building data models and using more advanced analytics methods, including conducting in depth analysis, rather than simple descriptive analysis

israel.title: Senior Product Designer
israel.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.



About the role:

Oscar’s Internal Tools design team creates the mission-critical products that power our insurance and care operations. These tools support teams across Clinical, Core Insurance, and Network as they manage complex workflows involving claims, risk adjustment, provider networks, clinical care, and other essential business functions.  As a Senior Product Designer, you will help define and deliver clear, effective experiences across this ecosystem. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners, clinicians, operational teams, and other designers to understand complex problems, identify opportunities, and take solutions from discovery through delivery.  The work is operational, workflow-heavy, data-rich, and technically complex. It requires strong systems thinking, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to connect decisions across users, workflows, and products. Your initial product area will be determined based on your experience, interests, and Oscar’s current needs.

Oscar is building an AI-enabled design practice. You will use approved tools such as Claude and Codex to clarify problems, explore workflows, identify risks and edge cases, and create realistic prototypes earlier in the design process. You will bring validated directions into Figma for complete state coverage, design-system alignment, and production readiness. You will also help the broader team develop effective and responsible ways of working with AI.

This role reports to a Product Design Director.

Work Location:

This position is based in our Marina Del Rey office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

Pay Transparency:

The base pay for this role is: $149,040.00 - $195,615.00 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.



Responsibilities:

- Independently lead the design process for complex problems, balancing immediate delivery and polish with a coherent long-term direction.

- Develop a deep understanding of internal users, their goals, and the operational environments in which they work.

- Partner with Product and Engineering to define product direction, identify opportunities, establish measurable goals, and contribute to roadmaps.

- Map complex workflows and systems to identify pain points, dependencies, duplication, and opportunities for simplification.

- Lead design work from early discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, implementation, and iteration.

- Use research, data, hypotheses, and experimentation to evaluate ideas and improve product direction.

- Create prototypes that help teams explore ideas, test assumptions, and build confidence in a proposed solution.

- Lead workshops, product-vision activities, and presentations when they help teams reach clarity.

- Use Claude and Codex to clarify user and business needs, explore possible approaches, and identify requirements, risks, and edge cases.

- Use Claude and Codex to build and test realistic interactions, workflows, and front-end prototypes.

- Apply strong design judgment to AI-generated output, refining its structure, behavior, accessibility, and visual quality.

- Partner with engineers to determine which prototypes, patterns, or components can be carried into production.

- Use Figma to ensure validated concepts have complete states, follow shared patterns, and are ready for implementation.

- Document and share useful prompts, workflows, prototypes, and lessons that improve how the broader design team uses AI.

- Use AI responsibly and in accordance with Oscar’s privacy, security, and member-data requirements.

- Collaborate closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure the shipped experience meets the intended quality bar.

- Navigate technical constraints without losing sight of user needs, product quality, or long-term scalability.

- Contribute to a consistent and scalable experience across Oscar’s internal products.

- Use and improve shared design-system components, patterns, and standards.

- Apply Oscar’s brand, accessibility standards, and design principles across product experiences.

- Present work clearly, explain the reasoning behind decisions, and invite feedback at the appropriate stages.

- Contribute to team critique, design practices, and the growth of the broader Product Design organization.

- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

- 4+ years of experience in Product Design, UX Design, or a related field.

- At least two examples of designing and shipping complex web, mobile, SaaS, or internal-tool experiences.

- 2+ years owning relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, systems thinking, interaction design, and visual craft.

- Experience owning product design work from problem definition through launch and iteration.

- Experience working autonomously across complex or ambiguous product areas.

- Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to define problems, evaluate solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

- The ability to translate requirements, business goals, research, and technical constraints into clear and useful product experiences.

- Active use of tools such as Claude, Codex, or comparable AI-assisted tools within a product design workflow.

- Comfort using AI-assisted development tools to create realistic prototypes, even if you do not write production code by hand.

- Examples of using AI to improve the speed, fidelity, or quality of product exploration and delivery.

- The ability to explain where AI was useful, where it was insufficient, and how your own judgment shaped the result.

- Strong written, visual, and verbal communication skills.

Bonus points:

- Experience designing SaaS products, enterprise software, CRM platforms, operational tools, or similarly complex applications.

- Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.

- Experience designing data-dense interfaces, configurable workflows, permissions, or multi-role systems.

- Experience simplifying fragmented products, workflows, or product ecosystems.

- Experience contributing to or working closely with a design system or front-end component library.

- Experience creating realistic or coded prototypes.

- Familiarity with front-end concepts such as components, states, responsive behavior, and accessibility.

- Experience planning and conducting customer interviews, usability testing, or other lightweight research.

- Experience using animated prototypes, working software, or user-flow diagrams to communicate a product direction.

- Experience contributing reusable prompts, patterns, components, or workflows to a broader team.

- Experience designing AI-powered products, including considerations around transparency, uncertainty, user control, and trust.

- Interest in accessibility, design ethics, and the responsibilities involved in designing healthcare products.

- A genuine and inquisitive working style, with humility, determination, and openness to feedback.

israel.title: Account Development Specialist
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Are you commercially minded, great at building relationships, and excited by helping businesses grow? Do you enjoy combining account development, data, and a hands-on approach to make a real impact? If so, we’d love to chat!

What you’ll be doing

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about developing strong partnerships and identifying opportunities for growth.

You might come from account management, trade marketing, business development, sales, hospitality, restaurant operations, or another commercially focused role where you’ve worked closely with customers or partners and had an impact on business performance. You don’t necessarily need to come from a traditional Account Management background. Perhaps you’ve managed a restaurant or worked in hospitality, where you were responsible for operations, commercial results, customer experience, or revenue growth. Or maybe you’ve already managed a portfolio of clients or partners, identifying opportunities, upselling, and helping them grow their business. What matters most is that you bring strong ownership, commercial thinking, relationship-building skills, and curiosity.

You’ll own and develop a portfolio of small and medium-sized local restaurant partners in Almaty, working closely with independent venues and growing local businesses. You’ll play an important role in understanding the local restaurant scene, identifying growth opportunities, and helping our partners get more value from Wolt.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Own and drive the growth of a portfolio of small and medium-sized local restaurant partners.

- Build strong, long-term relationships with restaurant owners, managers, and other key decision-makers.

- Develop a strong understanding of the local Almaty restaurant scene, partner needs, and market opportunities.

- Identify commercial opportunities and help partners grow through upselling, campaigns, and other growth initiatives.

- Use data and insights to understand partner performance and identify areas for improvement.

- Help improve operational and commercial KPIs across your portfolio.

- Work closely with Marketing and other internal teams to plan and execute campaigns and growth initiatives.

- Analyze the local market and restaurant landscape on an ongoing basis.

- Take ownership of partner challenges and proactively look for solutions.

- Contribute beyond your day-to-day responsibilities and maintain the hands-on mindset that is an important part of how we work at Wolt.

Our humble expectations

- Experience in account management, account development, trade marketing, business development, sales, hospitality, restaurant operations, partner management, or another relevant commercially focused role.

- Strong commercial mindset and genuine interest in helping businesses grow.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with a wide range of partners and stakeholders.

- A proactive, hands-on approach and strong sense of ownership.

- Comfortable working with data and using insights to support commercial decisions and conversations with partners.

- Structured, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to adapt your approach depending on the audience.

- Passion for the restaurant industry and interest in developing Almaty’s local restaurant scene.

- Previous experience with CRM systems is a plus.

- Experience with analytical tools such as Looker or Power BI is a plus.

- Previous sales or upselling experience is a strong plus.

- Fluent in Russian and Kazakh, with a good command of English.

Why you’ll love it

- 🚀 Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup

- 🤩 Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills

- 💪 Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference

- 💙 Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

What we offer

- 🌍 Independent work in a dynamic, international team

- 🩺 Medical Insurance and strengthened sick leaves

- 🚀 Career growth

- 💙 Employee Assistance Program - therapy and wellbeing

- % Discount on your Wolt orders

- 🧑‍🎓 Wolt-wide training programs

- 🎉 Team budgets

- 🍊 Fruits and drinks at the office

Next steps*

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going! Please make sure to submit your application in English.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

We're looking for a B2B Demand Generation Manager to join Wolt and own paid demand generation campaigns across multiple countries in one or more B2B product lines. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role at the heart of how Wolt grows its business. You'll be building and running full-funnel, multi-channel campaigns from scratch and developing the playbooks and processes that will scale with us. You'll work closely with Sales, Product, and cross-functional teams across EMEA.

What you'll be doing

This role is about ownership and execution. You'll be hands-on running campaigns while also thinking strategically about how to improve efficiency, test new channels, learn with data, and build systems that last.

Day-to-day in this role, you'll:

- Own end-to-end paid demand generation campaigns across multiple countries and B2B products, managing significant budgets across Meta, TikTok, Google, programmatic, and other channels

- Build full-funnel campaigns with B2B collaborators that span from next-level ad creatives and landing pages through to sign-up flows, lead qualification, and activated accounts

- Develop and test new (locally relevant) initiatives: new messaging, new channels, new tools, and turn successful pilots into scalable playbooks

- Drive automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort in day-to-day campaign management

- Support new product and feature launches with go-to-market demand generation campaigns

- Own reporting, tracking, and measurement, defining what success looks like and making sure we can see it clearly

- Build strong cross-functional relationships with Sales, Product, and global commercial teams to ensure campaigns drive real business impact

Our humble expectations

- B2B background in a tech company, plus for familiarity with the Food or Retail industries

- 5–8 years of experience running high-budget B2B paid campaigns (>€1M/year) across multiple channels, including Meta, TikTok, Google Search, and programmatic and multiple countries or products, or clients

- Demonstrated ability to effectively plan media investments based on both business and campaign-level KPIs, manage and optimize budget across channels, and do in-house media buying.

- Analytical and data-driven, comfortable defining KPIs, tracking performance, and translating data into clear decisions

- Intermediate to advanced knowledge in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (e.g, VLOOKUP, pivot, etc.) or experience with data analytics.

- Strong testing and problem-solving skills: you identify a challenge, come up with a hypothesis, devise a testing strategy to get statistically significant results and ultimately scale up what works

- Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve how you work, with concrete examples to back it up

- Collaborative and proactive, you work well with Sales and other functions and can build trust across teams

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; other languages are a plus.

Nice to have:

- Experience with ABM, intent-based tools, outbound motions (Clay, Cognism, ZoomInfo, etc.), media buying on industry platforms, content syndication, paid PR, or retail media

You'll work with companies of all sizes, from startups and SMBs to large enterprises, and engage stakeholders across HR, Finance, Procurement and senior management.

- Build trusted relationships with new partners and identify opportunities to expand those partnerships after acquisition.

- Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure a smooth partner experience from signing through launch.

- Consistently achieving monthly sales targets.

- Building a healthy sales pipeline.

- Delivering an exceptional customer experience.

- Proven experience in B2B new business acquisition/hunter sales, with responsibility for generating your own opportunities.

- Comfortable with high levels of outbound prospecting.

- Experience selling B2B solutions rather than transactional products.

- Experience managing consultative sales cycles lasting 1-6 months with multiple stakeholders.

- Confidence engaging multiple stakeholders, including HR, Finance, Procurement and senior decision-makers.

- Strong pipeline management and CRM discipline.

- Data-driven decision-making and forecasting.

- Fluent in English and Greek.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Csapatjátékosok figyelem! Szereted a rugalmas és dinamikus  munkakörnyezetet, ahol részt vehetsz a kereskedelem jövőjének kialakításában? Ha igen, akkor olvass tovább!

Csatlakozz hozzánk még ma teljes munkaidőben, és építsük tovább együtt a Wolt Marketet Zuglóban! 🤩

Mi lesz a feladatod?

- Rendelések elfogadása az alkalmazásunkon keresztül

- A beérkező áru feldolgozása

- Megrendelt termékek összekészítése, csomagolása és átadása a futároknak, vagy a vásárlóknak

- A belső rendszerünk naprakészen tartása a termékek adataival

- A bolt rendjének és tisztaságának fenntartása

- Részvétel a bolt működésének folyamatos fejlesztésében

Mit várunk tőled?

- Gyors tanulási- és multitasking képességet

- Proaktivitást, szolgáltatói szemléletet

- Önállóságot, ambíciót, a gyors tempójú startup környezet szeretetét

- Napközbeni, esti és hétvégi műszakok vállalását egyaránt - A Wolt Market Zugló reggel 7 órától 23.00-ig  tart nyitva!

- Bolti vagy raktári tapasztalat előny, de nem feltétel

- Legalább alapszintű angol nyelvtudást

- Folyékony magyar nyelvtudás (Fluent in Hungarian)

Mit kínálunk mi?

- Wolt-os dolgozói kedvezmény, kreditek formájában

- Cafeteria juttatás, Szép Kártya formájában

- All You Can Move Kártya lehetőség

- Wolt-specifikus tréning programok

- Csapatépítők és egyéb közös céges események

A következő lépés

Ha szívesen dolgoznál olyan környezetben, ahol gyorsan fejlődhetsz, ha szeretsz felelősséget vállalni a feladataidért, ha szeretnél egy extrém ambiciózus csapat tagja lenni, akkor kattints és beszélgessünk!

Folyamatosan dolgozzuk fel a beérkező jelentkezéseket, szóval küldd el, amilyen gyorsan csak lehet! 💙

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Are you a commercially driven professional who enjoys building strategic partnerships and growing high-impact business opportunities? Are you excited by the idea of helping shape the future of Wolt’s Commerce Platform in Greece while working with some of the country's largest merchants? If yes, we'd love to meet you!

At Wolt, you can grow your career with a fun and fast-scaling global business. Part of the DoorDash team, we're building a global logistics platform that can deliver almost anything in your city in minutes. Today, our products are used by 55+ million registered users who order from 200,000+ merchants across 30+ countries.

To support our expanding merchant offering, we are growing our Commerce Platform team in Greece. This role focuses on developing strategic partnerships across both existing and new merchants while working closely with the Commerce Platform Lead to unlock long-term growth opportunities.

Wolt Commerce Platform Products in a Nutshell

- Wolt Drive - A delivery-as-a-service solution (DaaS) enabling merchants to add fast, reliable last-mile delivery to their own ordering channels.

- Wolt Storefront - A white-label online ordering platform that helps merchants create branded digital stores with seamless checkout and increased conversion.

As Business Development Manager, you'll play a key role in expanding both products across Greece by growing strategic partnerships, identifying new business opportunities, and driving cross-functional initiatives from idea to execution.

What you’ll be doing

As a Business Development Manager, you'll work closely with the Commerce Platform Lead to grow Wolt Drive and Storefront across Greece. You'll own strategic partnerships, identify new business opportunities, and drive cross-functional initiatives from idea to execution.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

- Own and grow a portfolio of strategic merchant partnerships, across retail and restaurant verticals identifying opportunities to drive long-term commercial growth.

- Build and develop relationships with key stakeholders, leading commercial discussions and presenting solutions alongside the Commerce Platform Lead.

- Identify and pursue new strategic business opportunities, managing long sales cycles from prospecting through launch.

- Take end-to-end ownership of new partnership initiatives, coordinating with Product, Operations, Legal, Account Management and other internal teams to ensure successful execution.

- Monitor business performance, use data to identify growth opportunities, and support commercial decision-making.

- Act as a trusted partner to the Commerce Platform Lead, helping shape and scale Wolt's Commerce Platform in Greece.

Our humble expectations

You’ll succeed in this role if you:

- Have 3-6 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, key account management, or a similar commercial role.

- Have experience managing complex commercial discussions and building long-term relationships with large merchants or enterprise clients in retail, restaurant, or similar consumer-facing industries.

- Are comfortable working with commercial data and using insights to drive business ddecisions.

- Take ownership, thrive in ambiguity, and enjoy building new processes and partnerships from scratch.

- Are an excellent communicator who can confidently present to senior stakeholders and collaborate across multiple teams.

- Have experience in e-commerce, retail, logistics, SaaS, or marketplace businesses (considered a plus).

- Are fluent in English and Greek.

Next steps

If you're excited about driving growth, managing key business relationships, and contributing to the success of leading commerce solutions, apply below!

That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. The Category Manager is responsible for building and managing the assortment and trading plan including pricing and promotions, building relationships with suppliers and managing the category performance in the country. In addition, they are responsible for strategic projects to improve the commercial performance of the country aligned with global OKRs, and learning and development of the local category team.

The Category Manager has full ownership of the category performance across the assigned categories.

What you’ll be doing

As a member of the Category team, your most important task will be to develop an assortment within your managed categories that meets our customers’ needs while ensuring the level of profitability expected by the company.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Identify and proactively drive local strategic projects to improve the commercial performance of their country

- Having full ownership of assigned category performance, including forecasting, monitoring, reporting on the business.

- Contributing to driving projects and trading strategy to achieve business goals.

- Defining and continuously updating Wolt Market’s assortment at a store level to meet customer needs and optimise order economics.

- Leading effective negotiations with suppliers to establish joint goals, improve cost structure, and sustainably grow the P&L.

- Influencing the design of the categories, as well as contributing to new product groups and improving the customer experience to deliver growth.

- Responsible as key DRI to liaise with global POC’s for implementation of global initiatives and OKR’s including both commercial, and cross functional stakeholders

- Working cross-functionally with counterparts across in-stock management, marketing, finance, and retail systems to operate and grow the business.

- Continually improving and automating manual processes to enable the team to scale better as the business grows.

- Responsible for driving Ad sales with vendor revenue, confident understanding of tools and selling points

- Upon proposing new ideas, you devise  a plan to action these and see results

Our humble expectations

- Experience in a grocery retail, key account management/consulting environment with a proven track record of delivering results.

- Experience in category management.

- Strong communication skills and experience negotiating with internal and external stakeholders.

- Strong analytical skills.

- Ability to think both strategically and operationally with an eye for detail.

- Full professional proficiency in English and in a relevant local language.

- Excellent skills in G Suite or MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel).

Next steps

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team redefining grocery shopping, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an on-going basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply and submit your English CV/resume today!

israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is a Finnish technology company and we’re best known for our food delivery platform. In 2014, we started with restaurant food delivery in Helsinki, Finland. Today, we're in the delivery of (almost) everything, our platform is available in 30+ countries and used by more than 50 million consumers, and our diverse and talented team is already over 14,000 strong. From day one, we built our tech with scaling in mind. This allows us to operate efficiently across small countries and even small cities. Now, together with DoorDash, we’re building a global leader in our industry.

The role you are looking at is a part of Wolt Market - our very own grocery stores that deliver unprecedented convenience and world leading customer experience. People across 21 countries can order their groceries and have them delivered to their doorstep at lightspeed!

Reporting to the General Manager of Wolt Market Greece, the Category Manager is responsible for building and managing the assortment and trading plan, including pricing and promotions. The role also involves developing strong relationships with suppliers and taking full ownership of category performance across assigned categories in the Greek market.

The Category Manager works closely with Wolt Market stores to ensure the right assortment on every location, Content team, and Supply Chain to ensure that there is always stock. The person also works with retail partners to ensure constant optimisation of trading performance. Other key stakeholders include operations, marketing, and data teams to define and develop all necessary reporting, data models, tools and products to drive category performance in local stores.

You’ll get a lot of help and support on the way, but are also expected to be an amazing independent manager with an exceptional ability to execute every single day.

What you’ll be doing:

- Having full ownership of assigned category performance, including forecasting, monitoring, reporting on the business.

- Contributing to driving projects and trading strategy to achieve business goals.

- Defining and continuously updating Wolt Market’s assortment at a store level to meet customer needs and optimise order economics.

- Leading effective negotiations with suppliers to establish joint goals, improve cost structure, and sustainably grow the P&L.

- Influencing the design of the categories, as well as contributing to new product groups and improving the customer experience to deliver growth.

- Creating business plans for new opportunities and developing and executing project plans for the launch of new features, incorporating merchandising and pricing strategies.

- Working cross-functionally with counterparts across in-stock management, marketing, finance, and retail systems to operate and grow the business.

- Continually improving and automating manual processes to enable the team to scale better as the business grows.

Our humble expectations:

- Three (3) years of solid experience in category management, with a proven track record of delivering results.

- Experience in non-food categories is a strong plus

- Background in online grocery, traditional grocery retail, or e-commerce, ideally in fast-paced or scaling environments.

- Strong communication skills and experience in negotiating with both internal and external stakeholders.

- Excellent analytical skills.

- Ability to think both strategically and operationally, with strong attention to detail.

- Professional English and Greek is a must

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. israel.title: Courier HR Senior Specialist
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt’s Courier Employment team is building something that doesn’t really exist yet — a cross-country infrastructure for employed courier operations across multiple geographies. We sit at the intersection of operations, people, legal, and compliance, and we’re doing it largely from scratch.

The function currently spans three countries (Finland, Germany, Croatia), each at a different stage of maturity and with different legal frameworks. Courier employment is managed in all these countries by a functional team handling strategy, structure and resources, and country-level teams focused on execution and operational excellence from the ground up.

We operate in a fast-moving environment with a high degree of uncertainty — regulatory, operational, and structural. If you’re energised by the possibilities and want to be the person who builds the playbook, this might be the right role for you.

About the role

Croatia doesn't have an independent Courier HR operating model yet. It has support from the general employee HR team, great people working hard, manual workarounds, and a scale-up landing in the next few months that the current setup wasn't built to absorb. This role exists to establish Courier HR expertise within the function and build the processes needed while running the team's day-to-day HR operations.

As Courier HR Senior Specialist in Croatia, you'll own the full employee lifecycle for a fast-growing courier workforce: onboarding, contracts, documentation, leave, and the HR side of a workforce that includes couriers relocating from abroad. This includes tracking of work permits and other integration and compliance related matters.

You'll be supported by the function’s core team and leadership and work closely with your Courier HR Lead, the Workforce Ops team, Legal, and the sourcing agencies bringing couriers in. You'll be the most senior Courier HR operator on the ground in Croatia day-to-day — which means you'll be trusted to make independent decisions and participate actively in building foundations and standards that will apply across all markets.

What you'll be doing

Employee lifecycle execution at scale

- Own onboarding, contracts, documentation, and leave administration for Croatia's employed couriers, including the operational HR side of relocating couriers from abroad (documentation, work permit tracking, compliance).

- Delegating and syncing with a Tier 1 HR team that handles standard inbound tickets and manual entry.

- Build and maintain accurate employee records across HR systems as the courier base scales.

- Handle the volume and pace of onboarding waves without letting quality or compliance slip.

- Make the judgment calls on ambiguous or non-standard cases that come up, escalating appropriately to your Courier HR Lead or Legal.

Process and SOP creation

- Create SOPs, checklists, and documentation in collaboration with the functional Process & Systems Senior Specialist based on cross-market standards and calibrated to local requirements.

- Identify where the current setup will break under the incoming scale-up, then plan and build for it before it breaks.

- Partner with the Process & Systems Senior Specialist on anything that should become a cross-country standard rather than a local fix.

Cross-functional coordination

- Act as the day-to-day HR point of contact for the sourcing agencies bringing couriers into Croatia, ensuring HR-side obligations (documentation, onboarding timing, permits) are met on time.

- Work with Workforce Ops to keep HR and operational onboarding in sync as waves of new couriers arrive.

- Flag structural risks early and initiate appropriate action in collaboration with your Lead and functional colleagues.

Our humble expectations

There’s no single background that defines this role — but the people who do well here tend to combine sharp analytical thinking with genuine operational curiosity. Some things that matter:

- 3+ years of experience in HR operations, people operations, or workforce administration — ideally somewhere that involved real scale, strict deadlines, or a workforce with cross-border or compliance complexity.

- Experience working with foreign worker documentation, work permits, residence permits, or employment compliance processes.

- A genuine ability to operate without a finished playbook. If "there's no process for this yet" makes you anxious rather than interested, this isn't the right role.

- High attention to detail that holds up under volume and pressure — the documentation has legal weight, and the standard shouldn’t drop with rapidly increasing volume.

- Good judgment about what to decide yourself and what to escalate. This role only works if you can be trusted with ambiguity — and trusted to know your own limits within it.

- Fluency in Croatian (C1-C2) and professional level in English (B2-C2) are a requirement. Given the courier population arriving from abroad, comfort working through language and documentation barriers is a real asset — additional languages (Spanish, for instance) are a plus but not requirement.

- Ability to work in a hybrid model from our Zagreb office (4 office days, Wednesday optional work-from-home day).

What we offer

Most HR operations roles ask you to run a process well. This one asks you to build the process while running it, for a workforce that's about to grow faster than the current setup was designed for, in a market where the team is small and knowledge is yet to be mapped to documentation. You will work with a team of experts in multiple countries, giving you a unique chance to influence our strategies, standards and ways of working while constantly learning something new.

If it sounds like the kind of challenge you would enjoy solving, and if you are inspired by the potential of directly impacting the experience of hard working individuals establishing themselves in a new country, this will be a great opportunity for you.

Please note that this is a fixed-term contract until Dec 31st 2026, with a possibility to extend to a permanent contract. We’re expecting you to be able to start working with us during August-early September.

Additional benefits:

- Health insurance

- A sport benefit (PassSport)

- A tax-free commuter benefit

- A monthly lunch benefit

- Wolt Credits Cashback program

- Access to the Employee Assistance Program (free, confidential mental health support) and the Cuckoo wellness app

Next steps

Please submit your application and resume in English.

The hiring process includes conversations with the talent acquisition partner, hiring managers and a practical assignment with a final cross-functional discussion.

We’re now looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our EU-based Computing Platform team. What you’ll be doing

This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of platform strategy, people leadership, and execution. You’ll lead a team building core capabilities that help engineers ship business logic without owning the burden of running services themselves. Success in this role means growing a strong team, driving clear priorities, and delivering platform improvements that make the Computing Platform easier for developers, and safer, faster and more reliable to use at massive scale.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, creating clarity, strong execution habits, and a healthy engineering culture.

- Own the team’s roadmap and delivery across core Computing Platform areas such as performance, scaling and resource management, I/O optimization, integrations, developer experience, and observability.

- Partner closely with adjacent platform teams and product domains onboarding to Pedregal, turning their needs into platform capabilities and smoother adoption paths.

- Guide architectural and technical decisions for the Computing Platform runtime and developer-facing APIs, balancing reliability, simplicity, and long-term extensibility.

- Raise the bar on operational excellence by improving reliability, debuggability, and support for teams running production workloads on the Computing Platform.

- Help shape the next phase of the Computing Platform as a foundational platform for Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash through hiring, prioritization, cross-team alignment, and org leadership.

Our humble expectations

- At least 3+ years of solid experience as an engineering manager, including directly leading and growing a team of engineers in a fast-paced environment.

- At least 5+ years of strong background in backend, infrastructure, product or platform engineering, and good technical judgment when working with distributed systems, runtime platforms, or developer-facing infrastructure.

- You know how to turn an ambitious platform vision into clear priorities, pragmatic execution plans, and reliable delivery.

- You’re comfortable working across team boundaries and partnering with engineering, product, and platform stakeholders to drive alignment and adoption.

- You care deeply about people leadership and know how to coach engineers, create clarity, and build a healthy, high-performing team culture.

- You hold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and operational excellence, and can help teams navigate production challenges with calm and structure.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to lead a foundational platform team working on one of the most important backend building blocks. The Computing Platform is designed to simplify how engineers build and operate business logic at scale, and the work of this team has the potential to influence developer productivity, system reliability, and platform adoption across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.

You’ll get to work on meaningful engineering leadership challenges with broad scope: growing a strong team, shaping technical direction, and helping define how mission-critical compute platform evolves as more domains onboard. If you’re excited by high-leverage platform work, complex distributed systems problems, and the chance to have impact far beyond a single product surface, this is a rare role to step into.

Hledáme parťáky a parťačky do provozu Wolt Marketu na zkrácený úvazek! 💪🏻

Wolt Market je členem Wolt platformy. Máme vlastní kamenné výdejny, ale zákazník se k nám nepodívá - nakoupí si online přes Wolt aplikaci. My objednávku zpracujeme a předáme do rukou kurýra, který se postará o její rychlé doručení.

Jsme super kolektiv, rádi se spolu smějeme, řešíme cokoliv na place nastane a vzít za práci nám není cizí. 🩵

Co budeš mít na starost:

- Příjem a evidenci produktů do provozovny.

- Kompletaci objednávek a jejich předávání kurýrům.

- Udržování pořádku.

- Práci s interním systémem (PC/tablet).

- Zlepšování procesů v denním provozu.

- Když si vzájemně sedneme, můžeš se brzy stát vedoucím směny a rozšířit si záběr o koordinaci práce na dané provozovně; odbavení dodavatelů při příjmu/reklamacích atd.

Naše skromná očekávání:

- Rychle se učíš a multitasking ti není cizí.

- Máš proaktivní, pro-zákaznický, prostě “can-do” přístup.

- Poradíš si s technikou (umíš používat chytrý telefon a notebook).

- Je za tebe okay pracovat během dne, v noci, o víkendu i ve svátek.

- Umíš plynule česky slovem i písmem (B2/C1).

- Máš základy angličtiny (pro navigaci v našich systémech).


Na co se můžeš těšit:

- Počáteční mzdu 140 - 150 CZK / hodina (dle zkušeností).

- Možnost rychlého růstu na pozici vedoucího směny (v řádu týdnů/měsíců) a s ním spojené vyšší platové ohodnocení.

- Smlouvu na částečný úvazek.

- Slevy na všechny nákupy přes Wolt aplikaci.

- Multisport kartu.

- Pohodovou, přátelskou a uvolněnou atmosféru.

Nehledáme člověka, co všechno ví a zná. Jedna z našich hodnot je pokora a věříme, že každý z nás se může naučit cokoliv, když bude chtít. Proto se neváhej přihlásit, práce je vhodná pro každého.

Обращение ко всем командным игрокам - вы в поисках работы, которая изменит будущее розничной торговли? Если так, то добро пожаловать!

Мы активно набираем сотрудников в магазины Wolt Market в городах Алматы и Астана!

На данный момент открыты вакансии в следующих локациях:

-
Алматы: Горный Гигант, Mega Towers, Шевченко

-
Астана: Левый Берег, Правый Берег

У нас одна анкета на все точки магазинов — пожалуйста, при отклике обязательно выберите нужную точку, в которую вы хотите попасть. Это поможет нам быстрее связаться с вами и пригласить на следующий этап.

Описание должности

Wolt – тамақ жеткізу платформасымен танымал финдік технологиялық компания. Wolt 2017 жылы 4 елде және солтүстік елдердің 10 қаласында жұмыс істеді. Бүгінгі күнге біз 25 елде және 500-ден астам қалада 8000-нан астам адамнан тұратын командамыз, 29 миллионнан астам тіркелген пайдаланушыларға қызмет көрсетіп нарықта 50-ден астам Wolt Market дүкенін қамтимыз. Платформа экономикасы тұтынушылардың мейрамханалармен және саудагерлермен байланысу тәсілдерін өзгертіп жатқандықтан, біз жаһандық деңгейде құрған таңғажайып командалармен бұл саланың көшбасшысы болу мүмкіндігін мақсат етіп отырмыз.

Wolt Market - бұл әлемдегі жетекші ыңғайлылық пен ең жоғары тұтынушы тәжірибесін ұсынатын біздің жеке супермаркет - сіз есігіңізге жарық жылдамдығынанда тез азық-түлікке қол жеткізе аласыз! 🤩

Мы ищем сотрудников на полный и частичный рабочий день. Став частью нашей великолепной команды ты станешь сердцем нашей ежедневной работы онлайн магазина - твоей ответственностью будет чтобы все заказы собраны и упакованы правильно, чтобы затем передать нашим курьерам-партнерам (a.k.a героям доставки) или покупателям.

График работы зависит от магазина и заранее составляется на месяц:



Алматы

-
Шевченко / Mega Towers:Смешанные смены, в том числе:07:00–16:00, 09:00–14:00, 12:00–20:00, 17:00–23:00, 19:00–01:00, 22:00–07:00- Особенно важна готовность к утренним сменам с 07:00 и вечерним/ночным.

-
Горный Гигант:Вечерняя смена: 18:00–01:00 и 22:00–07:00, 4/3, 5/2 график. Утренняя смена: 07:00–16:00, 4/3, 5/2 график.

Астана

-
Правый берег:Возможные смены: 08:00–13:00 (частичная занятость с графиком 5/2), 08:00–17:00 и 02:00–08:00 (частичная занятость с графиком и фиксированными днями 2/2).

-
Левый берег:Основная смена: 17:00–02:00, 4–5 смен в неделю.



Вы будете частью веселой команды, которая переопределяет как должен выглядеть магазин и пока ваши коллеги делятся с вами шуткой, они так же гордятся местом в котором работают, потому что - как компания мы делаем обычные вещи необычайно хорошо!

Чем вы будете заниматься

- Принимать заказы через наше приложение.

- Собирать и упаковывать товары для передачи курьерам и покупателям.

- Обновлять нашу внутреннюю систему учета, отображающую актуальную информацию по составу и аллергенам.

- Поддерживать порядок и чистоту в магазине.

- Участвовать в ежедневном развитии магазина.

Наши ожидания

- Ты уверен в себе и тебе нравится работать в быстро изменяющейся обстановке.

- Ты проактивный и клиентоориентированный, у тебя хорошее внимание к деталям.

- Ты  быстро обучаешься - особенно когда дело касается технологий, а также мультизадачности.

- Командный игрок с хорошими коммуникационными навыками.

- Ты готов работать как днем, так и по вечерам в будние и выходные дни.

- Опыт работы в розничном магазине будет преимуществом.

- У тебя есть разрешение на работу в Республике Казахстан.

Что дальше

Если тебе понравилось все вышесказанное, ты не боишься ответственности, готов с головой погрузиться в работу с динамично растущей среде и ты хочешь стать частью невероятно амбициозной команды - то жми на кнопку!

Обращение ко всем командным игрокам - вы в поисках работы, которая изменит будущее розничной торговли? Если так, то добро пожаловать!

Описание должности

Wolt – тамақ жеткізу платформасымен танымал финдік технологиялық компания. Wolt 2017 жылы 4 елде және солтүстік елдердің 10 қаласында жұмыс істеді. Бүгінгі күнге біз 25 елде және 500-ден астам қалада 8000-нан астам адамнан тұратын командамыз, 29 миллионнан астам тіркелген пайдаланушыларға қызмет көрсетіп нарықта 50-ден астам Wolt Market дүкенін қамтимыз. Платформа экономикасы тұтынушылардың мейрамханалармен және саудагерлермен байланысу тәсілдерін өзгертіп жатқандықтан, біз жаһандық деңгейде құрған таңғажайып командалармен бұл саланың көшбасшысы болу мүмкіндігін мақсат етіп отырмыз.

Wolt Market - бұл әлемдегі жетекші ыңғайлылық пен ең жоғары тұтынушы тәжірибесін ұсынатын біздің жеке супермаркет - сіз есігіңізге жарық жылдамдығынанда тез азық-түлікке қол жеткізе аласыз! 🤩

Мы ищем сотрудников на полный рабочий день и частичную занятость. Став частью нашей великолепной команды ты станешь сердцем нашей ежедневной работы онлайн магазина - твоей ответственностью будет чтобы все заказы были  собраны и упакованы правильно, чтобы затем передать нашим курьерам-партнерам (a.k.a героям доставки) или покупателям.

Вы будете частью веселой команды, которая переопределяет как должен выглядеть магазин и пока ваши коллеги делятся с вами шуткой, они так же гордятся местом в котором работают, потому что - как компания мы делаем обычные вещи необычайно хорошо!

Чем вы будете заниматься

- Принимать заказы через наше приложение.

- Собирать и упаковывать товары для передачи курьерам и покупателям.

- Обновлять нашу внутреннюю систему учета, отображающую актуальную информацию по составу и аллергенам.

- Поддерживать порядок и чистоту в магазине.

- Участвовать в ежедневном развитии магазина и в других активностях стора.

Our humble expectations

- Ты уверен в себе и тебе нравится работать в быстро изменяющейся обстановке.

- Ты проактивный и клиентоориентированный, у тебя хорошее внимание к деталям.

- Ты  быстро обучаешься - особенно когда дело касается технологий, а также мультизадачности.

- Командный игрок с хорошими коммуникационными навыками.

- Ты готов работать как днем, по вечерам так и по ночам в будние и выходные дни.

- Опыт работы в розничном магазине будет преимуществом.

- У тебя есть разрешение на работу в Республике Казахстан.

Next steps

Если тебе понравилось все вышесказанное, ты не боишься ответственности, готов с головой погрузиться в работу с динамично растущей среде и ты хочешь стать частью невероятно амбициозной команды - то жми на кнопку!

We’ve grown significantly in the last three years, expanding our operations from just four countries across the Nordics, to 23 countries across Europe and Asia today. And we’re just getting started.

The role you are looking at is a part of Wolt Market - our very own grocery stores that deliver unprecedented convenience and world leading customer experience. People across Denmark can order their groceries and have them delivered within 30 minutes!

We are searching for full-time and part-time Grocery Associates to join our awesome team. In this role you are right in the heart of our day-to-day dark store operations. Beskrivelse av stillingen

Trives du med å jobbe i et dynamisk arbeidsmiljø, er du opptatt av god kundeservice og ønsker å arbeide i et morsomt og ungt team? Er du 16 år eller eldre? Dersom du svarer ja på dette - oppfordrer vi deg til å lese videre!

Rollen du leser om nå er en del av Wolt Market - våre egne matbutikker som leverer enestående convenience og verdens ledende kundeservice. Wolt Market er et fantastisk konsept - kunder kan bestille matvarer og få de levert i lynets hastighet!

Vi søker etter både heltids- og deltidsansatte Butikkmedarbeidere (Grocery Associates) til vårt fantastiske team i Wolt Market Bergen. Dersom du har fylt 16 år er du hjertelig velkommen til å søke jobb hos oss! I denne rollen vil du være en del av kjernen av vår daglige drift, du vil sikre at alle ordrene som kommer inn fra kunder er plukket og klare til å hentes av våre budpartnere.

Vår butikk er åpen 7 dager i uken og av denne grunn vil det bety at du må kunne jobbe både i helger og til ulike tider i løpet av Wolt Market sine åpningstider og leveringstider. Om du er en lagspiller, liker å jobbe selvstendig, og har god humor er du kanskje personen vi leter etter!

Hva du vil gjøre

- Ta imot bestillinger gjennom vår app

- Plukke og pakke dagligvarer og gi dem til budpartnere

- Varemottak av mat og forsyninger vi mottar fra leverandører

- Administrere våre interne systemer som inneholder nøyaktig informasjon om næringsstoffer og allergener

- Opprettholde orden og renslighet i butikken

Våre forventninger

- Du er proaktiv og rask-lærende med evnen til å multitaske

- Fleksibilitet med å jobbe i skift på kvelder, inkludert helger og helligdager - vår Wolt Market er åpen 07:00-00:00. Din arbeidstid vil være senest til 21:00.

- Du har rett til å jobbe i Norge.

Hva du får ved å bli med oss

- Wolt krediterer cashback-fordelen

- Ansatthjelpsprogram

- Wolt-dekkende treningsprogrammer

Høres dette spennende ut så langt?

Hvis du er gira på å jobbe i et miljø som er under rask vekst, du tar eierskap, og ønsker å jobbe i et ekstremt ambisiøst team, så klikk under for å søke slik at vi kan starte samtalen med deg!

Vi vil vurdere søknader kontinuerlig, så send inn applikasjon din så snart som mulig! 🚀

- Design, build, and scale reliable systems that power merchant experiences.

Scaling Kotlin Backend Development Podcast

Kotlin at Wolt

israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies.
