The Sustainability & Community Impact team at DoorDash works across our global brands — DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo — to advance the company's approach to the issues that matter most to our business, our communities, and the world we operate in. We sit within the Policy and Communications function and work closely with other teams on a daily basis.

We're hiring a Lead, Global ESG Reporting to build and lead DoorDash's global ESG reporting function from the ground up. This is a new role: the first dedicated strategic owner of ESG disclosures across the company. As regulations proliferate across jurisdictions (from the EU's CSRD to California's SB 253 to Australia's Modern Slavery Act), DoorDash needs someone to bring clarity, structure, and strategic thinking to a landscape that is growing in both volume and complexity.

The role spans more ground than a traditional ESG reporting function: alongside disclosure strategy and regulatory compliance, you'll own our GHG measurement program and Scopes 1 & 2 emissions strategy, and manage the growing volume of ESG data requests we receive from enterprise partners.

What you’ll be doing

You'll set the strategy, build the infrastructure, and become the internal expert on all things ESG reporting and disclosure.

- Own DoorDash's global strategy for ESG-related disclosures — determining how, when, and at what level of ambition we respond to mandatory regulations, voluntary frameworks, and reputational expectations across all jurisdictions including the EU, UK, US, Canada, and Australia

- Act as the internal expert and cross-functional DRI on ESG reporting, aligning Legal, Finance and Technical Accounting, IR, Communications, Policy, HR, and Operations around a coherent approach and holding the narrative and numbers together across all external-facing disclosures

- Build the reporting infrastructure, processes, and governance needed for the company to meet its disclosure obligations efficiently and consistently — establishing what doesn't yet exist and improving on what does

- Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise partner ESG data requests, building processes to address a growing volume of vendor questionnaires, framework-specific data fields, and merchant-facing disclosures in a scalable way

- Oversee GHG measurement — working closely with a measurement vendor, coordinating data collection across the business, and ensuring our approach is audit-ready as assurance requirements mature

- Own DoorDash's Scopes 1 & 2 emissions strategy — building a forward-looking plan to drive operational efficiency across our facilities

Our humble expectations

- Meaningful experience in ESG, sustainability reporting, compliance, or a closely related field — with hands-on ownership of major reporting frameworks such as CSRD/ESRS, TCFD, GRI, SASB, Modern Slavery, and/or CDP

- A genuine builder mindset: you've created reporting infrastructure or processes from scratch before, not just maintained what someone else built (and you're energized by that kind of work)

- Strong cross-functional influencer who can align stakeholders across Legal, Finance, IR, and Operations without direct authority, and who is comfortable being the person others look to for direction rather than waiting to be told what to do

- Excellent written communication skills — you can draft a regulatory disclosure, write an internal strategy memo, and brief a senior stakeholder, all with equal fluency and appropriate calibration to your audience

- A principled, business-grounded view of ESG: you take compliance seriously, bring genuine expertise to the space, and can advise leadership on where to invest and lead versus where meeting requirements is the right call

What we offer

This is a rare opportunity to build a new function and strategy, with real visibility across a global company. You'll be joining at an exciting moment: before the wave of regulatory requirements fully lands. The work is substantive and growing — from CSRD groundwork to enterprise partner data requests to our Scopes 1 & 2 strategy — and the cross-functional network you'll build (Legal, Finance, IR, Comms, Ops) means you'll have meaningful exposure from day one.

Next steps

Our process includes a short screener after resume review, followed by a series of interviews.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

- Motivate a high-performing local sales team to exceed ad revenue targets and customer acquisition and retention goals.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product development, marketing, and operations, to ensure sales objectives are met.

- Develop and implement sales processes and procedures to improve sales efficiency and effectiveness.

- Analyze sales performance metrics and provide regular updates to leadership on sales ROI and key trends.

- Negotiate and close advertising investment deals with a focus on revenue growth, product adoption, and customer engagement.

- with a proven ability to lead and motivate a high-performing sales team.

- Fluency in both Latvian and English.

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present to senior executives and clients.

- Excellent negotiation skills with a focus on win-win solutions.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform decisions.

- Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Demonstrated track record of successfully driving revenue growth through partnerships or ads.

- Excellent negotiation skills with a focus on win-win solutions.

What we offer

- An opportunity to be part of one of the fastest-growing media ecosystems in Europe

- Hands-on experience in digital advertising operations and campaign optimization

- A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

- The chance to make a tangible impact on partner success and Wolt’s advertising business

- Great benefits and clear opportunities for career growth

- 🚀Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup

- 🤩Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills

- 💪Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference

You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

- Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products

Role background

Are you eager to grow your HR career in an innovative global tech company where your work has a real impact? We're looking for a collaborative, detail-oriented HR professional to help deliver an outstanding employee experience across our Region East. If you enjoy solving complex people challenges, partnering with stakeholders, and continuously improving HR operations, we'd love to hear from you.

The People Team at Wolt consists of around 200 HR, Talent, Tech, Payroll and Talent Acquisition professionals located across Helsinki, Budapest, Copenhagen, Berlin, Tel Aviv, Athens, Tbilisi and more. We're a global People function, trusted by the teams we support and partner with every day.

We're now looking for a Regional HR Specialist to join our global People Team, based in Baku, Azerbaijan.

As our Regional HR Specialist, you'll own the employee lifecycle across our offices in Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan, while supporting broader HR initiatives across Region East. You'll partner closely with Team Leads, People Partners and employees to deliver excellent HR support, drive compliance, manage employee relations, and continuously improve our HR processes and service delivery.

What you'll be doing

- Provide expert guidance on complex HR questions (Tier 2), supporting employees across Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan.

- Support key annual HR programs, including performance reviews, compensation cycles and other People initiatives.

- Partner with People Partners and business leaders to resolve complex HR and employee relations matters.

- Lead and document employee relations investigations, ensuring fair, objective and legally compliant outcomes.

- Advise managers on HR policies, employment legislation and best practices, acting as a trusted HR partner.

- Monitor compliance with local labour legislation and internal policies, helping mitigate employment risks.

- Maintain accurate employee data in Workday and support employment contracts, HR administration and monthly payroll processes.

- Analyse HR data and identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting and employee experience.

- Design and deliver onboarding sessions and training for employees and Team Leads.

- Continuously improve HR processes, tools and ways of working across the region.

What makes you a great fit

- Experience working in HR, ideally within a multinational or fast-paced environment.

- Solid understanding of core HR practices, employee relations and employment legislation.

- Comfortable managing sensitive employee matters with professionalism, integrity and sound judgement.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify improvements and drive process excellence.

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to provide constructive challenge when needed.

- Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities independently.

- Comfortable working with HR systems (Workday experience is a plus) and using data to support decision-making.

- Fluency in Azerbaijani, English and Russian.

Why you'll love working with us

- Opportunity to grow your HR career in one of Europe's fastest-growing technology companies.

israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Über diese Rolle Wir haben unseren Service in Deutschland im August 2020 gestartet und in den letzten Jahren eine rasante Entwicklung auf dem Markt erlebt. Mittlerweile arbeiten wir mit mehreren tausend Restaurantpartnern in Berlin, München, Frankfurt, Köln, Hannover, Düsseldorf und Hamburg zusammen und expandieren weiter in neue Städte, Regionen und Geschäftsbereiche.

Bei Wolt fängt alles mit den Restaurants an. Gibt es keine Restaurants, gibt es keine Kunden – und gibt es keine Kunden, gibt es keine Kuriere. Der Restaurantbetrieb ist daher ein entscheidender Baustein für den Erfolg von Wolt in jeder Stadt und jedem Land. Unser Restaurantbereich gliedert sich in drei Abschnitte: Akquise, Onboarding und Support. Als Sales Team Lead (m/w/d) – Region Nord leitest du unsere Restaurantakquise und führst ein Team von Restaurant Partnership Managern.

Deine Aufgabe ist es, das Restaurantportfolio von Wolt zu verbessern, indem du die passenden neuen Lokale auf die Plattform holst und datenbasiert die Fokusbereiche identifizierst. Du nutzt deine umfangreiche Vertriebserfahrung, um Tools, Sparring und Coaching bereitzustellen, die Kompetenzen deines Teams auszubauen und dessen Leistung zu steuern. Zudem baust du einen starken Kommunikationsaustausch mit den Teamleads für Onboarding & Support auf, deren Team die von deinen Mitarbeitern akquirierten Partner einbindet.

Deine Aufgaben

-
Aufbau und Führung des Restaurant-Akquise-Teams in der Region Norddeutschland

-
Festlegen von Team-KPIs, Steuerung der Vertriebsleistung und Geben von Performance-Feedback

-
Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines Plans für das Vertriebsteam, um Lücken und Chancen im Markt gezielt anzugehen. Dazu gehört das Identifizieren von Restaurants, die perfekt zu Wolt passen, sowie das Erschließen potenzieller neuer Expansionsgebiete

-
Kontaktaufnahme und Beziehungsaufbau zu potenziellen Restaurant-Schlüsselpartnern sowie systematisches Management der Vertriebspipeline

-
Führen von Verhandlungen über Konditionen von Schlüsselpartnern und Verstehen der potenziellen Performance von Lokalen, um profitable Geschäftsbedingungen zu vereinbaren

-
Treffen fundierter geschäftlicher Entscheidungen, indem du deine Intuition durch Daten stützt

-
Schaffen eines positiven Arbeitsumfelds, das dem Team die Weiterentwicklung ermöglicht

-
Vorbildfunktion bei der Vorlebensweise der Werte und Verhaltensweisen von Wolt

Was wir bieten

-
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem dynamischen, internationalen Team

-
Ein schnell wachsendes Tech-Unternehmen mit vielen Karrieremöglichkeiten

-
Flache Hierarchien in einer familiären Start-up-Atmosphäre

-
Attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive Aktienoptionen

-
Rabatt auf Wolt-Bestellungen

-
Moderne Arbeitsausstattung

-
Verschiedene Softdrinks, Kaffee und Obst im Büro

-
Umfangreiche interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

-
Wöchentliche All-Hands-Meetings und regelmäßige Teamevents

-
Flexible Arbeitszeitregelung und 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub

-
Firmenwagen optional verfügbar

Qualifikationen

-
Nachweisbare Erfolge in einer Vertriebs-Führungsposition

-
Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Personalführung oder im Coaching im Außendienst (Field Sales)

-
Ausgeprägtes „Hunter“-Gen mit exzellenten Kommunikations- und Networking-Fähigkeiten

-
Echter Foodie mit guten Kenntnissen der lokalen Gastronomieszene

-
Hands-on-Mentalität und Eigeninitiative in einer flachen Organisation

-
Erfahrung in der Gastronomiebranche – insbesondere in Restaurants – ist ein Plus

-
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Warum bei Wolt arbeiten? Bei Wolt geht es darum, Dinge anzupacken und umzusetzen (Getting Things Done). Es wird dir hier wahrscheinlich gefallen, wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dich weiterentwickelst und von freundlichen, bodenständigen und ehrgeizigen Menschen umgeben bist.

Wir arbeiten hart daran, Städte zu besseren Orten zu machen, und es ist ziemlich cool zu sehen, wie wir jede Woche wachsen. Wenn du mit Leidenschaft Dinge aufbauen willst, die einfach… funktionieren, könnte Wolt genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Unser Engagement für Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit & Inklusion Wir möchten die unterschiedlichsten Menschen in unserem Team haben – Menschen wie du und ich und Menschen, die sich von dir und mir unterscheiden. Um mit vielfältigen Teammitgliedern zusammenzuarbeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer Herkunft, Lebenshintergrund, sexueller Orientierung, politischen Ansichten, Religion oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen – streben wir bewusst danach, allen die gleichen Chancen zu bieten, mit uns zu arbeiten. Wir sind überzeugt, dass vielfältige Teams die am besten durchdachten Entscheidungen treffen und Produkte auf die inklusivste Weise entwickeln.

Schließe dich uns heute an, um Wolt gemeinsam zu gestalten!

Bist du ein Vertriebsprofi mit fundierter Erfahrung im Management einer Sales Pipeline sowie in der Führung und Entwicklung eines Vertriebsteams? Hast du eine analytische und unternehmerische Denkweise und möchtest maßgeblich beeinflussen, wie Wolt sein Restaurantportfolio in Deutschland ausbaut? Wenn ja, dann lies bitte weiter!

Wenn du dich darauf freust, in einem wachstumsstarken Umfeld zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Teil eines extrem ehrgeizigen Teams zu sein, klicke unten, um dich zu bewerben und das Gespräch zu starten!

Wir prüfen Bewerbungen fortlaufend. Wenn klingt das nach einer Chance für dich? Dann bewirb dich noch heute!

Role background

Responsible for the Workplace Experience and Operations for a geographical region spanning 10 countries, our Workplace Managers combine People, Technology, and Space across Office and Serviced Office locations to create an exceptional workplace experience for our Employees, Visitors, Contractors and Courier Partners. Regional Workplace Managers support their direct reports (in country workplace managers) to perform at their best, providing guidance and oversight to ensure our workplaces’ functionality, comfort, safety, sustainability and efficiency; whilst ensuring that our office ‘hubs’ are properly set up for collaboration and focus as well as our smaller satellite locations without onsite staff appropriately situated, supported and well-equipped.

What you’ll be doing

- Lead a regional team of Workplace Managers & Workplace Coordinators in ensuring our workplace experience supports Wolt’s mission & values and team objectives are met.

- Setup and onboard new offices as Wolt expands in your region. Partner with business leads, local and global teams to ensure effective communication with landlords, internal and external stakeholders so that office projects in your region can be delivered on time and in accordance with both Wolt’s global standards and any local requirements.

- Ensure all sites within the regional portfolio are managed and maintained to a high standard and in compliance with local and global policies and guidelines.

- Build department policies and procedures in conjunction with Wolt’s Global Workplace and Facilities manager, complying with International Health and Safety Standards.

- Partner with South region teams such as Physical Security and Safety, Sustainability and People to provide office specific program roll outs for initiatives such as Health and Safety, Sustainability and DEI, Internal Events and Community.

- Partner with Integrated Facilities Management Vendors to ensure safe and compliant workspaces and that service level agreements are met. Conduct formal site condition inspections and work closely with responsible parties to ensure any deficiencies identified are resolved.

- Create and own the development of annual Opex budgets for your region, tracking and reporting on financial variance and operations expenses management.

Our Humble Expectations

- 8+ years previous experience, including regional-role experience, in Workplace or Facilities Management in a global organization within a fast-paced and high growth environment

- Bachelors or equivalent years of experience. Industry body qualifications  (IWFM, CFM or similar) are a bonus.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

- Strong leadership capabilities, proven experience to motivate and lead a team

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work with internal and external stakeholders

- A demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across departments and levels within a complex organization.

- Ability and willingness to travel in order to properly support all locations in-Region (especially during office relocations and openings)

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work autonomously in a fast-moving environment, strong relationship building and stakeholder management skills, and a true growth mindset to consistently learn and develop skills.

- Comfortable collaborating remotely and dynamically using digital tools such as GSuite, Slack and Zoom.

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Role overview:

As a Restaurant Offboarding specialist you will be  responsible for managing the end-to-end offboarding process for Merchants and venues, ensuring that each case is completed accurately, efficiently, and within the expected timelines.The role focuses on coordinating device returns, Merchant communication, inventory updates, invoicing preparation, and case closure, while maintaining accurate information across all relevant operational systems. The Offboarding Specialist works closely with Logistics, Hardware, Finance, Sales/Account Management, Support, and other internal stakeholders to resolve outstanding cases and ensure company-owned assets are successfully recovered.

Key Responsibilities:

- Manage the end-to-end merchant/venue offboarding process, from receiving the request through final closure.

- Review offboarding requests and validate information across relevant contracts, operational tools, and internal systems.

- Communicate with Merchants regarding device returns, including sending return instructions, reminders, and shipping labels.

- Track outstanding returns and proactively follow up with Merchants to ensure company-owned devices are recovered.

- Receive returned devices and ensure they are correctly unassigned/offboarded from inventory systems.

- Coordinate with Logistics, Hardware, Finance, Sales/AM, Support, and other internal teams to resolve offboarding cases.

- Manage cases involving lost, stolen, or unreturned devices according to internal guidelines.

- Prepare eligible cases for invoicing and coordinate with Finance regarding outstanding device charges.

- Update and maintain accurate information across Monday boards, Inventory, Ops tools, ticketing systems, and other relevant platforms.

- Ensure venues and devices are correctly removed/released from relevant systems once the offboarding process is completed.

- Maintain clear documentation and support improvements to offboarding SOPs, guidelines, and workflows.

Our humble expectations:

- 1-3 years of experience in operations, customer/merchant support, logistics, asset management, or a similar operational role.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage a high volume of cases simultaneously.

- Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working across multiple systems and handling device/inventory information.

- Strong written communication skills for Merchant and internal stakeholder communication.

- Comfortable working with ticketing systems, spreadsheets, operational tools, and workflow-management platforms.

- Ability to independently prioritize cases, follow up on outstanding actions, and escalate blockers when necessary.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Language Skills: Fluent written & spoken German (B2) & Good professional working English.

Nice to haves:

- Experience with device lifecycle or asset management.

- Experience with invoicing or Finance-related operational processes.

- Familiarity with Monday.com, inventory management systems.

israel.description:

israel.title: Retail Sales Manager (m/w/d) | Remote | Region München
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. Wolt ist im August 2020 als Land Nr. 23 offiziell in Deutschland an den Start gegangen! Was in Berlin mit der Gastronomie begann, hat sich rasant zu einer umfassenden Plattform für den lokalen Handel entwickelt.

Mittlerweile vernetzen wir zehntausende Kunden nicht nur mit großartigem Essen, sondern bringen den gesamten Einzelhandel direkt an die Haustür – von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln bis hin zu Non-Food-Sortimenten. Da wir den täglichen Bedarf unserer Kunden immer ganzheitlicher abbilden, freuen wir uns sehr, nun den nächsten Schritt zu gehen: Wir bauen unsere Aktivitäten im Retail-Segment deutlich aus und suchen Partner, die gemeinsam mit uns den Standard für modernen Quick Commerce definieren wollen.

Deine Hauptaufgaben bei Wolt

- Identifikation & Akquise: Du bist verantwortlich für das Sourcing der besten Retail-Partner der Stadt. Dein Ziel ist es, Supermärkte und führende Non-Food-Einzelhändler in München als Partner zu gewinnen und zu optimalen Konditionen auf die Wolt-Plattform zu bringen.

- Pipeline-Management: Du steuerst deine Sales-Pipeline eigenständig und baust belastbare Netzwerke zu Inhaber:innen sowie Geschäftsleiter:innen im Einzelhandel auf.

- Überzeugende Präsentation: Du positionierst Wolt als führende E-Commerce-Lösung. Dabei hörst du potenziellen Partnern aktiv zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und überzeugst Entscheidungsträger durch passgenaue Mehrwerte.

- Präsenz vor Ort: Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Außendienst. Deine Woche besteht aus ca. 1–2 Tagen strategischer Planung und Kaltakquise (Home Office) sowie 3–4 Tagen im Außendienst in München (inkl. gelegentlicher Hotelübernachtungen).

- Schnittstellenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team zusammen, um eine perfekte Abbildung deiner Partner – vom Supermarkt bis zum Blumenladen – auf unserer Plattform sicherzustellen.

Das bringst du mit

- Vertriebsprofi im Außendienst:Du bringst bereits 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sales mit und liebst die Kaltakquise. Es motiviert dich, Partner proaktiv vor Ort zu besuchen und zu überzeugen.

- Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst souverän auf Augenhöhe – vom Blumenladen bis zum C-Level-Entscheider. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.

- Performance-Drive: Du willst der Beste sein und die Top-Retail-Partner der Stadt für Wolt gewinnen, um unseren Marktanteil signifikant auszubauen.

- Selbstorganisation: Du planst deine Walk-in-Routen effizient, trackst deine Aktivitäten eigenständig und steuerst deine Pipeline absolut zuverlässig.

- Positives Mindset: Du bist hartnäckig, denkst lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei Gegenwind deine positive Ausstrahlung.

- Qualifikation & Sprache: Studium oder Ausbildung, fließendes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was wir dir anbieten

- Remote-Arbeit & Firmenwagen: Diese Position ist als Remote-Rolle ausgeschrieben. Dein Einsatzgebiet befindet sich innerhalb eines 50-km-Radius rund um München. Für deine Außendiensttätigkeit erhältst du einen Firmenwagen.

- Gestalte die Zukunft des Handels: Wir verändern, wie Menschen einkaufen. Dein Job ist es, den lokalen Handel so effizient zu machen, dass unsere Kunden Zeit für Wichtigeres gewinnen, anstatt sie in Warteschlangen im Supermarkt zu verbringen.

- Wachstum & Impact: Nutze die steile Lernkurve eines globalen Tech-Unternehmens und entwickle unseren Markt in München auf das nächste Level.

- Eigenverantwortung: Arbeite selbstständig in einem dynamischen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und direktem Einfluss auf den Markterfolg.

- Mobilität & Equipment: Du erhältst Top-Hardware (iPhone & MacBook) sowie die Option auf einen Firmenwagen für deine Einsätze im Außendienst.

- Wolt-Benefits: Rabatte auf Wolt-Bestellungen, ÖPNV-Zuschuss sowie Wellness-Angebote (z. B. Urban Sports Club).

- Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein modernes Office im Herzen von München.

Die Vergütung für diese Position beginnt bei einem On-Target-Earnings (OTE) von 67.000 € und ist in einem Verhältnis von 60 % Fixgehalt zu 40 % variabler Vergütung strukturiert.

Bereit, mit uns Geschichte zu schreiben?

Wir verändern nicht nur den Handel – wir geben den Menschen Zeit für das zurück, was sie wirklich lieben. Wenn du in einem High-Growth-Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen willst und ein Team suchst, das Ambition mit Spaß verbindet, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bewirb dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam den Markt revolutionieren!

Wichtiger Hinweis: Um deine Daten bestmöglich zu schützen (GDPR), akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze ausschließlich unsere Karriereseite für deine Bewerbung. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

At Wolt, you can grow your sales career with a fun and fast-scaling global business. Part of the DoorDash team, we’re building a global logistics platform that can deliver (almost) everything in your city, to your door in minutes. Today, our products are used by 55+ million registered users who can now order from 200,000+ restaurants and retail stores across 30+ countries around the world.

Our Sales teams create and build relationships with merchants and businesses. Together, we’ve helped big brands, local stores and neighborhood restaurants do over €15 billion’s worth of business through our platform. We’re constantly launching new cities and products, so there are always new opportunities to expand your skills and progress your career.

Now, with Wolt Wholesale, we’re bringing the speed and convenience of Wolt to the way businesses buy the products they need to run their day-to-day operations. Wolt Wholesale makes it possible for restaurants and other businesses to order wholesale products and have them delivered within 60 minutes.

Wolt Wholesale is a startup within Wolt. We’re building something completely new, and as a small team we work in a highly entrepreneurial way: testing, learning, moving fast and figuring things out as we go. That means you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact on how we build the business — and as Wolt Wholesale grows, there will be plenty of opportunities to grow your responsibilities and career along with it.

We’re looking for a Sales Associate to help us introduce Wolt Wholesale to more businesses, turn them into active customers and build lasting relationships with our growing customer base. If you enjoy talking to customers, are comfortable picking up the phone or getting out into the city, and get motivated by seeing your work translate directly into new customers and orders, we’d love to chat!

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Proactively reach out to potential Wolt Wholesale customers through phone calls, emails, in-person visits and other relevant channels.

- Introduce restaurant owners and other businesses to Wolt Wholesale and clearly communicate the value of having wholesale products delivered within 60 minutes.

- Guide interested customers through the simple Wolt Wholesale sign-up process and make it as easy as possible for them to get started.

- Follow up with prospects and newly signed-up customers to help turn interest and registrations into first orders and active customers.

- Manage and develop a portfolio of existing Wolt Wholesale customers, building relationships and making sure our service stays top of mind when they need to restock.

- Grow our core customer base by increasing the number of active and returning customers as well as the GOV they generate.

- Systematically build, manage and prioritize your sales pipeline to reach your acquisition, activation and account growth targets.

- Learn what resonates with different customers, handle questions and objections, and continuously improve how we pitch Wolt Wholesale.

- Spend time in the market meeting restaurants and businesses, building relationships and understanding their purchasing needs and habits.

- Work closely with the wider Wolt Wholesale team, sharing customer feedback and insights that can help us improve our proposition and accelerate growth.

- Use data and sales activity to understand what works, identify opportunities and focus your efforts where they can have the biggest impact.

- Contribute beyond your immediate sales responsibilities when needed. As part of a small, entrepreneurial team building a new business, we all roll up our sleeves and help solve problems along the way.

Our humble expectations

- You are early in your sales career — perhaps a recent graduate or with up to 1 year of experience in sales, outreach, hospitality, support, retail or another customer-facing role.

- You enjoy speaking with customers and are comfortable proactively reaching out to people you haven’t spoken with before.

- You have a commercial mindset and can communicate a simple value proposition in a clear, convincing and engaging way.

- You are persistent and have a natural “hunter” mentality. You enjoy working towards targets, following up and finding new ways to turn potential customers into active ones.

- You also enjoy building longer-term customer relationships and finding ways to grow existing accounts — not just winning new ones.

- You have a can-do attitude and are ready to roll up your sleeves in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

- You enjoy entrepreneurial environments where not everything has been figured out yet. You’re comfortable trying things, learning quickly and taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description.

- Building relationships comes naturally to you. You can quickly understand what matters to a restaurant or business owner and adapt your conversation accordingly.

- You are structured and good at managing your time and pipeline while keeping track of many customer conversations at once. Experience with CRM tools is an advantage.

- You are tech-savvy, curious and a quick learner.

- Experience within the restaurant, hospitality or HoReCa industry is a plus, but not a must.

- You are fluent in Danish and English, both verbal and written.

Why you’ll love it

- 🚀 Global company, startup opportunity: Get the best of both worlds — the pace, ownership and entrepreneurial environment of a startup, backed by Wolt and DoorDash.

- 🤩 Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build strong B2B sales and account management skills.

- 💪 Instant impact: See a direct connection between your work and the customers and orders you bring to Wolt Wholesale.

- 💙Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people who enjoy building things together.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an ambitious team building a new business within Wolt, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

- Samarbejde med resten af salgsteamet om at forbedre salgsmetoder og dele best practices

- Træffe solide forretningsbeslutninger baseret på både data og din kommercielle intuition

- Du er en ægte hunter med minimum 3 års dokumenteret erfaring indenfor B2B-salg

- Du trives i et performanceorienteret miljø, hvor du sætter ambitiøse mål og fejrer succeser sammen med teamet

- Du har en can-do attitude og trives i et tempofyldt miljø

- Du er en stærk kommunikator og har solid kommerciel forståelse

- Du taler og skriver flydende dansk og engelsk (bemærk; dine første interviews vil være på engelsk)

- Erfaring med CRM-systemer (fx Salesforce eller Pipedrive) er en fordel

- Kendskab til hotel-, restaurant- eller detailbranchen er et plus

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver en del af et dynamisk og erfarent salgsteam bestående af 8 Sales Managers, hvoraf 5 er baseret i København og 3 i Aalborg, som alle arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af Danmark. Teamet består af engagerede Sales Managers, der alle brænder for at skabe vækst for vores partnere – og for at gøre Wolt til det foretrukne valg for både restauranter og retailbutikker.

Hos Wolt får du:

- En rolle med stort ansvar og indflydelse, hvor dine resultater kan ses direkte på væksten

- Et stærkt fællesskab med ambitiøse og hjælpsomme kolleger

- Muligheden for at blive en del af en hurtigt voksende international virksomhed, der kombinerer lokalt kendskab med global rækkevidde

- Et kulturmiljø præget af tillid, frihed og ejerskab, hvor du kan udvikle dig fagligt og personligt

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så ansøg allerede i dag.
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte [indsæt navn / titel].

Bemærk: Vi accepterer ikke ansøgninger via e-mail af hensyn til GDPR. Ansøg venligst via vores karriereside.

About the role

We’re expanding our business in Denmark and are looking for a Sales Manager to join our experienced sales team in Copenhagen.

As a Sales Manager, you’ll play a key role in growing Wolt in Denmark by acquiring new restaurant and retail partners to our platform. You’ll own the entire sales process - from the first contact to a signed agreement - and be an essential part of our continued expansion.

You’ll reach out to potential partners via phone and email to book meetings - and then visit them in person to present Wolt and build strong, lasting relationships.

What you’ll be doing

- Manage your own portfolio of potential partners, driving outreach and systematic follow-ups

- Book and conduct meetings with restaurants

- Work primarily out of Copenhagen while covering all of Zealand to expand Wolt’s presence across our cities

- Plan your time efficiently and be flexible to travel - with 1-2 overnight stays per month when needed to cover your area effectively

- Negotiate commercial terms and ensure a smooth handover to our Partner Onboarding Team

- Collaborate closely with the rest of the sales team to share best practices and continuously improve our sales approach

- Make sound business decisions based on both data and your commercial intuition

What we’re looking for

- A true hunter with a proven track record in B2B sales (minimum 3 years)

- Someone who thrives in a performance-driven environment, setting ambitious goals and celebrating success together

- A can-do attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced setting

- Strong communication skills and solid commercial understanding

- Fluent in Danish and English (note: your initial interviews will be conducted in English)

- Experience working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce or Pipedrive) is a plus

- Experience within the hospitality, restaurant, or retail industry is an advantage

Who we are

You’ll be part of a dynamic and experienced sales team of 8 Sales Managers - 5 based in Copenhagen and 3 in Aalborg and 5 Inside Sales Associates - working closely together across Denmark. Our team is driven, collaborative, and passionate about helping our partners grow and making Wolt the preferred choice for both restaurants and retail stores.

What Wolt offers

At Wolt, you’ll get:

- A role with significant ownership and impact, where your results directly contribute to our growth

- A supportive and ambitious team culture, built on trust and collaboration

- The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing international company, combining local expertise with global reach

- A culture of freedom, ownership, and development, where you can grow both personally and professionally

Sales Manager
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Are you motivated by building new business and taking ownership of your results?
At Wolt, we are looking for a  Sales Manager who thrives on proactive outreach, values structure and enjoys turning opportunities into signed partnerships.

Wolt’s mission is to make cities better places to live through technology. Since 2014, we have expanded to 30 countries and serve more than 40 million users. From restaurants to retail and Wolt Market, we are building the everything app that brings the best of your city straight to your door.

At Wolt, the Sales Manager plays a key role in growing our business and strategically building a market-leading offer for our customers by signing new merchant partners. The Sales Manager becomes an expert within their assigned area, geographically and/or functionally, and manages a pipeline of small to medium-sized restaurant and retail partners.

The Sales Manager applies strong commercial thinking to identify the most relevant partners across various verticals and uses excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills to demonstrate the value Wolt brings to the industry and to merchants. As the primary local representative for SMB sales in Iceland, the Sales Manager develops a deep understanding of the local market, identifies high-potential partnership opportunities, and contributes to the growth and development of Wolt's SMB merchant portfolio.

The Sales Manager works closely with local commercial teams, regional stakeholders, and colleagues across Wolt to support the execution of Wolt’s commercial strategy and strengthen Wolt’s position across relevant merchant segments. In addition, the Sales Manager takes ownership of strategic sales projects and initiatives that contribute to Wolt’s growth and profitability while acting as a role model for more junior team members through knowledge sharing and best-practice development.

This individual works closely with stakeholders in Iceland, Norway, and across Wolt globally and always acts in Wolt’s best interests.

What You Will Be Doing:

- Define and develop a local market sales strategy to meet objectives set by the management team, strategically identifying high-potential partnerships and applying data and logic to assess potential partner performance and unit economics.

- Contribute to Wolt’s overall sales strategies to accelerate market entry in new markets and strengthen Wolt’s position in existing markets.

- Develop a deep understanding of the competition and retail verticals in the market, knowing the structure of each vertical and identifying which players are “must-haves” for Wolt.

- Act as the primary local representative for SMB sales in Iceland, building strong market expertise, identifying growth opportunities, providing local market insights, and collaborating with local commercial teams and regional stakeholders to drive merchant acquisition and support Wolt’s commercial objectives within the SMB segment.

- Target new partners in line with company strategy to meet strategic and operational objectives within the assigned geographical and/or functional scope.

- Build and systematically manage a pipeline of new potential partnerships, tailoring the approach to position Wolt as a partner of choice.

- Work with new potential partners and manage the full sales cycle, including researching leads, prospecting, conducting meetings and market visits, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

- Apply data-driven decision-making and strong commercial judgment to evaluate opportunities, assess market potential, and optimize partner performance.

- Own and lead projects and initiatives that contribute to Wolt’s growth and market position, working collaboratively with Sales and other relevant functions.

- Contribute to capability development within the Sales team by mentoring junior team members and helping build a best-in-class sales organization.

What We Are Looking For:

- A strong track record in B2B new sales and field sales, ideally combined with knowledge of the restaurant and/or retail industry.

- Demonstrated ability to juggle multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Experience with CRM tools is an advantage.

- Proven experience in setting direction for sales initiatives.

- A natural hunter with the drive to build a merchant portfolio and overcome bottlenecks and objections.

- Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build relationships and tailor commercial offerings to each partner.

- Strong communication, negotiation, networking, and presentation skills.

- A strategic mindset with the ability to prioritize time and resources toward the highest-potential opportunities.

- Strong analytical capabilities and an ability to understand sales metrics, commission structures, market potential, and commercial performance.

- A proactive, self-motivated, and solutions-oriented approach combined with a strong sense of ownership.

- A collaborative team-player who enjoys sharing knowledge and supporting the development of colleagues.

- Tech-savvy, curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

- Fluency in Icelandic and English is required to connect effectively with local merchant partners. Norwegian is considered an advantage when collaborating with regional stakeholders.

KPIs the Employee Will Be Measured Against:

- Monthly and quarterly sales targets.

- Penetration targets in assigned areas.

- Market-leading selection breadth and depth within assigned areas.

- Excellent pipeline management and active use of CRM tools and systems.

- Venue commission levels within agreed ranges.

KPIs may vary over time as business needs evolve. Each project or initiative may also have its own specific KPIs.

Why This Role Is Important:

The Sales Manager is a key contributor to Wolt’s continued growth and market leadership in Iceland. Through strong commercial execution, strategic market understanding, and effective partnership development, the role helps strengthen Wolt’s merchant ecosystem, improve customer choice, and drive sustainable business growth across the market.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

israel.title: Sales Manager - Wolt for Work
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, you can grow your sales career with a fun and fast-scaling global business. Part of the DoorDash team, we’re building a global logistics platform that can deliver (almost) everything in your city, to your door in minutes. Today, our products are used by 55+ million registered users who can now order from 200,000+ restaurants and retail stores across 30+ countries around the world.

Our Sales teams create and build our relationships with merchants. Together, we’ve helped big brands, local stores and neighborhood restaurants do over €15 billion’s worth of business through our platform. We’re constantly launching new cities and products, so there are always new opportunities to expand your skills and progress your career.

As our new Sales Manager, Wolt for Work, you'll play a key role in growing our B2B Wolt for Work business across Croatia. Working with companies of all sizes - from startups and SMBs to large enterprises - you'll focus on winning new partnerships, growing existing ones, and helping more businesses benefit from Wolt for Work.

This is a highly autonomous role where you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, working closely with regional and cross-functional teams while driving the growth of Wolt for Work in your local market. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of Wolt for Work in Croatia by helping establish the commercial strategy and bringing one of Wolt’s fastest-growing products to more businesses.

What you'll be doing

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

- Generate new business opportunities through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic account targeting.

- Maintain a high-quality CRM pipeline, keeping opportunities updated and ensuring accurate forecasting.

- Develop account strategies for key prospects and manage multiple stakeholders throughout the buying journey.

- Own the full sales cycle, managing consultative sales processes and long sales cycles from first conversation to launch.

- Build trusted relationships with partners of all sizes - from startups and SMBs to large enterprises - and identify opportunities to grow those partnerships over time.

- Build relationships with HR, Finance, Procurement and senior business stakeholders.

- Represent Wolt for Work in the local market, proactively identifying new commercial opportunities and helping grow the business.

- Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure a smooth partner experience from signing through launch.

- Manage your pipeline, negotiate commercial agreements, and use data to support business decisions.

Success in this role means:

- Consistently achieving monthly sales targets

- Building a healthy sales pipeline

- Delivering an exceptional customer experience

- Growing Wolt for Work adoption across Croatia

Our humble expectations

- Experience selling B2B solutions rather than transactional products.

- Comfort managing sales cycles of 1-6 months with multiple stakeholders.

- Confidence engaging HR, Finance, Procurement and C-level executives.

- Strong pipeline management and CRM discipline.

- Data-driven decision making and forecasting.

- High activity levels in outbound prospecting.

- Are fluent in English and Croatian.

Why you’ll love it

- 🚀Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup

- 🤩Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills

- 💪Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference

- 💙Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

Next steps

Learn more about Wolt for Work.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, add your CV, and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. If this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!  💙

That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

At Wolt, we’re all about great partnerships – and that starts with great people. We’re now looking for a Senior Account Manager to take on one of the most strategically important roles within our Danish restaurant team. If you’re commercially sharp, analytically strong, and motivated by solving complex challenges in close collaboration with your partners, this could be the role for you.

In this role, you’ll be trusted with a portfolio of nationally recognized brands, each with ambitious goals, multi-layered decision-making structures, and large operational footprints. You’ll be responsible for unlocking their full potential on Wolt by building strong relationships, running sophisticated campaigns, and making data-driven decisions that drive both growth and profitability.

You’ll join a team of 10 Account Managers who support and challenge each other every day. We celebrate wins, share learnings, and enjoy solving problems together – whether that’s out in the field with a partner or over a coffee at the office. If you enjoy taking ownership and being part of a humble yet ambitious team, we think you’ll feel right at home.

But don’t just take our word for it – see for yourself what your future colleagues say about working at Wolt here.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Account Manager, you’ll be the primary point of contact for a number of large enterprise accounts. You’ll work across multiple layers of each organisation – from central decision-makers to regional managers and local stores – with a focus on long-term growth and operational excellence.

You’ll plan and execute advanced promotional campaigns, lead commercial negotiations, and use data to optimize every aspect of partner performance. In addition to managing your portfolio, you’ll help shape internal tooling and best practices that support the broader enterprise AM community.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Own a small but commercially significant portfolio of restaurant enterprise accounts end-to-end

- Lead negotiations and strategic planning in collaboration with senior internal and external stakeholders

- Drive adoption of relevant Wolt products such as Wolt+, Wolt Ads, Wolt Drive, and Wolt Capital

- Analyse partner performance in depth – from conversion rates to delivery efficiency – and turn insights into concrete actions

- Collaborate cross-functionally with teams like Marketing, Operations, Analytics, and Product to ensure smooth execution of partner plans and bring feedback from the field into internal roadmaps

- Build tools, frameworks, or workflows that support smarter decision-making within your team and across the region

- Tailor your approach to different organisational layers, from headquarters to local store operators

Our humble expectations

We’re looking for someone who combines commercial sharpness, analytical depth, and strong interpersonal skills – and who’s motivated by solving complex challenges.

- Strategic commercial thinking – You understand what drives partner performance and profitability, and you can develop win-win plans that balance long-term growth with short-term impact

- Advanced analytical skills – You’re highly comfortable navigating BI tools like Looker or Excel, building your own performance views, and using data to guide negotiations, campaigns, and optimisations

- Ownership mindset – You take full responsibility for your portfolio, push projects forward without being asked, and proactively solve problems when roadblocks appear

- Process builder – You enjoy improving how things work – whether through creating internal tooling, building a new report, or refining the way we engage with partners

- Experience – You likely have 3+ years in account management, strategy, consulting, or commercial roles with enterprise exposure

- Languages – You’re fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken

What we offer

At Wolt, we believe great people thrive when given ownership, trust, and the chance to make an impact. As a Senior Account Manager, you’ll get exactly that – along with a competitive salary and the opportunity to grow in a fast-moving global tech company with plenty of career paths.

On top of that, you’ll get a competitive salary, Wolt discounts, daily lunch, and a well-stocked office with coffee, soft drinks, and fruit – plus a range of local benefits.

Now we are looking for two experienced Senior Analytics Engineers to join our Analytics Engineering teams (Consumer or Merchant domain). You can work in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki.

The role is focused on the business needs - you’ll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses.

Who We Are

Global Marts builds the technology behind DoorDash's own grocery and retail operations across DashMart, Wolt Market, and Deliveroo Hop.

Our systems decide what products our stores stock, how much inventory to purchase, which vendors to source from, how warehouses execute orders, and what prices customers see.

We build everything from forecasting and replenishment systems to vendor management, warehouse execution, labor scheduling, space optimization, and pricing. Our in-house forecasting platform has replaced third-party solutions and now powers production globally.

This isn't a traditional CRUD backend environment. Much of our work involves designing new systems that solve complex operational problems at global scale.



What You'll Do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll work primarily with Go or Kotlin and take end-to-end ownership of production systems and complex technical initiatives.

You'll:

- Design, build, and operate backend systems that support inventory, purchasing, warehouse operations, pricing, and fulfillment.

- Own technical solutions from problem definition and design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operation.

- Work on data-heavy systems where software engineering meets forecasting, optimization, and operational decision-making.

- Turn complex and sometimes ambiguous business problems into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions.

- Make and influence architectural decisions, balancing scalability, reliability, development speed, and long-term maintainability.

- Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams to shape solutions and technical direction.

- Improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and operational excellence of the systems you own.

- Support and raise the engineering standards of the team through technical discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

- Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while applying strong engineering judgment to validate their output, improve development velocity, and identify opportunities where AI can create additional leverage.



How We Work

- Autonomy & Ownership: Engineers have end-to-end responsibility for their services, from design and implementation to production and on-call.

- Collaboration: Architecture and technical direction are shaped together. Senior engineers are expected to contribute actively to decisions and help others arrive at strong solutions.

- Scalability & Simplicity: We value pragmatic solutions that solve today's problems while providing a sustainable foundation for tomorrow.

- Impact: We work closely with Product, Data Science, and Operations, connecting technical decisions directly to real-world retail and operational outcomes.



Our Tech Stack

Our primary backend languages are Go and Kotlin.

We also use Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, GitHub Actions, and modern cloud infrastructure.

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We're more interested in strong backend and distributed systems fundamentals and your ability to learn and make sound technical decisions.



Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who:

- Have strong experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems.

- Have professional experience with Go, Kotlin, or another modern backend language.

- Have experience owning services end-to-end, including design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, reliability, and production operations.

- Have strong knowledge of backend and distributed systems fundamentals, including APIs, databases, asynchronous processing, failure handling, testing, and observability.

- Are comfortable working with data-heavy systems and technologies such as Kafka, Snowflake, or similar streaming and data infrastructure.

- Can navigate ambiguous problems, break them into actionable steps, make appropriate technical trade-offs, and deliver incrementally.

- Can influence technical decisions beyond their immediate tasks and collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional partners.

- Communicate technical concepts and decisions clearly and concisely.

- Use AI-assisted development tools effectively in their everyday engineering workflow while critically evaluating generated solutions and taking full ownership of the resulting code and technical decisions.

- Look for opportunities to use AI to improve engineering productivity and solve problems more effectively, while understanding where human engineering judgment remains essential.



Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following is a plus:

- Forecasting, optimization, scheduling, recommendation, or decisioning systems.

- Grocery, retail, logistics, supply chain, or warehouse technology.

- ERP, vendor management, procurement, or workforce management integrations.

- Replacing third-party or legacy platforms with internally built systems.

- High-throughput event-driven or streaming architectures.



Why Join Us?

You'll help build the technology that powers DoorDash's global grocery and retail business, solving complex operational challenges across inventory, forecasting, fulfillment, pricing, and supply chain.

You'll have significant ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence technical direction while working closely with experienced engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams across multiple markets.

📍 This role is based in our tech hub in Helsinki or Stockholm. We work in distributed teams, but may not be able to support fully remote work or relocation.



Next Steps

We're reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

You can read more about our recruitment process here.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.



What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

- Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.

- Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.

- Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.

- Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.

- Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.

- Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.

- Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.

- Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.



How We Work

- Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.

- Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.

- Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

- Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.



Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.



Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

- An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

- Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.

- Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.

- Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

- Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.

- The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.

- Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.



Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

- Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.

- Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.

- Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.

- Integrations with external business systems.

- Kafka or other streaming technologies.

- Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

You’ll plan and execute advanced promotional campaigns, lead commercial negotiations, and use data to optimize every aspect of partner performance. In addition to managing your portfolio, you’ll collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of partner plans and bring feedback from the field into internal roadmaps. You will think 'outside the box' to identify and execute unconventional opportunities that drive sustainable impact, even when they fall outside standard playbooks .

- Own the most commercially significant portfolio of restaurant enterprise (Tier1) accounts

- Design and execute multi-quarter growth roadmaps for your portfolio, moving beyond reactive fixes to achieve long-term strategic scaling

- Lead commercial negotiations in collaboration with senior internal and external stakeholders

- Orchestrate complex, multi-solution plans where the full suite of Wolt products (Wolt+, Ads, Drive, Storefront) works in synergy to achieve specific partner KPIs

- Deep dive into complex data sets to uncover hidden patterns, root causes, and growth opportunities that inform every proposal and experiment

- Collaborate cross-functionally with teams like Marketing, Operations, Analytics, and Product to ensure smooth execution of partner plans and bring feedback from the field into internal roadmaps

- Work with colleagues across other countries and HQ teams to ensure a unified approach and execution for accounts that are present in multiple markets

- Tailor your approach to different organisational layers, from headquarters to local venues

Our humble expectations

We’re looking for someone who combines commercial sharpness and strong interpersonal skills – and who’s motivated by solving complex challenges.

- Experience - You likely have 4+ years in account management, customer success, or commercial roles with enterprise exposure

- Commercial Sharpness - Strong understanding of P&L drivers and unit economics, with a proven ability to lead high-stakes negotiations that result in win-win growth

- Analytical Rigor - A data-savvy mindset with the ability to translate complex data challenges into clear, actionable business insights for senior-level stakeholders

- AI experience - You are not afraid of incorporating AI tools into your day-to-day work and more complex analysis to both optimise your workload and gain unique insights

- Interpersonal and presentation skills - You excel at presenting with clarity and confidence, and you build trusted, long-lasting relationships with senior stakeholders

- Ownership mindset & Persistence - You take full responsibility for your portfolio, push projects forward without being asked, and proactively solve problems when roadblocks appear. You don’t give up easily and can follow through with multi-month solutions

- Languages - You’re fluent in Azerbaijani, English and Russian

What we offer

- An opportunity to work in a fast-growing tech company with a startup mindset

- The chance to make a significant impact on the growth and success of our restaurant partners.

- A supportive and inclusive team culture that values innovation and continuous improvement.

- Opportunities for personal and professional development within a global organization.

Why you’ll love it

- 🚀Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup

- 🤩Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills

- 💪Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference

- 💙Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

Next steps

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV and get the conversation going!

Are you an experienced legal professional with a passion for international commercial and compliance topics? Does working in a very global and fast-paced environment sound like something you’d get a kick out of? If so, then we’d love to have a chat!

We are now looking to hire an experienced Senior Legal Counsel to provide legal support across commercial and compliance topics in a number of countries in the Central region of Wolt that comprises various countries primarily in Central Europe.

We’re looking for someone who’s not afraid of digging into different kinds of legal issues and understands the Wolt way of doing things: a problem solver and a solution-oriented business enabler. In this role, you will be providing proactive legal advice to several of our country teams, with a primary focus on commercial and compliance topics. You will be bringing your deep expertise and drive the legal support in negotiations and contracting of complex deals in your area. You would be supporting the regional functions and you will provide guidance on legal and other topics. Depending on your level of expertise and aspirations, you  may also be given additional responsibility areas as the business needs and the team continue to evolve. The regulation concerning our industry is changing rapidly and we need more hands on deck to help us navigate it as we scale. Our ideal candidate is not only an expert in legal topics, but also someone who is curious and eager to learn and wants to be part of creating something new and who utilizes AI to work smarter and deliver results.

You will work closely with our global Legal team members across Wolt and Deliveroo, as well as others, such as the Public Policy team, regional and country management, commercial, business development, finance and operations teams.

We’re primarily looking for the person to join our team at our offices in Budapest, however other key Wolt locations in the region are not out of the question if our dream candidate is based elsewhere in the region.

What You’ll Be Doing

- As Wolt’s Senior Legal Counsel, you’ll support Wolt’s business and handle legal and compliance topics over various countries in the Central region.

- You will be the first point of contact and trusted advisor for our business stakeholders and management in the region and countries you are responsible for.

- Assessing and managing risks while supporting the business.

- Being in charge of expertise related to the regulatory landscape for Wolt’s operations in defined countries and ensuring compliance with regulations.

- Having a key role in contract negotiations with our merchants and other business partners.

- Working on the continuous development of contracting practices and related processes.

- Proactively identifying areas for improvement and finding solutions.

Qualifications

- 7+ years of legal experience as an in-house counsel and/or from a law firm in an international setting. In-house experience is considered as an advantage.

- Master of Laws degree from a reputable university in the EU, preferably from a university from the relevant region. An additional LL.M. degree from the US or another country is a plus, but not a requirement.

- Ability to push the boundaries of what is achievable by using AI to work faster, smarter, and more scalably to deliver results.

- Interest in taking on a generalist legal role with a very broad range of tasks.

- Experience in working in close cooperation with internal and external legal teams and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Commercial mindset, generalist skills and strong expertise with a solutions-driven can-do attitude are an absolute must.

- Our ideal candidate has a deeper knowledge in several legal fields relevant to our business, e.g. general contract law, e-commerce, consumer protection and competition law.

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

- The type of person who rolls up their sleeves and gets to work.

- Fluency in English AND Hungarian is a must. Other languages are a plus.

- Willingness to travel.

Additional Information

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join Event Streaming team — the distributed team responsible for the Kafka infrastructure and event streaming systems that power business-critical workflows across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.

You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of Platform Engineering and Reliability Engineering, building and running the streaming backbone that is used by thousands of services across 3 companies. This is deeply technical work: you'll own distributed systems at scale, contribute to long-term architecture decisions, and be working on the reliability of critical parts of infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, in-house Event Streaming abstraction (internally called Event Bus) and any future streaming platform technologies. These systems support critical workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Design, build and operate large-scale, event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.

- Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, Event Bus and related streaming components.

- Debug complex distributed systems issues — latency issues, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, partition imbalances — and drive them to resolution.

- Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.

- Contribute to the team’s 24/7 On-call rotation and incident response, and drive continuous improvement through pre-mortems, operational readiness checklists and post-mortem action items.

- Partner closely with other teams within Storage organization and wider Core Infrastructure org, like SRE, Data Platform, and Caching teams across EU and US regions — including occasional collaboration in the EU evening hours.

- Shape the long-term architecture and evolution of our event streaming platform, contributing to RFCs and technical strategy.

What You'll Need to Thrive

- Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

- Deep experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.

- Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar — with the emphasis on building reliable, production-grade systems and libraries.

- Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.

- Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.

- Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.

- Strong communication and writing skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Nice to have

- Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

- Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.

- Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.

- Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.
