israel.title: Operations Associate - Distribution Center, Cherry Hill
israel.description:
Gopuff is seeking Operations Associates (OAs) to join the Distribution Center team. Reporting to an Area Manager, you will play an essential role in our Distribution Center that requires drive, positivity, and enthusiasm for the challenge. You will complete a variety of warehouse responsibilities including receiving and loading product, operating equipment, cleaning, and sorting.

Customers turn to Gopuff to provide their everyday essentials—day and night, rain or shine. We're assembling a team of thinkers, dreamers and risk takers who are ready to help us reshape the world of retail faster than ever before. And it doesn't hurt if you like snacks.

You Will:
-Load and unload freight
-Operate manual and electric material handling equipment such as hand jacks
-Move product to storage area with proper equipment and stack and store merchandise
-Process orders including picking, checking, sorting, and consolidating freight, wrapping pallets, packing loading and shipment confirmation of customer orders.
-Checks and verifies freight for accuracy and damageRecord information such as weight, time, and date packaged
-Observe all safety procedures and promote a safety culture
-Ensure the Standards of Conduct policy is followed to provide a safe and inclusive work environment
-Assist Area Manager and Leads with all warehouse tasks when delegated

You Have:
-High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
-1+ years of warehouse, logistics, military, or equivalent experience
-General working knowledge of basic web-based software applications (e.g. Google G-Suite)
-Be able to lift up to 49 lbs.

We care about our team and want to make sure you know what to expect:
-Handle, scan and move product in a safe and well-organized manner
-Stand, push, pull, squat, bend, reach and walk during shifts
-Use carts, pallet jacks, dollies and other equipment to move product
-Lift up to 49 poundsHandle products that may contain tobacco, nicotine, and/or alcohol
-Work in freezer locations periodically throughout shifts

#LI-DNP

israel.title: Operations Associate,  Port Richmond, #290
israel.description:
Gopuff is looking for Operations Associates (OAs) to join the operations team. Directly reporting to a Site Leader, OAs play an essential role at Gopuff that requires drive, perseverance, positivity, and enthusiasm for the challenge. You will accomplish a variety of operations responsibilities including picking, packing, receiving product both within our site and accompanying kitchen (if applicable), and working with our partner drivers.

Customers turn to Gopuff to provide their everyday essentials—day and night, rain or shine. We're assembling a team of thinkers, dreamers and risk takers who are ready to help us reshape the world of retail faster than ever before. And it doesn't hurt if you like snacks.

Responsibilities:
-Pick and pack items for dispatch to customers
-Receive and unpack pallets of product from vendors, ensure physical inventory count matches purchase order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies
-Manage inventory and re-shelving of canceled orders
-Clean and organize sales floor and overall facility
-Manage waste and spoilage through strict compliance with FIFO practice
-Contact customer for substituted or out-of-stock items
-Handle, scan and move product in a safe and well-organized manner
-Stand, push, pull, squat, bend, reach and walk during shifts
-Use carts, pallet jacks, dollies and other equipment to move product
-Handle products that may contain tobacco, nicotine, and/or alcohol
-Work in freezer locations periodically throughout shifts
-Capability to walk several flights of steps periodically throughout the day
-Prepare quality beverages and food menu items for all customers by observing all recipes and presentation standards
-Ensure accuracy of all food and beverage packaged for delivery
-Follow health, safety and sanitation guidelines for all products
-Receive and put away order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies when they do not match expiration requirements
-Maintain Kitchen Facility organization and standards to ensure resources can be accessed while managing waste and spoilage through mindful pouring and food preparation
-Prepare, package and stage/handoff orders

Qualifications:
-High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
-Experience working in a restaurant or retail environment (preferred, not required)
-The ability to work a fluid schedule and be available during peak shifts (1st, 2nd, 3rd shifts)
-General working knowledge of basic web-based software applications (e.g. Google G-Suite)
-Stand and walk for the duration of an assigned shift
-Lift up to 49 pounds
-Available to work flexible hours that may include mornings, evenings, weekends, nights and holidays

#LI-DNP

Directly reporting to a Site Leader, OAs play an essential role at Gopuff that requires drive, perseverance, positivity, and enthusiasm for the challenge. You will accomplish a variety of operations responsibilities including picking, packing, receiving product both within our site and accompanying kitchen (if applicable), and working with our partner drivers.

Customers turn to Gopuff to provide their everyday essentials—day and night, rain or shine. We're assembling a team of thinkers, dreamers and risk takers who are ready to help us reshape the world of retail faster than ever before. And it doesn't hurt if you like snacks.

Responsibilities:
-Pick and pack items for dispatch to customers
-Receive and unpack pallets of product from vendors, ensure physical inventory count matches purchase order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies
-Manage inventory and re-shelving of canceled orders
-Clean and organize sales floor and overall facility
-Manage waste and spoilage through strict compliance with FIFO practice
-Contact customer for substituted or out-of-stock items
-Handle, scan and move product in a safe and well-organized manner
-Stand, push, pull, squat, bend, reach and walk during shifts
-Use carts, pallet jacks, dollies and other equipment to move product
-Handle products that may contain tobacco, nicotine, and/or alcohol
-Work in freezer locations periodically throughout shifts
-Capability to walk several flights of steps periodically throughout the day
-Prepare quality beverages and food menu items for all customers by observing all recipes and presentation standards
-Ensure accuracy of all food and beverage packaged for delivery
-Follow health, safety and sanitation guidelines for all products
-Receive and put away order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies when they do not match expiration requirements
-Maintain Kitchen Facility organization and standards to ensure resources can be accessed while managing waste and spoilage through mindful pouring and food preparation
-Prepare, package and stage/handoff orders

Qualifications:
-High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
-Experience working in a restaurant or retail environment (preferred, not required)
-The ability to work a fluid schedule and be available during peak shifts (1st, 2nd, 3rd shifts)
-General working knowledge of basic web-based software applications (e.g. Google G-Suite)
-Stand and walk for the duration of an assigned shift
-Lift up to 49 pounds
-Available to work flexible hours that may include mornings, evenings, weekends, nights and holidays

#LI-DNP

You will accomplish a variety of operations responsibilities including picking, packing, receiving product both within our site and accompanying kitchen (if applicable), and working with our partner drivers.

Customers turn to Gopuff to provide their everyday essentials—day and night, rain or shine. We're assembling a team of thinkers, dreamers and risk takers who are ready to help us reshape the world of retail faster than ever before. And it doesn't hurt if you like snacks.

Responsibilities:
-Pick and pack items for dispatch to customers
-Receive and unpack pallets of product from vendors, ensure physical inventory count matches purchase order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies
-Manage inventory and re-shelving of canceled orders
-Clean and organize sales floor and overall facility
-Manage waste and spoilage through strict compliance with FIFO practice
-Contact customer for substituted or out-of-stock items
-Handle, scan and move product in a safe and well-organized manner
-Stand, push, pull, squat, bend, reach and walk during shifts
-Use carts, pallet jacks, dollies and other equipment to move product
-Handle products that may contain tobacco, nicotine, and/or alcohol
-Work in freezer locations periodically throughout shifts
-Capability to walk several flights of steps periodically throughout the day
-Prepare quality beverages and food menu items for all customers by observing all recipes and presentation standards
-Ensure accuracy of all food and beverage packaged for delivery
-Follow health, safety and sanitation guidelines for all products
-Receive and put away order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies when they do not match expiration requirements
-Maintain Kitchen Facility organization and standards to ensure resources can be accessed while managing waste and spoilage through mindful pouring and food preparation
-Prepare, package and stage/handoff orders

Qualifications:
-High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
-Experience working in a restaurant or retail environment (preferred, not required)
-The ability to work a fluid schedule and be available during peak shifts (1st, 2nd, 3rd shifts)
-General working knowledge of basic web-based software applications (e.g. Google G-Suite)
-Stand and walk for the duration of an assigned shift
-Lift up to 49 pounds
-Available to work flexible hours that may include mornings, evenings, weekends, nights and holidays

israel.title: Operations Associate, State College
israel.description:
Gopuff is looking for Operations Associates (OAs) to join the operations team. Directly reporting to a Site Leader, OAs play an essential role at Gopuff that requires drive, perseverance, positivity, and enthusiasm for the challenge. You will accomplish a variety of operations responsibilities including picking, packing, receiving product both within our site and accompanying kitchen (if applicable), and working with our partner drivers.

Customers turn to Gopuff to provide their everyday essentials—day and night, rain or shine. We're assembling a team of thinkers, dreamers and risk takers who are ready to help us reshape the world of retail faster than ever before. And it doesn't hurt if you like snacks.

Responsibilities:
-Pick and pack items for dispatch to customers
-Receive and unpack pallets of product from vendors, ensure physical inventory count matches purchase order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies
-Manage inventory and re-shelving of canceled orders
-Clean and organize sales floor and overall facility
-Manage waste and spoilage through strict compliance with FIFO practice
-Contact customer for substituted or out-of-stock items
-Handle, scan and move product in a safe and well-organized manner
-Stand, push, pull, squat, bend, reach and walk during shifts
-Use carts, pallet jacks, dollies and other equipment to move product
-Handle products that may contain tobacco, nicotine, and/or alcohol
-Work in freezer locations periodically throughout shifts
-Capability to walk several flights of steps periodically throughout the day
-Prepare quality beverages and food menu items for all customers by observing all recipes and presentation standards
-Ensure accuracy of all food and beverage packaged for delivery
-Follow health, safety and sanitation guidelines for all products
-Receive and put away order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies when they do not match expiration requirements
-Maintain Kitchen Facility organization and standards to ensure resources can be accessed while managing waste and spoilage through mindful pouring and food preparation
-Prepare, package and stage/handoff orders

Qualifications:
-High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
-Experience working in a restaurant or retail environment (preferred, not required)
-The ability to work a fluid schedule and be available during peak shifts (1st, 2nd, 3rd shifts)
-General working knowledge of basic web-based software applications (e.g. Google G-Suite)
-Stand and walk for the duration of an assigned shift
-Lift up to 49 pounds
-Available to work flexible hours that may include mornings, evenings, weekends, nights and holidays

#LI-DNP

Gopuff is looking for Operations Associates (OAs) to join the operations team. Directly reporting to a Site Leader, OAs play an essential role at Gopuff that requires drive, perseverance, positivity, and enthusiasm for the challenge. You will accomplish a variety of operations responsibilities including picking, packing, receiving product both within our site and accompanying kitchen (if applicable), and working with our partner drivers.

Customers turn to Gopuff to provide their everyday essentials—day and night, rain or shine. We're assembling a team of thinkers, dreamers and risk takers who are ready to help us reshape the world of retail faster than ever before. And it doesn't hurt if you like snacks.

Responsibilities:
-Pick and pack items for dispatch to customers
-Receive and unpack pallets of product from vendors, ensure physical inventory count matches purchase order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies
-Manage inventory and re-shelving of canceled orders
-Clean and organize sales floor and overall facility
-Manage waste and spoilage through strict compliance with FIFO practice
-Contact customer for substituted or out-of-stock items
-Handle, scan and move product in a safe and well-organized manner
-Stand, push, pull, squat, bend, reach and walk during shifts
-Use carts, pallet jacks, dollies and other equipment to move product
-Handle products that may contain tobacco, nicotine, and/or alcohol
-Work in freezer locations periodically throughout shifts
-Capability to walk several flights of steps periodically throughout the day
-Prepare quality beverages and food menu items for all customers by observing all recipes and presentation standards
-Ensure accuracy of all food and beverage packaged for delivery
-Follow health, safety and sanitation guidelines for all products
-Receive and put away order/invoice, and resolve discrepancies when they do not match expiration requirements
-Maintain Kitchen Facility organization and standards to ensure resources can be accessed while managing waste and spoilage through mindful pouring and food preparation
-Prepare, package and stage/handoff orders

Qualifications:
-High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
-Experience working in a restaurant or retail environment (preferred, not required)
-The ability to work a fluid schedule and be available during peak shifts (1st, 2nd, 3rd shifts)
-General working knowledge of basic web-based software applications (e.g. Google G-Suite)
-Stand and walk for the duration of an assigned shift
-Lift up to 49 pounds
-Available to work flexible hours that may include mornings, evenings, weekends, nights and holidays

#LI-DNP

israel.title: Overnight Barista, Key Holder, Ballard, #523
israel.description:
BevMo! by Gopuff is seeking an Overnight Key Holder - Starbucks Standards Leader for our Ballard location. This is primarily an overnight retail key-holder role, with the added responsibility of working in and helping maintain standards within the store's Starbucks operation. The position supports safe, secure and efficient overnight operations and steps into the Starbucks workstream to prepare orders, protect product quality, reinforce routines and coach to established standards.
This role is not a full Starbucks supervisor position. It does not independently own staffing, scheduling, formal performance management or full shift deployment. The team member serves as a trusted on-shift standards resource, escalates concerns to the appropriate leader and helps keep both BevMo! and Starbucks operations ready for the next day.

israel.title: Payroll Administrator
israel.description:
Join Gopuff as a Payroll Administrator where you will make sure that all of our staff receive on-time paychecks and understand their salaries thoroughly. You will audit and verify all time keeping records of employees’ hours worked as well as any deductions or withholdings required to comply with state and federal law. As part of the People & Culture, you will report to the Payroll Manager and partner with accounting. We recognize that people come from diverse backgrounds and skills and welcome all to apply.
This is a hybrid position, reporting to the Philadelphia, PA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday during local business hours.

israel.title: Senior Associate Category Manager, Beer
israel.description:
The Sr. Associate Category Manager will work with the designated Category Director to drive, support, and maintain our brand and customer experience by driving product sales through price optimization, promotional planning, assortment productivity, cost negotiations, and product placement for the BevMo Brick & Mortar businesses. We are looking for an individual that is opportunistic, customer-focused and that is capable of partnering with cross-functional teams (ie. Supply Chain, Marketing, Planning, Business Development, and Digital Merchandising) to surpass financial objectives. It will be imperative that this person demonstrates the problem-solving and analytical skills necessary to thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
This is a hybrid position reporting to the Concord, CA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday during business hours.

israel.title: Senior Category Manager - Drinks
israel.description:
The Senior Category Manager for Drinks will be responsible for managing the P&L, assortment, pricing and marketing of the Drinks department across Gopuff and BevMo.  We are looking for an individual with working knowledge of the regulated industry that is an opportunistic and product-focused Merchant capable of partnering with cross-functional partners (i.e. Supply Chain, Distributors, Suppliers, Legal, and Digital Merchandising) to be a part of bringing to life a compelling assortment for our customers.  A strong analytical background is imperative to be able to analyze data and pricing to influence strategy.  It will be imperative that this person demonstrate the problem-solving and analytical skills necessary to thrive in a fast paced and entrepreneurial environment.
Gopuff takes pride in creative problem solving and in-person collaborating to make quick and informed decisions. This role will have a hybrid work schedule, where you will be able to showcase your creativity and build strong relationships with teams in a cross functional manner three days a week (Tuesday - Thursday) in our Philly or Miami office!

israel.title: Senior Director of Fresh Grocery (Produce, Meat & Seafood)
israel.description:
The Senior Director of Fresh Grocery (Produce, Meat & Seafood) serves as the strategic leader and full P&L owner for one of our most strategic and highly visible categories. Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, this role is responsible for driving the growth, profitability, and end-to-end execution of our fresh grocery business.
This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional leadership position requiring seamless orchestration across Merchandising, Field Operations, Pricing, Marketing, and Supply Chain. The ideal candidate will bridge corporate category strategies with field execution, overseeing everything from complex vendor relations and pricing architectures to instore merchandising, quality control, and strategic marketing programs.

israel.description:
Gopuff is an innovative and rapidly evolving company operating at the intersection of technology, retailing and last-mile fulfilment in the grocery delivery space. We are dedicated to redefining the way products are delivered to customers, leveraging cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

As a Site Leader of a Gopuff Micro Fulfilment Centre (MFC), you will play a pivotal role in delivering best-in-class customer order fulfilment. This is a fast-paced role within Gopuff, which requires drive, grit, great attention to detail and people-first focus. If you are a results-oriented, customer-centric leader with a deep passion for the retail and logistics industry, we warmly invite you to apply and become an integral part of our team.

Why Deliveroo?

Deliveroo’s mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We obsess about building the future of food, whilst using our network as a force for good. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.

Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build an engineering career, driven by impact. Firstly, the impact that working here will have on your development, allowing you to grow faster than you might elsewhere; secondly, the impact that you can have on Deliveroo, leaving your mark as we scale; and finally, being part of something bigger, through the impact that we make together in our marketplace and communities.

The Role

Working as part of our analytics engineering team and reporting to one of our Analytics Engineering Managers, your role will be to provide clean, tested, well-documented and well-modelled data sets, that will enable and empower data scientists and business users alike, via tools like Snowflake and/or Looker.

You'll work with product engineering teams to ensure modelling of source data meets downstream requirements.

You will maintain and develop SQL data transformation scripts, and advise and review data scientists on data modelling to achieve denormalised and aggregated output datasets.

You'll work with data scientists and other analytics engineers to surface clean, intuitive datasets in our BI tool, Looker.

You will be responsible for optimisation and further adoption of Looker as a data product in the business, catering to ~1500 current active users who need to discover and interact with data.



Skillset

Required

- 6+ years Analytics Engineering / Data Engineering / BI Engineering experience

- Excellent SQL skills

- Understanding of data warehousing, data modelling concepts and structuring new data tables

- Knowledge of cloud-based MPP data warehousing (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)

Nice to have

- Experience developing in a BI tool (Looker or similar)

- Good practical understanding of version control

- SQL ETL/ELT knowledge, experience with DAGs to manage script dependencies

- Python coding skills, particularly in the areas of automation & integrations

- Good knowledge of the Looker API

At the same time, we need to continuously enhance and communicate to customers the overall value we deliver.

Success in this role will require building excellent working relationships across Deliveroo, be a confident self-starter and have an ability to influence and make things happen.

- Working closely with Product, Data Science and the local markets to identify opportunities to improve our Consumer Pricing processes and algorithms

- Conducting in-depth performance and competitor analysis to understand trends and inform our price positioning

- Developing and presenting pricing insights and recommendations to key Exec decision makers

- Delivering and owning price changes end-to-end, from insight and proposal development to go-to-market launch and iteration

- Supporting the weekly and monthly pricing reporting cycles to senior stakeholders

Requirements

- 7+ years experience working in a Pricing/Commercial/Consulting/Strategy role

- Comfortable working with data to build business proposals; analysing and visualising data to identify and communicate key insights and opportunities (working knowledge of SQL preferred but not essential)

- A proactive, can-do attitude, full of great ideas and proven track record in making things happen - delivering results quickly and efficiently

- Good communicator and collaborator with a passion for building strong relationships and working cross-functionally

israel.title: Junior Business Development Manager - Lazio
israel.description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER (LAZIO) — 12-MONTH FTC

About the role

We are looking for a Business Development Manager based in Lazio

This is a rare opportunity to become a founding and important member of a growing, well-funded company. You'll collaborate with Italy's most premium and regarded restaurants.

As a member of the regional sales team, you will report to the Sales Lead, and your role will focus on developing new relationships with restaurants and stores.

This position is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract.

What you'll be doing

- Map, prospect, pitch and close new restaurants across your region in an organised fashion. This means being an area-level expert, including knowing the up-and-coming restaurants and which restaurants customers crave most

- Support partners in joining Deliveroo, providing the best experience to them

- Communicate (physical visits, email, calls, or social media) with restaurants to demonstrate Deliveroo technology

- Help restaurant owners/managers overcome any barriers or hesitations

- Attend restaurant and food meet-ups



Requirements

- You must be comfortable with targeting new business and have Sales Experience

- The job requires confidence or experience dealing with partners/customers, whether it be face-to-face, by phone, or email

- Experience in demonstrating product and industry knowledge to clients

- You will need to be comfortable with negotiations

- Fluent Italian (mandatory) + good command of English (nice to have)

- Knowledge of the restaurant industry is a significant plus

- You will need to be tenacious



Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.



OUR GLOBAL STRUCTURE

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

COMPENSATION

- National Collective Agreement (CBA): CCNL Commercio e Terziario

- Classification Level: Livello 4

The total target compensation (OTE (On-Target Earnings, ovvero la retribuzione totale prevista al raggiungimento del 100% degli obiettivi) for this role is €35,200 – €44,000 gross per year, of which the base salary range is €17,200 – €26,000. The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed above and is determined based on a number of job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.

This position is not eligible for consideration for an equity/RSU grant.

To learn more about our benefits, please do not hesitate to bring this up with your Talent Acquisition Partner!

DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

israel.title: Senior Corporate Security Engineer
israel.description:
Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer, you will lead the design and operation of security controls that protect our internal networks, workforce identities, endpoints and corporate systems. You will be working globally with security teams across US, EU and APAC, delivering against our goals and objectives - reducing risk and maturing controls.



As a Senior, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will define technical direction, make architectural decisions, and deliver complex security initiatives end-to-end. You will be expected to balance risk reduction with usability, ensuring controls are robust without impeding employee productivity.

This role focuses on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint security (EDR), Network Security, logging and detection engineering, and secure SaaS enablement. You will work closely with IT, Legal, Privacy, Engineering and business stakeholders to embed security as a default practice across the organisation.



Security controls will be aligned to recognised frameworks such as the CIS Critical Security Controls and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Architecture & Control Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain core corporate security controls, including phishing-resistant MFA, Just-In-Time (JIT) access, strict role-based access control (RBAC), zero-trust architectures, device and identity bound proofing and modern network isolation.

- Tooling Ownership: Serve as the technical owner for a broad suite of corporate security systems, managing deployments, configurations, and API integrations for tools across the corporate environment.

- Technical Leadership: Lead and implement the technical strategy for Endpoint Device trust, Data Loss Prevention, Intellectual property storage, and SaaS application security. Alongside wider corporate security technical controls.

- Automation & Engineering: Write scripts and build tools to automate security workflows, incident response tasks, and audit evidence collection for compliance.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with IT and business operations to integrate security tools into everyday workflows. Guide non-security teams to adopt secure baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) as standard practice.

- Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, and help improve the team's engineering standards.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

- 5+ years’ experience in Security Engineering, Corporate Security, Detection & Response, or a related field.

- Hands-on experience administering IAM platforms (e.g. Okta, GoogleWorkspace).

- Deep hands-on experience with GoogleWorkspace products

- Practical hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (e.g AWS, GCP)

- Relevant and practical experience with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g Terraform)

- Experience implementing modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect).

- Practical experience securing macOS, Windows and Linux endpoints using MDM and EDR/XDR tooling.

- Experience operating SIEM and/or SOAR platforms and tuning detection logic.

- Experience with vulnerability management and patch governance.

- Ability to write production-quality automation scripts.

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives.



DESIRABLE SKILLS

- Experience with SASE or Zero Trust Network Access platforms.

- Hands on experience deploying applications into K8 and Docker environments

- Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS security governance.

- Advanced detection engineering or SOAR playbook development.

- Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

- Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, GIAC).



Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

israel.title: Vendor / Category Manager - Deliveroo Hop UAE
israel.description:
Vendor / Category Manager - Deliveroo Hop UAE

Deliveroo Hop is Deliveroo's 24/7 supermarket - a digital-only experience that allows customers to shop online for all of their groceries, ingredients, household essentials & more, on-demand, and delivered to them in minutes.

Role Overview:

As Vendor / Category Manager, you will be responsible for the performance of a category within Deliveroo Hop. Working closely with the Vendor Management Lead, you will play a key role in shaping the category strategy through range selection, sourcing, pricing, cost and contract negotiations, promotions, merchandising and marketing campaigns, as well as managing the vendors within that category. We are looking for a candidate with a strong commercial mindset focused on driving growth and creative approach to problem solving.

You will be based in our Dubai office (DIFC), where we operate on a hybrid model (three days a week working in the office), and this role will report to the Senior Vendor Manager.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Category Management

- Support the Vendor Management Lead in selecting a great range of products and set pricing, as per selection and pricing principles and in line with the Deliveroo Hop CVP;

- Ensure the right SKUs are nominated for effective and efficient promotional campaigns and events;

- Monitoring SKU performance and optimising the range;

- Deep dive category performance vs plan and define and execute plans to drive improvement and sustainable growth;

Vendor Management

- Develop and manage relationships with local and international grocery suppliers;

- Negotiate contracts and agreements with vendors to ensure favourable terms and service levels;

- Analyse vendor performance and take corrective actions to improve service and quality.

- Manage vendor compliance and ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.

- Work closely with the in-stock team to source new products and maintain inventory levels.

- Resolve vendor-related issues and disputes and escalations including invoice, payment and account reconciliation with the vendors.

- Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new vendor & range opportunities.

- Drive media spend with vendors on the platform to promote products and enhance visibility.

Requirements

- 3+ years experience in vendor/category management or buying function (grocery experience would be a benefit but not requirement);

- An analytical and problem-solving mindset used to evaluate vendor and category performance and identify areas for improvement.

- Good negotiation skills and the ability to build strong partnerships with vendors;

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with internal teams and resolve vendor-related issues.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt to changing market dynamics;

- A proactive and results-driven approach to vendor management and procurement;

- Good knowledge of working on spreadsheets (Excel / Gsheets).

Desirable requirements

- Experience in international FMCG sourcing and sourcing of fresh categories to cater to diversity of offerings is a bonus.

- Knowledge of BI and data analytic tools like SQL, Tableau, Power BI, etc would be an added advantage.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

Our Analytics community is highly active, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes and a robust technical review process.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you’ll enable high-quality human-led decision-making to maximise impact.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Data Scientist at Deliveroo, your goal is to maximise business impact within one of our product areas. A core part of the role is designing, running and interpreting experiments, and using causal inference to guide product decisions in complex, real-world settings.

You will go beyond simply answering “did this feature work?” and instead focus on understanding what the true impact is, why it worked or did not work, and how results generalise across users, markets and time.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Driving Strategy/insights through Experimentation: Leading the design of both simple and complex experiments and proactively translating findings into strategic direction.

- Master Causal Inference: Apply advanced techniques to estimate long-term and heterogeneous treatment effects.

- Drawing reliable conclusions in settings with selection bias or imperfect randomisation.

- Drive Deep Product Insights: Uncover the fundamental drivers of experiment performance, determining why features succeed and how results generalise across different users, markets, and timeframes.

- Using insights from past experiments to improve future decision-making.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

- Strong experience designing, running and interpreting A/B experiments in production environments

- Solid understanding of causal inference concepts

- Ability to apply statistical thinking to messy, real-world product problems, not just ideal experimental setups

- Great communication skills in person, in writing and in code, with both technical and non-technical audiences

- A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

- Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

When you first think about Deliveroo, you probably think of getting great food delivered to your door in less than half an hour. But behind the scenes, there is a bigger story: one of high growth, exciting challenges, and a huge opportunity ahead.

- Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with a high-volume workload and short turnaround times.

- Support the Kuwait marketing team with creative design and motion graphics across campaigns, always delivering work that is on-brand and visually engaging.

- Help raise the standard of visual storytelling across marketing channels through strong motion design, layout, and creative execution.

- Interpret briefs clearly and translate campaign objectives into compelling visual assets.

- Maintain a strong understanding of Deliveroo’s brand guidelines, visual identity, and campaign style.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Support the Kuwait marketing team across all campaigns with design and motion graphics requirements.

- Create motion graphics for marketing campaigns, social media, CRM, owned channels, digital placements, and other campaign touchpoints.

- Interpret creative briefs and develop visual concepts that align with campaign objectives.

- Adapt campaign assets across different formats, channels, and audience needs.

- Work closely with the marketing and brand teams to ensure all visual assets are consistent with Deliveroo’s brand identity.

- Create static and animated assets using Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.

- Support the localisation of campaign visuals for the Kuwait market.

- Take feedback from stakeholders and revise creative work quickly and accurately.

- Organise and manage design files, templates, and campaign assets efficiently.

- Stay current with emerging design tools, AI-enabled creative workflows, and motion graphics best practices.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- At least 1 year of experience in a corporate, agency, or in-house creative environment.

- A strong portfolio showcasing both motion and static graphics work.

- Good working knowledge of Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop.

- Knowledge of Figma and experience adapting designs across digital formats.

- Strong understanding of visual design principles, layout, typography, colour, and composition.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects at once.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver polished work within tight deadlines.

- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn, experiment, and improve.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in graphic design, motion design, visual communication, multimedia design, or a related creative field.

- Experience working on marketing campaigns, social media content, or digital advertising assets.

- Experience working with local or regional Middle East brands is a plus.

- Interest in food, culture, social trends, and digital content.

- 30 days of annual leave

- Medical insurance

- Free Deliveroo Plus — free delivery and access to special offers

- Maternity and paternity benefits

- End-of-year parties and regular social events

- An extremely fun team to work with

CE QU’IL VOUS FAUT POUR RÉUSSIR

- Vous justifiez d'une première expérience dans la relation client, les opérations, le recrutement, l'événementiel ou dans un environnement dynamique (startup, entreprise technologique, plateforme de services, logistique, etc.).

- Vous aimez le contact humain et savez mettre vos interlocuteurs en confiance.

- Vous êtes organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et appréciez les missions de terrain.

- Vous faites preuve d'autonomie tout en appréciant le travail en équipe.

- Vous êtes capable de vous adapter rapidement à un environnement en constante évolution.

- Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils collaboratifs tels que Google Workspace, Slack ou Salesforce (la connaissance de Looker est un plus).

- La maîtrise du français est indispensable. La connaissance d'une autre langue, notamment l'anglais, l'arabe ou Hindi/Urdu constitue un atout.

- Vous êtes titulaire du permis B et êtes disponible pour effectuer des déplacements fréquents.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Nous sommes des passionnés de food, des problem solvers, des créateurs de communauté et bien plus encore. Ce qui nous rassemble : un esprit entrepreneurial fort et l’envie de construire quelque chose d’ambitieux ensemble.

🌱 Un environnement stimulant favorisant l’apprentissage, le développement et l’évolution de carrière
💙 Des avantages pensés pour le bien-être et l’équilibre de nos équipes
🌍 Une culture inclusive, internationale et collaborative où chacun peut trouver sa place

In this role, you’ll lead a team of Analytics Engineers embedded in a key business domain, owning the pipelines, models and metrics that power day-to-day decisions and building the data foundations your stakeholders rely on.

ABOUT THE ANALYTICS ENGINEERING ORG

Analytics Engineering is a core pillar of Deliveroo’s Analytics organisation, alongside Data Science. With over 70 Analytics Engineers across the UK and India, we are embedded directly within product and business domains, owning the pipelines, models and metrics that power decision-making at scale: from self-serve AI-enabled analytics and experimentation through to executive reporting and strategic planning.

The discipline is evolving fast. With new tooling changing how we work, we are shifting from building data pipelines to building AI first data products, developing rich semantic and data context layers and empowering self-serve data users. This role leads that work across a defined business domain, directly managing a team of Analytics Engineers and helping shape AE standards, culture and direction across the wider org.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Directly lead a team of Analytics Engineers embedded in a defined business domain, owning their performance, development and wellbeing

- Own the AE roadmap for your domain, identifying the highest-leverage investments, prioritising competing requests, and building the case for them with your business and product stakeholders

- Drive a data products mindset across your estate: clear ownership, SLAs, observability and data contracts built into how your team works by default

- Maintain strong technical involvement: reviewing data models and SQL, guiding architectural decisions, and stepping in hands-on when your team needs unblocking

- Contribute to AE-wide decisions on tooling, standards and process, helping shape how Analytics Engineering works at Deliveroo beyond your immediate team

- Build a high-performing, inclusive team culture by giving regular and actionable feedback, handling performance and motivation challenges, and running effective rituals

- Partner with Recruiting to hire strong, diverse AE talent into your team

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO THRIVE

- Experience in an Analytics Engineering, BI Engineering, or Data Engineering role, with strong, hands-on SQL foundations you still draw on regularly

- Proven experience managing a team of ICs, with a track record of developing people, giving hard feedback, and handling typical team situations independently

- Demonstrated ability to own a technical roadmap for a domain area and deliver against it with measurable business impact

- Strong grounding across the modern AE stack (cloud data warehousing, transformation tooling, data modelling, and data quality practices), with the ability to engage credibly on technical decisions and unblock your team

israel.title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Fidélisation (Deliveroo Plus) - Alternance 12 mois
israel.description:
Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont les gens commandent et apprécient leurs repas. Chez Deliveroo, notre équipe Brand & Experience crée des expériences engageantes qui renforcent le lien entre notre marque et nos clients, partenaires et livreurs.

Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Fidélisation en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Fidélisation, vous contribuerez au développement de Deliveroo Plus, notre programme d'abonnement, en participant au déploiement de campagnes marketing et en accompagnant des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos clients.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

Au sein de l'équipe Fidélisation, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Marketing Managers ainsi qu'avec les équipes CRM, Brand, Media, Creative, les équipes commerciales et nos partenaires stratégiques.

Au quotidien, vous serez amené·e à :

- Coordonner la création des campagnes Deliveroo Plus en rédigeant et en pilotant les briefs CRM, créatifs et juridiques avec les équipes locales, globales et les agences.

- Adapter et localiser les campagnes marketing internationales pour le marché français en garantissant leur cohérence avec notre identité de marque.

- Assurer le suivi des performances des offres Deliveroo Plus et contribuer à l'identification des opportunités d'optimisation.

- Préparer les reportings hebdomadaires et mensuels destinés à nos partenaires stratégiques.

- Participer aux lancements de campagnes marketing 360° (CRM, digital, TV, influence, événementiel et in-app) en coordonnant les différentes parties prenantes.

- Réaliser une veille concurrentielle sur les programmes de fidélisation et partager des recommandations pour enrichir notre stratégie.

CE QUI VOUS PERMETTRA DE RÉUSSIR

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les points suivants :

- Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle.

- Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.

- Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.

- Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.

- Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.

POURQUOI REJOINDRE DELIVEROO ?

Chez Deliveroo, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets concrets ayant un impact direct sur des millions de clients.

En rejoignant notre équipe, vous bénéficierez :

- D'un accompagnement tout au long de votre alternance par des experts du marketing.

- D'une forte exposition à des projets stratégiques et à des équipes internationales.

- D'un environnement collaboratif où l'autonomie, l'innovation et l'apprentissage sont encouragés.

- D'une expérience au sein d'une entreprise technologique internationale en constante évolution.

NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

Notre objectif est de vous permettre de montrer votre potentiel dans les meilleures conditions.

Le processus comprend généralement :

- Un échange avec notre équipe Talent Acquisition.

- Un entretien avec le manager de l'équipe Fidélisation pour échanger sur vos motivations, votre façon de travailler et découvrir davantage l'équipe.



CONSTRUIRE UN ENVIRONNEMENT OÙ CHACUN A SA PLACE

Chez Deliveroo, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes fait notre force. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, quelles que soient l'origine, le genre, l'âge, le handicap, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, les convictions ou le parcours.

israel.title: Commercial Strategy Associate
israel.description:
Why Deliveroo?

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.



The Role

As the Commercial Strategy Associate, you will assist in driving large cross-functional strategic projects. You will do this through analysis of operational efficiency, unlocking growth through data backed solutions. You will be a key part of the Belgium commercial team.

This is the ideal role for someone looking to take their analytical skills into execution, process-building and iteration to get to commercial excellence. It is also a rare opportunity to gain a valuable understanding of all the moving parts within a successful, high-growth company.

You will work in our main office in Brussels. You can work 2 days a week remotely.



Responsibilities

- Become a subject-matter expert on Deliveroo operations, especially restaurant operations

- Data analyses and deep-dives to support the commercial strategy and sales teams' performance

- Creation, roll out & ownership of processes and tools to improve internal efficiency

- Being the link between HQ and the local team, which involves strong exposure on new projects initiation and new product developments

- Collaborate with other markets to share knowledge and best practices

- Influence commercial stakeholders and partners to provide best-in-class operations



Requirements

- Experience in data analysis, business insights, business intelligence or a similar role

- An interest in the food and/or retail industry is a plus

- An ability to understand incrementally and cause/effect

- You have a strong business acumen and an ability to prioritise your projects

- Good execution skills - as you will put your analysis into execution

- You are capable of client-facing interactions to support our commercial team during meetings

- Organised - always deliver the right work at the right time

- You enjoy collaborating with teams of wildly different skills

- Inquisitive - infectiously curious and happy to question the status-quo

- Resilience and an ability to adapt to an ever evolving market and product

- You have a good command of Dutch or French. You have a good knowledge of the second national language and are fluent in English



Benefits

- Become an important member of a fast-growing, exciting start up changing the food delivery landscape

- Work with people who love what they do every day

- A market-based salary

- Benefits include: a MacBook, fee for telephone costs, meal vouchers

- Fee for sport activities

- Lots of delicious food!



We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is love for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing start ups around.

israel.description:
About the team

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Information Security team enables innovation at speed—securely. As digital guardians of DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, we safeguard our systems and the data of our employees, customers, riders, and partners. We defend against emerging cyber threats and embed security into every facet of the business. From building resilient defenses and responding to incidents to empowering teams with security knowledge, we are trusted partners protecting these global brands from the inside out.

About the role

The Senior Security Operations Centre Specialist Lead offers a unique opportunity to shape our global Security Operations strategy across a global footprint of DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt. This role provides the platform to optimize our technology and AI investments while pioneering new methods to protect our data, people, and partners. As we expand, your specialist capabilities will be essential to our continued success.

What you'll be doing

- Lead a team of SOC specialists and analysts, balancing technical work with total ownership of your shift.

- Act as the primary decision-maker for critical security matters while overseeing team development, performance, and operational metrics.

- Work in a 24/7 global security operations centre, including scheduled night and weekend shifts.

- Lead the triage and investigation of security alerts, including phishing, malware, network attacks, security hygiene and privacy related incidents within specified SLAs.

- Lead the development and continuously improve operational documentation, processes and playbooks

- Build and manage autonomous AI runbooks to automate and scale our alert triage capabilities.

- Lead incident response and escalation, ensuring lessons learned are translated into continuous security improvements.

- Support the design, development and review of threat-detection use-cases to identify suspicious activity across our cloud environment.

- Feed into the risk framework of emerging and observed threats from intelligence and / or incidents (e.g., post incident activity / repair items).

- Support wider security incident investigations involving Threat Intelligence and Incident Response & Digital Forensics stakeholders.

- Keep up to date with current security trends, advisories, publications and security research across the threat landscape

- Leverage metrics and KPIs to improve security posture and identify opportunities for strategic optimisation

- Collaborate with the team to develop and help deliver cybersecurity awareness programs for employees, emphasising incident reporting and best practices.

Requirements

- 7–9 years of SOC experience, with a proven track record of acting as a technical lead and managing shift operations.

- Proven experience building threat detection capabilities in a cloud-centric, fast-moving organisation.

- Hands-on experience with AWS security config, SOAR, GSO, EDR/XDR, Splunk and SQL queries.

- Practical experience ideating, configuring, managing defensive security solutions and technical project management

- Committed to continuous improvement, leveraging feedback to elevate both personal and team performance.

- Exceptional collaborative team player and a knowledge-sharing mindset.

- Working knowledge of security compliance standards, e.g. ISO27001, GDPR, NIS2 and PCI-DSS.

- Capable of working well both independently and collaboratively, whilst keeping calm, under the pressure of an incident with potentially high impact to the business.

- Able to communicate effectively during or after any incident update to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Coordinate with the US, UK and EU central security teams as required.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

- Knowledge of the restaurant industry is a significant plus

- You will need to be tenacious

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!



Descriptif du poste :

En tant que Business Development Manager basé(e) à Paris, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l’expansion de Deliveroo en France. Rattaché(e) au Sales Manager, vous rejoindrez une équipe ambitieuse et déterminée à accélérer notre croissance.

Vos principales responsabilités seront:

- Prospecter et développer les relations commerciales avec de futurs partenaires restaurateurs au téléphone et sur le terrain

- Maintenir un niveau d’activité quotidien constant en matière de prospection (cold-calling).

- Présenter les services de l'entreprise de manière claire, convaincante et professionnelle en s’appuyant sur le script de vente interne de l’entreprise.

- Gérer les négociations commerciales et réussir à closer rapidement.

- Atteindre les objectifs de vente mensuels de l'entreprise et maintenir à jour votre lead-list / CRM pour faciliter nos actions de suivi.

- Assurer un suivi auprès de nos partenaires pour garantir leur satisfaction et leur performance sur Deliveroo après leur mise en ligne.

- Réaliser un reporting régulier de vos actions commerciales auprès de votre manager.



Profil recherché:

- Minimum Bac+3, Bac+4 en commerce, marketing ou toute autre discipline pertinente.

- Expérience confirmée en vente de produits ou services.

- Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et présentation.

- Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et à gérer efficacement son temps.

- Connaissance des techniques de vente et de marketing modernes.

- Bonne connaissance du marché de la livraison de repas et de son environnement concurrentiel.

Ce que nous offrons :

- Un salaire fixe attractif avec des commissions déplafonnées sur les ventes réalisées.

- De réelles perspectives d'évolution au sein de l’équipe commerciale et plus largement dans l'entreprise.

- Une politique avantageuse pour les parents.

- Un accès à WellPass à tarif préférentiel pour entretenir votre bien-être.

- Les frais de livraison offerts sur Deliveroo+ pour profiter de nos meilleurs offres.

Si vous êtes motivé(e), persévérant(e) et prêt(e) à relever de nouveaux défis au sein d’une équipe de vente dynamique et ambitieuse, postulez dès maintenant et participez à la croissance de Deliveroo !

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!

Deliveroo France a obtenu un score de 98/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2024, témoignage de notre engagement envers la diversité et l'égalité des chances. Ce dont vous avez besoin pour nous rejoindre, c'est surtout le désir de faire partie de l'une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide dans un secteur passionnant, celui de la foodtech.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

About the role

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the teams building Wolt, Deliveroo’s and DoorDash’s global regulatory and compliance technology in London.

What you'll be doing

You’ll work with legal, finance, engineering, and other teams to translate regulatory needs into robust product solutions. This includes everything from anti-money laundering (AML) and safeguarding to tax and licensing compliance across 40+ markets.

You’ll define the long-term product strategy for our compliance stack. Including building internal tools, APIs, and automation for regulatory requirements like KYC, AML, and audit readiness.

You’ll lead and grow a group of senior Product Managers, guiding their work across multiple roadmaps and domains. Together, you'll solve the most critical regulatory and financial compliance challenges in our business.

You’ll also work closely with teams like Licensing Services, Tax, Legal, and Finance to understand changing rules and requirements, and ensure we build the right solutions to stay ahead.

Requirements

You could come to this role from different backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

- A strong grasp of EU regulatory frameworks such as AML/CTF, KYC and KYB, Payments Regulations, Tax regulations, Invoicing and e-Invoicing systems.

- Experience turning legal requirements into product designs

- Experience leading other Product Managers or Product Leads, including setting direction across multiple teams, coaching individuals, and aligning senior stakeholders

- High level of technical and analytical fluency. You are comfortable working with APIs, data models, audits, and reporting workflows

- Familiarity with financial services infrastructure, such as KYC, KYB and AML systems, licensing processes, scalable invoicing platforms incl e-Invoicing and core banking platforms

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing executives and cross-functional teams across legal, finance, and engineering

- A track record of operating in high-ambiguity environments, navigating risk, and delivering product impact without full information

- Fintech & Payments Subject Matter Expertise: Minimum 8–12 years of overall Product Management experience, with a significant portion dedicated to the Fintech or Financial Services sector

- Ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.
