israel.title: Marketing Manager, Promotions and Incentives
israel.description:
Title: Marketing Manager, Promo & Incentives
Market: UAE & KW

Location: Dubai, UAE

Role Overview

As Marketing Manager, Promo and Incentives, you will report to the Senior Marketing Manager, Value & Promotions for the Middle East. You will own the operational delivery and performance of our promotional and incentive programmes, working cross-functionally to ensure every offer is targeted, well-timed, and commercially sound.

Incentives sit at the centre of how customers experience value on the platform - they influence whether someone tries the app, comes back, or drifts away. This role owns that layer day to day: turning the promotional calendar into targeted campaigns across the customer lifecycle, and making sure every campaign earns its budget.

What You'll Be Doing:

You’ll be joining the Middle East Marketing team. You will work cross-functionally with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Tech, Data Science, and Global/Central teams to build promotional plans that improve customer experience and drive operational excellence.

Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like:

- Promotional Calendar Execution: Own the execution of the Middle East promotional calendar, translating quarterly strategy into targeted campaigns across the customer lifecycle: acquisition, activation, retention, and win-back.

- Promo Strategy Development: Implement robust strategies focused on how value propositions can change customer behavior and drive ROI for Deliveroo and our Partners.

- CRM & Lifecycle Campaigns: Work with CRM and Tech to build and deploy in-app and lifecycle campaigns, ensuring offers reach the right customer segment at the right moment.

- Quarterly Strategic Planning: Develop quarterly and annual promotional roadmaps aligned with commercial priorities, seasonal opportunities, and market dynamics.

- Budget Ownership: Manage and report campaign-level budgets, tracking spend against target and flagging when a promotion's ROI or margin impact is off plan.

- Customer-centric Programmes: Partner with Data Science to translate customer and performance data into promo mechanics that are genuinely relevant, not just discounted.

- Performance Optimization: Own weekly reporting on in-flight campaign performance and lead post-campaign analysis to identify what worked, what didn't, and what's worth testing next.

- Promotional Analytics: Analyze price elasticity and discount depth mechanics by running structured tests to find the minimum effective discount.

- Test & Learn Agenda: Design and run local test-and-learn experiments, feeding results back into the broader promotional strategy.

- Competition Monitoring: Keep on top of competitor trends and market activity to keep our offers sharp and well-positioned.

- Commercial Business Cases: Build business cases with financials for scaling a successful test into a recurring, budgeted promotional mechanic.

- Customer Advocacy: Champion the consumer voice, ensuring every promotion offers genuine value rather than just a lower price.

- Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex datasets into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

What You'll Need to Thrive:

- Experience: 5-8 years of experience in Growth Marketing, Data Analytics, User Segmentation, Marketing, Commercial Strategy, or Promotions within a high-growth technology, marketplace, e-commerce, or consumer platform.
Commercial Acumen: Proven experience owning customer incentive strategies and promotional campaigns that drive measurable business outcomes. Working knowledge of core commercial metrics (CAC, LTV, GMV, margin impact) and how promotional decisions move them is a plus.

- Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Analytics, or a related discipline.

- Analytical Rigor: Strong analytical skills - proficient in Excel, Google Sheets, and BI tools like Looker, and comfortable interpreting data to shape campaign decisions.

- Technical know-how: Experience running or supporting A/B tests and translating results into recommendations.

- Collaborative Leadership: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to manage multiple cross-functional stakeholders.

- Execution Focus: A self-starter attitude, with a proven ability to deliver results quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced, matrixed organisation.

- Language Skills: Fluent English; Arabic language skills are a strong advantage in this market.

Why Deliveroo?

We are a small team, with very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, we're always looking for new ideas and we're very transparent about the decisions we make and why we make them.

There are so many questions we need to answer and plenty more we haven't even encountered. How do data and technology help restaurants to grow as consumer habits change? How can we predict what someone wants to order for dinner long before the idea has even crossed their mind?

Workplace & Diversity

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer multiple great benefits in areas including health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing startups in an exciting space.

israel.title: UAE & Kuwait Account Associate - UAE National
israel.description:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

We're looking for a UAE & Kuwait Account Associate to join our Dubai HQ team. In this role, you'll help us ensure seamless "on-app" execution, high stock availability, and a frictionless ordering experience for customers seeking beauty, pharmacy, and toy products on demand.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Alshaya Group team. You will support Account Managers in ensuring that Alshaya's world-class brands are optimized for the Deliveroo platform, working across Ulta Beauty, Boots, Disney, and NYX Professional Makeup.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

- On-App Merchandising: Own the technical upload of promotions, ensuring discounts and "Buy 1 Get 1" offers are live and accurate across all Alshaya brand storefronts on Deliveroo.

- Ad Operations: Assist in activating "Deliveroo Ads" for brands like NYX and Ulta, ensuring campaigns are launched on time to drive maximum visibility.

- Quality Assurance: Regularly audit the Alshaya brand pages to ensure images, descriptions, and promotional tags are correct and visually appealing.

- Stock Tracking: Monitor the frequency of stock updates from the Alshaya side. Ensure that fast-moving items (e.g., Boots essentials) are consistently updated to minimize "Order Mark-outs."

- Proactive Flagging: Identify and flag gaps where brands have failed to send stock updates, working quickly to resolve data silos before they impact the customer experience.

- Menu Creation: Work with the Catalogue teams to improve menu structures, such as adding "Trending" categories for Ulta or "Gift Ideas" for Disney.

- Menu Sprints: Execute rapid updates to menu tags and categorization to improve searchability and conversion rates on the Deliveroo app.

- Reporting: Pull performance data for daily and weekly "Health Checks" to help Account Managers identify growth opportunities.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

- Q-Commerce Mindset: You understand that in the world of Deliveroo, every minute counts. You are fast, responsive, and organized.

- Data Literacy: Comfortable handling CSV files and basic data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) for menu uploads and performance tracking.

- Detail Oriented: You have an eye for the small things, ensuring a NYX lipstick shade name is exactly right or a Disney price point is updated.

- Collaborative: A natural team player who can work with multiple stakeholders.

- Problem Solver: When a stock feed fails or a promotion doesn't trigger, you don't just report it—you help find the fix.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale — Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast — Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership — Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders — High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

israel.title: Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager
israel.description:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

Integrated Marketing France orchestrates major marketing moments, brand initiatives and local activations, working closely with central functional teams.

The Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager translates central marketing direction, France business priorities, and consumer and performance insights into an integrated 360° marketing plan tailored to the French market. They bring local and central expertise together, make prioritisation recommendations, coordinate delivery and measure the plan’s effectiveness against Deliveroo France’s marketing and business objectives.

This is a hybrid role, based in Paris.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. INTEGRATED MARKETING PLANNING & BUSINESS PERFORMANCE — FRANCE

- Analyse business priorities, performance data, consumer insights and previous campaign results to identify opportunities and risks for the French market.

- Lead France quarterly planning, from kick-off through approval of priorities, objectives and the calendar.

- Translate central direction and French market needs into one coherent integrated 360° marketing plan.

- Develop prioritisation recommendations and trade-off scenarios based on expected impact, capacity, investment and dependencies.

- Partner with the relevant teams to define campaign objectives and KPIs, then feed campaign learnings into future plans.

- Act as PMO for key marketing moments, including Back-to-School and Black Friday, and build the overarching narrative.

2. ORCHESTRATING 360° CAMPAIGNS

- Bring local and central teams together around a shared delivery plan and build integrated timelines.

- Lead the localisation of global campaigns and align media plans with the mix defined by Brand Marketing, ensuring they are tailored to the French market.

- Coordinate local campaigns and partner activations with the Promo & Partnerships teams.

- Clarify ownership, dependencies, decision dates and success criteria; resolve friction and escalate issues requiring a trade-off decision.

3. TRACKING, PERFORMANCE & GOVERNANCE

- Track deliverables, analyse gaps against objectives and the France brief, and run coordination check-ins.

- Maintain campaign documentation and prepare the memos required for decisions and trade-offs.

- Ensure legal requirements and local market considerations are reflected.

- Consolidate visibility over marketing investment, identify gaps or constraints that could affect the plan, and facilitate trade-off decisions with budget owners.

- Run campaign reviews with Measurement teams, analyse results and turn learnings into recommendations for future plans.

4. AGENCIES & PARTNERSHIPS

- Consolidate and prioritise French market feedback for the Creative team, coordinate deadlines and ensure deliverables meet the France brief. The Creative team retains ownership of creative development and approval.

- Act as the day-to-day point of contact for agencies on execution, deliverables and planning.

- Coordinate major brand partnerships, such as Top Chef, with the Promo & Partnerships teams, media owners and relevant partners.

WAYS OF WORKING

- Works across multiple functional teams without direct authority over most contributors, leading through influence.

- Distinguishes what can be resolved independently from what requires escalation, and arbitrates competing local and central priorities.

- Maintains visibility through one shared, up-to-date campaign calendar that serves as the reference point for all stakeholders.

Success in this role depends equally on the quality of relationships and the quality of organisation.

KEY SKILLS

- Strategic thinking, intellectual curiosity and business orientation, with the ability to understand complex topics quickly and connect marketing choices to market priorities and objectives.

- Data fluency and strong analytical skills to interpret performance, challenge assumptions and make recommendations.

- Integrated marketing planning and complex programme management, from setting priorities through 360° campaign execution.

- Stakeholder management and influence in a matrix environment, with the ability to simplify complex topics and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

- Prioritisation, trade-off decision-making and operational rigour, including risk anticipation, agency management and dependency management.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

EXPERIENCE

- 5–8 years of experience in integrated marketing, marketing planning, marketing strategy or marketing programme management, either client-side or in an agency.

- Demonstrated experience turning business priorities and performance data into plans, trade-off scenarios and marketing recommendations.

- Experience orchestrating 360° campaigns in a matrix environment, working with local teams, central teams and agencies.

- Strong understanding of the main marketing levers, their contribution to business and brand objectives, and the French market.

SUCCESS MEASURES

- One integrated 360° France marketing plan, aligned with business priorities and recognised as the reference point by local and central teams.

- Data-driven recommendations and trade-off decisions based on expected impact and available capacity.

- Clear campaign objectives and KPIs, with results analysed and applied to future plans.

- Coherent 360° campaigns delivered without major surprises and with risks anticipated.

- Local execution that contributes to Deliveroo France’s marketing and business objectives.

- Clear stakeholder visibility on priorities, risks, decisions and results.

WHY THIS ROLE?

This role offers unique exposure to Deliveroo France’s strategic marketing challenges, working directly with local leadership and central functional teams. It provides a strong platform for progression into broader Integrated Marketing responsibilities.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically three days in the office.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll be joining the SDUI team. We own the Android rendering layer of our server-driven UI platform, and the backend services that drive it, ensuring every consumer surface built on it is fast, correct, and visually indistinguishable from native.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Drive technical execution by designing, building, and evolving the Android SDUI renderer — and the backend services (Kotlin, Golang, Protobuf) that feed it — to handle complex, real-time UI updates at scale.

- Lead architectural improvements and code reviews, ensuring the maintainability, visibility, and operational health of the renderer as more teams build on top of it.

- Partner with cross-functional disciplines (iOS and Web renderer engineers, product and design teams) to plan rollouts, align on platform decisions, and influence the roadmap.

- Own large-scale initiatives from design to delivery — including the push to bring SDUI motion and interaction quality to native-equivalent, and the ongoing migration off legacy rendering systems.

- Support the growth of others by mentoring colleagues and taking an active role in our engineering hiring process.

- 5+ years building Android applications at scale, with a deep understanding of Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

- Backend development experience, specifically with Golang, Kotlin, and Protobuf, and the comfort to move between client and server code as the work demands.

- Experience building or maintaining a server-driven / declarative UI system, with a keen interest in pushing what's possible with declarative rendering — bonus points if that included Litho or another DSL-based renderer.

- A product mindset, and the instinct to apply it to how you design platform services for the teams that build on top of them.

- Demonstrated ownership of technical delivery within cross-functional teams, guiding implementation choices and technical design for a platform other teams build on.

- Strong communication skills, working across time zones with iOS, Web, and Backend counterparts, plus PMs and multiple product teams.

Bonus points for exposure to Figma-to-code tooling, design-token/theming systems, or accessibility work in mobile rendering.

israel.title: Strategy & Operations Manager – Emerging Fraud & Abuse
israel.location: Remote — London - The River Building HQ
israel.description:
About the Role

Fraud is constantly evolving. As our business grows, so do the ways bad actors seek to exploit our products, promotions, and operations.

As the Senior Strategy & Operations Manager for Emerging Fraud & Abuse, you'll lead the discovery, investigation, and mitigation of new and evolving abuse vectors across our platform. Your mission is to identify risks before they become systemic, working across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Legal, and Policy to design scalable solutions that protect our customers, partners, and business.

This isn't a role focused on running existing fraud programmes. It's about identifying what's next.

You'll combine deep analytical thinking with strategic problem solving to uncover emerging threats, quantify business impact, influence product strategy, and build new controls that keep us ahead of increasingly sophisticated fraudsters.

If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, following the data, and building solutions where no playbook exists, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

- Identify Emerging Abuse

- Proactively identify new fraud patterns, abuse trends, and vulnerabilities across our products, customer journeys, and operational processes.

- Investigate anomalies, understand attacker behaviours, and translate observations into actionable mitigation strategies.

- Continuously scan for evolving risks, whether driven by organised fraud, policy loopholes, technological change, or new product launches.

- Build the Strategy

- Define the roadmap for emerging fraud prevention across the business.

- Prioritise risks based on customer impact, financial exposure, operational complexity, and strategic importance.

- Develop business cases that influence investment in tooling, automation, machine learning, and product improvements.

- Turn Insights into Action

- Lead complex investigations to understand how abuse occurs and where existing controls can be strengthened.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to design scalable prevention mechanisms rather than tactical fixes.

- Establish metrics that measure both emerging risk and the effectiveness of mitigation strategies.

- Drive Cross-Functional Execution

- Act as the central point of coordination between Fraud, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Customer Operations, Legal, Finance, and Data Science.

- Influence roadmaps to ensure fraud prevention is embedded into product development from the earliest stages.

- Support major product launches by identifying potential abuse scenarios and recommending preventative controls.

- Build Organisational Capability

- Develop frameworks for identifying, prioritising, and responding to emerging threats.

- Improve how intelligence is shared across teams to ensure new attack patterns are detected and mitigated quickly.

- Help foster a culture of proactive fraud prevention across the organisation.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys solving complex, high-impact business problems.

You'll likely come from fraud, trust & safety, cybersecurity, payments, marketplaces, fintech, consulting, or another analytical environment where you've been responsible for identifying and solving new risks.

You'll bring:

- Experience investigating complex fraud, abuse, or operational risk problems

- Strong analytical skills with SQL and the ability to work comfortably with large datasets

- A structured approach to solving ambiguous problems with limited information

- Experience influencing Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams without direct authority

- The ability to translate technical findings into clear business recommendations

- Strong commercial judgement and an understanding of balancing customer experience with risk mitigation

Experience in experimentation, machine learning, fraud detection, marketplace integrity, or trust and safety is advantageous but not essential

You'll thrive here if you...

- Love solving problems that don't have an obvious answer

- Are naturally curious and enjoy uncovering hidden patterns in data

- Think like both an investigator and a strategist

- Can connect technical detail with commercial impact

- Influence through evidence rather than hierarchy

- Stay ahead of emerging technologies and evolving fraud techniques

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. israel.location: Remote — London - The River Building HQ
israel.description:
About the Role

The head of EMEA Refund Fraud will lead Doordash’s EMEA strategy for preventing and managing refund abuse across our marketplace.

You will be accountable for the performance of the Credit and Refund (C&R) Fraud domain: setting the long-term vision, determining where we focus our resources, and building the team, controls and capabilities required to reduce fraud sustainably while protecting the experience of genuine customers.

This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of Integrity, Customer Care, Product, Engineering, Analytics and Finance. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment.

You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy

- Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap.

- Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.

- Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest.

- Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls.

- Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments.

2. Owning Performance and Risk

- Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails.

- Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost.

- Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions.

- Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken.

- Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats.



3. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities

- Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys.

- Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place.

- Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions.

- Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails.

- Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention.

- Challenge legacy processes and controls, simplifying or retiring them where they no longer provide sufficient value.

4. Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment

- Act as the senior C&R Fraud partner to Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Merchant, Finance, Analytics and other Integrity teams.

- Translate fraud problems into clear product and business opportunities and influence roadmaps outside your direct reporting line.

- Lead complex decisions where fraud prevention, customer experience, commercial performance and operational efficiency are in tension.

- Create alignment around priorities, decision rights and accountability without relying on excessive consensus.

- Make longer-term trade-offs and ensure resources are concentrated on the initiatives with the greatest expected impact.

- Communicate complex risks and recommendations clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.



5. Build and Lead a High-Performing Team

- Lead and develop a team of experienced fraud, strategy and operations professionals.

- Translate your strategy into clear, measurable outcomes for individual team members.

- Empower your team to own significant problems independently while providing effective challenge, coaching and direction.

- Establish strong operating mechanisms and rituals for reviewing performance, prioritisation, delivery and emerging risks.

- Build capability and succession within the team, identifying development opportunities and future talent needs.

- Create an inclusive environment in which different perspectives are actively sought and people are able to challenge assumptions.

- Hold yourself and others accountable for delivering ambitious outcomes while maintaining focus and sustainable ways of working.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced leader who has previously owned a meaningful fraud, risk, trust & safety, operational or related business domain. You will ideally bring:

- Significant experience in fraud, risk strategy, trust & safety, marketplace integrity, strategy & operations or a related domain, typically gained over 10+ years.

- Experience leading and developing experienced individual contributors and/or managers.

- Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business outcome, risk domain or portfolio rather than solely individual projects.

- A track record of defining and executing strategies across a 1–2 year horizon.

- Experience identifying complex problems, setting direction and making high-quality decisions where the answer is not immediately clear.

- Strong commercial judgement and the ability to evaluate financial impact alongside customer and operational consequences.

- Experience influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics and Finance.

- Strong analytical judgement and the ability to use data, customer insight and operational evidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions.

- Experience translating complex problems into scalable product, policy or operational solutions.

- Strong people leadership, with evidence of developing talented individuals and creating teams that operate effectively with increasing autonomy.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear executive-level recommendations.

Experience with refund abuse, customer claims fraud, payments fraud, marketplace abuse or adjacent fraud domains would be valuable, but deep expertise in refund fraud itself is not essential. We are equally interested in leaders who have demonstrated the ability to quickly understand a complex risk domain and build the strategy and organisation required to improve it.

What Success Looks Like

- In this role, you will have built a clear and widely understood C&R Fraud strategy, established measurable outcomes and guardrails, and focused the organisation on a number of high-impact priorities.

- You will have materially improved our ability to prevent and respond to refund abuse while protecting genuine customers, created a scalable control and monitoring framework, and influenced the product investments required to address systemic vulnerabilities.

- You will have built a team capable of owning complex problems independently — creating an organisation that anticipates risk and continuously improves rather than reacting to the fraud we see today.

israel.description:
SOFTWARE ENGINEER, GENAI PLATFORM

ABOUT THE TEAM

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalization to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, with a primary focus on our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You’ll work across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

YOU’RE EXCITED ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY BECAUSE YOU WILL…

- Build the infrastructure that helps Deliveroo teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

- Work on our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

- Design scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

- Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

- Build platforms that support rapid experimentation while meeting production standards for latency, scale, monitoring, SLOs, playbooks, and operational excellence.

- Partner closely with ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

- Shape the future of the centralized GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimization, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalization.

WE’RE EXCITED ABOUT YOU BECAUSE YOU HAVE…

- BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent

- 3+ years of industry experience in software engineering

- Strong backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems.

- Experience building production services, APIs, data pipelines, or ML infrastructure at scale.

- Experience operating systems in production, including observability, debugging, reliability, incident response, and performance/cost optimization.

- Hands-on experience with LLM inference and/or fine-tuning of open-weight models in production — serving (latency, throughput, batching, autoscaling, GPU utilization) and/or fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA).

- Ability to work across ambiguous, fast-moving technical areas and turn customer use cases into reusable platform capabilities

- Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience with LLM inference engines and serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) in production

- Experience with distributed/multi-node fine-tuning and training pipelines (SFT, DPO/RLHF, LoRA), including data preparation and evaluation

- GPU performance work — multi-node/distributed inference, KV-cache/memory optimization, quantization (FP8/INT8/AWQ/GPTQ), or cold-start/throughput tuning

- Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), GPUs, serverless/elastic GPU platforms (e.g., Modal), or high-throughput batch systems

- Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, vendor abstraction, or cost attribution

- Experience building developer platforms, internal platforms, or self-serve infrastructure

- Experience building and deploying AI agents or MCP servers in production

- Experience with eval systems, LLM observability, tracing, RAG, search, or vector databases

DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

israel.description:

The Role

As Franchisee Manager, you will be Deliveroo's main commercial presence on the ground across your region, looking after some of our largest and most complex franchise networks, including the UK's biggest QSR brands. You will be responsible for growing franchisee advertising impact, raising operational standards, and building strong relationships with franchise operators that drive real growth.

You will:

- Own your portfolio: You are responsible for a large, multi-brand franchisee portfolio across your region. These are your accounts. You run the relationships, you own the numbers, and you are the person operators call.

- Onboard new sites: Get new franchisees and newly opened sites set up properly. As brands grow, every new operator needs to understand the platform, know the standards, and have a relationship with you before problems arrive.

- Grow advertising impact: Help franchisees grow their business through Deliveroo advertising. Most operators are only scratching the surface of what ads can do, and your job is to change that through consultative conversations about driving growth.

- Raise operational standards: Work with franchisees to close operations gaps that impact rider and customer experiences. You are the person who makes it happen on the ground.

- Build the local promo plan: Work with each franchisee to shape the promotional activity that suits how they trade, and how they can maximise growth.

- Work with the national team: What you do in the field should drive the national strategy. You will ensure the national strategy is executed with excellence across your franchisee portfolio.

- Report and track: Keep your weekly tracking up to date, present your region's performance every month, and contribute to quarterly business reviews. You will be a key part of your partners success

This role suits someone who combines genuine commercial hunger with the ability to build trust quickly across very different franchise operators, from a multi-site owner running several restaurants to a network manager covering a whole region. You are comfortable in the field, self-directed, and able to hold your own in commercial conversations without always having a senior sponsor in the room. You understand that great relationships and great commercial outcomes are not in tension.

The desired skills/experiences include:

- Field credibility: A proven ability to build genuine relationships at business owner level. As comfortable sitting down with a franchisee owner as presenting to a regional brand director. You earn trust through preparation and follow-through, not job title.

- Commercial instinct: You understand how advertising investment relates to growth, and you can make that case convincingly to a sceptical franchisee. You do not just take orders. You sell, influence, and bring partners with you on the journey.

- Resilience and pace: This is a field-based role with significant travel. You thrive on variety and manage your own schedule effectively.

- Team player: You take direction stakeholders, and you share what you learn on the ground quickly. The whole team is better when you bring back what you are seeing.

En tant que Sales Team Lead, vous serez responsable de la performance, du développement et de l'engagement d'une équipe de 8 à 10 Business Development Managers couvrant l'ensemble de la France. - Créer une culture de la performance basée sur l'exigence, la collaboration et le dépassement de soi.

- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités de croissance et améliorer en continu les méthodes de prospection, de négociation et de vente.

- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Onboarding, Account Management et Operations afin d'assurer un lancement réussi et une croissance durable de nos nouveaux partenaires.

Vous êtes un leader commercial qui aime autant développer son équipe que dépasser ses objectifs.

Nous sommes des passionnés de gastronomie, des entrepreneurs, des innovateurs et des personnes qui aiment relever des défis ensemble. Chez Deliveroo, vous aurez l'opportunité de construire bien plus qu'une carrière commerciale.

- Shape how AI and human expertise come together to deliver faster, smarter, and more effective customer experiences.

- Build products that leverage rich customer and operational context to enable better decisions and more personalized experiences.

- Create intelligent feedback loops that continuously improve product quality, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

- Partner with regional teams around the world to understand local market needs and translate them into globally scalable solutions.

- Work closely with Engineering, Applied AI, Design, Data Science, and Operations to bring innovative products to life.

- Communicate product vision, strategy, and business impact to senior leadership.

- You have 7+ years of Product Management experience building impactful products.

- You have 2-3+ years of experience managing and developing Product Managers.

- You have experience building products that leverage AI or machine learning to solve meaningful user problems.

- You have a strong track record of defining product vision, strategy, and roadmaps that deliver measurable business impact.

- You have experience leading highly cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Operations.

- You are equally comfortable thinking strategically and diving deep into execution.

- You are an exceptional communicator with experience influencing senior leaders and driving alignment across organizations.

- You have empathy for the users you build for and a passion for creating products that improve customer experiences at global scale.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, MACHINE LEARNING INFRASTRUCTURE - GENERATIVE AI

ABOUT THE TEAM

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalization to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, with a primary focus on our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You’ll work across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

- Build the infrastructure that helps Deliveroo teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

- Work on our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

- Design scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

- Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

- Partner closely with ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

- Shape the future of the centralized GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimization, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalization.

israel.description:
Franchisee Manager, Enterprise QSR (UK and Ireland)



Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo's marketplace, shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand, this is the team for you.



The Role



As Franchisee Manager, you will be Deliveroo's main commercial presence on the ground across your region, looking after some of our largest and most complex franchise networks, including the UK's biggest QSR brands. You will be responsible for growing franchisee advertising impact, raising operational standards, and building strong relationships with franchise operators that drive real growth.



You will:



- Own your portfolio: You are responsible for a large, multi-brand franchisee portfolio across your region. These are your accounts. You run the relationships, you own the numbers, and you are the person operators call.

- Onboard new sites: Get new franchisees and newly opened sites set up properly. As brands grow, every new operator needs to understand the platform, know the standards, and have a relationship with you before problems arrive.

- Grow advertising impact: Help franchisees grow their business through Deliveroo advertising. Most operators are only scratching the surface of what ads can do, and your job is to change that through consultative conversations about driving growth.

- Raise operational standards: Work with franchisees to close operations gaps that impact rider and customer experiences. You are the person who makes it happen on the ground.

- Build the local promo plan: Work with each franchisee to shape the promotional activity that suits how they trade, and how they can maximise growth.

- Work with the national team: What you do in the field should drive the national strategy. You will ensure the national strategy is executed with excellence across your franchisee portfolio.

- Report and track: Keep your weekly tracking up to date, present your region's performance every month, and contribute to quarterly business reviews. You will be a key part of your partners success



The Candidate:



This role suits someone who combines genuine commercial hunger with the ability to build trust quickly across very different franchise operators, from a multi-site owner running several restaurants to a network manager covering a whole region. You are comfortable in the field, self-directed, and able to hold your own in commercial conversations without always having a senior sponsor in the room. You understand that great relationships and great commercial outcomes are not in tension.



The desired skills/experiences include:



- Commercial foundation: 2 or more years in field sales, territory management, account management, or franchise support. Experience working with or within QSR or franchise businesses is strongly preferred. You understand how operator economics work and how commercial decisions get made at franchisee level.

- Data fluency: Confidence reading dashboards and drawing your own conclusions. You will not need a data team to tell you where your portfolio is underperforming. You will already know, and you will walk into franchisee meetings with the numbers that make the case.

- Field credibility: A proven ability to build genuine relationships at business owner level. As comfortable sitting down with a franchisee owner as presenting to a regional brand director. You earn trust through preparation and follow-through, not job title.

- Commercial instinct: You understand how advertising investment relates to growth, and you can make that case convincingly to a sceptical franchisee. You do not just take orders. You sell, influence, and bring partners with you on the journey.

- Resilience and pace: This is a field-based role with significant travel. You thrive on variety and manage your own schedule effectively.

- Team player: You take direction stakeholders, and you share what you learn on the ground quickly. The whole team is better when you bring back what you are seeing.

- Organisation: Able to manage a large, geographically spread portfolio across several brands at once, knowing when to escalate, when to solve things yourself, and how to communicate clearly without creating noise.

SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Core Engineering teams build the systems and tooling that enable Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash engineers to develop, ship, and operate software at scale. We treat infrastructure, CI / CD, and developer tooling as software products, engineered with the same care as customer-facing systems. Our mission is to increase engineering velocity, reliability, and security as we transform the way the world eats and shops.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Working in the Infrastructure team, you’ll be responsible for the foundational compute and cloud components that product engineering teams build on: our Kubernetes clusters, related cloud infrastructure and networking, and the Infrastructure-as-Code and provisioning frameworks that let our teams safely self-serve environments and capacity. Expect to split your time between hands-on operational ownership and writing production-quality code to build automation / tooling that removes toil and friction, while also designing and running scalable systems in AWS.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Take ownership of complex infrastructure initiatives end-to-end, spanning Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networking, and infrastructure-as-code frameworks - making most technical decisions within scope without needing oversight.

- Break initiatives down into executable work, identify dependencies, provide accurate estimates, and document project-level technical decisions and how infrastructure components interact.

- Design, deploy, and operate secure, scalable systems in AWS, and know when and how to pull in other teams to support cross-cutting initiatives.

- Independently plan and drive technical improvements to the compute and cloud platform, using data and clear success metrics to prioritize work.

- Build and own self-service tooling, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks that let other engineering teams provision environments and infrastructure safely and consistently.

- Unblock other teams through code and design reviews, proactively answering questions, and sharing knowledge via guides, playbooks, and internal tech talks.

- Serve as a first responder during on-call rotations for core infrastructure, lead root cause analysis, and drive incident mitigation and follow-through.

- Drive team-wide quality objectives for the Infrastructure platform: reliability, operational readiness (alerting, dashboards, runbooks), and developer experience / productivity tooling.

- Act as a role model for other engineers by sharing constructive feedback, recognizing colleagues' contributions, and supporting hiring through interviewing and recruiting activities.

- Deep, hands-on expertise operating Kubernetes and container orchestration in production, including cluster scaling, upgrades, and multi-tenancy.

- Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), including networking, IAM, account structuring, and cost management.

- Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred) and building provisioning or automation frameworks that other engineers rely on.

- Solid software engineering skills (Go, Python, or similar) applied to building internal tooling and automation, not just operational scripting.

- Broader knowledge across supportive technologies (e.g. Kafka, gRPC, Postgres / MongoDB, Redis, CI / CD such as GitHub Actions) and the ability to weigh trade-offs between them for a given problem.

- Solid understanding of SRE principles, including incident response, fault-tolerant architecture, and capacity planning.

- Experience unblocking and mentoring other engineers (e.g. code / design reviews, knowledge sharing, or driving best practices), and willingness to contribute to hiring across interviewing, tech talks, etc.

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills; this role works closely with many engineering teams, increasingly operating at global scale.

- Experience operating multi-cluster or multi-region Kubernetes environments at scale.

- GCP exposure, especially compute and networking aspects.

israel.title: Data Science Manager - Merchants Team
israel.location: Remote — London - The River Building HQ
israel.description:
DATA SCIENCE MANAGER – MERCHANTS TEAM

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and applied machine learning.

We’re hiring a Data Science Manager to join our Merchants team. Merchants are central to Deliveroo’s marketplace: they drive selection, order volume and a significant proportion of the value created across the business.

You’ll lead a team focused on helping Deliveroo acquire, onboard, support and retain the right merchant partners. You’ll work across a broad set of merchant problems, from identifying the restaurants, grocers and retailers we should partner with, to improving order management, reducing merchant defects and helping partners manage their business more effectively through self-serve tools and communications.

This role is based in London and sits within the wider Merchants Data Science team. You’ll report to a Senior Data Science Manager and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy, Operations and Commercial teams.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll own the analytical direction and measurable impact of a defined area within Merchants, while leading and developing a team of approximately four to seven data scientists.

The team already has several data scientists in place and is continuing to grow. You’ll help shape that growth, build a high-performing team and bring structure to a fast-moving and ambiguous environment.

Depending on the final scope, your team may work across areas such as:

- merchant acquisition and onboarding, including identifying the most valuable restaurants, grocers and retailers to partner with;

- improving models used to understand restaurant, grocery and retail supply;

- merchant order management and reducing defects such as missing items, inaccurate orders, menu issues and rider waiting time;

- merchant account management, churn and retention;

- self-service tools, automated communications and partner support.

You’ll identify high-value problems, guide the team’s analytical approach and ensure the work drives clear product, operational or commercial decisions.

You’ll partner closely with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Strategy, Operations and Commercial to shape priorities, make trade-offs and focus on the highest-impact areas.

This is a hands-on management role with meaningful technical involvement. You should be comfortable getting into the detail and unblocking work, while prioritising people leadership and strategic direction.

You’ll also maintain high analytical standards, delegate effectively and support team development through coaching and feedback.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

Our ideal candidate will bring:

- Experience line managing data scientists and developing high-performing teams

- A strong background as a senior data science individual contributor

- Expertise in experimentation, causal inference or applied machine learning

- The ability to guide technical work and translate data science into product, operational or commercial decisions

- Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working with senior leaders

- The ability to bring structure to ambiguity, prioritise effectively and shape a clear roadmap

Experience working with merchants, marketplaces, restaurants, grocery, retail or B2B products would be valuable, but is not essential. We’re more interested in your ability to solve complex, non-standard problems within a multi-sided marketplace.

WHY JOIN US?

Merchants are fundamental to Deliveroo’s success. The strength of our merchant network directly affects customer choice, order volume and the performance of the wider marketplace.

In this role, you’ll work on complex, high-impact problems across product, commercial strategy and operations. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape the team’s roadmap, influence senior stakeholders and develop a growing team of strong data scientists.

You’ll also have the opportunity to apply experimentation, causal inference, machine learning and AI to problems that directly affect Deliveroo’s growth, profitability and merchant experience.

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, can create structure where needed and can align teams around the most important problems.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

At Deliveroo, we believe great workplaces reflect the world around us. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion or belief.

If you require adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re committed to ensuring everyone has an equitable opportunity to succeed.

Ready to shape how Deliveroo works with the merchants at the heart of our marketplace? Apply today.

israel.title: Data Science Manager - Delivery Team
israel.description:
DATA SCIENCE MANAGER – DELIVERY TEAM

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and applied machine learning.

We’re hiring a Data Science Manager to join our Delivery team. Delivery is responsible for making sure we have the right rider supply to meet consumer demand at a local level, while maintaining speed, reliability and network efficiency.

You’ll lead a team focused on areas such as rider pay, incentives, supply and demand, load management and network economics. The work is highly specific to Deliveroo’s marketplace and requires balancing multiple interconnected outcomes across riders, consumers and the wider delivery network.

This role is based in London and sits within the wider Delivery Data Science team. You’ll report to a Senior Data Science Manager and partner closely with Operations, Product, Machine Learning and Engineering teams.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll own the analytical direction and impact of a defined area within Delivery, while leading and developing a team of approximately 4 to 6 data scientists.

The team spans a range of experience levels and is continuing to grow. You’ll provide structure, coaching and technical direction to help them operate effectively in a complex, fast-moving environment.

Depending on scope, your team may work across areas such as:

- rider pay, incentives and surge pricing;

- rider supply and fleet sizing at a local level;

- balancing supply and consumer demand;

- load management and network performance;

- understanding rider behaviour, including changes in acceptance rates;

- using experimentation to understand how riders and the network respond to changes in pay, incentives and demand signals;

- improving how different operational and economic levers are used across the delivery system.

You’ll identify the highest-value problems, guide the team towards the right analytical approach and ensure the work leads to clear operational, product and commercial decisions.

A key part of the role is applying systems thinking. Changes to pay, supply, incentives or dispatch can have knock-on effects across the network, so you’ll need to reason through these interactions and support informed trade-offs.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Product, Machine Learning and Engineering, including teams closest to day-to-day rider and market performance.

This is a hands-on management role, with a meaningful portion of your time spent on direct technical contribution. Hands-on work is likely to be analytical, such as investigating market changes, interpreting experiments and unblocking complex problems.

You’ll also maintain high analytical standards, delegate effectively and support team development through coaching and feedback.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

Our ideal candidate will bring:

- Experience line managing data scientists and developing high-performing teams

- A strong background as a senior data science individual contributor

- Strong expertise in experimentation and causal inference

- The ability to reason through complex systems and understand how changes in one area affect wider network outcomes

- Experience translating analysis into operational, product or commercial decisions

- Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working with senior leaders

- The ability to bring structure to ambiguity, prioritise effectively and shape a clear roadmap

Experience in economics, marketplaces, logistics, mobility, supply and demand, pricing or operations would be valuable, but is not essential. We’re more interested in your ability to solve complex analytical problems within a dynamic, multi-sided marketplace.

WHY JOIN US?

Delivery is at the heart of Deliveroo’s customer proposition. The team’s work directly affects whether we have the right rider supply, how quickly orders arrive and how efficiently the marketplace operates.

In this role, you’ll work on distinctive and highly interconnected problems across network economics, logistics and rider operations. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape the team’s roadmap, influence senior stakeholders and develop a strong team of data scientists.

You’ll also have the opportunity to apply experimentation, causal inference and systems thinking to decisions that directly affect Deliveroo’s growth, service quality and network efficiency.

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, can create structure where needed and can align teams around the most important problems.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

At Deliveroo, we believe great workplaces reflect the world around us. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion or belief.

If you require adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re committed to ensuring everyone has an equitable opportunity to succeed.

Ready to shape how Deliveroo balances rider supply, consumer demand and delivery performance? Apply today.

israel.description:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our innovative legal professionals don't just solve problems - we partner with the business to find creative solutions, think holistically, and help drive Deliveroo's mission forward while protecting our company and stakeholders.

We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Counsel, Procurement to join our London team. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ for a minimum of 3 days a week. In this role, you’ll help us navigate complex commercial contracts, mitigate vendor risks, and scale our international technology and procurement capabilities across high-growth markets. You’ll report to the Senior Director, Associate General Counsel for the UK & Ireland.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

You’ll be joining the Technology and Procurement team within Commercial Legal. As part of DoorDash’s international legal function, we support our international business across Deliveroo and Wolt markets.

The Vendor/Tech team advises on critical matters that keep the business moving forward and are integral to facilitating market-leading initiatives. Whether it’s negotiating a deal to bring innovative technology into the business to support our cutting edge engineering team, managing the roll-out of highly-integrated SaaS platforms across multiple interfaces in many jurisdictions, or supporting the business with BAU contracts, we work closely with our business counterparts to make things happen.

Our responsibilities include technology procurement, AI procurement, payment services provider contracts, marketing and advertising procurement, commercial disputes, material outsourcings, strategic projects in vendor management, assisting with policy and handbook drafting and more.

As a Senior Counsel, you will consistently provide high-quality, risk-based legal advice across a range of commercial areas. You will build relationships of trust with stakeholders across the business, acting as a true partner to unlock opportunities and manage risk.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Advise on complex commercial transactions: Structure and negotiate a wide range of agreements, from off-the-shelf SaaS contracts to large-scale, multi-jurisdictional business unit outsourcings. You’re comfortable with the uncomfortable - whether that’s taking English law principles you know and collaborating with our external experts to work out the French law equivalent, or working in an entirely new area of law.

- Partner cross-functionally: Deliver pragmatic, business-focused legal advice to key stakeholders across Tech, Marketing, People, Finance, and Supply Chain on strategic projects and procurement needs.

israel.title: Account Manager - Paris
israel.description:
Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Descriptif du poste :

En tant que Account Manager – Paris, vous serez responsable du succès de votre portefeuille de comptes stratégiques, afin de mettre en place les outils les plus pertinents pour nos utilisateurs. Vous reporterez directement au Client Partner en place.

Vos principales missions :

- Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés dans des secteurs matures, nécessitant une réelle expertise et une attention particulière.

- Créer un partenariat privilégié et durable en apportant votre expertise Food Tech, en tant qu’expert(e) de votre zone/ville.

- Optimiser la rentabilité de votre portefeuille et proposer un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme avec l’appui de la data.

- Soyez un expert de votre zone et assurer le rayonnement de Deliveroo grâce à une vision 360 : account management, sales, marketing, opérations.

- Analyser la performance de votre portefeuille et prendre les mesures adéquates. Faire des recommandations directes au Client Partner, faire preuve d’agilité et d’ouverture à la nouveauté. Deliveroo est une entreprise en mouvement, avec des outils et options à déployer à un rythme soutenu.

- Suggérer et mettre en œuvre des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles adaptées à votre portefeuille.

- Suivre de près les opérations pour optimiser l’expérience à la fois des restaurants partenaires et des clients.

Votre expérience et vos qualités :

- 2 à 3 ans d’expérience minimum sur un poste similaire.

- Capacité à négocier, anticiper des discussions commerciales, entreprendre les actions nécessaires pour maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociation d’outils commerciaux, etc.) et atteindre les objectifs (OKRs).

- Capacités d’analyse data afin d’y tirer des axes de croissance nécessaires au développement de vos comptes.

- Capacité à garder le contrôle de son portefeuille Partenaires, à observer les tendances du marché et à fournir des retours en temps réel à ses partenaires et à son manager.

- Expertise terrain : proche de vos partenaires, vous êtes capable d’assurer une veille concurrentielle qualitative sur votre portefeuille et votre secteur.

- Capacité à convaincre et à influencer vos partenaires pour atteindre les objectifs fixés, tout en respectant les valeurs de Deliveroo.

- Proactivité et capacité à tirer des conclusions des résultats de vos actions pour faire des recommandations pertinentes aux partenaires.

- Compréhension et appropriation rapide des objectifs à atteindre, avec autonomie et détermination.

- Capacité à mettre en place des actions personnalisées et cohérentes avec les besoins des partenaires et les directives managériales.

- Capacité à identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance commerciale et opérationnelle sur l’ensemble de votre portefeuille dans une logique d’excellence de service.

- Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit/parlé) pour défendre un point de vue et communiquer efficacement.

- Capacité à construire des relations commerciales durables afin de faire de Deliveroo la référence de la “food” aux yeux de nos partenaires.

Environnement de travail & avantages

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.

Diversité

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.
