israel.title: Implementation Manager
israel.location: Remote — London - The River Building HQ
israel.description:
We’re in the business of delivering awesome meals into everyone's home or office – fast.

We achieve this by building and running a superb website, suite of mobile apps, a complex logistical platform, a fleet of passionate drivers, and a global operation, all to help bring great food from the world's best-loved local restaurants to consumers with an unparalleled level of convenience. We don’t want people to have to suffer with bad takeaway delivered an age after they order.

About the team

This role sits within the Express Integrations Team. You will be helping the hospitality industry grow as a member of the Technology org that is responsible for building the best food delivery platform for our first-party restaurant and grocery partners.

About the role

You will be responsible for managing the integration efforts and relationships across multiple parties including restaurant & grocery partners, external technology providers and business stakeholders, to ensure clear visibility within each project and drive the project to successful completion.

This is a great opportunity to work with a diverse set of teams in a fast-changing environment and is integral to driving success as we grow. This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week fro our London office, and you will report into our Senior Technical Integrations Manager.

What you'll be doing

- Technical integration ownership: Manage the end-to-end API technical integration of partners, from integration through to test planning, UAT, and production go-live, working with engineering and product to troubleshoot and resolve issues along the way.

- Detailed planning: You will manage pre-kickoff preparations, project kickoffs, project plans including milestones and all project communications to ensure the successful adoption of the product with our key accounts.

- Management throughout the lifecycle of a project: responsibilities include, but are not limited to creating rollout plans specific to each project, establishing go-live criteria and defining the owners of each stage, issue tracking and clearing, and communicating progress to the wider business. Throughout, you will need to anticipate bottlenecks, explore contingencies and provide escalation management throughout new product launches.

- Stakeholder management: This is a critical role for Deliveroo to make sure both external and internal teams are working toward the same goal and managing communication & changes as we roll out the product further. You’ll need to advocate for all stakeholders throughout the release cycle to ensure they have the support needed to succeed.

- Process optimisation: It’s essential that we learn from every launch, and get quicker and more streamlined every time. You’ll be responsible for identifying where we can improve, and making sure that we execute required changes across product and engineering, business, or POS teams.

- Analyse and aggregate feedback from our partners on our products and liaise with Product Management to assist in their prioritisation.

Requirements

- Understanding of API integrations

- 5 yrs relevant experience in Technical Integrations Management, Technical Programme Management or similar roles

- Technical understanding and ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical audience

- Ability to manage technical configuration of SaaS-like solutions

- Comfort troubleshooting technical issues using data tools

- Willingness to take responsibility, run multiple projects simultaneously, and drive them forward without close supervision

- Experience working with product and engineering teams

- Very good working knowledge of Jira, Confluence & Jira Service Management

- Excellent communication, organisation and project planning skills with emphasis on technology

- Demonstrated stakeholder management / relationship building skills

- Ability to hold each party responsible for their actions

You may have:

- Experience leveraging AI tooling as a means to improve your and the team’s productivity.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

israel.title: Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform
israel.description:
SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, MACHINE LEARNING INFRASTRUCTURE - GENERATIVE AI

ABOUT THE TEAM

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, leading the design and architecture of our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You’ll set technical direction across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability, and mentor engineers as you go. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous, high-impact systems and pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

YOU’RE EXCITED ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY BECAUSE YOU WILL…

- Lead the design of infrastructure that helps teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

- Own and evolve our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

- Architect scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

- Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

- Build platforms that support rapid experimentation while meeting production standards for latency, scale, monitoring, SLOs, playbooks, and operational excellence.

- Partner closely with — and raise the technical bar for — ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

- Set technical direction for the future of the company's centralised GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimisation, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation.

WE’RE EXCITED ABOUT YOU BECAUSE…

- BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent

- 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering

- Deep backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems.

- Track record of designing and owning production services, APIs, data pipelines, or ML infrastructure at scale.

israel.description:
We’re in the business of delivering awesome meals into everyone's home or office – fast.

We don’t want people to have to suffer with bad takeaway delivered an age after they order.

This role sits within the Express Integrations Team. You will be helping the hospitality industry grow as a member of the Technology org that is responsible for building the best food delivery platform for our first-party restaurant and grocery partners.

About the role

You will be responsible for managing the integration efforts and relationships across multiple parties including restaurant & grocery partners, external technology providers and business stakeholders, to ensure clear visibility within each project and drive the project to successful completion.

This is a great opportunity to work with a diverse set of teams in a fast-changing environment and is integral to driving success as we grow. This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week fro our London office, and you will report into our Senior Technical Integrations Manager.

What you'll be doing

- Technical integration ownership: Manage the end-to-end API technical integration of partners, from integration through to test planning, UAT, and production go-live, working with engineering and product to troubleshoot and resolve issues along the way.

- Understanding of API integrations

- 5 yrs relevant experience in Technical Integrations Management, Technical Programme Management or similar roles

- Technical understanding and ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical audience

- Experience working with product and engineering teams

- Very good working knowledge of Jira, Confluence & Jira Service Management

- Excellent communication, organisation and project planning skills with emphasis on technology

As the UKI Value & Promotional Strategy Manager you will translate central initiatives and promotions into high impact UKI campaigns. - Pitch and sell strategic promotional programmes to key commercial stakeholders to secure buy-in and maximum partner engagement.

- Keep on top of competitor trends and activity to refine strategies in the regional market.

- Owning the Go To Market strategy and sell-in for UKI promotions

- 3-4 years experience in Marketing or Commercial role, mandatory to have worked with value / promotional campaigns

israel.location: Remote — London - The River Building HQ
israel.description:
HEAD OF CREATIVE

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We’re looking for a Head of Creative to join our London team. This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week from our London HQ. In this role, you’ll set the creative vision for Deliveroo's global brand, leading a multidisciplinary team to deliver bold, high-impact work that drives measurable business success.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll be joining the Brand & Experience team. Sitting at the heart of our customer, rider, and partner touchpoints, we blend strategic thinking with creative excellence to shape perceptions and spark engagement worldwide.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Set the creative vision and strategy: Partner with Marketing, Product, and cross-functional stakeholders to define, evolve, and execute global creative strategies for major brand campaigns, product launches, and key initiatives.

- Lead and develop talent: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of nine creatives (including three direct reports) across art direction, digital content, and copywriting, fostering an inclusive culture of growth and collaboration.

- Champion creative excellence: Drive cross-functional collaboration with global and local teams, overseeing work from concept through execution to guarantee exceptional standards across every touchpoint.

- Advance creative innovation: Partner with Creative Operations and Creative Technology to scale AI-enabled workflows, automation, and emerging tools (such as Figma Make, Figma AI, or Weave) that enhance team speed, quality, and efficiency.

- Optimise team delivery and impact: Collaborate with Project Management to prioritise initiatives, allocate resources effectively, and keep the team ahead of creative, cultural, and technological trends.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

Essential

- Creative Leadership: Significant experience leading high-performing multidisciplinary creative teams across both agency and in-house environments, with exceptional coaching and talent development skills.

- Strategic & Hands-on Expertise: Strong expertise in brand strategy, creative direction, and digital content, supported by a portfolio demonstrating creative strategy that delivers measurable business impact.

- Process & AI Integration: Deep understanding of the end-to-end creative process alongside practical experience embedding AI-powered creative tools and workflows into day-to-day team operations.

- Stakeholder & Change Management: Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to influence senior leaders, collaborate cross-functionally, and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

- Execution & Balance: Excellent organisational skills with a strong creative instinct that balances ambitious, bold thinking with pragmatism and attention to detail.

Nice to Have

- Experience operating within both technology and high-growth in-house creative environments.

- Advanced proficiency with Figma and its AI capabilities, including Figma Make, Figma AI, and Weave.

WHY JOIN US?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

israel.location: Remote — London - The River Building HQ
israel.description:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions.

Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us own the vision, strategy, and execution for Double Order—transforming one of our most exciting consumer bets into a scaled, lasting part of how people use Deliveroo.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll be joining the Double Order team. Double Order allows customers to add a second restaurant or store to a single delivery, sitting directly at the intersection of customer experience, marketplace economics, and real-world logistics. You will be responsible for balancing these forces to find creative, high-impact moves that grow the business and delight customers simultaneously.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Own vision and strategy: Define and execute the end-to-end roadmap and OKRs for Double Order, taking it from early discovery through to a scaled, sustainable product.

- Balance complex marketplace dynamics: Solve for customer value and business growth alongside the underlying economics and logistics required to make multi-order journeys viable.

- Drive cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Logistics, Finance, and Market teams to ship, learn, and iterate at pace.

- Combine data with strong judgement: Lead experiment-driven development, navigating incomplete information, and knowing when to incrementally optimise versus completely rethink an approach.

- Align senior stakeholders: Communicate strategy, trade-offs, and key learnings clearly to build wide organisation-level conviction in your domain's direction.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

- Demonstrated product ownership: Proven track record of delivering measurable outcomes for consumer-facing products operating at scale.

- Broad domain experience: Breadth across multiple stages of the customer journey (e.g. checkout, discovery, pricing, retention) with an ability to connect strategic dots across complex systems.

- Navigating ambiguity and trade-offs: Experience taking ownership of high-stakes, ambiguous problems and balancing competing business priorities within a marketplace, platform, or low-margin environment.

- Analytical and commercial rigour: Strong quantitative skills paired with sound business instincts to validate hypotheses and make consequential calls.

- Cross-functional and stakeholder leadership: Proven ability to build trust across multidisciplinary teams (Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, Finance) and align senior stakeholders on difficult trade-offs.

- Exceptional communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex strategies with conviction.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with bundling, multi-order, or complex marketplace logistics products.

- Deep familiarity with large-scale experimentation frameworks and product development.

WHY JOIN US?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale

Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast

Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership

Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders

High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create

Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog deliveroo.engineering.

israel.title: S&O Manager - Rider Fraud
israel.location: Remote — London - The River Building HQ
israel.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

This role will lead our approach to understanding and reducing courier/rider fraud and abuse across Wolt and Deliveroo. Combining data-led investigation with strong operational judgement, you will identify emerging risk patterns, understand the features of our operating models that may contribute to those risks, and assess their potential impact.

A key part of the role is turning insight into action. You will translate analysis into clear, proportionate policies and operational responses that protect platform integrity and customer outcomes, while remaining practical to implement and appropriate for the markets in which we operate. You will work closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science and Operations to navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations and ensure our approach is effective, fair and robust.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead a programme of work to identify, assess and prioritise courier/rider fraud and abuse risks across Wolt and Deliveroo.

- Translate identified risks into proportionate policy, process and operational responses, balancing risk reduction with customer outcomes, courier/rider experience and business practicality.

- Lead the implementation, monitoring and ongoing refinement of fraud and abuse policies, with clear measures of effectiveness and residual risk.

- Ensure policy approaches are developed with appropriate consideration of legal, regulatory, compliance and reputational implications.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Build a deep understanding of our courier/rider operating models, incentive structures and end-to-end journeys to identify where fraud or abuse risk may arise, using data, operational knowledge and structured, hypothesis-led analysis.

- Develop analytical approaches and key metrics to identify patterns, quantify impact, assess detection signals and measure the effectiveness of policy interventions over time.

- Define new policies, or revise existing ones, in response to identified risks that may negatively affect customers, couriers/riders, the platform or the wider business.

- Conduct impact and risk assessments, framing clear options and recommendations that consider effectiveness, operational feasibility, cost, legal and regulatory requirements, and potential unintended consequences.

- Partner closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science, Trust and Operations teams to shape business requirements, implement agreed responses and resolve complex trade-offs.

- Establish effective ways of working across Wolt and Deliveroo so that emerging trends, priority risks and lessons from policy performance are identified early and shared with relevant stakeholders.

- Lead cross-functional delivery from problem identification through to implementation, reporting and post-launch monitoring, adapting the approach as new evidence emerges.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 6+ years’ experience in fraud, risk, compliance, policy, operations, consulting or a related field.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to combine data, operational context and judgement to identify root causes and prioritise action.

- Experience translating complex or ambiguous risk issues into practical policies, recommendations and implementation plans.

- Experience navigating complex legal and regulatory landscapes and working constructively with Legal and Public Policy stakeholders.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders and challenge constructively when needed.

- Strong project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, prioritise effectively and drive delivery in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable using AI-enabled tools appropriately to support analysis, hypothesis generation and problem solving.



Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

The Live Network team owns real-time execution of Deliveroo's delivery network across all European markets (UK&I, France, Italy, Belgium), with supporting scope in the Middle East. israel.description:
Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!



Descriptif du poste :

En tant que Business Development Manager basé(e) à Marseille, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l’expansion de Deliveroo en France. Rattaché(e) au Regional Sales Manager, vous rejoindrez une équipe ambitieuse et déterminée à accélérer notre croissance.

Vous serez responsable du développement commercial d'un portefeuille de villes situées principalement dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, le Var et le Vaucluse (notamment Marseille, La Ciotat, Toulon et Avignon), avec une présence régulière sur le terrain afin d'accompagner la croissance de Deliveroo sur votre secteur.

Vos principales responsabilités seront :

- Prospecter et signer de nouveaux restaurateurs partenaires (téléphone & terrain).

- Développer un portefeuille de restaurateurs sur plusieurs villes de votre secteur, principalement dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, le Var et le Vaucluse.

- Générer un volume d’appels quotidiens pour alimenter votre pipeline commercial.

- Être présent(e) sur le terrain afin de rencontrer les restaurateurs de votre secteur.

- Présenter et vendre l’offre Deliveroo en s’appuyant sur le script de vente interne et en adaptant votre discours à chaque interlocuteur.

- Piloter les négociations commerciales de bout en bout et conclure efficacement les ventes.

- Atteindre vos objectifs mensuels et assurer un suivi rigoureux dans le CRM.

- Accompagner les partenaires après signature et reporter régulièrement votre activité à votre manager.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

- Bac+3 minimum ou expérience équivalente en vente.

- Expérience confirmée en commerce, idéalement en B2B.

- À l’aise avec la prospection terrain et le contact commerçant.

- Excellent relationnel, sens de la négociation et du closing.

- Autonome, organisé(e) et orienté(e) résultats.

- Appétence pour l’univers de la restauration et de la foodtech.

- Permis B obligatoire.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

- Un salaire fixe attractif avec des commissions déplafonnées sur les ventes réalisées.

- De réelles perspectives d'évolution au sein de l’équipe commerciale et plus largement dans l'entreprise.

- Un environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif, au cœur d’une entreprise en pleine croissance.

- Télétravail hybride pour un meilleur équilibre entre autonomie et esprit d’équipe.

- Une politique avantageuse pour les parents.

- Un accès à WellPass à tarif préférentiel pour entretenir votre bien-être.

- Les frais de livraison offerts sur Deliveroo+ pour profiter de nos meilleures offres.

Si vous êtes motivé(e), persévérant(e) et prêt(e) à relever de nouveaux défis au sein d’une équipe de vente dynamique et ambitieuse, postulez dès maintenant et participez à la croissance de Deliveroo !



Environnement de travail & avantages

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.



Diversité

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!

Ce dont vous avez besoin pour nous rejoindre, c'est surtout le désir de faire partie de l'une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide dans un secteur passionnant, celui de la foodtech.

You’ll be joining the Global Supply Chain team, responsible for getting physical goods—courier apparel, equipment, in-store technology, and consumables—to our riders, merchants, and partners across every market. Sourcing Strategy & Execution

- Translate category strategies into actionable sourcing plans across warehousing, last-mile fulfilment, apparel, manufacturing, and consumables, driving consolidation across our brands.



- Lead end-to-end competitive sourcing events, utilizing spend analytics, market intelligence, and total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling to secure optimal commercial outcomes.



- Build and execute robust negotiation positions, focusing on unit cost, freight, duty, quality protections, and working capital impact.



Contract & Supplier Management

- Own the end-to-end contracting process in partnership with Legal, maintaining a complete contract register and enforcing lifecycle obligations, renewals, and rebates.



- Drive day-to-day commercial supplier management, conducting structured performance reviews, establishing operational KPIs, and managing Joint Improvement Plans.



- Mitigate supply chain risk and ensure continuity of supply, establishing dual-sourcing strategies, financial risk assessments, and strict ethical sourcing/modern slavery compliance across manufacturing partners.

- Proven capability in supplier relationship and performance management, with experience handling complex commercial disputes and driving joint innovation.



- Strong analytical and financial acumen, with expertise in total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling, landed cost structures, and spend analytics.

Nice to Have

- Experience sourcing apparel or hardgoods manufacturing, including factory selection, quality control, and ethical audit frameworks.

israel.title: Value and Promotional Strategy Manager, UKI
israel.description:
About the role

As the UKI Value & Promotional Strategy Manager you will translate central initiatives and promotions into high impact UKI campaigns. You will have end-to-end ownership of the UKI promotional calendar along with defining the value strategy for both customer and merchants, liaising, pitching and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders and localising the Global strategy for UKI. Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, you will work cross-functionally to optimise promotional investments and deliver maximum customer value while driving business growth. This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week from our Manchester office.

You will be responsible for utilising data driven insights, past performance and market trends to identify growth opportunities to improve ROI and impact through experimentation. This is a high impact role where you will bridge the gap between commercial objectives and customer experience.

What you'll be doing

- End to end ownership of UKI local promotions and merchant offers. Partnering with central functions to identify market needs and partner requirements and defining the “where” and “how” to play, building and implementing a strategy to support these needs

- Owning the team’s reporting cycle, delivering weekly and monthly performance analysis and campaigns. Identify emerging trends and data-driven optimisation areas to foster a culture of continuous improvement.

- Champion the voice of customers and partners in the promotional space, working closely with the commercial, finance, value & promotions and partner facing teams to stay up to date with partner needs and perspectives.

- Partner with Insights and Data Science teams to develop a strong sense of Customer needs and key Qs and research that needs deploying.

- Partner with central teams to adapt global strategies for the UKI market, ensuring regional priorities and merchant needs are embedded into business plans

- Define and implement promo strategies to deliver on objectives and KPIs, ensuring best in class execution. Lead on trade offs and requests based on importance, urgency and impact.

- Align promotional plans between different central and local marketing teams to ensure we have the right technical, reporting and targeting foundations in place for the plan.

- Instrumental in defining the UKI customer and merchant promotional strategy. Driving high-value discount, vouchering, and offer initiatives that maximise local engagement, ROI, and partner growth.

- Pitch and sell strategic promotional programmes to key commercial stakeholders to secure buy-in and maximum partner engagement.

- Keep on top of competitor trends and activity to refine strategies in the regional market.

- Owning the Go To Market strategy and sell-in for UKI promotions

Requirements

- 3-4 years experience in Marketing or Commercial role, mandatory to have worked with value / promotional campaigns

- Preferred Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, particularly commercial teams.

- Experience presenting ideas and recommendations to senior leadership to gain buy in

- You’re both analytical & commercial and you enjoy interpreting data to develop insight/consumer-led marketing strategy. Comfortable with analytical tools like excel.

- You have strong interpersonal skills and can manage multiple cross-departmental stakeholders; confident communicating at all levels

- Ability to adapt and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for improvement.

- You have a proven track record in making things happen - delivering results quickly and efficiently.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

- Demonstrated leadership and experience training other associates

israel.description:
The Role

As a Senior Operations Manager for our New Partner Experience team you will oversee and develop high-performing operational teams while designing and delivering long-term strategic frameworks to enhance commercial performance. As an Operations Manager, you will work closely with the function leads to ensure the operation is both efficient and high performing. You will strive for excellence by understanding stakeholder requirements and support on delivering operational initiatives that drive performance.

Based in Manchester and reporting to the Head Of New Partner Experience, this is an ideal role for an individual who has experience in delivering a number of support roles that enables large operations to run smoothly whilst also being able to design and implement long term initiatives that drive change.

The Team

The Small Medium Business (SMB) teams are responsible for Deliveroo’s relationships with thousands of independent restaurant and retail partners that operate on the Deliveroo marketplace in a number of markets across Europe, ensuring that they continue to grow and operate efficiently. The SMB team spans the full life-cycle of partner interactions from initial acquisition, on-boarding, reactive support and proactive account management. We do this through our in-house contact centre based in Manchester and in collaboration with our third-party contact centre providers.

Core Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Team Management

- Guide daily activities across operational functions, ensuring service excellence, adherence to performance targets, and seamless cross-team collaboration

- Championing change and leading on identifying new ways of working in collaboration with other Deliveroo functions to ensure we have the right tools and content to support our agents in delivering the right partner outcomes

- Coach, mentor, and develop team members, cultivating an inclusive and accountable environment focused on continuous improvement.

Strategic Planning

- Define and translate medium to long-term strategies into actionable business plans that drive commercial objectives—such as revenue growth, profitability, and efficiency.

- Monitor KPIs and financial metrics, using insights to adjust processes, manage risk, and support strategic decision-making and effective planning processes

- Collaborate with senior leadership to align commercial strategy with operational capabilities and resource allocation

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

- Drive transformation and continuous improvement initiatives, integrating new technologies and operational models that support commercial targets.

- Communicate strategic plans, performance trends, and operational insights to executive teams, commercial partners, and frontline staff

What You’ll Be Doing

- Transforming insights into actionable, measurable, and resilient growth plans

- Delivering the operational strategy for the EU hub, ensuring local programs are executed efficiently including but not limited to implementation of product launches, identifying skill gaps, creating and implementing local incentives that drive performance.

- Championing change and leading on identifying new ways of working in collaboration with other Deliveroo functions to ensure we have the right tools and content to support our agents in acquiring new partners

- Partnering with the central teams to build robust plans that support driving change in the hub; through better engagement, improved efficiencies or increased capabilities.

- Manage a team of Onboarding Agents across one of Deliveroos key markets.

- Acting as a mentor and senior lead to junior Team Leads.

The candidate will be passionate about delivering initiatives that drive performance across the operation and will be someone who is innovative in their approach. The successful candidate will have a keen eye for detail and will be someone who has strong stakeholder management skills.

The required skills include:

- Good organisational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a live operational environment

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

israel.title: Business Development Manager - Paris (CDD 6 mois)
israel.description:
Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Descriptif du poste :

En tant que Business Development Manager en CDD basé(e) à Paris, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l’expansion de Deliveroo en France. Rattaché(e) au Regional Sales Manager, vous rejoindrez une équipe ambitieuse et déterminée à accélérer notre croissance.



Vos principales responsabilités seront:

- Prospecter et signer de nouveaux restaurateurs partenaires (téléphone & terrain).

- Générer un volume d’appels quotidiens pour alimenter votre pipeline commercial.

- Être présent sur le terrain

- Présenter et vendre l’offre Deliveroo en s’appuyant sur le script de vente interne et en adaptant votre discours à chaque interlocuteur.

- Piloter les négociations commerciales de bout en bout et conclure efficacement les ventes.

- Atteindre vos objectifs mensuels et assurer un suivi rigoureux dans le CRM.

- Accompagner les partenaires après signature et reporter régulièrement votre activité a votre manager.

Profil recherché:

- Bac+3 minimum ou expérience équivalente en vente.

- Expérience confirmée en commerce, idéalement en B2B.

- À l’aise avec la prospection terrain et le contact commerçant.

- Excellent relationnel, sens de la négociation et du closing.

- Autonome, organisé(e) et orienté(e) résultats.

- Appétence pour l’univers de la restauration et de la foodtech.

- Permis B obligatoire.



Ce que nous offrons :

- Un salaire fixe attractif avec des commissions déplafonnées sur les ventes réalisées.

- De réelles perspectives d'évolution au sein de l’équipe commerciale et plus largement dans l'entreprise.

- Un environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif, au cœur d’une entreprise en pleine croissance.

- Télétravail hybride pour un meilleur équilibre entre autonomie et esprit d’équipe.

- Une politique avantageuse pour les parents.

- Un accès à WellPass à tarif préférentiel pour entretenir votre bien-être.

- Les frais de livraison offerts sur Deliveroo+ pour profiter de nos meilleures offres.

Si vous êtes motivé(e), persévérant(e) et prêt(e) à relever de nouveaux défis au sein d’une équipe de vente dynamique et ambitieuse, postulez dès maintenant et participez à la croissance de Deliveroo !



Environnement de travail & avantages

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.



Diversité

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!

Deliveroo France a obtenu un score de 98/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2025, témoignage de notre engagement envers la diversité et l'égalité des chances. Ce dont vous avez besoin pour nous rejoindre, c'est surtout le désir de faire partie de l'une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide dans un secteur passionnant, celui de la foodtech.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

israel.description:

Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We’re looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to join our London team. This is a six month fixed term contract and will be a hybrid role working 3 days a week from our London HQ. In this role, you’ll help us drive business growth and manage best-in-class strategy, planning, and execution for digital media across key channels.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Digital Media team. We are a vibrant, data-driven function collaborating closely with creative, data science, and marketing technology teams to deliver innovative campaigns.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Manage end-to-end platform setup, activation, optimisation, and reporting for programmatic video and paid social across brand proposition and tactical campaigns.

- Respond to briefs in collaboration with internal planning teams, forecasting audience reach and recommending channel strategies to meet commercial goals.

- Build and manage ad-serving tags, trackers, and CM360 trafficking processes to ensure accurate performance measurement and conversion tracking.

- Design and run A/B tests and brand lift studies to strengthen channel insights and systematically improve campaign efficiency.

- Deliver weekly performance updates and post-campaign analysis, translating complex metrics into actionable learnings for key internal and external stakeholders.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

- Direct expertise activating and optimising media via DV360, Meta, and TikTok within a high-growth consumer-facing or D2C brand.

israel.title: Business Development Manager - Strasbourg
israel.description:
Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!



Descriptif du poste :

En tant que Business Development Manager basé(e) à Strasbourg, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l’expansion de Deliveroo en France. Rattaché(e) au Regional Sales Manager, vous rejoindrez une équipe ambitieuse et déterminée à accélérer notre croissance.

Vos principales responsabilités seront:

- Prospecter et signer de nouveaux restaurateurs partenaires (téléphone & terrain).

- Générer un volume d’appels quotidiens pour alimenter votre pipeline commercial.

- Être présent sur le terrain au moins 3 jours par semaine pour développer votre zone.

- Présenter et vendre l’offre Deliveroo en s’appuyant sur le script de vente interne et en adaptant votre discours à chaque interlocuteur.

- Piloter les négociations commerciales de bout en bout et conclure efficacement les ventes.

- Atteindre vos objectifs mensuels et assurer un suivi rigoureux dans le CRM.

- Accompagner les partenaires après signature et reporter régulièrement votre activité a votre manager.



Profil recherché:

- Bac+3 minimum ou expérience équivalente en vente.

- Expérience confirmée en commerce, idéalement en B2B.

- À l’aise avec la prospection terrain et le contact commerçant.

- Excellent relationnel, sens de la négociation et du closing.

- Autonome, organisé(e) et orienté(e) résultats.

- Appétence pour l’univers de la restauration et de la foodtech.

- Permis B souhaité.



Ce que nous offrons :

- Un salaire fixe attractif avec des commissions déplafonnées sur les ventes réalisées.

- De réelles perspectives d'évolution au sein de l’équipe commerciale et plus largement dans l'entreprise.

- Un environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif, au cœur d’une entreprise en pleine croissance.

- Télétravail hybride pour un meilleur équilibre entre autonomie et esprit d’équipe.

- Une politique avantageuse pour les parents.

- Un accès à WellPass à tarif préférentiel pour entretenir votre bien-être.

- Les frais de livraison offerts sur Deliveroo+ pour profiter de nos meilleures offres.

Si vous êtes motivé(e), persévérant(e) et prêt(e) à relever de nouveaux défis au sein d’une équipe de vente dynamique et ambitieuse, postulez dès maintenant et participez à la croissance de Deliveroo !



Environnement de travail & avantages

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.



Diversité

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!

Deliveroo France a obtenu un score de 98/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2025, témoignage de notre engagement envers la diversité et l'égalité des chances. Ce dont vous avez besoin pour nous rejoindre, c'est surtout le désir de faire partie de l'une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide dans un secteur passionnant, celui de la foodtech.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

israel.description:
The Dev Environments team sits within DoorDash's Foundations group (Platform Engineering). We own the local and remote developer experience across the DoorDash group of companies supporting over 5000 engineers. Our mission is to enable engineering velocity, quality, and efficiency at significant scale by removing friction from the day-to-day developer loop: spinning up a working environment, getting code building, and getting feedback fast, whether the "developer" is a human or an AI agent.

As a Staff Engineer on Dev Environments, you'll be recognised as an expert across the dev environments space, covering both local and remote dev flows, devcontainers, IDE/remote backends, and how they all fit together, including owning accountability for outcomes that span multiple teams. You'll set technical direction for the team's roadmap, unblock deep cross-cutting technical problems other engineers can't resolve alone, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership across the group to translate ambiguous, company-wide developer-experience problems into a concrete, sequenced technical strategy.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Technical direction

- Define the architecture for how thousands of engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo actually develop and ship code: local and remote dev containers, remote IDE/VM lifecycle, and the full local-to-remote loop.

- Build monorepo dev tooling at scale. It's part of consolidating all the companies under DoorDash’s umbrella onto one global backend - you're setting the standard, not patching one org's tooling.

- Provision production-shaped environments in seconds, keep state in sync over the network, and make a remote machine feel local, reliably and cheaply, at thousands-of-concurrent-engineers scale.

- Expect to invent as much as you adopt: much of this is genuinely unsolved elsewhere in the industry.

- Design for AI agents as first-class consumers of the environment, not an afterthought: sandboxes that spin up on demand, run in parallel, and are safe to hand a real repo.

- Support agents launched from an IDE, a CLI, or a Slack message - with no laptop required to review and ship what the agent did.

Collaboration & leadership

- Align teams that don't naturally sit adjacent to each other (e.g. Security, Infrastructure, Product Engineering) around unstructured, ambiguous problems where there's no existing playbook.

- Mentor engineers at all levels: run design reviews; raise the engineering bar through code review, pairing, and architectural guidance when appropriate.

- Help set the hiring bar: lead interview loops, help calibrate, and support onboarding of senior hires.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

Essential:

- A track record of shipping production systems and leading cross-team initiatives with group level impact - comfortable owning delivery end to end, from design through to production and adoption.

- Hands on fluency with the languages and tooling used to build developer tooling (e.g. Go, Python, TypeScript) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).

- Experience managing compute via Kubernetes (multi-tenant workload isolation, autoscaling ephemeral workloads, cost management), or lightweight VM/sandbox technology (e.g. Firecracker).

- Working knowledge of cloud networking, including securely and cost-effectively routing traffic across network boundaries (VPNs, service meshes, etc.)

- Experience integrating LLM/AI tooling into developer workflows - e.g. Claude Code - both locally, and remotely.

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence senior stakeholders and align multiple non-adjacent teams without formal authority over them.

- Experience building close working relationships with the engineering teams who consume your platform, not just the platform team itself.

Nice to have:

- Experience in developer platforms or adjacent infrastructure: devcontainers, remote development, remote IDE backends, or developer workstation tooling.

israel.description:
DIRECTOR OF REVENUE ACCOUNTING

About the Role

Hopper is hiring a Senior Manager or Director of Revenue Accounting to own our end-to-end revenue recognition and partner economics function — building it from the ground up. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role reporting directly to the Global Corporate Controller, sitting at the intersection of technical accounting, data infrastructure, and commercial partnership. You'll mature manual workflows into a fully automated solution in NetSuite while serving as the primary Finance contact across a broad range of partner arrangements.

What would your day-to-day look like

- Design and build the end-to-end automated invoicing and revenue accounting cycle in NetSuite, converting current manual processes into a scalable, repeatable solution

- Liaise with the data warehouse team to reconcile source data, identify gaps, and drive corrections that ensure accurate data flows into accounting workflows

- Own the full invoicing cycle across all partner arrangements — revenue share, commissions, and other structures — from setup through collection

- Interpret and account for complex deal structures including tiered revenue share, variable commissions, clawbacks, and multi-element arrangements

- Ensure accurate revenue recognition under ASC 606 and draft technical accounting memos to support it

- Maintain the AR subledger, reconcile to the GL, and own month-end close across all partner revenue streams

- Use advanced SQL to independently pull, validate, and reconcile large transaction datasets across systems

- Read and interpret commercial contracts to surface accounting implications; partner with BD and Legal on new deal structuring

- Serve as the primary Finance contact for external partners on dispute resolution, remittance inquiries, and contract interpretation

- Oversee collections including aging review, escalation, and resolution of overdue balances

- Establish internal controls and support external audits related to revenue and partner accounting


An ideal candidate has

- CPA designation a must

- 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including revenue recognition and partner or customer billing

- Advanced SQL skills — able to independently pull and reconcile data without relying on a data team

- Deep knowledge of ASC 606 and demonstrated experience drafting technical accounting memos

- Ability to read and interpret commercial contracts and identify their accounting implications

- Strong data reconciliation skills across large, multi-source datasets

- Experience owning collections and managing external partner relationships

- Clear, confident communication style with senior leadership and external partners alike

Preferred: NetSuite AR, billing, and automation experience

Preferred: A background at a high-growth technology or marketplace company

Preferred: Experience working cross-functionally with data engineering or warehouse teams

Preferred: Experience working as an IC and independently owning accounting functions


PERKS AND BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US:

- Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.

- Unlimited PTO.

- Carrot Cash travel stipend.

- Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.

- Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

- Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.

- Open communication with management and company leadership.

- Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

- 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees.

- Access to Disability & Life insurance.

- Health Reimbursement Account (HRA).

- DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan.

MORE ABOUT HOPPER

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

HERE ARE JUST A FEW STATS THAT DEMONSTRATE THE COMPANY’S RECENT GROWTH:

- Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

- Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

- Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

- Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

- Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company.

We have raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

- Concevoir et mettre en place le cycle automatisé de facturation et de comptabilité des revenus dans NetSuite, en transformant les processus manuels actuels en une solution évolutive et reproductible

Il s'agit d'un véritable rôle « 0 à 1 ». Vous serez la personne qui définit le produit : comment les capacités sont regroupées et tarifées, comment les partenaires les découvrent et les intègrent, et comment la place de marché évolue en tant que plateforme d'affaires. Les capacités techniques sous-jacentes — orchestration de la connectivité, tarification et tri, cartographie de contenu, extranet — sont détenues par des équipes de capacités dédiées. Votre rôle est de travailler en étroite collaboration avec ces gestionnaires de produits (PM) pour comprendre, packager et exposer commercialement ces capacités sous forme de produits API cohérents et de calibre entreprise.

Nous attendons de ce PM qu'il agisse rapidement avec agilité (scrappily). Vous devez être à l'aise avec les outils d'IA et la programmation intuitive (vibe coding) pour prototyper des flux de travail, simuler des API et tester l'expérience des partenaires avant de passer le relais à l'ingénierie. Le candidat idéal privilégiera toujours un prototype avant un document d’exigences produit (PRD).

Vous collaborerez avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de science des données, commerciales, financières et d'approvisionnement — et vous coordonnerez étroitement avec d'autres PM à travers l'organisation — pour faire passer la place de marché du concept à une plateforme génératrice de revenus.

Ce poste est entièrement en télétravail.

- Définir la place de marché API de HTS : structurer, packager et tarifer les capacités d'un portefeuille incluant HTS Connect, les polygones de recherche, l'autocomplétion, le classement, la cartographie de contenu et de propriétés, la cartographie de chambres, la déduplication/enchères, la tarification, l'extranet, les taxes et le moteur d'accords personnalisés.

- Coordonner avec les PM de capacités : comprendre la feuille de route, les contraintes et les possibilités de personnalisation des systèmes techniques sous-jacents, et les traduire en produits API consommables à l'externe.

- Gérer le modèle commercial : prendre les décisions entre frais de plateforme et frais variables, définir la structure de commission (take rate) par capacité, le packaging entreprise et le cadre d'accords personnalisés pour les grands partenaires.

- Bâtir l'expérience développeur et partenaire à partir de zéro : spécifications d'API, flux d'intégration des partenaires, normes de documentation, environnements bac à sable (sandbox) et outils d'intégration minimisant le délai de rentabilisation.

- Utiliser l'IA et le prototypage rapide : tester les idées rapidement (simulations de réponses API, prototypes de portails partenaires) avant d'engager des ressources d'ingénierie.

- Établir la stratégie de mise en marché (GTM) : identifier les bons partenaires, séquencer les lancements et définir les critères de succès commerciaux.

- Gérer les revenus et pertes (P&L) de la place de marché : modéliser et suivre le volume d'affaires (GBV), le taux de commission et la rentabilité par unité de capacité en partenariat avec l'équipe des finances.

UN(E) CANDIDAT(E) IDÉAL DÉTIENT:

- Plus de 7 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits, avec au moins un produit bâti de « 0 à 1 » (du concept au lancement commercial).

- Expérience démontrée dans la création de produits B2B ou de places de marché orientées développeurs, incluant la conception de produits API et le packaging commercial pour entreprises.

- Méthode de travail axée sur l'IA : vous utilisez les LLM et la programmation intuitive comme outils de première ligne pour le prototypage. Vous avez déjà conçu des démos ou des preuves de concept (PoC) fonctionnels via l'IA.

- Solide compréhension de l'économie des places de marché : commissions, incitatifs côté offre, optimisation côté demande et modèles commerciaux variables vs plateforme.

- Capacité de coordination inter-équipes : synthétiser des feuilles de route et assurer l'alignement sans gérer directement l'ingénierie sous-jacente.

- Expérience avec des partenaires entreprises externes : traduire les besoins commerciaux en exigences produit et gérer les attentes lors de déploiements multiphasés.

- Maîtrise de SQL et des ensembles de données transactionnels à grande échelle.

- Excellentes capacités de communication écrite et verbale, incluant la rédaction de documentation API et produit claire.

Atouts :

- Expérience dans le commerce du voyage (hébergement, voitures, vols) ou dans les secteurs fintech ou publicitaires.

- Connaissance des systèmes de distribution (GDS, gestionnaires de canaux, API d'agences de voyages en ligne).

- Expérience préalable en ingénierie ou en science des données.


Ce poste requiert une maîtrise du français et de l’anglais. La personne retenue devra communiquer et collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, gestionnaires, clients, fournisseurs et partenaires d’affaires situés à l’extérieur du Québec, ainsi que consulter, préparer et utiliser de la documentation, des systèmes et des communications en français et en anglais. La connaissance de l’anglais est donc nécessaire à l’exercice des fonctions liées au poste ainsi qu’au respect des exigences opérationnelles et des besoins de la clientèle dans un environnement d’affaires international.

AVANTAGES À TRAVAILLER AVEC NOUS:

- Startup bien financée avec de grandes ambitions; salaire compétitif et options d'achat d'actions (pre-IPO).

- Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective.

- Couverture d'assurance vie et d'invalidité de courte et longue durée.

- Accès à un plan REER avec retenues salariales automatiques avant impôts.

- Congés payés (PTO) illimités.

- Crédits de voyage Carrot Cash.

- Accès à des espaces de cotravail sur demande via FlexDesk ET allocation pour le télétravail.

- Culture entrepreneuriale valorisant l'audace et la prise de risque.

À PROPOS DE HOPPER

Chez Hopper, notre mission est de devenir la plateforme de voyage de référence mondiale, propulsant l'application Hopper, notre site web et notre division B2B, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). En exploitant d'immenses volumes de données et des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique avancés, Hopper combine une offre d'agence de voyages de classe mondiale avec des produits fintech propriétaires pour apporter transparence et flexibilité aux voyageurs du monde entier.

HTS, notre division B2B, représente aujourd'hui plus de 75 % de nos activités. Nous aidons nos partenaires (compagnies aériennes, banques, hôtels) à dynamiser leurs canaux directs en intégrant nos produits fintech ou en alimentant leurs portails de voyage complets. Nos partenaires incluent des marques de renom telles que Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada et bien d'autres.

Hopper a été nommée l'entreprise la plus innovante dans le domaine du voyage par Fast Company. Avec plus de 750 millions $ US de capitaux levés, nous sommes prêts à poursuivre notre croissance en tant que chef de file du commerce électronique de voyage.

Venez prendre votre envol avec nous !

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.

This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.

We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.

You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.

This is a fully remote role.
