- Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.

- Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.

- Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.

- Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.

- Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.

- Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.

- Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine).


AN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:

- 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.

- Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.

- AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.

- Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.

- Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.

- Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.

- Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.

Bonus:

- Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.

- Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).

- Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.

- Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.


This position requires proficiency in both French and English. The successful candidate will be required to communicate and collaborate on a regular basis with colleagues, managers, clients, suppliers, and business partners located outside Quebec, and to review, prepare, and use documentation, systems, and communications in both French and English. Knowledge of English is therefore necessary for the performance of the duties associated with the position and to meet operational and client requirements in an international business environment.

PERKS & BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US:

- Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.

- Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan.

- Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage.

- HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses.

- All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere.

- All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay.

- Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.

- Unlimited PTO.

- Carrot Cash travel stipend.

- Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.

- Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.

- Open communication with management and company leadership.

- Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

#LI-REMOTE

This is a foundational role at the intersection of marketplace economics, machine learning, and financial systems. The work you do will directly shape partner economics, supplier transparency, and HTS’s global commerce platform.

What would your day-to-day look like:

- Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for pricing intelligence, supplier performance intelligence, and financial reconciliation across all travel verticals.
Architect and evolve reference pricing systems leveraging predictive modeling, elasticity signals, competitive benchmarking, and real-time anomaly detection.

- Build the supplier intelligence layer, transforming transactional data into automated performance signals, demand insights, and pricing diagnostics.

- Establish and govern the canonical source of truth for revenue, margin, take rate, transactions, and cancellations across systems and partners.

- Design model evaluation, monitoring, and feedback frameworks, including drift detection and continuous improvement mechanisms.

- Drive cross-functional execution across Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Commercial, and Supply to deliver production-grade, model-integrated infrastructure.


An ideal candidate has:

- 5+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of AI-native products and model-driven systems in production. You have built and scaled systems where AI is foundational to product behavior — not an additive feature.

- Hands-on experience writing prompts, designing evaluation harnesses, or prototyping with LLMs/foundation models as part of their PM workflow (not just overseeing others doing it)

- Strong fluency working independently with SQL and large-scale transactional datasets.

- Demonstrated experience operating as an AI-native PM, with hands-on ownership of model lifecycle management including problem framing, signal design, evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall tradeoffs, forecasting accuracy), monitoring frameworks, drift detection, and retraining strategies.

- Experience shipping predictive systems, anomaly detection platforms, automated decisioning infrastructure, or model-driven pricing systems at scale.

- Experience owning pricing systems, financial reporting platforms or marketplace intelligence tools.

- Deep understanding of marketplace economics, revenue mechanics, and pricing strategy.

- Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional systems with measurable business impact.

- Exceptional communicator able to operate effectively across technical and commercial stakeholders.

Bonus:

- Prior experience in Data Science, Engineering, or a highly technical role.

- Background in travel commerce, fintech, ads, or other transaction-heavy marketplace environments.


Perks and benefits of working with us:

- Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.

- Carrot Cash travel stipend

- Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend

- Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

- Open communication with management and company leadership

- Small, dynamic teams = massive impact



Engagement Status: Independent Contractor

Note on Contractual Status: This position is offered as an Independent Contractor engagement (Contract for Services) and does not constitute an offer of direct employment. The successful candidate will operate as a self-employed individual or through a Personal Service Company (PSC). You will be responsible for your own tax, PRSI, and VAT compliance in accordance with Irish Revenue Commissioners regulations. Engagement is contingent upon providing proof of valid business registration and appropriate professional indemnity insurance.


More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

Come take off with us!

israel.title: Gestionnaire principal, Systèmes de paie mondiaux et opérations d'équité
israel.description:
À PROPOS DU POSTE

En tant que gestionnaire principal des systèmes de paie mondiaux et des opérations d'équité chez HTS, vous agirez à titre de leader-accompagnateur se rapportant à la responsable des opérations de gestion des personnes et des technologies de la main-d'œuvre afin de moderniser et de mettre à l'échelle notre infrastructure de rémunération globale. Siégeant au sein de l'équipe de direction, votre mandat sera de faire évoluer la fonction pour passer d'un modèle de transferts manuels et de fournisseurs multiples à un modèle opérationnel automatisé et hautement évolutif qui maximise l'efficacité systémique sans croissance proportionnelle des effectifs. Ce poste à haute visibilité combine de manière unique la conception de systèmes interfonctionnels mondiaux et l'exécution pratique afin d'atténuer directement les risques opérationnels et financiers.

À QUOI RESSEMBLERA VOTRE QUOTIDIEN

- Prendre en charge le modèle opérationnel de paie mondiale de bout en bout pour les employés, les pigistes, les EOR, les PEO et les fournisseurs de paie locaux.

- Diriger et perfectionner une équipe de 2 à 3 subordonnés directs tout en maintenant une rigueur d'exécution et des normes opérationnelles élevées.

- Piloter l'administration opérationnelle de l'actionnariat des employés dans Shareworks, incluant le traitement des octrois, la mise à jour des données et la réconciliation interservices.

- Identifier et implanter des flux d'automatisation afin de minimiser les transferts manuels de données, les exceptions récurrentes et les frictions de données.

- Collaborer avec les équipes des technologies RH, des TI et des finances pour mener à bien la consolidation des plateformes de paie et maximiser la fiabilité des systèmes.

- Renforcer les protocoles de conformité, les contrôles de paie et la conservation de la documentation afin de protéger l'entreprise contre l'exposition financière et d'assurer la préparation aux audits.

- Établir des calendriers de traitement clairs, des indicateurs de responsabilité et des tableaux de bord de données pour mesurer l'exactitude de la fonction et les gains de capacité.

- Intervenir directement dans les dossiers complexes de fiscalité, d'équité et de paie propres à chaque marché afin de guider une résolution interfonctionnelle rapide.

LE CANDIDAT IDÉAL POSSÈDE

- Leadership en paie mondiale : Une expérience avérée dans la gestion d'opérations de paie multi-pays, en naviguant particulièrement dans les structures de type EOR, PEO et de fournisseurs locaux.

- Expertise en administration d'équité : Une connaissance directe des plateformes d'actionnariat comme Shareworks, incluant la gestion du cycle de vie des octrois et la coordination fiscale complexe liée à l'équité.

- Orientation systèmes et automatisation : Des antécédents solides en conception d'intégrations de SIRH, en optimisation de flux de travail et en élimination volontaire des interventions manuelles dans les opérations financières.

- Rigueur en matière de contrôles et conformité : Une connaissance approfondie des contrôles de paie, de la préparation aux audits financiers et des implications fiscales au sein d'une structure d'entreprise technologique ou fintech en forte croissance.

- Capacité de leader-accompagnateur : La capacité démontrée à gérer et à faire progresser une équipe opérationnelle à distance, tout en agissant simultanément comme expert technique pratique.

- Esprit commercial et analytique : La capacité de traduire des schémas opérationnels complexes en décisions claires et axées sur les données qui améliorent l'efficacité de la mise à l'échelle à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

AVANTAGES

- Une entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée : De grandes ambitions, un salaire concurrentiel et tous les avantages liés à des blocs d'actions pré-IPO.

- Assurance collective : Hopper prend en charge 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective.

- Protection du revenu : Hopper offre une couverture d'assurance vie ainsi qu'une assurance invalidité de courte et de longue durée.

- Compte de dépenses de santé (CDS) : Un compte qui couvre les frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles.

- Télémédecine : Tous les employés et leurs personnes à charge ont accès aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue, en tout temps et en tout lieu.

- Épargne-retraite : Tous les employés ont accès à un régime de REER avec des retenues à la source automatisées avant impôt à chaque paie.

- Congés parentaux : N'hésitez pas à nous poser des questions sur nos congés parentaux très généreux, qui dépassent largement les normes de l'industrie!

- Congés payés illimités (PTO) : Une politique de vacances flexible pour vous ressourcer.

- Allocation de voyage : Crédit de voyage « Carrot Cash » pour vos propres déplacements.

- Mode de travail flexible : Accès sur demande à des espaces de cotravail via FlexDesk ET une allocation pour le travail à domicile.

- Culture entrepreneuriale : Un environnement dynamique où repousser les limites et prendre des risques fait partie du quotidien.

- Communication transparente : Des échanges ouverts avec les gestionnaires et l'équipe de direction de l'entreprise.

- Impact maximal : De petites équipes dynamiques pour un impact concret et direct.

EN SAVOIR PLUS SUR HOPPER

Chez Hopper, nous avons pour mission de devenir la plateforme de voyage de référence à l'échelle mondiale – en propulsant l'application mobile Hopper, notre site Web ainsi que notre division B2B, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). En tirant parti de volumes massifs de données et d'algorithmes avancés d'apprentissage automatique, Hopper combine son offre d'agence de voyage de classe mondiale à des produits fintech exclusifs afin d'apporter transparence, flexibilité et économies aux voyageurs du monde entier. Nous avons développé plusieurs solutions fintech uniques qui répondent à tous les enjeux, de la volatilité des prix aux perturbations de voyage, aidant ainsi les gens à mieux voyager et à économiser davantage.

La plateforme Hopper sert des centaines de millions de voyageurs et continue de gagner des parts de marché partout dans le monde. L'application Hopper a été téléchargée plus de 120 millions de fois et est devenue particulièrement populaire auprès des jeunes voyageurs – 70 % de ses utilisateurs appartenant à la génération Z et aux millénariaux.

Bien que nous soyons reconnus comme l'application de voyage par excellence de la génération Z et des millénariaux, Hopper a grandement évolué. Au cours des dernières années, nous sommes devenus un fournisseur de fintech de voyage, une plateforme de commerce électronique et une agence de voyage mondiale qui propulse certaines des plus grandes marques au monde.

Grâce à HTS, notre division B2B, l'entreprise dynamise les canaux directs de ses partenaires en intégrant nos produits fintech à leurs sites ou en propulsant leurs portails de voyage de bout en bout. Aujourd'hui, nos partenaires comptent des marques de voyage de premier plan telles que Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada et bien d'autres.

Voici quelques statistiques qui témoignent de notre croissance récente :

- Des milliards de dollars de voyages et de produits fintech de voyage sont vendus chaque année par l'entremise des canaux de Hopper et de HTS.

- Nos produits fintech – incluant Annulation pour n'importe quel motif et Aide en cas de perturbation de vol – affichent des scores de satisfaction client (CSAT) exceptionnellement élevés, car les conditions sont toujours claires et les clients bénéficient de résolutions instantanées, sans poser de questions.

- Près de 30 % des clients de notre application achètent au moins un produit fintech lors de leur réservation; et les consommateurs sont 1,6 fois plus susceptibles de réserver à nouveau s'ils ajoutent une option fintech, comparativement à un achat de voyage seul.

- Fort du succès de ses produits fintech, Hopper a lancé l'initiative B2B HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), qui représente aujourd'hui plus de 75 % des activités de l'entreprise.

- Grâce à HTS, tout fournisseur de voyage (compagnies aériennes, hôtels, banques, agences de voyage, etc.) peut intégrer et distribuer de façon transparente la fintech ou l'inventaire de voyage de Hopper sur ses propres canaux directs. Dans le cadre de son premier partenariat HTS, l'entreprise s'est associée à Capital One pour co-développer Capital One Travel, un nouveau portail de voyage conçu spécifiquement pour ses titulaires de cartes. Parmi les autres partenaires de HTS figurent Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines et plusieurs autres.

- Hopper a été nommée l'entreprise numéro 1 la plus innovante du secteur du voyage par Fast Company. L'application Hopper a dépassé les 120 millions de téléchargements et continue d'enregistrer des millions de nouvelles installations chaque mois. Hopper se classe désormais au 3e rang des plus grandes agences de voyages en ligne en Amérique du Nord.

- Hopper a mobilisé plus de 750 millions de dollars USD en capitaux privés et est soutenue par certains des plus grands investisseurs institutionnels et banques au monde. HTS est idéalement positionnée pour poursuivre sa croissance en tant que leader du commerce électronique de voyage, au sein d'une catégorie d'achat en ligne qui représente 1 000 milliards de dollars. L'application et le site Web de Hopper resteront également les choix privilégiés de la génération Z et des millénariaux pour leurs voyages.



Ce poste fait appel à des systèmes de décision automatisée pour évaluer l'aptitude des candidats. Conformément à la réglementation locale, vous avez le droit de connaître les principaux facteurs utilisés dans le cadre de cette évaluation, de demander la rectification de vos données ou de demander qu'une personne révise toute décision automatisée. Pour exercer ces droits, veuillez communiquer avec privacy@hopper.com.

You will design and scale model-driven infrastructure that continuously interprets transactional data, generates reference pricing, detects performance shifts, reconciles financial flows, and governs revenue integrity in real time.

This is a foundational role at the intersection of marketplace economics, machine learning, and financial systems. You will partner deeply with Data Science and Engineering to productionize predictive models, define evaluation frameworks, manage model lifecycles, and ensure intelligence systems are measurable, adaptive, and trusted.

The work you do will directly shape partner economics, supplier transparency, and HTS’s global commerce platform.

What would your day-to-day look like:

- Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for pricing intelligence, supplier performance intelligence, and financial reconciliation across all travel verticals.
Architect and evolve reference pricing systems leveraging predictive modeling, elasticity signals, competitive benchmarking, and real-time anomaly detection.

- Build the supplier intelligence layer, transforming transactional data into automated performance signals, demand insights, and pricing diagnostics.

- Establish and govern the canonical source of truth for revenue, margin, take rate, transactions, and cancellations across systems and partners.
Design model evaluation, monitoring, and feedback frameworks, including drift detection and continuous improvement mechanisms.

- Drive cross-functional execution across Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Commercial, and Supply to deliver production-grade, model-integrated infrastructure.


An ideal candidate has:

- 5+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of AI-native products and model-driven systems in production. You have built and scaled systems where AI is foundational to product behavior — not an additive feature.

- Hands-on experience writing prompts, designing evaluation harnesses, or prototyping with LLMs/foundation models as part of their PM workflow (not just overseeing others doing it)

- Strong fluency working independently with SQL and large-scale transactional datasets.

- Demonstrated experience operating as an AI-native PM, with hands-on ownership of model lifecycle management including problem framing, signal design, evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall tradeoffs, forecasting accuracy), monitoring frameworks, drift detection, and retraining strategies.

- Experience shipping predictive systems, anomaly detection platforms, automated decisioning infrastructure, or model-driven pricing systems at scale.

- Experience owning pricing systems, financial reporting platforms or marketplace intelligence tools.

- Deep understanding of marketplace economics, revenue mechanics, and pricing strategy.

- Prior experience in Data Science, Engineering, or a highly technical role.

À PROPOS DU RÔLE

Nous recherchons un Gestionnaire de produit principal+ (Senior+ Product Manager) « natif de l'IA » exceptionnel pour bâtir et diriger l’épine dorsale d’intelligence et de réconciliation de HTS pour les segments Vols, Hôtels, Voitures et Services auxiliaires.

Ce rôle est responsable des systèmes qui définissent l'intelligence des prix, les rapports de performance des fournisseurs et la « vérité financière » à travers des millions de transactions de voyage. Il s'agit d'un rôle fondamental à l'intersection de l'économie de marché (marketplace), de l'apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et des systèmes financiers. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de science des données et d'ingénierie pour mettre en production des modèles prédictifs, définir des cadres d'évaluation et garantir que nos systèmes d'intelligence sont mesurables, adaptatifs et fiables.

CE À QUOI RESSEMBLERA TON TRAVAIL AU JOUR-LE-JOUR

- Stratégie et feuille de route : Piloter la stratégie de bout en bout pour l'intelligence des prix, la performance des fournisseurs et la réconciliation financière pour tous les segments de voyage.

- Architecture de prix de référence : Concevoir des systèmes de tarification utilisant la modélisation prédictive, les signaux d'élasticité et la détection d'anomalies en temps réel.

- Intelligence fournisseur : Transformer les données transactionnelles en signaux de performance automatisés et en diagnostics de prix.

- Gouvernance des données financières : Établir et gérer la source de vérité unique pour les revenus, les marges, les taux de commission (take rate), les transactions et les annulations.

- Cycle de vie des modèles : Concevoir des cadres d'évaluation, de surveillance et de rétroaction des modèles, incluant la détection de dérive (drift detection).

- Exécution interfonctionnelle : Collaborer avec l'ingénierie, la science des données, la finance et le commercial pour livrer une infrastructure de qualité production intégrée aux modèles.

UN(E) CANDIDAT(E) IDÉAL(E):

- 5 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de produit, incluant la responsabilité de produits natifs de l'IA et de systèmes pilotés par des modèles en production.

- Expérience pratique (« hands-on ») : Capacité à rédiger des prompts, concevoir des tests d'évaluation ou prototyper avec des LLM/modèles de fondation dans votre flux de travail (pas seulement superviser les autres).

- Gestion du cycle de vie de l'IA : Maîtrise de la définition de problèmes, conception de signaux, mesures d'évaluation (ex. compromis précision/rappel), cadres de surveillance et stratégies de réentraînement.

- Systèmes à grande échelle : Expérience dans le déploiement de systèmes prédictifs, de plateformes de détection d'anomalies ou d'infrastructures de décision automatisée.

- Compétences techniques : Maîtrise de SQL et des ensembles de données transactionnelles massifs.

- Expertise métier : Expérience avec les systèmes de tarification ou les plateformes de rapports financiers.

- Communication : Capacité exceptionnelle à vulgariser des concepts complexes entre les parties prenantes techniques et commerciales.

Atouts (Bonus) :

- Expérience préalable en science des données, en ingénierie ou dans un rôle hautement technique.

Expérience dans le commerce du voyage, la fintech, la publicité ou d'autres environnements de place de marché à haut volume de transactions.

Ce poste requiert une maîtrise du français et de l’anglais. La personne retenue devra communiquer et collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, gestionnaires, clients, fournisseurs et partenaires d’affaires situés à l’extérieur du Québec, ainsi que consulter, préparer et utiliser de la documentation, des systèmes et des communications en français et en anglais. La connaissance de l’anglais est donc nécessaire à l’exercice des fonctions liées au poste ainsi qu’au respect des exigences opérationnelles et des besoins de la clientèle dans un environnement d’affaires international.

AVANTAGES ET BÉNÉFICES DE TRAVAILLER AVEC NOUS :

- Croissance et équité : Une startup solide aux ambitions mondiales. Salaire compétitif et avantages liés aux options d'achat d'actions (pre-IPO).

- Santé et protection : Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective (incluant l'assurance vie et l'invalidité de courte et longue durée).

- Compte de dépenses santé (HSA) : Couvre vos frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles.

- Télémédecine : Accès illimité aux services de Dialogue pour vous et vos personnes à charge, partout et en tout temps.

- Épargne retraite : Accès à un régime de REER avec retenues automatiques avant impôts sur chaque paie.

- Famille : Un congé parental ultra-généreux, largement supérieur aux normes de l'industrie. Parlons-en !

- Culture entrepreneuriale : Un environnement où repousser les limites et prendre des risques fait partie du quotidien.

- Proximité : Communication ouverte avec la direction et le leadership de l'entreprise.

- Impact : De petites équipes dynamiques pour un impact massif.

Conformément à la réglementation locale, vous avez le droit de connaître les principaux facteurs utilisés dans le cadre de cette évaluation, de demander la rectification de vos données ou de demander qu'une personne révise toute décision automatisée. - Collaborer avec les partenaires d'entreprise, de la découverte à la définition des exigences jusqu'aux décisions de lancement, en traduisant leurs besoins en choix de produit

- Rester proche des équipes de mise en marché, des solutions partenaires et de la réussite client, afin de réinjecter les apprentissages du terrain dans la feuille de route

- Une approche fondée sur les données, ancrée dans les indicateurs de service à la clientèle et d'automatisation

- Une connaissance pratique des produits basés sur les grands modèles de langage

- Accès à un espace de coworking à la demande via FlexDesk et une allocation pour le télétravail

- Une culture entrepreneuriale où repousser les limites fait partie du quotidien

- Communication ouverte avec la direction et les dirigeants de l'entreprise

- De petites équipes dynamiques ayant un impact considérable

israel.description:
À propos du poste

HTS Assist est l'assistant d'intelligence artificielle agentique d'Hopper pour le voyage. Il résout de véritables enjeux clients, notamment les changements de vol, les annulations, les remboursements et les réservations, par clavardage et par la voix, pour certaines des plus grandes marques de voyage au monde. Nous recherchons un ingénieur ou une ingénieure full stack sénior pour piloter ce produit, en assurant la responsabilité complète de la couche vocale et temps réel, tout en contribuant à l'ensemble de la pile technologique : interfaces React/TypeScript, services Scala et Python, et infrastructure infonuagique. L'équipe est restreinte et expérimentée, la portée des responsabilités est large, et le chemin entre votre code et l'appel téléphonique d'un voyageur est court.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien

- Assurer la responsabilité complète du canal vocal, y compris les intégrations de téléphonie et de CPaaS (par exemple Twilio, Amazon Connect), les pipelines de reconnaissance et de synthèse vocale en continu, l'orchestration de modèles en temps réel, ainsi que les budgets de latence et de qualité

- Développer des fonctionnalités sur l'ensemble de la pile technologique, y compris des interfaces de clavardage web en React/TypeScript, des services back-end en Scala et Python, et une infrastructure sur GCP

- Concevoir une architecture multilocataire, où un seul code source dessert plusieurs partenaires par configuration plutôt que par des versions distinctes

- Construire les mécanismes de sécurité et de conformité audités par les partenaires d'entreprise, notamment les garde-fous, le filtrage de contenu et les points d'intégration de la rédaction des renseignements personnels

- Maintenir la santé des déploiements essentiels aux revenus grâce à l'observabilité, aux alertes, à la gestion des incidents et au respect des ententes de niveau de service

- Développer les capacités de plateforme que nos ingénieurs déployés sur le terrain configurent pour les intégrations de téléphonie des partenaires et les mises en production

- Contribuer à l'excellence technique de l'équipe par la révision de code, les revues d'architecture et le mentorat


Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- Plus de 6 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, avec une responsabilité de niveau sénior sur des systèmes en production et une réelle polyvalence full stack

- Une expérience concrète des systèmes en temps réel : applications vocales, WebRTC/SIP, diffusion multimédia en continu, ou produits comparables à faible latence

- Une solide maîtrise d'un cadre front-end moderne (React, TypeScript) et une expertise back-end (Scala ou un autre langage JVM, et/ou Python), ainsi qu'une expérience en infrastructure infonuagique (GCP ou AWS)

- Une expérience dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance d'API RESTful, de microservices ou de systèmes pilotés par événements

- L'utilisation des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour la programmation comme partie intégrante de son flux de travail, avec le jugement nécessaire pour réviser, corriger et assumer la responsabilité de tout ce qui est mis en production

- Une mentalité axée sur l'exploitabilité des systèmes : ententes de niveau de service, observabilité, astreintes et plans de retour en arrière

- La capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, à faire des compromis pragmatiques et à livrer de façon itérative, appuyée par une communication solide avec les équipes de produit, de conception et d'opérations

- Un atout : une expérience en IA conversationnelle ou en orchestration de modèles de langage, y compris des technologies vocales comme Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Whisper ou OpenAI Realtime

- Un atout : une connaissance pratique des plateformes de téléphonie infonuagique ou CPaaS telles que Twilio, Amazon Connect, Genesys ou LiveKit

- Un atout : une expérience dans la création d'outils de service à la clientèle, de gestion de la relation client, de centre de contact ou d'automatisation des processus

- Une connaissance des technologies propres à l'industrie du voyage (PSS/GDS, PMS/CRS hôteliers) est un atout, mais non requise


Avantages sociaux

- Une entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée, avec de grandes ambitions, un salaire compétitif et les avantages d'un régime d'actions pré-IPO

- Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective

- Hopper offre une couverture vie, invalidité de courte durée et invalidité de longue durée

- Un compte de dépenses santé qui couvre les frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles

- Tous les employés et leurs personnes à charge ont accès aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue, en tout temps, où que vous soyez

- Tous les employés ont accès à un régime REER avec retenues automatiques avant impôt à chaque paie

- Renseignez-vous sur notre congé parental très généreux, bien au-delà des normes de l'industrie

- Vacances illimitées

- Allocation de voyage Carrot Cash

- Accès à un espace de cotravail sur demande via FlexDesk, et une allocation pour le télétravail

- Une culture entrepreneuriale où repousser les limites et prendre des risques fait partie du quotidien

- Communication ouverte avec la direction et les leaders de l'entreprise

- Des équipes petites et dynamiques, un impact considérable

À propos d'Hopper
Chez Hopper, notre mission est de devenir la plateforme de voyage numéro un au monde, en propulsant l'application mobile et le site web d'Hopper ainsi que notre division B2B, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). En exploitant d'importantes quantités de données et des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique avancés, Hopper combine une offre d'agence de voyages de calibre mondial à des produits fintech propriétaires afin d'offrir transparence, flexibilité et économies aux voyageurs du monde entier. Nous avons développé plusieurs solutions fintech uniques qui répondent à tout, de la volatilité des prix aux perturbations de voyage, aidant ainsi les gens à mieux voyager et à économiser davantage sur leurs déplacements.

La plateforme Hopper sert des centaines de millions de voyageurs à l'échelle mondiale et continue de gagner des parts de marché partout dans le monde. L'application Hopper a été téléchargée plus de 120 millions de fois et est devenue particulièrement populaire auprès des jeunes voyageurs, la génération Z et les milléniaux représentant 70 % de ses utilisateurs.

Bien que tout le monde connaisse Hopper comme l'application de voyage de la génération Z et des milléniaux, l'entreprise est devenue bien plus que cela. Au cours des dernières années, nous sommes devenus un fournisseur de services fintech de voyage, une plateforme de commerce et une agence de voyages mondiale qui propulse certaines des plus grandes marques au monde.

Grâce à HTS, notre division B2B, l'entreprise renforce les canaux directs de ses partenaires en intégrant nos produits fintech à leurs sites ou en propulsant des portails de voyage de bout en bout. Aujourd'hui, nos partenaires comptent des marques de voyage de premier plan comme Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, et bien d'autres.

Voici quelques statistiques qui démontrent la croissance récente de l'entreprise:

- Des milliards de dollars de voyages et de produits fintech de voyage sont vendus chaque année par l'intermédiaire des canaux d'Hopper et de HTS.

- Nos produits fintech, dont Cancel for Any Reason et Flight Disruption Assistance, affichent une satisfaction client exceptionnellement élevée, car les conditions sont toujours claires et les clients obtiennent des résolutions instantanées, sans questions.

- Près de 30 % des clients de notre application achètent au moins un produit fintech lors d'une réservation, et les consommateurs sont 1,6 fois plus susceptibles de racheter s'ils ajoutent un produit fintech à leur réservation plutôt que de réserver seulement le voyage.

- Devant le succès de ses produits fintech, Hopper a lancé une initiative B2B, HTS, qui représente aujourd'hui plus de 75 % de l'entreprise.

Grâce à HTS, tout fournisseur de services de voyage (compagnies aériennes, hôtels, banques, agences de voyages, etc.) peut intégrer et distribuer facilement l'inventaire fintech ou de voyage d'Hopper sur ses canaux directs. Pour son premier partenariat HTS, l'entreprise s'est associée à Capital One afin de co-développer Capital One Travel, un nouveau portail de voyage conçu spécifiquement pour les détenteurs de carte. Parmi les autres partenaires HTS figurent Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines et bien d'autres.

Hopper a été désignée entreprise la plus innovante en voyage par Fast Company. L'application Hopper a été téléchargée plus de 120 millions de fois et continue d'enregistrer des millions de nouvelles installations chaque mois. Hopper est maintenant la 3e plus grande agence de voyages en ligne en Amérique du Nord, et 70 % des clients de notre application sont des voyageurs de la génération Z et des milléniaux.

Hopper a amassé plus de 750 millions de dollars américains en capital privé et est soutenue par certains des plus importants investisseurs institutionnels et banques au monde. HTS est bien positionnée pour poursuivre sa croissance en tant que principal fournisseur de commerce électronique du voyage dans une catégorie mondiale de magasinage en ligne évaluée à 1 000 milliards de dollars. L'application et le site web d'Hopper continueront également d'être le fournisseur de voyage privilégié de la génération Z et des milléniaux.

Prenez votre envol avec nous!

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Platform team in Tel Aviv. You'll build the infrastructure that powers our entire engineering organization, accelerating how our teams ship features that millions of customers rely on. This role is perfect for someone who loves solving complex distributed systems challenges and creating tools that make other developers' lives better.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL:

- Build core platform services that support all Lemonade development teams across web, mobile, and backend systems

- Design and maintain robust APIs for distributed microservices architecture using TypeScript, with Rust experience as a major plus

- Collaborate with staff engineers and tech leads to establish platform standards, patterns, and best practices across the engineering organization

- Own service stability and communication between systems, implementing both synchronous and asynchronous patterns at scale

- Drive developer efficiency initiatives by creating tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that eliminate friction for product teams

- Work hands-on with AWS infrastructure including Kafka, RabbitMQ, EKS, SQS, Lambda, and infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi

- Partner closely with DevOps teams to ensure seamless deployment, monitoring, and scaling of platform services

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

- 5+ years as a software engineer with strong focus on backend systems and platform development

- Deep experience with distributed systems and microservices, including building and maintaining APIs that serve multiple teams

- Hands-on expertise with modern infrastructure — AWS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, EKS, SQS, Lambda, Helm, Terraform, or Pulumi

- TypeScript proficiency with Rust experience strongly preferred

- Platform or core team background — you've built infrastructure that supports multiple development teams, not just end-user features

- Developer empathy — you understand what makes engineers productive and can translate that into platform solutions

- Ready to work in an office environment most days a week

israel.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Pricing Platform
israel.description:
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build the core systems that power how Lemonade prices insurance for millions of customers. You'll join our Pricing Team in Amsterdam, working on everything from our homegrown domain-specific language to AI-powered research pipelines that push the boundaries of actuarial science.

Team Context Our Pricing Team operates at the intersection of complex mathematics and high-performance engineering. We've built our own DSL in TypeScript for actuarial calculations, compiled to Rust for production performance, and increasingly leverage AI to discover new pricing patterns. You'll work alongside actuaries who understand the logic of risk, but you'll be the one designing the technical architecture that makes their insights scale.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL

- Design and build core rating services that calculate prices for insurance products used by millions

- Architect complex systems spanning TypeScript, Rust, and Python across different problem domains

- Build AI-powered research pipelines that help actuaries discover new pricing insights

- Create SDKs and code patterns that other teams can build on top of

- Optimize performance-critical systems where milliseconds matter for customer experience

- Collaborate with actuaries to translate complex mathematical models into scalable code

- Lead technical decisions about system architecture, interfaces, and design patterns

What you'll need

- Adaptability, drive, and an efficiency mindset — we believe these matter most in human-AI collaboration

- Deep experience with system design and architectural decision-making, not just API development

- Strong proficiency in one of backend languages with ability to quickly pick up new ones (our stack includes TypeScript, Rust, and Python)

- Experience building performance-optimized systems where technical choices directly impact business outcomes

- Track record of designing complex technical systems from scratch, including interfaces and abstractions

- Comfort working with heavy Kubernetes deployments and cloud-native architectures would be nice to have

- Educational degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

- Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

- Enthusiasm about learning and adapting to the exciting world of AI — a commitment to exploring this field is a fundamental part of our culture

israel.title: Sr Decision Science Analyst, Capital & CAT Modeling
israel.description:
We are looking for a Senior Decision Scientist to design and own mathematical risk thresholds across our insurance products.
In this role, you will operate at the intersection of catastrophe modeling, capital modeling, and portfolio strategy, ensuring that each policy we write is evaluated against explicit capital requirements and aligned with long term growth and risk objectives. You’ll dive into the details, build practical solutions, and turn well grounded analysis into clear, actionable decisions that move the business forward.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

IN THIS ROLE YOU’LL

- Own and build the capital modeling framework, running catastrophe models and integrating their outputs to support portfolio management, growth planning, and strategic decision making

- Build and maintain the analytical tools and data structures used for catastrophe, capital, and portfolio modeling

- Evaluate how individual policies and portfolio changes impact capital requirements, PMLs, tail risk, and expected returns

- Partner closely with insurance, finance, and underwriting teams to assess the impact of reinsurance structures, retentions, and limits on portfolio risk and capital efficiency

- Translate capital and catastrophe model results into clear takeaways and recommendations that help guide growth and risk decisions

- Approach problems with curiosity and good judgment, challenging assumptions when needed and contributing to a team that values learning and shared ownership

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 4+ years of experience in CAT modeling, capital modeling, or quantitative risk analytics within P&C insurance or reinsurance

- Solid grounding in statistics and probability, especially as applied to extreme events and heavy-tailed distributions

- Proficiency in data science programming languages such as R or Python, and database query tools such as SQL

- Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, or a related field

- Understanding reinsurance structures and how they impact portfolio risk and capital is a plus

- Ability to work remotely

- Enthusiasm about learning and adapting to the exciting world of AI – a commitment to exploring this field is a fundamental part of our culture.


*Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

israel.title: Senior Car Insurance Pricing Expert
israel.description:
We're looking for a Senior Car Insurance Pricing Expert to help shape how Lemonade prices risk across our global business, from our Tel Aviv office.

This isn't a traditional actuarial role. You'll sit at the intersection of Insurance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Business Strategy on our Insurance team, owning hard pricing and risk-management problems end to end. That means finding opportunities, designing better approaches, building scalable tools with technical teams, and turning insights into decisions that move growth, profitability, and risk selection forward.

You might be a trained actuary, a pricing leader, a decision scientist, or a technically strong insurance operator who's built serious pricing capabilities. Formal credentials are a plus, but they're not the point. The point is whether you can use data, insurance intuition, statistical rigor, and AI-enabled tools to solve complex pricing problems better and faster than the industry standard.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL

- Own and evolve core components of Lemonade's Car pricing strategy, bringing analytical rigor and product-minded creativity to how we price risk

- Identify high-leverage opportunities across rating, underwriting, segmentation, risk selection, growth, profitability, and portfolio management

- Build, evaluate, and improve Car pricing and risk models using actuarial methods, machine learning, AI-enabled workflows, and strong business judgment

- Partner with Data Science, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Growth to turn pricing ideas into scalable capabilities

- Translate complex pricing problems into clear product and platform requirements, helping teams build internal tools that make better decisions faster

- Define and track key metrics - loss ratio, rate adequacy, conversion, retention, segmentation lift, and model performance - to keep decisions grounded in real impact

- Make complex actuarial and pricing concepts clear and actionable for technical and non-technical audiences alike, and help build pricing acumen across the Tel Aviv team

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 8+ years of experience in Car insurance pricing, actuarial science, decision science, risk analytics, or a closely related field

- A proven track record solving complex pricing, underwriting, segmentation, or risk-management problems with measurable business impact

- Strong analytical instincts - knowing how to find signal in data, make decisions under uncertainty, and separate elegant analysis from useful analysis

- Hands-on fluency with modern analytical tools, agentic AI capabilities, and code - including experience using generative AI, coding agents, or advanced automation to materially improve analytical workflows

- Solid understanding of Car insurance pricing fundamentals, including rating plans, loss costs, rate adequacy, segmentation, model validation, telematics and financial performance.

- Experience building or modernizing pricing platforms, rating engines, underwriting tools, or internal decision-support software

A new category of professional service provider is emerging: people who build, configure, and deploy AI for small businesses. They call themselves AI Implementers, AI Consultants, and automation specialists. The practice is still being invented. There is no shared training path. No standard pricing. No clear playbook for how to make it a sustainable business.

We've done the homework. Exploratory interviews with implementers and their clients, a large respondent demand survey, a respondent supply-side survey. The pattern is consistent: the market is real, growing fast , and almost nothing about it is solved. Their #1 pain is getting clients. Their clients' #1 pain is finding someone they can trust.

This is the kind of market HoneyBook was built to win. We've spent over a decade learning how independent service providers run their businesses, how they price, how they sell, how they build trust. AI Implementers are independent service providers. The substrate is the same. The opportunity is to be the platform that turns this fragmented, inventing-itself category into a real profession with real economics, and to capture the value of doing so.

We're not building this as a distribution play for HoneyBook. The bet is that this stands on its own as a business. Cross-sell to our existing portfolio is a bonus, not the thesis.

The mission:

Take this from concept to a category-defining business. Zero to outcomes. You will:

- Live in the market until you understand it better than anyone at HoneyBook

- Define the strategy, the wedge, the offering, the pricing, and the brand

- Build the early product and the early GTM in parallel

- Land the first paying customers yourself

- Build the team you need to scale once we have signal

Market. Talk to 50+ AI Implementers in your first 90 days. Map the segments (technical builders vs business strategists, project-based vs retainer, generalist vs vertical specialists). Map the communities, the influencers. Decide which segment we go after first and why.

Strategy. Build the business case, the product thesis and the GTM foundations. What's the offering? What's the wedge? What's the pricing model? What does the unit economics look like at scale? What are the four to five things we have to be opinionated about, and what are we deliberately not doing?

GTM. Design the acquisition motion from scratch. Community, content, partnerships, paid, sales-led, product-led, some combination. Test cheap, kill what doesn't work, double down on what does. Treat GTM as foundational, not as something we figure out after product is built.

Product. Partner with engineering and design to ship the first version. You won't build it alone, but you'll set the bar for what it is, what it isn't, and what good looks like. Customers. Land the first 10 paying customers personally. Get on the calls. Read every email. Watch every demo. Be the most informed person on what's working and what isn't.

- Founded a company that got to product-market fit, with a meaningful exit or a clear track record of building something from nothing

We're looking for a strategic and collaborative Director of Revenue Enablement to help scale our go-to-market organization. In this role, you'll partner across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, Recruiting, and Learning & Development to ensure our customer-facing teams have the knowledge, tools, processes, and content they need to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive business results.
You'll serve as the connective tissue across our GTM organization—translating strategy into execution, identifying performance gaps, enabling successful product launches, and creating scalable programs that improve sales effectiveness and customer outcomes.

What You'll Do
Sales Enablement & Training

- Design, build, and continuously improve onboarding programs to accelerate new-hire ramp time.

- Develop ongoing training programs that strengthen product knowledge, consultative selling, objection handling, and customer experience.

- Work closely with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is consistently reflected throughout the customer journey.

- Partner with Revenue Operations to support CRM adoption, process improvements, sales workflows, and operational readiness.

Content & Communication

- Create and refine high-converting playbooks, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and cross-sell/upsell matrices for the sales team.

- Own the organization and maintenance of sales enablement content, including playbooks, product documentation, competitive battle cards, sales presentations, and knowledge resources.

- Ensure customer-facing teams have easy access to current, accurate, and actionable enablement materials.

- Package customer proof points, case studies, and FAQs into reusable assets teams can pull from in the moment

- Develop scalable communication plans for product launches, process updates, and organizational changes.

Tools & Process

- Own or co-own enablement tooling (e.g., CRM/helpdesk macros, content/asset libraries, call recording platforms) so teams can find the right resource in seconds, not minutes

- Partner with RevOps to keep CRM data clean and process consistent across teams

What You'll Bring

- Prior experience carrying an individual sales quota or serving in a consultative customer-facing role (Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Customer Success, Retail Leadership, or similar). You understand firsthand what it takes to build trust with customers, navigate objections, and operate in a performance-driven environment.

- 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing revenue role and/or Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Operations, Product Marketing, or a related GTM function.

- Experience designing and scaling enablement programs that improve onboarding, sales readiness, product adoption, or customer experience.

- Proven ability to build trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, and executive leadership.

- Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and influence audiences ranging from frontline employees to senior leaders.

- An analytical mindset with experience using performance metrics, customer feedback, and business insights to identify opportunities and measure the impact of enablement initiatives.

- A builder's mentality—you enjoy creating scalable programs, playbooks, and processes that help teams perform at their best.

- High emotional intelligence and credibility. You listen before prescribing solutions, seek to understand the realities of frontline teams, and earn trust through empathy, collaboration, and thoughtful execution.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a direct-to-consumer, retail, consumer technology, marketplace, or high-growth environment.

- Experience supporting product launches and go-to-market initiatives across multiple customer-facing teams.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), learning management systems, and enablement tools such as Gong, Highspot, Seismic, WorkRamp, or similar platforms.

- Experience coaching managers or facilitating leadership development programs.

Success in This Role
After your first 60-days, you will have:

- Built scalable onboarding and ongoing enablement programs that improve sales readiness and consistency.

- Successfully enabled multiple product launches across customer-facing teams.

- Established trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Experience.

- Increased adoption of key sales processes, tools, and messaging.

- Demonstrated measurable improvements in ramp time, productivity, customer experience, or sales effectiveness.

- Become a strategic partner who helps connect business strategy with frontline execution.

Why This Role Matters
Our customers experience our brand through every interaction with our teams. This role helps ensure those interactions are consistent, informed, and customer-centric. By connecting strategy with execution and enabling our teams to perform at their best, you'll play a critical role in helping us scale our business while delivering an outstanding customer experience.
Why You'll Love Inspira

- Amazing people with a great vision and values

- Mission-driven team culture focused on student success

- Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe

- Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid

- Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)

- Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

- 401(k) with company match

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

- Du adaptierst Creatives für unterschiedliche Plattformen, Platzierungen und Formate – insbesondere 1:1, 4:5 und 9:16 sowie weitere Display- und Webformate.

- Du achtest bei allen Formaten auf Safe Zones, Lesbarkeit, mobile Darstellung und eine konsistente visuelle Qualität.

- Du entwickelst aus erfolgreichen Ads neue Varianten und Iterationen, beispielsweise mit anderen Hooks, Bildern, Headlines, Farben, Layouts oder CTAs.

- Du setzt bestehende Brand-Vorgaben sicher um und entwickelst unsere visuelle Kommunikation gemeinsam mit uns weiter.

- Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing-Team zusammen, setzt Feedback schnell und zuverlässig um und bringst eigene Ideen und Empfehlungen ein.

Qualifikation

- Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Performance Creatives für Meta, TikTok, Google oder vergleichbare Paid-Media-Kanäle.

- Du besitzt ein aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit relevanten Werbeanzeigen, Landingpages oder E-Commerce-Designs – idealerweise aus den Bereichen Beauty, Fashion, Lifestyle oder D2C.

- Du verstehst die grundlegende Creative Strategy hinter erfolgreichen Werbeanzeigen und weißt, warum Hook, visuelle Hierarchie, Produktinszenierung, Lesbarkeit, Social Proof und CTA entscheidend sind.

- Du hast Erfahrung mit conversionorientiertem Web- und Landingpage-Design und kannst ansprechende Layouts entwickeln, die auch auf mobilen Geräten funktionieren.

- Du beherrschst relevante Designprogramme sicher, beispielsweise Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign oder vergleichbare Tools.

- Du hast ein sehr gutes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie, Farben, Komposition, Bildauswahl und modernes E-Commerce-Design.

- Du kannst Informationen visuell priorisieren und auch komplexere Produktvorteile schnell verständlich darstellen.

- Du weißt, wie man eine hochwertige Markenwirkung mit klarer, performanceorientierter Kommunikation verbindet.

- Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und detailgenau und hältst vereinbarte Deadlines zuverlässig ein.

- Du kannst deutschsprachige Werbetexte sicher verarbeiten und erkennst, wenn eine Headline oder Botschaft im Design nicht optimal funktioniert.

- Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Creative Iterations und der Auswertung von Ad-Performance ist ein starkes Plus.

- Erfahrung mit einfachen Animationen, Motion Graphics oder KI-gestützter Bildbearbeitung ist ebenfalls von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

- Flexible und ortsunabhängige Zusammenarbeit auf Freelance-Basis.

- Die Möglichkeit einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßigen Projekten und planbaren Aufgaben.

- Abwechslungsreiche Designprojekte für Paid Social, Google Ads, Landingpages, Produktseiten und unseren Onlineshop.

- Klare Briefings, vorhandene Brand-Guidelines, Produktmaterialien und Werbetexte als Grundlage für deine Arbeit.

- Direkte Kommunikation, schnelle Entscheidungen und konkrete Feedback-Loops.

- Einblicke in die Performance deiner Creatives, damit du nachvollziehen kannst, welche Designs funktionieren und warum.

- Raum für eigene Ideen, neue Designkonzepte und kreative Testansätze.

- Die Möglichkeit, die visuelle Weiterentwicklung einer wachsenden D2C-Beauty-Brand aktiv mitzugestalten.

- Faire und transparente Vergütung, abgestimmt auf Erfahrung, Qualität und Projektumfang.

Wir benötigen weder einen klassischen Lebenslauf noch ein Anschreiben. Entscheidend sind die Qualität deiner Arbeit, dein Gespür für Ästhetik und deine bisherigen Ergebnisse.
Bitte sende uns mit deiner Bewerbung:

- fünf bis acht deiner stärksten und relevantesten Arbeiten,

- Beispiele für Performance Ads sowie, wenn vorhanden, Landingpages oder E-Commerce-Designs,

- eine kurze Information dazu, was du bei den gezeigten Projekten übernommen hast,

- wenn möglich, konkrete Ergebnisse oder Erkenntnisse zur Performance deiner Arbeiten,

- deine aktuelle Verfügbarkeit und ungefähre wöchentliche Kapazität,

- deine Preisvorstellung pro Creative, Stunden- oder Paketpreis.

Wenn du bereits an einer besonders erfolgreichen Werbeanzeige oder Landingpage gearbeitet hast, zeige uns gerne, was daran funktioniert hat und welchen Beitrag du geleistet hast.
Bewerbungen ohne relevantes Portfolio können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen. Wenn deine Arbeiten und dein Profil zu uns passen, erhältst du von uns einen kurzen und klar abgegrenzten Test-Task.
Wir freuen uns darauf, deine Arbeiten zu sehen und gemeinsam Designs zu entwickeln, die nicht nur hochwertig aussehen, sondern Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen, Vertrauen aufbauen und echte Ergebnisse erzielen.

Product-Led Growth Enablement

- Champion experimentation and learning across GTM and customer journeys.

- Define activation and adoption milestones in partnership with Product and Data.

- Partner with Product and Growth teams to ensure PMM insights are fully activated across journeys.

Product Marketing Leadership & Team Management

- Manage, mentor, and develop a team of Product Marketing Managers across Wave’s product lines (Accounting, Invoicing, Payments, Payroll).

- Set strategy, priorities, and operating rhythms for the product marketing team.

- Establish best practices, frameworks, and standards for positioning, messaging, and GTM excellence.

- Act as a senior point of escalation for PMM initiatives.

- Define success metrics for product marketing initiatives and drive continuous improvement.

Portfolio & Go-to-Market Ownership

- Own GTM strategy across major product launches, feature releases, and enhancements.

- Partner with Product and Growth leadership to align launch plans with adoption and revenue goals.

- Ensure launches/enhancements are supported across lifecycle, product education, enablement, and marketing channels.

- Cross-Functional Influence & EnablementServe as the primary Product Marketing partner to Product, Growth, and Customer Experience.

- Ensure internal teams are equipped with clear messaging, narratives, and enablement resources.

You'll thrive here if you have:

- Have 7–10+ years of product marketing experience in SaaS, with experience managing other PMMs.

- Have operated in a product-led SaaS model and understand adoption-driven and lifecycle growth.

- Are an effective people leader who can coach, scale, and inspire a team.

- Are highly cross-functional and comfortable influencing without authority.

remote.title: Senior Software Engineer with Accounting Experience (Chile)
remote.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)
Hiring Manager: Matthew Sedlacek
About Sezzle:
With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!
About the Role:
We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer with accounting and financial experience. This role offers an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for leadership and innovation.
This position is ideal for professionals who began their careers in accounting or finance and later transitioned into software engineering — individuals who now want to leverage that domain expertise to architect and scale technical solutions that solve complex financial challenges in fintech.
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize high-impact systems that power Sezzle’s financial reporting, reconciliation, and automation workflows. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams — including Accounting and Finance — to ensure data integrity, streamline financial processes, and build robust, auditable systems that meet enterprise-grade standards.
Your role will extend beyond development. You’ll mentor engineers, shape technical direction, and bring a strong sense of ownership to every project you lead. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative, and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards, technical design, and regulatory best practices.
Compensation:
For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.
Interview Process
We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

- Application submitted (you are here)

- Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

- Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)

- Interview with recruiters (30 min)

- Interview with engineers (1 hour)

- Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)

- Offer!

What You'll Do:

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.

- Participate fully in the software development lifecycle, from design through deployment.

- Build new features and products as part of an integrated engineering team.

- Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.

- Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.

- Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.

- Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.

- Design software applications and features in Golang

- Build reports and automations using Python and SQL.

- Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly

- Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products

- Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products

- Deliver high-quality, testable features that meet reporting and compliance standards.

- Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

- At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience

- Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward

- Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go and Java Python or a similar language.

- Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

- Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.

- Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.

- Experience in banking or financial institutions is a plus

- Proficient in multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and experience with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.

- Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.

- Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.

- Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS

- Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications

About You:

-
You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

-
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

-
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

-
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

-
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

-
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

-
Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python

-
Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native

-
Backend: Golang

-
Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch

-
DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes

-
Version Control: Git

-
CI/CD: Gitlab

-
Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

-
Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?
At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

-
EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree12+ years demonstrated experience leading enterprise network architecture assessments, design, and build out preferred
