remote.title: Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer
remote.description:
Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer – Infrastructure & Security | Remote
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer to support and maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology infrastructure.
Depending on your background and specialization, this role may focus on cloud engineering, network infrastructure, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a combination of these areas.
You’ll help configure and monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot complex technical issues, manage access and authentication, support security operations, and contribute to infrastructure deployments and upgrades.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with a practical understanding of networking, cloud environments, systems, and security best practices.
What You’ll Own
Cloud & Infrastructure Management

- Configure, monitor, and maintain cloud and infrastructure environments

- Support platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, or related technologies

- Monitor infrastructure health, availability, and performance

- Assist with infrastructure deployments, upgrades, and configuration changes

- Help maintain reliable and scalable technical environments

Network Engineering & Troubleshooting

- Configure and support network environments

- Troubleshoot network, connectivity, DNS, routing, and infrastructure issues

- Diagnose complex technical problems across systems and environments

- Monitor network health and performance

- Help maintain reliable connectivity across business systems

Cybersecurity & Security Operations

- Implement and maintain security best practices

- Monitor systems for potential security issues

- Support security-related troubleshooting and incident response

- Help identify infrastructure vulnerabilities and operational risks

- Collaborate with relevant teams to improve the organization’s security posture

Identity & Access Management

- Manage user access, permissions, and authentication

- Support appropriate access controls across systems and platforms

- Troubleshoot authentication and authorization issues

- Help maintain secure access practices

- Assist with onboarding, offboarding, and access changes when required

Monitoring & Incident Response

- Monitor systems for performance, availability, and security issues

- Investigate alerts and technical incidents

- Support incident response and troubleshooting

- Identify root causes and help implement corrective actions

- Escalate critical infrastructure or security issues appropriately

Infrastructure Automation

- Identify repetitive infrastructure tasks that can be automated

- Build or support automation for routine technical processes

- Improve consistency and efficiency across infrastructure workflows

- Reduce unnecessary manual administration where possible

Documentation & Technical Operations

- Maintain clear technical documentation

- Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures

- Keep operational and security documentation current

- Support repeatable processes for deployments, incidents, and system changes

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaborate with engineering, IT, security, and business teams

- Support technical projects and infrastructure initiatives

- Communicate technical issues clearly to relevant stakeholders

- Help coordinate deployments, upgrades, and operational changes

Requirements

-
3+ years of experience in network engineering, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a related infrastructure role

- Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or enterprise networking technologies

- Strong understanding of networking fundamentals

- Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts and security best practices

- Experience troubleshooting complex technical and connectivity issues

- Understanding of user access, permissions, and authentication

- Experience monitoring infrastructure, networks, or systems

- Strong technical documentation skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

- Strong communication and collaboration skills

- Professional working English

- Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

- Relevant technical certifications

- Cloud certifications related to AWS, Azure, or GCP

- Networking or cybersecurity certifications

- Experience with infrastructure or task automation

- Experience supporting incident response

- Experience with identity and access management

- Familiarity with DevOps and deployment workflows

- Experience supporting distributed or cloud-based environments

Tools & Technologies
AWS | Microsoft Azure | Google Cloud Platform (GCP) | Enterprise Networking | Identity & Access Management | Infrastructure Monitoring | Security Tools | DevOps & Automation Technologies
What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

- Can troubleshoot complex technical problems methodically

- Understand how networks, systems, cloud infrastructure, and security interact

- Think about security as part of everyday infrastructure operations

- Stay calm and organized when responding to technical incidents

- Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work

- Maintain clear documentation rather than relying on tribal knowledge

- Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Take ownership of problems through resolution

What a Typical Day Looks Like
Your day may include reviewing infrastructure and security alerts, troubleshooting a connectivity issue, managing user permissions, supporting a cloud deployment, or investigating a technical incident.
You may also update infrastructure configurations, automate repetitive tasks, document technical processes, and collaborate with engineering or IT teams on deployments and upgrades.
In short: you help keep the organization’s infrastructure secure, reliable, accessible, and running smoothly.
Key Metrics for Success

- Infrastructure availability and reliability

- Network and system performance

- Speed and effectiveness of technical issue resolution

- Security and access-control compliance

- Successful infrastructure deployments and upgrades

- Effective incident response

- Reduction in repetitive manual infrastructure work

- Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation

Interview Process

- Initial Application

- Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview

- Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

- Infrastructure / Technical Interview

- Client Interview

- Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required
As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.
After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.
Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.
Apply Now
If you have experience in cloud infrastructure, network engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, or systems administration and enjoy solving complex infrastructure and security challenges, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply today and help maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology environments.

remote.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

-
Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

-
∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.

-
18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

remote.title: Operational Readiness Analyst
remote.description:
Nymbus ( isn’t just a leader in fintech; we’re a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel.
We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work and the value we deliver to our clients. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, accountability, and a strong commitment to execution.
The journey to growth begins with doing something different, and that journey starts with the talented people who make Nymbus successful. Thank you for considering Nymbus as the catalyst for the next chapter of your career.
WORK ENVIRONMENT:
Nymbus is a remote-first company. Occasional travel may be required for client engagements, team planning sessions, or project activities. Highly collaborative, client-facing environment with stakeholders across data, engineering, and product teams.
Working hours primarily align with the Eastern Time Zone; candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred.
This position is performed remotely and requires flexibility in work hours to accommodate client implementations, release cycles, testing windows, on call availability, and occasional in office work requirements.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
The physical requirements outlined herein are indicative of those essential for an employee to effectively carry out the primary responsibilities of this position. The employee is regularly seated and frequently engages in activities such as using hands to handle, finger, or feel. Periodic standing and walking may also be necessary. Additionally, there may be occasional lifting or movement of objects weighing up to 10 pounds. Specific visual capabilities essential for this role include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
INTERNET REQUIREMENTS
As a condition of employment, this role requires the candidate to maintain a stable, high speed internet connection.
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Operational Readiness Analyst supports the day to day operational infrastructure of the Digital Experience Center (DXC), a multitenant contact center supporting multiple financial institution clients. Working under the direction of the Operational Readiness Manager, this role helps build, configure, test, document, and maintain the systems, forms, routing, content, and processes that DXC agents and clients rely on every day.
This is a hands-on execution role. The analyst assists with Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform administration, IVR script maintenance, virtual agent and agent assist configuration, digital and electronic form builds, knowledge management, operational reporting, and vendor case management. The analyst also supports new client implementations by configuring the environment, building the required forms, content, and documentation, and validating that everything works before go live.
Success in this role requires someone organized, technically curious, and comfortable moving between configuration work, testing, documentation, and client facing deliverables. The work is detailed and often deadline driven, and accuracy matters because these systems directly affect how customers reach their financial institution and how agents serve them.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. CCaaS Platform Administration and Vendor Support

- Assist with administration of the CCaaS platform, including user provisioning, role and permission assignment, security profiles, and access reviews.

- Support configuration of skills, queues, routing rules, points of contact, hours of operation, holiday schedules, and dispositions across multiple client environments.

- Help maintain and audit platform configuration to ensure settings remain consistent, accurate, and aligned to client requirements.

- Assist with platform release reviews, feature evaluations, and regression testing following vendor updates.

- Review CCaaS vendor release notes ahead of each release and identify new features, changes, and deprecations that affect DXC configuration, workflows, agent experience, or client setup.

- Summarize release findings with recommended actions, risks, and opportunities, and provide them to the Operational Readiness Manager for review and leadership discussion.

- Perform routine platform health checks and escalate anomalies to the Operational Readiness Manager.

- Monitor vendor service status, incident notifications, and scheduled maintenance announcements, and alert the Operational Readiness Manager and affected DXC teams to timing and expected impact.

- Track platform incidents, degradations, and outages through resolution, documenting start and end times, affected functionality, workarounds applied, and operational impact.

- Validate platform functionality following maintenance windows, vendor changes, and incident resolution, and report residual issues promptly.

- Maintain a running record of incident and outage history to support trend review, vendor accountability, and service level discussions.

- Support the intake, triage, and documentation of agent reported platform issues.

- Open, document, and track vendor support cases with clear reproduction steps, impact statements, and supporting evidence.

- Monitor open cases through resolution, follow up on aging items, and escalate when cases stall or impact expands.

- Maintain records of platform defects, enhancement requests, known issues, and documented workarounds.

- Support vendor meetings by preparing agendas, capturing notes, and tracking action items to completion.

- Assist with license, user count, and entitlement reviews for the CCaaS platform and related supported tools.

- Maintain accurate internal documentation of platform configuration, routing logic, and operational processes so settings and decisions are traceable.

- IVR and Call Routing Support

- Support IVR script development by preparing call flow requirements, documenting menu structures and routing logic, and making defined script updates under the direction and review of the Operational Readiness Manager.

- Assist with routing configuration tasks including menu options, DNIS assignments, department routing, transfer paths, and business hour logic.

- Coordinate prompt recording requests, upload and verify audio files, and confirm prompt accuracy across client environments.

- Test IVR changes in a development environment prior to production deployment and document test results.

- Maintain IVR documentation, including call flow diagrams and plain language journey documentation for internal and client audiences.

- Support reconciliation between development and production script sets by comparing configurations and flagging discrepancies for correction.

- Virtual Agent, Conversational AI, and Agent Assist Support

- Support virtual agent development on the conversational AI platform (Cognigy.ai) by maintaining intents, utterances, and responses, and making defined configuration updates under the direction and review of the Operational Readiness Manager.

- Support knowledge source configuration and upkeep, including tagging, labeling, and filtering, so the virtual agent retrieves accurate, current, and approved content.

- Structure and format operational content so it can be retrieved correctly by conversational AI and agent assist tools, and flag content that is unclear, outdated, or likely to produce poor retrieval.

- Build and execute test utterance libraries to validate virtual agent behavior before and after changes go live.

- Review virtual agent and agent assist outputs for accuracy, consistency, and alignment with approved processes, and escalate concerns to the Operational Readiness Manager.

- Assist with preparation and testing of agent assist resources, including knowledge cards and suggested responses.

- Document defects, missed intents, and containment gaps, and track them through resolution with the appropriate technical or vendor teams.

- Assist with virtual agent updates required by product changes, policy changes, or new client onboarding.

- Support user acceptance testing cycles and compile results for review.

- Digital Forms and Document Administration

- Build, configure, test, and maintain electronic signature forms (DocuSign) and client facing web forms across financial institution clients.

- Translate client provided form requirements into functional builds, including field logic, conditional routing, validation rules, and recipient workflows.

- Maintain form libraries, templates, and standard data sets used across clients.

- Test forms end to end prior to release and validate submissions route correctly to the intended destinations.

- Troubleshoot form errors, submission failures, and routing issues reported by clients or agents.

- Create client facing navigation guides and supporting documentation for forms and digital tools.

- Knowledge Content Maintenance

- Create, update, and maintain knowledge articles, procedures, job aids, and troubleshooting guides following the content standards, formatting, and taxonomy defined by the Operational Readiness Manager.

- Collaborate with cross functional teams and subject matter experts to gather and organize information so content is accurate, current, and usable by agents.

- Conduct regular content reviews to identify outdated, duplicated, or incomplete documentation, and coordinate corrections with process owners.

- Apply tagging and categorization consistently so content is findable by agents and retrievable by supported tools.

- Move content through established review and approval workflows and track items pending approval.

- Flag content that is unclear, conflicting, or noncompliant with organizational policies, privacy laws, or security standards for resolution.

- Monitor changes to Nymbus platforms and supported client systems, assess downstream impact to DXC processes, and update affected knowledge content so agent guidance stays accurate after a release.

- New Client Implementation Support

- Support the implementation of new financial institution clients onto the CCaaS platform.

- Work from client requirements provided by the Operational Readiness Manager and translate them into platform configuration, routing, forms, and supporting content.

- Build the operational assets required for launch, including electronic and web forms, knowledge content, and agent documentation, and assist with routing, IVR, and virtual agent configuration.

- Coordinate with Project Management Operations, client services, and technical teams on internal implementation tasks, dependencies, and timelines.

- Participate in readiness testing and validation prior to go live and document results for review.

- Prepare client facing training materials, navigation guides, and documentation for review and delivery by the Operational Readiness Manager.

- Assist with post launch support, issue resolution, and stabilization activities.

- Reporting and Data Support

- Build, maintain, and refresh recurring operational reporting, including call volume, IVR selection and containment, virtual agent performance, form submission activity, and platform usage.

- Produce recurring reports on an established cadence and deliver them to the Operational Readiness Manager and internal stakeholders for distribution.

- Build and maintain reporting views, dashboards, and data extracts requested by the Operational Readiness Manager, DXC leadership, and client services.

- Pull and prepare interaction analytics data to support reviews of contact drivers, escalation reasons, and containment performance.

- Validate report accuracy, reconcile discrepancies between systems, and correct data quality issues at the source where possible.

remote.title: Forward Deployed AI Architect (GenAI, AWS)
remote.description:
About the role:

Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide and are obsessed with reimagining how they operate and compete.

Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.

We embed engineers and leaders inside client operations as Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and Forward Deployed Executives (FDX) — people who learn the work, ship the system, and own the outcome. Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Bluprints.

You will do the customer’s job before you automate it.

Most AI engagements fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a PRD, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements-gathering step is the bug. So we remove it.

A Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Provectus spends the first weeks of an engagement in the operator’s seat — as the underwriter, the analyst, the RCM specialist, the claims clinician, whoever actually does the work we’ve been asked to change. You do the job. You learn the constraints from the inside, the ones nobody writes down. Then you sit at a table with that operator and a Forward Deployed Executive and rebuild the function from first principles — and you are the one who builds it.

Three things define how you work:

-
Embedded, not engaged. You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it.

-
Real tasks, not scope. You are not fenced into a siloed deliverable. You go where the operating problem is.

-
Autonomous. Embedded is not staff-augmented. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket.

You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. That loop is the difference between an outcome and an invoice.

You’ll be measured on whether the Business Unit’s number moved — not on hours, not on scope delivered.

This is a role for engineers who have led before — as a founder, a CTO, a staff engineer — and who want to stay in the code while owning the outcome. On most days you’ll be the most senior technical person in the room, and you’ll still be the one shipping.

Requirements:

-
8+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands-on today and intend to stay that way.

-
You will take the operator’s seat. You are genuinely willing to spend weeks doing someone else’s job — claims processing, underwriting, revenue-cycle work — before you write a line of code. Engineers who need to stay in the IDE should not apply.

-
You learn domains fast. Demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly enough to argue with the people who do it for a living.

-
Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works.

-
You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why.

-
Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack.

-
Cloud-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus): containers, Kubernetes/ECS, IaC, CI/CD, and the operational reality of a system someone else inherits.

-
Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room.

-
Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job.

-
Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes, not just call the API.

- Strong hands-on prodcution experience with Claude Code/Cowork.

- Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

- Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution.

- Real depth in one of our blueprint industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare, asset management.

- Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery.

- Data platform depth: data lakes, warehouses, streaming and real-time analytics, data mesh and data contracts, governance and data quality.

- MLOps and classical ML: PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow.

- Fine-tuning, distillation, or inference/serving optimization.

- Graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune).

- IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform.

- Open-source contributions or public writing on applied AI.

What you’ll do:

Take the seat

- Do the operator’s job for two to four weeks at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc.

- Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow — in weeks, not quarters.

- Sit with the operator and the Forward Deployed Executive and redesign the function from first principles. Discovery, user research, and PRD-writing collapse into one team that re-imagines its own job. You are all three roles.

Build

- Ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment — LLM applications, agentic workflows, retrieval and structured-extraction pipelines, and the services around them. Running software, not recommendations.

-
Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. When the engagement is bound to a business KPI, “it looked good in testing” is not an answer. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design.

- Write production code across the stack — backend services, data pipelines, and the AI layer. Python and TypeScript are our centre of gravity; we choose tools to fit the customer, not the résumé.

- Take systems to production on AWS (GCP/Azure where the customer requires it): containerized, observable, and maintainable after we leave.

- Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from.

Own the outcome

- Work in a pair with a Forward Deployed Executive who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number.

- Drive adoption. A system the BU routes around has not shipped. Change management is part of the engineering job here, not a phase after it.

- Be credible with the customer’s engineers, their operators, and their executives — and be willing to disagree with all three.

- Shape what we commit to before we commit to it. You’ll have the standing to do it, because you’re the one who will build it.

What We Offer:

- Frontier delivery work across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare

- The chance to shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment

- A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers

- A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them

- Remote-friendly culture

- High-impact role with direct visibility to leadership.

- Strong earning potential with performance-based bonuses.

- Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cloud solutions.

- B2B contract model or full-time model.

- Unlimited Vacation policy.

- Generous health, vision, and dental insurance.

- 401(K) matching plan.

- OTE range $150-180k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data.

How we hire:

-
Intro conversation — the role, your background, what you want to be doing.

-
Two live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor. You may use an LLM assistant (ChatGPT, Claude) — how you work now includes these tools. Autocomplete/agentic coding tools are off for these sessions.

-
The redesign session. We hand you an unfamiliar business function and the constraints of the person who performs it. You have to understand the job well enough to rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. No LLMs for this one.

- Team and practice conversation.

remote.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We design large hyperscale data center campuses and colocation data centers throughout the U.S.. This role will give you the opportunity to work on some of the largest and most complex engineering-driven projects being built today. Our clients are relationship based and truly value the work we do for them, affording us the opportunity to contribute to society’s technological and connected community through the design of the critical infrastructure that is the foundation of these projects.

- Using your talents to positively affect communities

-
Certifications: One or more current Salesforce certifications (Admin/Advanced Admin, Sales/Service Cloud/CPQ/Field Service, Platform Developer 1 or 2, App Builder); multiple certifications preferred

And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

remote.title: VP of Finance
remote.description:
Open to remote, or Headquartered in Lehi, UT with a hybrid schedule.

About SchoolAI

SchoolAI is one of the fastest-growing AI platforms in K-12 education. We believe every student deserves a personalized learning experience, and every teacher deserves a partner in that work. We're building something that matters, and we're building it fast — this role gets to build the financial backbone that makes that possible, with direct visibility into every major decision the company makes.

Values

We want everyone at SchoolAI to make a competitive wage, have fun, and do good. As we build out the team, we optimize for, and invest in, great people who:

- 🪄 Make Magic: You're making magic when you dream big, sweat the details, make the complex look elegant, and the final result is one that puts a smile on everyone's face. People are drawn to working with you and your work.

- ☀️ Rise to the Moment: You're rising to the moment when you show up, answer the call, make the extra effort, and appreciate the fact that we are working with the coolest technology, in the biggest space it’ll impact, and we’re in pole position.

- 🔗 Connect the Dots: You've done the work to prioritize, understand, and tie your work to your team, to students, and to the people who support them. You're driving tangible outcomes and can connect your work to meaningful, tangible business results and goals. You're connecting the dots when you've thought deeply and have a throughline narrative for your work.

- 🚀 Find Leverage: Always consider the board in front of you – using data, instinct, honed expertise, and user problems to pick the best move and maximize the impact of every resource. When the moment is right – go all in.

- ➡️ Simplify and Go: Cut through the noise. Focus on what’s essential and act with urgency. Speed is your ally, simplicity your tool. Embrace clarity and let it guide you to swift victories.

We use our core values to make decisions, evaluate work, and win. We expect that every team member demonstrate these values. In turn, we'll invest in you and your impact at SchoolAI.

The Role

You'll be the most senior finance person in the company and own the full finance function: forecasting, accounting, budgeting and board and internal reporting, and the systems that support how SchoolAI runs day to day.

You'll work directly with the CEO and the leadership team on the numbers behind every major decision: how and when we allocate capital, how decisions impact runway, what’s working and not working and why, etc. This is a seat at the leadership table, not just a seat behind the numbers.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll be closing the books, modeling, running reports and analysis, building and presenting board decks, while also being the person leadership calls when looking for clarity or financial insight.

We expect the work to get done differently than it would have in the past. We sell AI and we expect our own functions to leverage it and finance is one of the places where the leverage is most obvious and useful.

What this role owns

FP&A

- Own company-wide forecasting, budgeting, and scenario modeling: cash runway, burn rate, headcount costs, and vertical SaaS unit economics (ARR, GRR, NRR, CAC payback, LTV, gross margin, burn multiple)

- Build and maintain the model that leadership and the board actually rely on, not a spreadsheet that only makes sense to the person who built it

- Holds teams accountable to budgets set and agreed upon.

Board & Investor Reporting

- Own the monthly and quarterly board reporting package and investor updates, including quarterly board decks

- Handle ad hoc data requests from our investors directly and quickly

- Build the model and materials that support our next capital raise, and be the person who's ready for what investors ask in diligence

Financial Operations & Systems

- Own the finance stack: GL, spend platform, billing, the month-end close process, and how it all integrates: Rippling (payroll), Ramp (Spend management), and HubSpot (revenue/contract data)

- Build the systems and processes now so they still work when the company is twice the size

- Decide what stays outsourced (bookkeeping, tax) versus what should move in-house, and build the team as the work demands it

Cash & Runway Management

- Own runway targets and the working capital execution that protects them. Collections against district payment cycles, billing terms, deferred revenue mechanics, and the seasonal cash trough

- Flag risks and opportunities early: if a decision moves runway or burn in a meaningful way, you're the person who catches it before it becomes a surprise

- Partner with the executive team on hiring, spending, and pricing decisions

Accounting

- Owns monthly, quarterly, and annual close process. Execution is outsourced today to a third-party accounting firm. The output and fidelity of the results are yours even if you’re not fully executing the close for each period

- Proper GAAP treatment is your call to make and your position to defend via documented memos: ASC 606 revenue recognition, Deferred revenue, Capitalized R&D, accruals, stock compensation, ASC 842

- Compliance & audit readiness

Deal & Pricing Support

- Partner with the revenue team on deal structuring, bookings reporting and optimizations, discounting guardrails, and the margin implications of go-to-market decisions

- Bring a clear point of view on what a deal actually costs us versus what it's worth

What we're looking for

- Strong finance leadership experience. Previously owned and built the function. We care more about what you’ve owned and demonstrated than the number of years experience. CPA is a plus, not a requirement.

- You’ve built or scaled finance teams inside a SaaS company, ideally through more than one stage of growth, without inheriting a finished playbook.

- You've owned board and investor reporting directly, not just fed numbers to someone else who presented them

- You've built financial systems and processes from a smaller, scrappier state into something that could support a much bigger company, without waiting for someone to hand you a finished playbook

-
You're comfortable being hands-on: this isn't a role where you build a big team on day one. You're modeling, closing books, and running analysis yourself, while also being the person leadership calls when looking for clarity.

- Strong instincts on SaaS unit economics and what those metrics mean as we scale

- Comfortable in a lean, fast-moving company where priorities shift and you're expected to figure things out rather than inherit a fully built-out finance org

- Experience with K12 or public sector revenue cycles is a strong plus

remote.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Neobank
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

remote.title: Director, Product Marketing
remote.description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

As the Director, Product Marketing, you will lead the strategy and execution of Roofr’s product marketing function, helping us scale our go-to-market engine and position Roofr as the leading software platform for roofing businesses.
You’ll lead a team of three product marketers and serve as the connective tissue between Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. You’ll own how we bring products to market, translate product capabilities into compelling customer value, and create the positioning, messaging, and enablement that drive adoption and revenue.
This is a highly cross-functional leadership role for a product marketing leader who can operate strategically while staying close to execution. You’ll develop the team, establish scalable PMM processes, and build differentiated GTM strategies across both Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Sales-Led (PLS/SLG) motions.
Most importantly, you’ll bring a deep understanding of B2B SaaS and SMB customers and know how to translate complex products into simple, compelling value propositions that resonate with customers and drive business outcomes.
What you’ll get to do

- Lead and develop a team of product marketers, establishing clear priorities, ownership, goals, and development plans

- Own Roofr’s product marketing strategy across PLG and sales-led motions, ensuring both motions are aligned to broader company and revenue goals

- Partner closely with Product leadership to translate roadmap priorities into compelling positioning, messaging, launch strategies, and customer value propositions

- Lead the end-to-end GTM strategy for major product launches, from market insight and positioning through launch execution, enablement, adoption, and post-launch analysis

- Develop differentiated positioning and messaging that clearly communicates Roofr’s value to SMB customers in a B2B SaaS environment

- Build and continuously improve product marketing frameworks, processes, and playbooks that enable the team to scale

- Partner with Sales and Customer Success leadership to identify customer needs, improve enablement, and strengthen how we communicate product value throughout the customer lifecycle

- Oversee the development of sales collateral, product messaging, onboarding content, lifecycle campaigns, competitive intelligence, and other GTM assets

- Develop strategies to increase product adoption, engagement, expansion, and customer retention across the product portfolio

- Establish feedback loops between Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure customer insights influence roadmap and GTM decisions

- Use market research, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and product data to inform positioning and GTM strategy

- Define and monitor product marketing KPIs, including launch performance, adoption, engagement, pipeline influence, and revenue impact

- Identify opportunities to leverage PLG, lifecycle marketing, automation, and digital experiences to improve the customer journey and scale GTM execution

- Serve as a senior product marketing voice across the organization and represent the customer perspective in strategic planning

- Partner with the broader Marketing leadership team on company positioning, campaigns, content strategy, and demand generation

What you bring to the role

- 7+ years of product marketing experience, including experience leading product launches and cross-functional GTM initiatives in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment

- Demonstrated experience managing and developing product marketing teams

- Strong understanding of SMB SaaS buyers and customer journeys, including the unique challenges of acquiring, onboarding, activating, and retaining SMB customers

- Hands-on experience supporting both Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Sales-Led/PLS motions

- Proven ability to develop product positioning, messaging, segmentation, personas, competitive differentiation, and GTM strategies

- Experience translating complex SaaS products and capabilities into simple, compelling customer value propositions

- Strong understanding of the full product lifecycle, from discovery and roadmap planning through launch, adoption, expansion, and retention

- Experience building scalable product marketing processes, frameworks, and operating rhythms

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect product marketing initiatives to measurable business outcomes

- Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to tailor messaging for executives, sales teams, customers, and prospects

- Experience with product marketing and GTM tools such asPendo, Appcues, Navattic, HubSpot, Figma, or similar platforms

- Experience in vertical SaaS, construction technology, or SMB-focused software is a strong plus

- Product Marketing Core Certification or similar professional certification is a plus

What success looks like
In your first year, you will have:

- Built and developed a high-performing team of three product marketers with clear ownership and accountability

- Established a scalable product marketing operating model across PLG and sales-led motions

- Improved the consistency and effectiveness of Roofr’s product launches and internal GTM readiness

- Strengthened Roofr’s product positioning and differentiation within the SMB SaaS market

- Built stronger alignment between Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

- Established measurable product marketing KPIs tied to adoption, engagement, pipeline, and revenue

- Created repeatable GTM playbooks that allow Roofr to launch and scale products more efficiently

- Increased customer understanding and adoption of Roofr’s products and capabilities

Compensation Range: $150,000.00–$175,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:

- 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!

- 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)

- Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years

- Flexible time off

- 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada

- RRSP/401k match

- Generous Parental Leave policy

🤝 Perks:

- We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities

- Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career

- Home office setup stipend

- Internet and phone allowance

- Remote first culture

- Weekly Friday paydays!

🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️

⚠️ Important Notice

We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: .

If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at .

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

- Effective group-facilitation skills and confidence in proposing and leading customer meetings to gain strategic footing and pursue opportunities.

- Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle and API architecture.

- Outstanding spoken and written communication skills, presentation skills, and confidence in explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Develop a comprehensive understanding of Connect, Stripe's solution for enabling platform payments, exploring its various features, and integration methodologies.

- Gather an in-depth understanding of Stripe's Payments and Billing systems and their applicability across diverse business models to cater to individual clients' and their customers' needs.

- Ability to understand how a wide variety of applications such as ERP, CRM, Billing, Tax, and legacy systems interact with each other in a platform technology stack and ecosystem.

- Strong organizational and time management skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities while working with multiple strategic opportunities and customers.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience as a customer-facing, domain expert in the payments space, presenting, and architecting solutions for platform customers.

- Prior experience driving technical sales with top-tier enterprise-scale platforms and supporting them and their customers' unique requirements

- Experience with integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications.

- Experience in systems design, building, and deploying complex applications.

- Experience in helping customers adopt and consume software in a cloud model.

- Passionate about learning and actively seek out knowledge

- Ability to work independently and confidently to develop a path forward with customers under ambiguous circumstances.

- Strategic and creative thinker who proactively identifies challenges and maintains a positive approach when facing difficult obstacles.

- Strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly with extended teams to support our users.

If you're a results-driven person with an entrepreneurial mindset, who takes the initiative and thrives in a dynamic environment, then this is a great opportunity to play a pivotal role in a fast-growing cyber security company. We are looking for a smart and driven leader to have a direct impact on the future of our business by helping to influence global adoption of our award-winning Picus Security Validation Platform.

We are looking for a dynamic individual contributor to drive key initiatives and elevate our Product Marketing function and play a critical role in shaping our positioning and GTM strategy. Deliver sales enablement, sales plays and objection handling tool sets that motivate and arm our team to win.

- Own execution of Product Launch Strategy. Proactively plan and time our product launch roadmap to deliver timely and informed product announcements that keep Picus at the forefront of our market. Lead cross-functionally ensuring alignment and go-to-market success.

What You Have

- 3+ years of experience in B2B cybersecurity software product marketing

- Deep understanding of the cybersecurity ecosystem, and specific expertise in some of these categories: automated pentesting, BAS, EDR/XDR, SIEM, RVBM, Vulnerability Management

- Drive to be hands on and competitive in a high-stakes environment and competitive landscape.

- Progressive growth over the course of your career and proven success in managing key initiatives.

- Demonstrated collaboration and alignment with product management to create messaging that resonates in the market

- Experience working with sales leadership and technical teams to translate key differentiators into sales enablement outputs

- Communication and presentation mastery that is easy to consume, and engages customers, prospects and sales teams. You can motivate sales teams and customer success with the latest launch enablement presentation with ease and gladly serve as the evangelist for our products

- Very strong presenting and storytelling skills, specifically the ability to distill complex product capabilities into a simple and compelling narrative that delivers on our unique value. Delivering comprehensive long form content

- Proactive and inquisitive nature, with problem solving skills that can lead teams through cybersecurity start-up challenges.

- History of technical or customer facing roles (ie. support, incident response or systems engineering) are very desirable.

- Values and ethics that align with the Picus team

- B.S. or equivalent experience

Working at Picus

Fascinating work - a chance to shape and lead an exciting, fast-growing cyber security segment. Security Validation is a concept that helps organizations evaluate their security posture in a continuous, automated, and repeatable way. This approach allows for the identification of imminent threats, provides recommended actions, and produces valuable metrics about cyber-risk levels.
Unlimited opportunity! We are growing. At Picus, you'll be provided with as much responsibility as you can handle - new career development opportunities constantly arise given our rate of growth.
Global exposure - Get a lot of experience working not only in a fast-growing startup but also interact with customers all around the world.
Be part of a global remote team who is taking on Exposure Validation and a growing market segment.

We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.
Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for.
Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.
Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:
WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE
Why Syneos Health

- We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

- We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.

- We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

- Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.

- Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.

- May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).

- Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.

- Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.

- Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.

- Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.

- Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.

- Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.

- Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.

- Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.

- Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.

- Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.

- Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.

- Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.

- Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.

- Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.

- Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.

- Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.

- Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.

- Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience

- Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones

- Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.

- Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)

- Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring

- Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management

- Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements

- Must demonstrate good computer skills

- Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites

- Strong conflict resolution skills

- Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.

- Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues

- Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

remote.description:
About EdgeUno

EdgeUno is a US-based technology infrastructure company headquartered in Miami, with a strong operational presence across Latin America, including Colombia, Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Peru, and Ecuador. We enable digital businesses to scale with high performance and reliability by providing connectivity, IP Transit, private networks, data centers, bare metal, and cloud solutions to ISPs, hyperscalers, content providers, and global technology companies. Through our own infrastructure platform and strategic interconnection with major global hubs, we deliver low latency, security, and operational resilience across the Americas and beyond. As part of our growth, we are developing AI-driven internal systems to improve automation, decision-making, and operational intelligence across the company.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior AI Automation Engineer to join our team in Medellín, working remotely and closely with our Chief of AI to design and build internal AI systems that function as digital teammates across different areas of the company.
This role focuses on architecting and delivering AI agents, internal tools, and automation workflows that integrate with EdgeUno's systems and data to streamline operations and reduce repetitive manual work at scale.
You will work closely with leadership and internal teams to identify, prioritize, and execute opportunities where AI can automate tasks, improve productivity, and accelerate decision-making across operations, sales, marketing, finance, HR, and engineering.
