remote.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

remote.title: Snowflake Field CTO
remote.description:
You’re joining our growing Snowflake practice across multiple industries where you have a unique opportunity to be part of our practice and solutions team to drive the pre-sales motion along with helping our customer to be strategic advisors and design their AI Data Cloud architecture using Snowflake technology stack as part of your delivery responsibilities on the engagement.  You’ll be helping in Go-to-Market (GTM) motion in conducting the customer workshops, hands on labs with Snowflake sales teams and also driving pre-sales efforts to win more Snowflake opportunities, working with internal practice and solutions team in designing relevant solutions and accelerators that we can leverage for our customers in faster time to value.
As a Field CTO and Snowflake Architect, your role is to serve as the technical authority — making platform decisions, representing them to client stakeholders, and guiding the team through the complexity of data and AI architecture and multi-tenant infrastructure design. You’ll report to Blend’s VP of Practice and Solutions and Global Snowflake Practice Head while working within the practices and solutions team along with delivery team and will have regular visibility to the client’s executive leadership.
What You’ll Own
Platform Architecture & Decisions, Pre-sales efforts

- Define and validate the technical blueprint across cloud data warehouse, clean room infrastructure, embedding compute, and AI architecture.

- Design Data and AI architecture with best practices recommendations leveraging Snowflake technology stack.

- For pre-sales and solutioning efforts, you will be recommending the solution approach, prepare high level effort estimates and lead presentations to the client stakeholders.

Technical Leadership & Unblocking

- Identify and resolve critical path blockers across infrastructure, data architecture and integrations, and identity resolution as a Snowflake technical thought leader.

- Pressure-test technical proposals against real-world scale and operational complexity

- Bridge between Blend’s engineering and data science teams and the client’s senior technical stakeholders as a Snowflake technical subject matter expert and chief architect

Executive Presence & GTM Alignment

- As a Snowflake Field CTO, you will drive GTM initiatives working with the Practices and Solution team. Participate in regular leadership touchpoints within Blend, Snowflake team as well with client leadership as required.

- As a leader, you will creatively think where there is a gap and opportunity to drive more value for our customers using Snowflake solutions, translating technical capabilities into commercially relevant differentiation

- Ensure the technical roadmap aligns with for our go-to-market solutions and accelerators

- Serve as a credible technical voice in early client and partner conversations


Who You Are:
Technical Depth

- Enterprise data platforms (Snowflake plus AWS or equivalent)

- Real-time and batch data architecture

- ML/AI systems and embeddings infrastructure

- Cortex AI, CoWork and AI architecture of Snowflake

- Data integration capabilities including Snowflake native as well as nice to have expertise on 3rd party solutions such as Fivetran, dbt and/or other relevant providers.

Executive Presence & Communication

- You’ve worked directly with CTO-level stakeholders and executives with clear communication — not through layers

- You move comfortably between technical depth and business context

- You articulate architectural tradeoffs clearly and in terms of business impact

- You’re comfortable working and leading high-stakes clients in their Snowflake journey

Problem-Solving Orientation

- You ask hard questions about scale, cost, compliance, and risk before committing to approaches. This is applicable for both pre-sales and delivery engagements so you can drive the best practices and solutions for the customers.

- You hold opinions but update them when presented with better information

- You see your role as unblocking the team

Collaborative Mindset

- You’ve worked in embedded delivery, presales or partner roles

- You don’t need to own everything to drive impact

- You value getting to the right answer over being the one with the answer

Required

- 15+ years in data or platform architecture, with at least 3 years on systems at significant scale

- Deep experience with Snowflake and AWS (or other) cloud service providers, or a comparable enterprise data platform

- Demonstrated ability to lead technical strategy in high-stakes client or executive contexts

- Background in consulting delivery or embedded partner roles

- Migration or Modernization expertise in Snowflake

- Building Data Mesh architecture with data sharing capabilities of Snowflake

- You have worked with Snowflake sales and solutions team

Nice to Have

- Clean room or federated data architecture experience  or feature store work

- Identity resolution or data monetization projects

- AWS or cloud infrastructure design

- Snowflake certification

- How to launch our solutions as Snowflake marketplace

Less Important

- Familiarity with every tool on the stack (you’ll learn what you need)

- Specific certifications (outside of Snowflake) or credentials

- Individual contributor “rock star” energy — we care about collaborative problem-solving

The starting pay range for this role is $250,000 - $300,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 offers a competitive benefits program designed to support the health and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Benefits vary by role and eligibility and may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, paid holidays, commuter benefits, flexible spending accounts, life and disability insurance, and employee assistance programs.
Blend360 is a premier data, AI, and marketing consulting firm that partners with the world's most ambitious organizations to turn complex challenges into competitive advantage. We sit at the intersection of deep analytical rigor and pragmatic business execution—helping Fortune 1000 companies and Private Equity-backed businesses unlock transformational value through data, technology, and human expertise.

remote.title: Adoption Coordinator for Dog Rescue - Remote Volunteer (5 hr/wk)
remote.description:
Updated/Reviewed 08.28.26
Matchmaker
Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization
Position Name: Matchmaker
Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States
Job Type: Part Time
Office Setting: Fully Remote
Remote: Yes
Compensation: Volunteer
Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible)
Role Mission
A Matchmaker's primary focus is matching the right dog to the right home. We take the time to learn about adopters and what they are looking for in a dog. We believe by taking our time to match the right dog to the right family, we can prevent many problems down the road. The Matchmaker is the primary contact between the potential adopter and Path of Hope Rescue. They guide the adopter through the process of adoption with empathy, care and professionalism.
What Winning Looks Like
Key Results Area #1 - Communication & Professionalism

- Ensures a smooth, professional and friendly experience for adopters

- Adheres to PHR Core Values

- Adheres to PHR adoption/matchmaking policies

- Best fit for dog

- Best fit for family

- Updates software platforms throughout process, keeping good notes

- Communicates with other PHR team members as needed

Key Results Area #2 - Dog Roster

- Familiar with roster of available dogs and incoming dogs

- Stays up to date on foster reports/dog descriptions

Key Results Area #3 - Applicant Process

- Reviews pre-screened applications assigned to them

- Sets up and conducts 'Matchmaking' phone interview

- Coordinates and oversees group text with foster and adopter

- Conducts long distance In Home Trials via video call

- Coordinates Puppy Delivery if option is chosen

- Finalizes Adoption with contract and donation

- Needed Skills

- Must like people! Our dogs have nowhere to go if people don't adopt them. You must have an equal love for people as for dogs. A hugely important part of this role is establishing and creating a relationship with an applicant over the phone. We want them to feel taken care of and that we care about them.

- Excellent communication, both oral and written.

- Comfortable using CRM and multiple online platforms

- Team player, willing to collaborate and foster a positive/no drama work environment.

Unique Company Culture and Mission
Our Mission
At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.
Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.
Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.
Core Values:
Transparency - sharing the good with the bad
Community - dog loving people who treat each other well
Integrity - doing what you say will do
Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated
Our Company Culture
We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.
We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

remote.title: Senior Security Consultant, Continuity and Compliance
remote.description:
About the Role:
Pondurance is looking for a Senior Security Consultant, Continuity and Compliance to join our Compliance Consulting team. In this role, you will lead compliance-focused consulting engagements and serve as a trusted advisor to clients navigating complex cybersecurity, risk, and regulatory requirements.
You’ll work primarily independently while collaborating with other consultants and internal subject matter experts as needed. The ideal candidate brings strong experience with regulatory and security frameworks, including HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST, and CMMC, and has experience applying these requirements across industries such as healthcare, manufacturing, financial services, education, technology, and retail.
Responsibilities:

- Lead and execute multiple client consulting engagements concurrently, ensuring delivery aligns with established scope, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

- Lead annual PCI DSS compliance assessments, including SAQs, ROCs, and other applicable validation activities in accordance with PCI SSC requirements and QSA responsibilities.

- Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for PCI DSS, NIST, HIPAA, and other applicable security and compliance frameworks, providing accurate, practical, and actionable client guidance.

- Assess client security programs, technical controls, and regulatory requirements to identify risks, vulnerabilities, compliance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

- Develop practical remediation strategies and recommendations aligned with regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, risk, and client business needs.

- Own assigned consulting engagements from initiation through completion, including the accuracy, quality, documentation, and final readiness of assessment deliverables.

- Conduct client interviews, strategic advisory sessions, and workshops with executive leadership, technical teams, and key stakeholders to evaluate controls and communicate findings.

- Establish, review, and advise on client policies, procedures, and controls to support compliance, security, and risk-management objectives.

- Serve as a trusted security and compliance advisor, providing strategic guidance and applying professional judgment to complex, nuanced, or ambiguous client situations.

- Provide technical direction, quality review, and mentorship to consultants and peers, promoting consistency, accuracy, and adherence to established assessment standards and methodologies.

Knowledge and Skills:

- Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience in information security compliance, auditing, and assessments; or 7+ years of demonstrated experience in a related information security discipline.

- Active PCI DSS Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) certification, with a professional certification such as CISSP, CISA, CMMC, or an equivalent credential required.

- Strong working knowledge of security and regulatory frameworks, including PCI DSS, NIST, HIPAA, and CMMC, with the ability to interpret requirements and apply them within client environments.

remote.title: Senior Staff AI Platform Engineer
remote.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Staff AI Platform Engineer, you will be tasked with serving as a hands-on builder of SentinelOne's enterprise AI platform, including the Gateway, Harness, and Semantic Layers that every internal AI use case runs on top of. You will write the production code that governs, observes, secures, and scales AI activity across the company, working closely with the Sr. Director of Enterprise AI Platform Engineering and the rest of the platform team to take the architecture from design into running infrastructure.
What Will You Do?
Primary responsibilities include:

- Design, build, and operate components of the AI Gateway including centralized identity and authentication/authorization, token budgeting, DLP and content guardrails, multi-model routing and failover, MCP allow-listing, and request-level audit logging.

- Build and maintain pieces of the Harness layer including agent orchestration (LangGraph or equivalent), prompt construction and context management, memory and state handling across multi-turn interactions, and model abstraction across providers such as AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex.

- Develop and extend production services in Python (FastAPI) and pydantic.ai for LLM-powered components, and contribute to the React/TypeScript surfaces that expose platform capabilities to internal teams.

- Implement MCP/tool wiring for internal and SaaS-embedded agents, ensuring every caller regardless of origin passes through the same policy controls.

- Contribute to the Claude and Gemini Enterprise plugin framework by building, testing, and hardening role-based skills and agents, and help mature the pipeline for how plugins are authored, evaluated, and deployed.

- Instrument the platform for observability including metrics, tracing, and audit trails, and participate in on-call and operational support for platform services.

- Write clear technical documentation and participate in architecture and code reviews, holding a high bar for quality, security, and maintainability.

- Partner with engineers across Enterprise Data, Enterprise Apps, Product Development, and Infosec to integrate the platform with governed data sources and shared architectural contracts.

- Work with the Sr. Director and model evaluation tooling to help close the loop between evaluation results and model selection, prompt tuning, and routing decisions.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
Ideal candidates will have:

- Hands-on experience building production services that sit in front of multiple consumers such as an API gateway, internal platform, or data platform, with real exposure to authentication/authorization, rate limiting, observability, or audit logging; direct AI and LLM platform experience is a strong plus but not required.

- Practical experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph or equivalent) and calling hosted model providers such as AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex, with a working understanding of how context windows, memory, and tool-calling actually behave in production, not just conceptually.

- 8 or more years of professional software engineering experience; with experience building or operating AI and ML infrastructure in a production environment.

- Strong Python skills, ideally with FastAPI, and comfort picking up frameworks like pydantic.ai for LLM-powered components; working familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus.

- Exposure to or curiosity about the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the challenges of governing tool access for agents operating across enterprise systems.

- Familiarity with enterprise AI deployments such as Claude Enterprise (Anthropic) or Gemini Enterprise is a plus, including how they are administered and how access and policy controls work.

- Solid software engineering fundamentals including clean, tested, production-grade code, strong API design skills, and the ability to give and receive feedback well in code and architecture reviews.

- Comfort operating in a fast-moving, still-forming platform environment where you are energized by ambiguity and enjoy turning a rough architecture into working, reliable infrastructure.

Why SentinelOne?
AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Flexible time off

- Paid company holidays and paid sick time

- Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) retirement plan with company match

- Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

- ARAG pre-paid legal

- Nationwide pet insurance

- Cancer Care program

- Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Home office allowance

- Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Wellness coach

- Wellness/gym reimbursement

- Fertility coverage

- Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Base Salary Range

$184,000—$253,000 USD

remote.title: Lifecycle Marketing Contractor (Iterable)
remote.description:
Cofertility is a Series A company focused on the fast-growing field of fertility and family planning. Through Cofertility Freeze, women can freeze their eggs for free when they donate eggs to a family who can't otherwise conceive. Cofertility Family serves as a more transparent, ethical egg donor matching platform. We are passionate about improving the family-building journey and are in an endless pursuit to make these experiences more positive.


What We're Looking For
If you can look at a funnel, spot the places people are falling out, and have a drip built and live in Iterable the next day, this could be you.
We're looking for an experienced lifecycle marketer to take on our email and SMS program in Iterable as an ongoing contract role. We're a two-sided marketplace, which means you'll be building for two very different audiences at once: women in their 20s and 30s considering egg freezing through our Split program, and intended parents navigating one of the most emotionally loaded decisions of their lives. The journeys are long, high-consideration, and full of moments where the right message at the right time changes the outcome. Lifecycle is a core driver of our business.
We'll share the business priorities, core lifecycle strategy, and our brand and messaging guidelines. You’ll translate those into effective email and SMS journeys: drafting the copy, building, testing, launching and optimizing, with our sign-off before anything ships. We'll also look to you for recommendations on what to test, refine, or retire based on how flows are performing.
Responsibilities
Priorities are set collaboratively each month. Ongoing work includes:

- Building new drips and expanding or optimizing existing ones across the full customer journey, from first touch through activation, conversion, and retention

- Drafting email and SMS copy for new and updated flows, working from our brand voice guidelines and refining based on our feedback

- Digging into our funnels to find where people drop off, then designing and launching re-engagement and win-back programs to address it

- Standing up lifecycle support for new program and campaign launches

- Auditing existing flows and updating messaging, logic, and timing as our programs and positioning evolve

- Building and maintaining journeys, campaigns, templates, segments, and lists in Iterable

- Partnering with our product and engineering team to confirm existing tracking is firing correctly, and to spec new events or data points when a flow needs something we don't yet capture

- Hand-coding and troubleshooting responsive HTML/CSS email templates that render correctly across clients

- Owning segmentation logic, list hygiene, suppression rules, and deliverability

- Reporting on performance against funnel-stage conversion, not just opens and clicks, with a clear point of view on what to scale and what to kill

- Running a real testing roadmap: subject lines, send timing, cadence, sender identity, and offer framing

- Documenting what you build, so the program stays maintainable and our team understands what's running

Who We're Looking For

- 4+ years running lifecycle, CRM, or email marketing programs, ideally for consumer or D2C brands

- Deep, current, hands-on Iterable experience: journeys, campaigns, segmentation, templates, data feeds, snippets/Handlebars, HTML, email QA, and testing. Experience with Klaviyo, Braze, or Customer.io is welcome but Iterable fluency is the requirement

- Comfortable writing HTML and CSS for email, including debugging why something looks fine everywhere except Outlook

- Strong copy instincts. You should be able to draft a solid first pass on most flows and edit toward clarity and warmth

- Highly analytical. You can define the metric that matters for a flow, confirm the data behind it is firing correctly, analyze the results, and come back with recommendations

- Comfortable working with sensitive, high-stakes subject matter with care and precision. Our audience is making medical and family-building decisions, and tone and accuracy are important

- A self-starter who takes a business goal, asks the two questions that actually matter, and comes back with a plan

- Bonus: experience in healthcare, fertility, or femtech; familiarity with marketplace or two-sided funnels; familiarity with long consideration funnels and journeys

Details

- Ongoing independent contractor role, with scope and priorities reviewed each month

- Estimated 60-100 hours per month, though you set your own schedule and working hours

- Hourly rate: $80-$110/hour, depending on experience

About Us
We are a fully remote team and are spread out across the coasts. Since we’re located all over the country, communication using Slack, Gmail, Zoom, and other tools is key. We communicate regularly throughout the day, and you’ll never be alone. We believe in giving our team members autonomy, and place value on the output of each team member. Above all, we’re proud to engage in meaningful work that will impact tons of people throughout the family-building process.
We are an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at our company are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.
Additionally, we encourage candidates who have non-traditional/diverse backgrounds to apply. Candidates who have been challenged or chosen to challenge themselves in unique ways, but may not fit all specified criteria are still encouraged to apply and share why this is such a compelling opportunity for you.

remote.description:
At Root, we’re on a mission to improve the lives of our customers by offering better insurance solutions. We challenge ourselves to think differently in order to reimagine insurance to make it smarter, more equitable, and a better experience for all.

- 5+ years of experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning systems and ML model pipelines in partnership with data scientists.

- Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, with the ability to build maintainable ML systems and production-quality code.

- Experience building and operating production ML systems, including deployment, monitoring, debugging, and workflow orchestration.

- Ability to design reproducible systems with clear lineage, versioning, and operational visibility across complex ML workflows.

- Comfort working in ML systems with interconnected components, simulation-driven logic, and embedded business rules.

- Strong judgment around model evaluation, code quality, system reliability, and maintainable engineering tradeoffs.

- Experience with cloud-based ML infrastructure and data platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

- Exposure to ML and data tooling, orchestrators, and platforms such as MLflow, Airflow, Dagster, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, and Spark

remote.title: Media Buyer (Google Ads) - 20 to 40 Small US Accounts
remote.description:
What this is
We run Google Ads for US small businesses. Most of them are independent auto repair shops, in places like Boise, Salt Lake, Wichita and Raleigh. The rest are a mix: a med spa, a pool service company, a forklift dealer, a financial advisor, an e-commerce brand, a home detailing company.
We are hiring one person to run the media buying across all of it. About eighteen accounts today, heading toward forty.
Read this part carefully, because it is what makes the job unusual: this is not one big account. It is twenty to forty small ones. A typical shop spends between $1,000 and $4,000 a month. The largest spends about $7,800.
That changes the work completely. At these budgets you rarely have enough data to test your way to an answer. Forty clicks and no conversion is not evidence that a keyword is dead. Most of this job is making sound decisions on thin data, at volume, without fooling yourself. If your experience is one account spending six figures a month where you could run a clean experiment every fortnight, this will be an uncomfortable fit and we would rather you knew that now.
You will not be an account manager
We are hiring one of those separately. You are not running monthly review calls, chasing invoices, or managing expectations. You own performance.
You do talk to shop owners for one thing: technical discovery. When a new shop comes on, you interview the owner about what they actually do and do not do, their service radius, their seasonality. That conversation produces the service definition our automation runs on, and it is the most valuable thirty minutes in the whole onboarding. Get it wrong and the account generates months of avoidable work. We will not hand that to someone who does not understand the media.
The automation covers part of the book, not all of it
On the auto repair side we built a control system that reviews search terms, applies negative keywords inside guardrails, moves bids and budgets within hard drift limits, logs every lever change with attribution, and flags drift before it reaches the numbers. On a normal week it proposes about two thousand changes and asks a human about thirty.
The other accounts are run hands-on. No controllers, no auto-apply. Several of them are the more interesting problems in the business, and they are where most of your build work will be. We are telling you this up front because the automation is a genuine advantage and we would rather you not arrive expecting it to cover everything.
So nobody here spends their day pulling search-term reports on the automated side. What is left there is the deciding. Is this negative keyword blocking a competitor or blocking real demand? Is this campaign underspending because the budget is low or because the query pool is exhausted? Did conversions actually stop, or did the tracking break? Those calls are the job, and getting them wrong is expensive in a way no guardrail catches. On the hands-on side, you are doing the work yourself.
What you would own

- Performance across the whole book. Campaign structure, bidding strategy, budget allocation, negative keyword decisions, and knowing when to scale versus protect.

- The decisions the system escalates. Twice a week you work a board of flagged items and rule on them. Early on you stage those rulings for review. Once you have earned it, you rule and we read the log.

- Measurement. Conversion tracking, GA4 and GTM, call tracking, offline conversion imports. When the numbers look wrong you find out why before anyone changes a bid.

- Technical discovery and build for new shops as we grow toward forty.

- Later, a junior buyer. Once the book justifies it we add someone to take the mechanical side of onboarding and reporting. You would help hire and train them, and there is a step on the ladder for running that seat.

What we pay
A base plus a growth fee that rises as the book does. No bonus scheme, no discretionary pool, nothing to argue about at review time. You can work out your own pay on a napkin.
Base: $2,000 per month. Paid in USD as an independent contractor.
Book fee, and it tiers upward:

- Accounts 1 to 20: $25 each per month

- Accounts 21 to 30: $50 each per month

- Accounts 31 and beyond: $75 each per month

Most places pay you less per account as the book grows, on the logic that scale makes each one easier. We do the opposite. The accounts past twenty are the ones you will have built yourself, and we would rather you want the next one than quietly resist it.

- Today, about 18 accounts: $2,000 base plus $450 book fee = $2,450 per month

- 25 accounts: $2,000 plus $750 = $2,750

- 30 accounts: $2,000 plus $1,000 = $3,000

- 40 accounts: $2,000 plus $1,750 = $3,750

There is no separate retention bonus, on purpose. You are paid per account you run, so an account that leaves takes its fee with it. Keeping clients is already how you get paid, and adding a bonus on top would just be paying you twice for the same thing.
We publish all of this because we would rather you self-select than spend three calls discovering we are far apart. If you want a flat salary with no variable component, we are not the right fit, and that is a fair thing to want.
Who we are looking for

- 5 or more years buying Google Ads, and you can prove it. Genuine multi-account experience. Be ready to walk us through real accounts you have run: what was wrong, what you changed, why you changed it, and what happened next. We are not impressed by titles. We want someone who has done this work with their own hands for five years and can show the work. Running one large account well is a different skill and it is not this one.

- Lead-gen and local service first. Most of the book is graded on cost per qualified phone call, not ROAS. A couple of accounts are e-commerce, so knowing both helps, but if ROAS and shopping feeds are all you have done this will be a harder fit.

- Sound judgment on small samples. You know why "40 clicks, no conversions" is usually not a reason to pause anything, and you can explain what would change your mind.

- You can explain a bidding strategy, not just set one. Target CPA and target ROAS, what happens when a target is too tight versus too loose, and why.

- You understand offline conversion imports. Why the number in Google Ads and the number in a client's booking system disagree, and which one you optimize against.

- Call tracking experience, CallRail preferred. Every account here is graded on tracked phone calls, so the call data is the scoreboard and not a side report. If you have never worked with call tracking, this will not be a fit.

- You already work with AI, and you want more of it. This is not a culture question, it is the job. Our whole operation runs on it: the control system, the reporting, the daily decision board. We use Claude and Claude Code every day and you would too. We are not asking for an engineer. We are asking for someone who reaches for these tools by instinct rather than waiting to be handed them, and who can tell us what they have actually built or automated with them. If AI feels like a threat to your job rather than the reason this one is interesting, we are not a fit.

- You think in portfolios. Forty accounts is not forty craft projects. What works has to be systematized so it can be applied everywhere, not hand-tuned shop by shop.

- Very fluent English, spoken and written. Hard requirement, no exceptions. You will interview shop owners about their business, explain technical findings to people who are not technical, and work with us every day. We test this on a live call, not from a CV. You do not need to be able to sell, but you do need to be genuinely easy to talk to.

- Willing to say "I do not know yet, let me check." Our worst outcomes have all come from confident wrong answers. Yours will too.

Nice to have: Claude Code or similar AI tooling in your daily workflow, Local Services Ads, Performance Max at small budgets, Looker Studio, Spanish, experience working inside an agency's own tooling rather than only the Google Ads interface.
We do not care about Google Ads certifications. We will ask you to walk us through a real account instead.
This is probably not for you if

- You are a marketing director or head of department looking for the next step up. This is a hands-on seat and it stays hands-on. There is no team to run here except, eventually, one junior buyer.

- Your written English is strong but you would not be comfortable holding a technical conversation on a live call in English.

- Your best work is on one large account with real statistical power.

- You want to own client relationships and grow into an account director.

- You would rather execute a plan someone else made than make the call yourself.

- You are looking for something part-time alongside other retainers.

Hours
Full time, and we mean available for a full week. Our clients are mostly in US Mountain and Central time, with a few on the coasts. You need to overlap US business hours, roughly 9am to 3pm Mountain. From most of Latin America that is an ordinary working day.
Being straight about the workload: at today's book of eighteen accounts, the steady-state work runs closer to thirty hours a week than forty. That will not last, and it is not what we are hiring for. Getting to forty accounts means roughly twenty-two onboardings, and each one is a campaign build, a tracking setup and a service definition written from scratch. We are hiring for the full week and we expect you available for it, not for the lighter version that happens to fit an early month.
How we work

- Direct. You report to the owner. No layers.

- Written. Decisions get recorded with the reasoning, so nobody has to remember why.

- Slow on levers, fast on breakage. Bid and budget changes are paced deliberately. Tracking failures and disapprovals get fixed the day they appear.

- No busywork reporting. The reporting builds itself.

To apply
Apply through this posting and answer these five in your application. Skip the cover letter. Specific beats polished, and a real number beats a confident adjective.

- A campaign has a $220 target CPA and is actually producing conversions at $125. What is happening, and what do you do?

- Google Ads reports 30 conversions last month. The client's booking system shows 5 real jobs from ads. Which number is right?

- An account spends $1,200 a month. One keyword has 40 clicks and no conversions. Do you pause it? Why or why not?

- Which AI tools do you use in your work today, and what have you actually built or automated with them? Also, what do you think this job looks like in three years?

- Where you are based, and your monthly rate in USD.

Our process: a paid exercise on a real anonymized account (about 2 to 3 hours, we pay $150 whether or not we move forward), then two calls. Start to offer is usually three to four weeks.

About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

RoleDescription:
The Manager – Companion Animals Global On-market Clinical Studies & Outcomes Research will serve as a key research and subject matter expert for the Zoetis Pet Care business globally. This scientist will plan and execute research studies that demonstrate the technical, emotional, and economic value of Zoetis products and services for companion animal customers worldwide.
The role will ensure alignment of research with the Global Pet Care Strategy and foster close collaboration with regional colleagues, Technical Services, Marketing, Veterinary Medical Research & Development (VMRD), Regulatory Affairs, Global Medical Portfolio Support (GMPS) and Global Portfolio Marketing (GPM).
Research will be conducted in partnership with global customers (veterinary partners and pet owners), contract research organizations, universities, and internal facilities. The focus will be on product performance, differentiation, and delivering customer value across diverse markets.
Responsibilities:

- Develop and execute clinical studies and outcomes research strategies that support the objectives of multiple Companion Animals brands across markets.

- Design and implement pharmacoeconomic and outcomes research models to quantify the value proposition of Zoetis Companion Animals products globally.

- Work with regional teams, Marketing, Technical Services, GMPS and GPM to ensure alignment of research with customer and market needs.

- Support global lifecycle planning, ensuring Phase 4/OR principles are integrated into product development and post-launch strategies.

- Publish and present research outputs internally (Sales, Marketing, Technical Services, Global teams) and externally (customers, industry meetings, publications).

- Ensure dissemination of research results across markets, facilitating knowledge transfer and synergies.

- Engage with global Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), universities, and contract research organizations to expand the scientific evidence base.

Education and Experience:

- PhD, DVM, or MS in Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, Outcomes Research, Epidemiology, Health Economics, Public Health, or a related quantitative field; companion animal focus strongly preferred

- Advanced training in epidemiology and biostatistics (e.g., causal inference, longitudinal/mixed models, survival analysis) is strongly preferred

- Proven track record designing and executing outcomes and real world evidence studies in companion animals (e.g., comparative effectiveness, PRO/HRQoL, adherence, utilization), including economic analyses and decision modeling

- 5+ years of relevant experience in companion animal health or outcomes research, ideally with multi market or global exposure and collaboration with clinics, referral centers, or practice networks

- Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific and economic findings into clear, customer focused insights for veterinarians, practice owners, payers/insurers, and internal stakeholders

- Strong oral and written communication skills with experience presenting to diverse audiences (clinical, medical, commercial, regulatory), including publication and conference presentations

- Experience working with companion animal data sources (EMR/PIMS, insurance claims, registries), data quality assessment, and privacy/ethics compliance preferred

- Proficiency in study design, principles of statistical analysis and reproducible analytics; familiarity with survey design and patient (owner) reported outcomes is a plus

- Proven expertise in scientific writing, including the ability to synthesize complex information and collaborate on the development of research papers, protocols, and project summaries.

- Proven cross functional collaboration with Medical/VMRD, Commercial, and Regulatory teams to align evidence with value messages and decision needs.

Technical Skills Requirements:

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) for executive-ready deliverables and data summaries

- Broad knowledge of companion animal health across species (canine, feline), clinical practice workflows (general practice vs referral), and prevalent conditions impacting outcomes and quality of life

- Statistical analysis expertise (R, Python, SAS, or other softwares) strongly preferred, including design and analysis of observational studies and pragmatic trials

- Health economics and outcomes research methods (cost effectiveness/budget impact modeling, PRO/HRQoL measurement, utility elicitation, causal inference) with application to companion animal contexts

- Experience with companion animal data sources (PIMS/EMR from veterinary practices, insurance claims, registries) and data engineering basics for cohort building and data quality assessment

- Advanced modeling skills: generalized linear/mixed models, survival/time to event analyses, longitudinal/clustered data methods (e.g., mixed effects), and sensitivity analyses

- Data visualization and communication: ability to build clear, persuasive charts/dashboards (e.g., ggplot, matplotlib, Power BI/Tableau) and translate statistical results for clinical and business audiences

- Reproducible analytics and governance: version control, documentation and audit ready outputs; familiarity with privacy/ethical standards for veterinary data.

Physical Position Requirements:

- Ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed environment across functions and geographies

- Flexibility to manage research projects with variable timelines and regional needs

- International travel (20–30%, variable)

- Ability to work in a home office environment with reliable high speed internet and a confidential workspace suitable for handling sensitive data

About the Client
Our client is a physician-founded, science-backed wellness brand in the health and nutrition space, known for a premium, clinically-informed product line and a highly engaged, loyal customer base with tens of thousands of five-star reviews. They operate as a fast-moving, high-growth DTC company where product launches, promotions, and customer touchpoints move quickly and content needs to keep pace. Trust, credibility, and precision matter deeply to their brand — every word customers read reflects the same rigor they apply to their product.

Why does this role exist?

As the brand scales, support and self-service content can't be an afterthought — it has to be as sharp, current, and on-brand as the marketing customers see before they buy. This role exists because someone needs to own that consistency: catching outdated templates, contradictory FAQs, or missing coverage before they become escalations, and building the systems (templates, style guides, AI-assisted workflows) that let the support and content functions scale without sacrificing voice or accuracy. This is a builder's role, not a maintenance role — the person who takes it will be expected to grow the scope of what "copy infrastructure" means for this team over time.

The Impact you’ll make

Support Copy Template Library

- Write, edit, and maintain the library of standardized responses across email, live chat, and social channels.

- Audit the library on a recurring cadence to retire duplicates, fix contradictions, and update details tied to changed policies, pricing, or products.

- Draft new response templates for product launches, promotions, expansions, and recurring customer inquiry themes.

- Version and organize content so support agents can locate the correct response efficiently.

Help Center Self-Service Content

- Write and update help-center and FAQ articles, including coverage for new products and channels.

- Identify content gaps where repeat inquiry volume signals a missing or unclear article.

- Maintain consistent formatting, structure, and internal linking across the knowledge base.

Lifecycle Transactional Copy

- Draft and revise transactional and service email copy, including order updates, account changes, delays, and resolutions.

- Partner with marketing teams on tone alignment across shared customer touchpoints.

Brand Voice Quality

- Serve as the day-to-day guardian of brand tone and voice — warm, credible, plain-spoken, and clear.

- Review agent-drafted responses for voice, clarity, and accuracy, providing specific, constructive feedback.

- Maintain the content style guide and usage guidelines.

Innovative Builder

- Develop and test generative AI prompts to scale content production without sacrificing brand voice.

- Design standardized copy templates, messaging frameworks, and style guides to streamline team workflows.

- Create dynamic content experiments and multivariate copy testing frameworks to optimize conversion rates.

- Build centralized campaign messaging repositories and asset libraries to improve cross-functional collaboration.

Enablement Support

- Translate approved policy and process changes into clear internal reference docs and summary guides.

- Support content rollouts by drafting announcement materials and quick-reference guides.

- Coordinate with graphic design teams when written material requires visual support.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:

- 2+ years of experience writing customer-facing copy in a content, support, or messaging role (DTC or e-commerce strongly preferred)

- Demonstrated ability to write independently and originally — not solely under the direct guidance/editing of another writer or manager

- A portfolio or work samples that can be reviewed and discussed in detail

- Strong written English capabilities with the ability to write consistently in a defined brand voice across hundreds of pieces
Comfort working in a fast-moving remote environment with asynchronous review cycles and shifting schedules

Your superpowers are...

-
Technical:

- Hands-on experience with help desk or knowledge-base platforms (Zendesk, Gorgias, Intercom, Help Scout — nice to have)

- Familiarity with AI writing tools as a drafting accelerant, paired with strong independent editing judgment

- High attention to detail regarding formatting, links, dates, and product nomenclature

- Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, Notion, Google Workspace)

-
Soft Skills:

- Strong self-direction — able to manage an ongoing content backlog independently, without heavy oversight

- A builder's mindset: proactively spots gaps and creates systems, rather than waiting to be told what to fix

- Flexible and fast-moving, comfortable with shifting schedules and priorities

- Clear, plain-spoken communicator who can translate policy/process changes into simple guidance for others

WFH Set-Up:

- Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.

- Internet speed of at least 40MBPS

- Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam

- Back-up computer and internet connection

- Quiet, dedicated workspace at home

You should apply if...

- You take pride in owning your work end-to-end — you don't just write copy, you notice when something's outdated or inconsistent and fix it before anyone has to ask.

- You think like a builder: given a messy or nonexistent system, your instinct is to create the framework, not just patch the immediate problem.

- You're comfortable being early in a role that will grow and change shape as you prove yourself, and you move quickly without needing every detail handed to you.

- Precision matters to you — you'd rather double-check a date or product name than let something slip through.

What to expect...Work Setup:

- Required to provide own computer with Intel Core i5 or something similar or higher operating system

Working Hours:

Compensation:

The Development Coordinator will support fundraising strategy and operations for the Global Priorities team, with a focus on data management, reporting, complex calendaring, and process coordination. This role will also support the development, documentation, and refinement of processes and workflows, improving efficiency and consistency across the team. The Coordinator applies established processes and practices to improve team effectiveness and ensure smooth operations.

In this role, you will operate at the center of the Global Priorities Development Team—coordinating workflows, managing data, and ensuring fundraisers have the information and tools they need to be effective.

You are someone who thrives on bringing structure to complexity and enjoys working behind the scenes to drive results. You are comfortable managing multiple priorities, tracking details across systems, and collaborating with colleagues across teams and geographies. - Are skilled at managing and organizing data, systems, and processes

- Communicate clearly and professionally with a wide range of colleagues

- Take initiative, solve problems, and follow through on details

- Are motivated by contributing to mission-driven work and collective impact

remote.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Investing
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Role Summary
The Senior Solutions Consultant is a strategic technical and business advisor embedded within the Business Unit leadership team. This role provides deep expertise across the BU product portfolio and influences roadmap priorities to align with market needs and customer requirements. Senior Solutions Consultants play a critical role in shaping complex, large-scale deals—including Global Flagship and Large Account opportunities—by partnering with Commercial Solution Consultants and Account Management teams. They engage directly with executive stakeholders at customer organizations to ensure integrated solutions are positioned effectively, driving adoption and long-term value.
Key Responsibilities
1. Lead Solution Discovery & Requirements Gathering

- Engage with prospective and existing customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, and key workflows.

- Conduct stakeholder interviews and facilitate discovery workshops across business and IT functions.

- Translate discovery insights into tailored solution strategies that incorporate SaaS, licensed software, and services components.

2. Design and Present End-to-End Solution Proposals

5. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in solution consulting, enterprise architecture, or technical pre-sales roles, preferably in SaaS and enterprise software environments.

- Proven track record of influencing product strategy and shaping complex, multi-product deals with executive-level stakeholders.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The RCM Client Integration Specialist is responsible for coordinating and supporting the successful onboarding of new Revenue Cycle Management clients post contract execution through go-live and stabilization. Following go-live, this position will provide structured 30-, 60-, and 90-day post-go-live support, monitoring workflows, performance, staffing, reporting, and client concerns before transitioning the account to the ongoing Client Success and RCM Operations teams.

Key Responsibilities
Client Onboarding & Implementation

Go-Live & Stabilization

30/60/90-Day Transition

- Monitor implementation performance against established goals and expectations.

- Identify trends, recurring issues, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

- Ensure outstanding implementation items are resolved or appropriately transitioned to the responsible team.

- Track project risks, issues, dependencies, and changes.

- Assist in developing templates, checklists, workflows, and other tools to improve implementation efficiency.

Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, medical billing, healthcare operations, or a related field.

- Experience working with multiple RCM functions, including coding, billing, AR, denials, payment posting, and/or charge entry.

- Strong project coordination and organizational skills.

- Experience working directly with clients or healthcare practices.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.

- Ability to learn and navigate healthcare information systems, EHR/PM systems, clearinghouses, and reporting platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, project management, or related field.

- Experience leading or coordinating RCM client implementations.

- Experience with RCM transitions, acquisitions, staff transitions, or system implementations.

- Experience developing workflows, SOPs, implementation checklists, and project plans.

- Knowledge of healthcare claims, payer requirements, denials, and reimbursement processes.

Key Competencies

Project Management – Effectively organizes multiple workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders while maintaining accountability.
Communication – Communicates clearly and professionally with clients, leadership, and internal teams.
Problem Solving – Identifies barriers early, evaluates solutions, and coordinates appropriate resolution.
Attention to Detail – Maintains accurate implementation documentation and follows through on critical details.
Relationship Management – Builds trust with clients and internal stakeholders while maintaining appropriate expectations.
Healthcare/RCM Knowledge – Understands the relationship between clinical workflows, billing operations, coding, claims, reimbursement, and AR.
Adaptability – Comfortable working in a changing environment with multiple implementations occurring simultaneously.
Ownership & Accountability – Takes responsibility for assigned implementations and proactively drives work forward rather than waiting for issues to be identified.
FULL TIME BENEFITS

- Employer sponsored Vision

- Accidental Death and Disability insurance

- 401K matching

- Generous paid time off

- True opportunity for advancement

DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.
As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. You'll lead paid media across channels like Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube and drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables. You'll shape HubSpot as an architect, not just a user, and build the reporting that tells our leadership team whether any of it worked. This isn't a blank slate: paid channels are already live with an agency in place, the event calendar is established, and HubSpot and attribution already exist. You're inheriting a functioning engine, with plenty of authority to make it even stronger.
It's a small team with a large surface area, so roughly two thirds of your time goes toward driving demand through campaign strategy, paid media, and events, and the other third goes toward building the systems that make that demand measurable and repeatable through HubSpot architecture, lifecycle programs, and attribution. In this role, one person connects both sides of the engine, creating a much tighter link between what we invest, what we learn, and what ultimately produces pipeline.
You'll have real authority to change what isn't working from day one, and on a team this size, a fix you make on Tuesday can be live by Friday. By the end of the year, you'll be the person leadership trusts for a straight answer on whether campaigns and events are actually working.

What Success Looks Like

- Take full ownership of the paid channels and the agency relationship, and identify specific over- or under-spending by channel.
