remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

remote.title: Senior Account Executive (Enterprise)
remote.description:
🧡 Coverflex

Work changed. Pay didn’t.
Coverflex exists to make compensation work for everyone.
Pay is still rigid, fragmented, and hard to feel.
We turn compensation into choice — one platform, one card, one app — for benefits, meal allowance, insurance and more.
Our platform is simple for HR and meaningful for employees.
We provide choice, smarter compensation tools and empowerment.
⚙️ TL;DR (The Essentials)
Role: Account Executive (Enterprise)
Seniority Level: Senior
Type: Individual Contributor
Languages: Portuguese (main) / English (fluent)
Main Tools: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Notion, Slack
Location: Remote (Portugal)
Contract Type: Permanent
Compensation:

- Base Salary: €50,000 – €80,000

- Bonus / Commissions: Earn 8% commission on all revenue you sell (EUR), with no caps.

- Equity: Yes – Stock Options under our Equity Incentive Plan

- Benefits: you can check them below (at the end of the page)

💥 Your Impact
Your role will play a major role in our success because as an Account Executive (Enterprise), you will be responsible for successfully closing the deals in your pipeline and helping your manager understand how Coverflex can create new efficiencies and impact the business through sales. You will drive revenue growth by expanding the customer base, generating new revenue from both new leads and existing clients, and ensuring your pipeline contributes to company goals.
You’ll know you’re successful when, after 90 days, you’ve...
Built and managed a structured pipeline in Hubspot with accurate forecasts, generated new revenue from new leads and existing clients, and led effective discovery sessions, demos, and proposals that convert.
Delivered actionable frontline feedback to marketing, product, and customer success teams, and collaborated closely with your manager to align revenue strategies with broader business objectives.
How we’ll measure success:

- Main KPI 1: ARR generated from enterprise accounts

- Main KPI 2: Pipeline coverage

- Main KPI 3: Forecasting accuracy and CRM discipline for long-cycle, high-value deals

- Main KPI 4: End-to-end ownership of complex enterprise sales processes

⚡ Reality Check - What Makes This Role Hard
This role sits at the intersection of complex buying, internal politics, risk, and long time horizons.
You’re not “selling a tool”, you’re entering a big organization and getting it to agree to change how compensation and benefits work (which impacts budgets, compliance, employees, and leadership reputation).
Here’s what makes it challenging:

- Enterprise sales cycles are long (and don’t follow a straight line): you’ll need patience, stamina, and strong deal orchestration

- Deals are multi-stakeholder and political: HR, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and leadership may all need to align

- You’ll handle high risk sensitivity: decisions involve budget, employee impact, and regulatory considerations

- Most of your pipeline will be self-generated: outbound discipline and consistency are non-negotiable

- You’ll need to stay sharp through ambiguity and constant context-switching, while still forecasting accurately and delivering results

👤 You
Must-haves (evidence, not years)

- Experience in B2B/Enterprise software sales

- Experience with inside and outside sales, including inbound and outbound prospecting

- Ability to create strong relationships with prospects in a growth environment

- Strong work method to organize and prioritise a full pipeline

- Exceptional communication skills

- Fluent in English and Portuguese (internally, we communicate exclusively in English)

Nice-to-have

- Experience with Hubspot or other CRMs

- Insurance or benefits market experience

🧬 Your DNA

- Passion, drive and desire to make a real difference

- Motivated by being part of a growing team

- Focused on continuous self-improvement

- Resilient when things get hard

- Autonomous and proactive in how you work

You’ll probably find this frustrating if…

- You don’t love to communicate

- You don’t love to be in the driver seat

- You don’t like to influence decisions

- You are not persuasive

- You are not an active listener

👥 Manager & Team
Meet Your Manager
Hiring Manager: Inês Odila - GM Portugal
Location: Portugal
LinkedIn Profile:
Profile Snapshot:

- Energy: Goal-driven and relentless, but always valuing people and team effort.

- Communication: Direct, no fluff. Says what he means and means what he says.

- Feedback Style: Open door, both ways. Bruno welcomes honest feedback and gives it just as freely.

How to work with me - in the Manager's own words:
"I've spent 8 years in sales, so I'm wired for results, but I've learned that the best results come through people, not despite them. I'm pragmatic: if something isn't working, let's fix it fast and move on. I don't do politics. Tell me what you think, even if it's uncomfortable. I'd rather have a hard conversation on day one than a slow problem."
Your Team
You’ll work day-to-day with the other Account Executives and General Manager.
Key Stakeholders:

- Sales Team

- Success Team

- Marketing

- Product

Team Rituals:

- Weekly team meeting

- Pipeline check

- 1:1s with Manager

💜 Access & Belonging (Equal Opportunity)
We hire for impact and potential, not pedigree.
We welcome applications from people with non-linear careers, career breaks, caregiving gaps, and those changing fields.
No discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity/expression, marital or family status, pregnancy, neurodivergence, race/ethnicity, religion/belief, gender, sexual orientation, or any other protected ground.
Assessment fairness:
We anchor on evidence of outcomes (what you shipped, moved, or influenced).
We actively de-bias by using structured rubrics, multiple assessors, and blind screening most of the time (we won’t know your name, gender, or personal info until the interview stage).
📬 Application Clarity
No cover letter required.
Apply with your LinkedIn or upload your CVin English.
You may be asked a few short, relevant questions.
Total candidate time investment: ~4 hours end-to-end.
🧩 Hiring Stages (What to Expect, Why & How Long)
1. CV / LinkedIn Screen / Video — Signal check vs must-haves

- Done by People + Hiring Manager.

- You’ll hear from us within 10 business days.

2. Hiring Manager Interview - Mutual fit & context • 45 min
Structured around outcomes, decisions, and collaboration.
3. Challenge – How you think in enterprise sales •
Use our case or a real artefact from a complex deal.
We assess judgement, decision quality, stakeholder leadership, and ethics.
4. People Interview - Allow us to know you better! • 45 min
With People. Stress-free virtual coffee, focused on getting to know you as a person. We talk about culture, beliefs, and purpose.
5. Final Conversation (CEO / C-Level) — Values, strategy, and your growth • 30 min
🤖 AI & Hiring Tools Transparency
We use a few tools to reduce bias and improve documentation, not to make hiring decisions.

- Teamtailor anonymisation: profiles are reviewed without relying on names/personal identifiers.

- Meeting recorder (e.g., Talka.ai, Granola): may be used to capture interviews so we can focus on the conversation.

- ChatGPT: may be used to turn interview notes/transcripts into clear, structured summaries.

Important: every application is reviewed by a human, and no decision or rejection is made by AI. If recording is used, we’ll be transparent and (where required) ask for consent.
⏱️ Speed & Communication

- Decision: within 4 weeks of your application.

- Updates: weekly if the process runs longer.

- Scheduling: interviews between 10:00–16:00 CET (flexible across Europe).

- Feedback: from the Case stage onwards, you’ll always receive written or verbal feedback - what went well, and what to strengthen next time.

remote.title: Faculty Success & Instructional Designer (US)
remote.description:
Faculty Success & Instructional Design Manager

Classavo | Full-Time
Classavo is an education technology company helping professors create, deliver, and improve engaging digital course experiences.
We're growing quickly and looking for an Instructional Designer / Faculty Success professional who can become a trusted partner to the professors we serve.
This is not a traditional behind-the-scenes instructional design role. You'll work directly with professors throughout their Classavo journey, from helping them envision what's possible during the evaluation process to designing and launching their course, training them on the platform, and ensuring they're successful throughout the semester.
What You'll Do
You'll work closely with professors, our sales team, and the broader Classavo team to:

- Participate in discovery conversations and product demonstrations with professors.

- Understand how professors teach today, what they're trying to accomplish, and where Classavo can help.

- Help professors translate their existing course content and teaching approach into Classavo.

- Lead professor onboarding, course setup, instructional design, and training.

- Guide professors through the steps required to successfully launch their courses.

- Proactively manage implementation timelines, commitments, and potential roadblocks.

- Support professors after launch and help drive successful adoption.

- Identify opportunities to improve and expand successful Classavo courses.

- Troubleshoot issues and coordinate with the Classavo team when additional support is needed.

- Take ownership of professor success from initial engagement through successful adoption.

Who We're Looking For
We’re looking for someone who understands the education world, is comfortable with technology, and isn’t afraid to be a trailblazer — someone excited to try new approaches and help educators rethink how they create and deliver their courses.
Experience in instructional design combined with sales, customer success, implementation, or another customer-facing role is ideal. Most importantly, you need to be comfortable working directly with educators, learning new technology, making recommendations, and helping people make decisions and move forward.
We’re especially interested in people who have:

- A strong understanding of education culture and how educators think, work, and make decisions.

- A willingness to try new things, challenge traditional approaches, and help shape how Classavo works with faculty.

- Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

- Experience working with software or technology; experience with LMS platforms or EdTech is a plus.

- Experience in instructional design, curriculum, or learning design is a plus.

- Experience in sales, customer success, implementation, training, or another customer-facing role is a plus.

- Classroom teaching experience, whether K–12 or higher education, is a plus.

- The ability to learn new technology quickly, explain it simply, and help educators feel confident using it.

- A desire to work in an entrepreneurial environment where you'll have the opportunity to help build the process, not just follow one.

The Characteristics That Matter Most
Experience matters, but how you work matters just as much.
We're looking for someone who:

- Takes ownership. You view professor adoption and success as your responsibility and don't wait for someone else to solve problems.

- Has exceptional follow-through. You can manage multiple professors, deadlines, and commitments without dropping balls.

- Is hands-on. You enjoy executing, not just advising. Some of the work required to successfully launch a course is detailed and unglamorous, and you're willing to do it.

- Can teach. You make complicated things feel simple and don't overwhelm people with technology.

- Can lead. You're comfortable telling a professor, respectfully, what you recommend they do next rather than simply taking orders.

- Is coachable. You welcome feedback and can quickly turn it into changed behavior.

- Is smart and technology-capable. You learn software quickly, troubleshoot effectively, and don't need everything explained multiple times.

- Is humble and curious. You ask questions before jumping to solutions and bring intelligence without being judgmental or a know-it-all.

- Cares deeply about educator and student success. You understand the demands professors face and work hard to earn their trust.

- Has a strong work ethic. When something needs to get done to make a professor successful, you're willing to roll up your sleeves and do it.

What This Role Is Really About
We're not simply hiring an instructional designer.
We're looking for an educator who can help Classavo win, onboard, and retain professors.
The right person can enter a professor relationship early, establish credibility around teaching and course design, help the professor see what's possible, and then stay involved through implementation, launch, and successful adoption.
If you're an educator at heart, enjoy technology, like working directly with people, and get satisfaction from taking ownership and making things happen, we'd love to hear from you.
Our Interview Process
Because this is a hands-on role, our interview process will include conversations with the Classavo team as well as a short, practical exercise designed to give you an opportunity to show us how you learn, communicate, teach, and work with educators.
We're much more interested in seeing how you think and work than in hearing perfectly rehearsed interview answers.

remote.title: Revenue Operations Lead
remote.description:
About Ema
Ema is building the world’s leading Agentic AI platform to transform enterprise productivity. We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production — we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
About the Role
Ema sells through two motions that behave very differently, and today they share one pipeline, one CRM, and one forecast.
Direct enterprise — field Account Executives landing Fortune 2000 logos at $250K+ initial contract value and expanding past $500K, into buying committees that include IT, security, data governance, and procurement.
Partner-led — global systems integrators and ISVs, including Teleperformance, PwC, Wipro, NTT Data, Hitachi, KPMG, Atos, ADP, Microsoft, and Google, who deploy Ema's Frontier Apps to their own clients. In some cases the partner embeds Ema inside their own product and owns the end-client relationship entirely.
Those two motions require different definitions, different attribution rules, and different quota treatment. Building that distinction — and the systems, reporting, and compensation logic that sit on top of it — is the core of this role.
This is the first dedicated Revenue Operations hire supporting the US go-to-market organization. You will be building the function, not maintaining one.
What You Will Own
Forecasting and pipeline management

- Own the weekly forecast process and cadence across direct and partner motions, and report forecast accuracy against commit.

- Define and enforce opportunity stage definitions with entry and exit criteria configured in the CRM rather than documented in a slide.

- Instrument CUPMEDDPIC Ema's qualification methodology as required, inspectable fields tied to stage progression.

- Maintain pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, and stage-aging analysis by segment, motion, rep, and vertical.

- Run pipeline hygiene and inspection routines, and surface at-risk and stalled opportunities before they reach the forecast call.

Partner and channel revenue operations

- Build and own the attribution model that distinguishes partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and partner-delivered revenue, with written definitions the finance organization will sign off on.

- Design and administer deal registration, including registration windows, approval logic, and expiry.

- Establish channel conflict and account overlap rules, and arbitrate disputes between direct and partner teams.

- Define revenue treatment and reporting for OEM and embedded arrangements, including revenue share and end-customer visibility.

- Report partner-sourced pipeline and bookings as a first-class metric alongside direct.

Territory, quota, and compensation

- Design territories and account coverage across direct and partner-facing seats.

- Build the capacity and quota model, including ramp assumptions, and support annual and mid-year planning.

- Design and administer variable compensation plans — accelerators, multipliers, partner-sourced credit, and split credit between an Account Executive and a Partner Manager on the same opportunity.

- Own commission calculation accuracy and the dispute process, partnering with Finance and People Operations.

GTM systems and data

- Own the go-to-market technology stack end to end — CRM (HubSpot), reporting and warehouse layer (Metabase), enrichment, and sales engagement tooling — including administration, integrations, and roadmap.

- Own the CRM data model: objects, properties, validation rules, required fields, permissions, and workflow automation.

- Establish data governance and hygiene standards — deduplication, account hierarchy, domain matching, and currency normalization.

- Own the pipeline from CRM into the warehouse so that reporting is a single query rather than four exports.

Deal desk and lead-to-cash

- Support pricing and packaging across a complex surface: seat-based, consumption, embedded and OEM, on-premise and air-gapped deployments, and multi-year enterprise agreements.

- Own the approval matrix, discount governance, and non-standard terms review.

- Reduce cycle time through the paper process — MSA redlines, DPA, security questionnaires, vendor onboarding, and purchase order issuance — and ensure it runs in parallel with technical evaluation rather than after it.

- Own the closed-won handoff data contract between Sales, ETS (pre-sales), and CVE (post-sales delivery), so that what was sold is what gets scoped.

Reporting and business insight

- Build reporting on win and loss rates by competitor and motion, ramp curves, cycle time with and without a partner in the deal, customer acquisition cost by channel, and expansion signal from live deployments.

- Deliver the go-to-market inputs for board and investor reporting in partnership with Finance.

- Retire reporting that does not change a decision.

What You Bring

- 4–8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy and Operations, or Deal Desk at a B2B enterprise software company, with experience supporting deals in the $250K–$1M+ range.

- Demonstrated build experience. You have stood up a process, model, or system where none existed and owned the outcome — not only administered one that was already running.

- Hands-on SQL. You query the warehouse, build the model, and audit your own numbers rather than filing a request and waiting. Strong spreadsheet modeling skills.

- CRM depth at administrator or architect level in HubSpot or Salesforce — data model, custom properties, workflow, permissions, and integrations.

- Partner or channel operations exposure. Deal registration, partner attribution, co-sell, marketplace transactions, or OEM and embedded revenue.

- Forecasting and compensation ownership. You have called a forecast, designed or materially rebuilt a comp plan, and defended a quota model.

- Commercial judgment. You can tell a sales leader their forecast is soft, and be right often enough that they keep asking you.

- Comfort operating without supporting infrastructure. There is no analyst, no BI function, and no operations vendor. You are the function for the first several quarters.

Nice to Have

- Experience at an AI-native, agentic, or automation and orchestration company (UiPath, Workato, Boomi, Celonis, or similar).

- Familiarity with GSI or hyperscaler ecosystem economics — practice P&Ls, rate cards, utilization, marketplace private offers, and co-sell programs.

- Consumption or hybrid pricing model experience.

- Domain exposure to Ema's target markets: BPO, HRIS and payroll technology, financial services, healthcare, or legal.

- Python or dbt in addition to SQL.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.
About the Role:

- As a Scaled Customer Success Manager focused on Ads, you will build and manage our digital and 1:Many Customer Success strategies specifically for customers leveraging Helium 10 Ads and Amazon Seller Central advertising solutions. In this role, you will manage a broad portfolio of customers, ensuring their success by providing exceptional support and guidance through a one-to-many approach via developed playbooks, content delivery, metrics, and the right level of automation. You will also carry and grow a small book of direct customer relationships, blending scaled digital engagement with strategic 1:1 partnership.

- To excel in this role, you will need complete command of the scaled customer success discipline, including program design, ads strategy, and cross-portfolio retention economics, with the judgment to set direction without relying on established playbooks. You will be at the forefront of designing innovative programs grounded in data insights about ad performance, campaign management, and ROI optimization. You’ll be ready to adapt and iterate for continuous improvement while helping sellers maximize their advertising investment on Amazon.

Responsibilities:

- Diagnose and solve diverse, undefined retention and expansion challenges across the ads portfolio, building new frameworks and precedent where none exist — including onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion strategy — rather than executing against a defined playbook.

- Become an expert on Helium 10 Ads and Amazon Seller Central advertising tools, including campaign management features, bid optimization, keyword targeting, and performance metrics. Utilize this knowledge to build scaled engagement strategies that drive advertising ROI and customer success.

- Manage a small book of direct business by maintaining strategic relationships with key accounts, conducting quarterly business reviews, identifying expansion opportunities within the ads product suite, and ensuring personalized support for high-value advertising customers.

- Familiarize yourself with the full suite of Helium 10 products with emphasis on ad-related tools and how they integrate with broader seller strategies. Help develop strategies that position advertising as a core growth lever for customer success.

- Become an expert on new Helium 10 ads products and enhancements, assisting in scaling awareness and adoption of new advertising features, campaign types, and optimization capabilities across your customer base.

- Utilize customer data to identify trends in ad performance, spend patterns, and campaign outcomes. Create targeted engagement campaigns for customers at different spots in their advertising journey, from campaign setup to advanced optimization and scaling.

- Exercise independent judgment on retention and expansion strategy across the full ads book, with decisions reviewed only at major milestones rather than in regular check-ins, given the direct impact on portfolio-wide revenue outcomes.

- Evaluate the self-serve experience for ads products and work to continually improve and evolve based on customer feedback and usage data. Partner with product teams to enhance the user experience for advertising features.

- Serve as the primary point of judgment for Support, Marketing, Product, and Brand Evangelists on ads-related customer strategy, shaping how those teams prioritize and execute educational resources and cross-functional initiatives..

- Iterate and test scaled program initiatives with emphasis on ads engagement, onboarding, and adoption campaigns. Track and report on results, customer feedback, and ROI improvements from your initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or customer retention, with a demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end programs independently.

- Direct experience with Amazon Seller Central Ads (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) or Helium 10 Ads platform. Hands-on knowledge of ad campaign management, budget allocation, bid strategies, and performance metrics.

- Deep understanding of Amazon advertising including campaign structures, bidding mechanics, keyword research and targeting, budget optimization, and ROI measurement. Ability to translate ad performance data into customer guidance.

remote.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

remote.title: Senior QA Engineer
remote.description:
Senior QA Engineer
We build and operate web products used daily by tens of thousands of people across 13 European countries. Treatwell Connect is our SaaS platform for salon and venue management, the tool thousands of salon owners rely on to run their business every day. Following the integration of Salonized, we now have a dedicated QA team and we're shaping it with intention. We've seen firsthand that embedded, proactive QA is what separates reliable releases from reactive firefighting.
We're looking for a senior QA engineer who is passionate about quality as a team discipline: someone who builds automation foundations, runs effective exploratory testing, and shifts how the people around them think about quality, not just how they personally test.
You will be responsible for:

- Build an automation framework from scratch, starting with API-level coverage of critical end-to-end happy path flows, the ones that must never break in a product shipping multiple times a day.

- Mentor QA team members into more technical and structured testing practice.

- Work with developers to build shared ownership of quality across engineering: encourage better unit testing, help them understand what good coverage looks like, and shift quality from a QA concern to a team habit.

- Run exploratory testing to surface edge cases and failure modes that specs don't anticipate

- Own feature aftercare: monitor releases in production, track stability, and drive continuous improvement from what you find.

- Identify gaps that developers and PMs miss and bring them to the table early, contributing to product decisions throughout the cycle, not just at the end.

- Track QA metrics that matter, bug detection rate, release confidence, post-release defect counts, and own the narrative around what they mean for the product.

Our QA context
Treatwell Connect is a SaaS platform with web and mobile surfaces. The product moves fast, and what breaks has a direct impact on the livelihoods of the beauty & wellness businesses that depend on it every day.
This is a greenfield role with a real mandate. There is no framework to inherit and no years of technical debt to unpick. The starting point is API coverage for the most critical flows, with UI automation following as confidence in the foundation grows.
You will work alongside a junior QA specialist and a mid-level QA analyst, reporting to the QA Team Lead, with engineering and product leadership actively invested in where this function goes.
About you:

- 5+ years of QA experience with hands-on automation work and structured manual and exploratory testing. You know when each approach is the right tool.

- You've built automation frameworks before, not just used them. You're fluent in at least one programming language and can make and defend tooling decisions without a spec telling you what to choose.

- You take satisfaction from shifting how a team thinks about testing, not just from shipping test suites. Quality culture is something you actively build, not something you leave to others.

- You influence without authority: you bring developers, designers and product closer to quality, and the habits you build outlast your direct involvement.

- You can articulate risks clearly to engineers, PMs, and non-technical stakeholders, and you're comfortable pushing back when something isn't ready to ship.

- You want to make the people around you better, and you're patient enough to do it consistently.

Nice to haves:

- Experience with observability and monitoring tools, particularly Datadog. Knowing how to read production signals and connect them to your testing strategy is a meaningful advantage.

- Experience working across web, mobile, and API surfaces in a single product. Treatwell Connect spans all three, and comfort with that complexity matters.

- Experience with SQL for data validation, debugging, and exploratory testing. Ability to write queries to trace data flows, verify backend logic and support root cause analysis across distributed systems is a plus

About Treatwell

Hi, we’re Treatwell. Nice to meet you.
We’re a team of 700 passionate and brilliantly talented people across Europe. We’re the industry’s smartest salon management software, all connected to Europe’s leading bookings platform, working with over 50,000 salon partners across 13 countries, processing over 8 million bookings every month. And….breathe.
But we’re not done yet. We’re on an exciting journey to digitally revolutionise the hair and beauty community.
If this excites you, we might just have the role for you.
We’ll treat you with:

- 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays

- Monthly €40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too

- Mental health support through our partnership with Plumm

- Growth funds for you to develop and grow with your team

Equal Ops
We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their condition.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

remote.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
remote.description:
Description
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters.
With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security.
We’re in a period of significant global growth. There’s an enormous amount to build, improve, and shape, and every hire has the opportunity to change the trajectory of the company.
About the Role
We’re looking for an exceptional Talent Acquisition Partner to join our growing global Talent team.
This is not a role for someone who needs a fixed set of requisitions, one function, or one geography to be successful. We’re looking for a recruiter who thrives in a fast-moving environment, can shift gears quickly, and is excited to go wherever the business needs them most.
One quarter, you may be building a GTM team in the US. The next, you could be supporting a critical leadership search, helping scale a new region, or partnering with another member of the global TA team on a completely different function.
You’re agile, low ego, highly resourceful, and comfortable with ambiguity. You know how to prioritize when everything feels important, and you don’t wait for a perfect process or playbook before taking action.
You know how to identify hard-to-find talent, engage passive candidates, build pipelines from scratch, and create momentum in competitive markets.
This is an opportunity for someone who wants broad exposure, meaningful ownership, and the ability to directly influence how a global company scales.
This is a remote U.S.-based role, with a preference for East Coast-based candidates.
What You’ll Do

- Own full-cycle recruiting across multiple functions, levels, and geographies.

- Flex across the business as hiring priorities evolve, quickly learning new markets, talent pools, and candidate profiles.

- Build high-quality pipelines from scratch through proactive sourcing, creative market mapping, referrals, networking, and modern AI-powered recruiting tools.

- Partner closely with hiring managers and leadership to deeply understand business needs, challenge assumptions, calibrate profiles, and drive hiring decisions.

- Operate with urgency and ownership, identifying bottlenecks and proactively moving searches forward rather than waiting for direction.

- Become a trusted talent advisor to the business, bringing market insights, candidate intelligence, and recommendations that help teams make better hiring decisions.

- Deliver a thoughtful, high-touch candidate experience from first interaction through close.

- Build and nurture long-term talent networks rather than approaching every search as a one-time transaction.

- Partner seamlessly with our global Talent team across the US, Israel, EMEA, and APJ, jumping in to support critical hiring needs wherever they emerge.

- Help us continuously improve how we recruit, from sourcing strategies and tooling to processes, reporting, and ways of working.

Requirements
What We’re Looking For
Must-have

- 5+ years of full-time, full-cycle recruiting experience, within fast-paced, high-growth technology companies.

- Exceptional sourcing skills and a track record of identifying and engaging high-quality passive talent.

- Ability to recruit across different functions, seniority levels, and/or geographies, and the curiosity to quickly learn a new talent market.

- Strong business judgment and the ability to understand what truly matters in a profile rather than simply matching candidates against a job description.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and changing direction quickly as business priorities evolve.

- A highly proactive mindset, you see what needs to happen and move without waiting to be asked.

- Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to partner with and influence senior leaders.

- Excellent organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple searches without sacrificing quality or candidate experience.

- Comfortable using modern recruiting technology, data, and AI-assisted sourcing tools to work smarter and scale your impact.

- A collaborative, low-ego approach. You care more about the team hitting its hiring goals than about whose requisition or candidate it is.

- A genuine sense of urgency and an ability to operate at startup speed.

Nice-to-have

- Experience recruiting internationally or supporting multiple regions.

- Experience across both GTM and technical hiring.

- Experience recruiting for cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or another highly competitive technology market.

About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join Joist AI and become a vital bridge between our product and go-to-market teams. In this role, you'll be embedded directly in the Product teams to help shape the strategy to drive business objectives. You’ll translate complex innovation into compelling narratives that champion the customer and focus on value to make a real impact on the business.
As a core member of our marketing team, you'll work hand-in-hand with Product Management to shape how we bring new features to market, ensure our teams are armed with the knowledge they need to succeed, and empower customers to adopt and grow with our product. You'll be the "eyes and ears" of GTM—making sure everyone knows what is being built, when, and why it matters–and the “megaphone” for the PM team, making sure that we maximize product investments for the business.
What You'll Do
Core Responsibilities
Product Expertise & Collaboration

Launch Excellence

Messaging & Enablement

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Collaborate with Product, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption of new and existing capabilities

- Work closely with Product and Product Design teams on UX iterations, bringing the customer and market perspective

- Maintain a Voice of Customer program to inform product and messaging strategy

- Help translate competitive intelligence and market insights back to Product teams

What Success Looks Like

- Launch Excellence: Predictable, scalable feature launches that consistently generate excitement among internal teams and customers while driving clear market differentiation

- Product Adoption: New features achieve strong adoption rates, demonstrating clear value delivery

- Customer Impact: Contributions to improved renewal rates and expansion opportunities through better product understanding and positioning

- Team Enablement: GTM teams are confident, well-informed product advocates who can articulate value clearly

Who You Are
Required Experience & Skills

- 5-7 years of Product Marketing experience in B2B SaaS or related go-to-market roles

- Technical Collaboration: Proven experience working directly with technical teams, especially those building AI agents or complex technical products

- Launch Track Record: Prior experience running cross-functional product launches from planning through execution

- Exceptional Communication: Strong storytelling and writing skills with the ability to craft product marketing copy that drives differentiation, establishes voice, and clearly articulates value

- Product Intuition: Natural ability to identify what drives value and to design a strategy and story that non-technical teams can understand and sell

- Deep Product Partnership: Ability to become "mind-melded" with Product Managers, understanding their goals, priorities, risks, and what makes them tick

- Collaboration Excellence: Skilled at framing product expertise into clear documentation and seamless hand-offs, particularly when enabling distributed teams

- Customer-Centric: Deep customer obsession and empathy that informs all messaging and positioning decisions

- Maker Mentality: Just as excited about creating the product as the Product Managers are—you find joy in the building process

- Organizational Excellence: Highly organized and detail-oriented with a commitment to documenting everything clearly and accessibly

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior work experience in martech, sales tech, enablement tech, or revenue operations companies

- Experience thriving in a small, early-stage startup environment where you've worn multiple hats and moved quickly; or experience in a larger SaaS environment where you owned PMM for a full product lifecycle end-to-end or a full strategic product area

Location & Work Requirements

- Based in India with the ability to collaborate in real-time with US-based teams (overlap with East Coast mornings, approximately 8am-12pm EST)

Why This Role Matters
You'll be joining at a formative stage where your work will directly shape how we bring products to market and how our teams understand and sell our value. The messaging foundations you build, the processes you establish, and the partnerships you forge will scale with us as we grow. If you're energized by the opportunity to be a maker, a bridge-builder, and a storyteller all at once—and you thrive in the dynamic environment of an early-stage startup—we'd love to hear from you.
This role offers the opportunity to make an outsized impact on our go-to-market success while working with cutting-edge technology and a passionate, collaborative team.

Who we are
Process Street is an AI software and compliance operations platform startup from San Francisco. We help our customers build, document, automate, and track recurring workflows. Our platform automates the work, enforces the standards, and proves compliance so our global customers can run their businesses. We service over 3k customers around the world, and are VC-backed by Accel, Salesforce, and Atlassian.
Our Mission
To make work fun, fast, and faultless for teams everywhere.
Our Culture
Process Street was founded on a strong belief in the work-life benefits of a healthy, collaborative, remote culture. We value flexibility because many of us are parents, travelers, or just creatives who aren't inspired by the construct of a mundane 9-to-5. Spread across 9 different time zones, we communicate asynchronously, work autonomously, and take real ownership of our work. We know human connections make strong teams, so we regularly catch up over virtual coffee chats, play games, share stories, and more to build strong relationships.
If you’re entrepreneurial and seek an environment that values impact, ownership, and flexibility we look forward to meeting you!
The Opportunity
We're looking for a driven Account Executive to join our sales team. This is a full-cycle closing role for an early-career seller - someone with 2+ years SaaS sales experience who’s ready to own deals end-to-end, sharpen their craft, and sell a product that’s differentiating how AI is reshaping work.
You'll own every inbound lead that lands in your pipeline - from first discovery through close - and you'll help build the playbook for how we convert them. Process Street is selling a new way of working, and this role is for someone who wants to help build a new way of selling it. You won't be handed a finished motion. You'll shape it.
You'll carry two products: Process Street, our compliance operations platform, and Dash, our browser and Slack-native AI coworker. Dash is brand new — you'll be among the first people selling it, which means you won't inherit a pitch so much as build one.
This seat is for someone who's entrepreneurial by default. You manage your own week, figure things out without waiting to be told, and are energized by ambiguity. This role is an opportunity for real ownership and a chance to compound your craft fast.
This position will be based in Eastern, Central, or Pacific time.
What You'll Do

- Own your full sales cycle - from first discovery call to close

- Run discovery calls to understand prospects' workflow pain points

- Present and demo Process Street to prospective clients

- Sell across our product line — the Process Street platform and Dash, our browser and Slack-native AI coworker — and confidently articulate how AI agents change the way teams operate

- Leverage AI tools to optimize your own sales workflows, boosting personal productivity and shortening the feedback loop

- Build and refine the inbound conversion playbook as you go - what works, what doesn't, what we should do more of

- Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline hygiene

- Collaborate with Customer Success on handoffs and early expansion opportunities

- Meet and exceed monthly activity metrics and quarterly pipeline targets

About You

- You have 2+ years experience selling AI tools, SaaS, or professional services with full-cycle closing exposure

- You're comfortable selling something new — you can hold a confident conversation about an emerging product in a category that's still being defined

- You are entrepreneurial and self-directed by nature

- You are comfortable in ambiguity and would rather figure it out and ship than wait for a playbook to arrive

- You are a 'Challenger' or Gap seller

- You have a proven track record of sales target attainment and exceeding goals

- You have a passion for start-ups and technology

- You adapt well, and you're a fast learner

- You are coachable, curious, and hungry to learn sales craft

- You communicate clearly and confidently

- You're enthusiastic about improving processes and systems

Our Benefits

-
Unlimited PTO policy – Most take 3-4 weeks, plus their major holidays, AND a company-wide week off in December.

-
Social time – Regular coffee chats, games, story-telling, house tours (only if you're comfortable), and more to build connections.

-
Generous health insurance for US employees and their families.

-
Equity for all full-time roles.

- A chance to shape how companies around the world run through the future of no-code automation.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. At Process Street, we believe in growth. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day.

LOCATION
Remote Work-at-HomePOSITION OVERVIEW
MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.
At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.
This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.
To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES
Key Responsibilities:

- Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues

- Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks

- Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade

- Explain and position the products and processes with customers

- Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team

- Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS
WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?
All positive, and driven applicants are encouraged to apply. The Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated and dedicated and should possess the below qualities:
Qualifications

- Must be 18 years of age or older

- High school diploma or equivalent

- Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills

- The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)

- Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)

- Basic understanding of Windows operating system

- Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality

- The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues

- An aptitude for conflict resolution, problem solving and negotiation

- Must be customer service oriented (empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious)

- Ability to multi-task, stay focused and self-manage

- Strong team orientation and customer focus

- The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where change and ambiguity prevalent

- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with your team and customers

ABOUT MCI (PARENT COMPANY)
MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services. In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa's Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI's subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines. remote.description:
Company Overview:
Designed for beauty, built for growth, PatientNow brings clinical-grade EMR with intuitive charting, smart AI automation, advanced photography, marketing, patient engagement, and seamless practice management into one elegant system. Everything works together naturally, helping clients create a smooth, intentional patient experience from consultation to checkout. Supported by a U.S.-based team that understands the pace and artistry of aesthetics, PatientNow provides the technology and partnership to scale with confidence.
Vision: Empowering practices and businesses to improve health and wellness worldwide by helping their clients look and feel their best.
Mission: PatientNow is elevating businesses focused on beauty, wellness and medical aesthetics with innovative, all-in-one software and consulting service solutions. People who partner with us stand out in the industry with strong market differentiation, while streamlining operations for long term success and sustainable growth.
Values:

-
Show up – being present and supportive: for each other through collaboration and respect, for our customers with exceptional service, and for the business with dedication to excellence and growth.

-
Own the outcome – By understanding the objective, exceeding expectations with pride, confirming resolution, communicating early and often, and continuously learning and improving

-
Be Authentic – By sharing thoughts and opinions, keeping promises, showing your true self, and engaging with respect

Position Summary:
PatientNow is a leading healthcare technology company focused on helping aesthetic and wellness practices grow through innovative software, AI-powered solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. Our mission is to empower practices to streamline operations, strengthen patient engagement, and drive sustainable business growth.
We are seeking a motivated, high-energy Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our growing sales organization. This role is critical to generating pipeline growth by engaging prospective customers, qualifying opportunities, and scheduling high-quality product demonstrations for our sales team. As the first point of contact for many prospects, the SDR plays an essential role in delivering a strong customer experience while representing the PatientNow brand with professionalism, urgency, and authenticity.
The ideal candidate is curious, coachable, resilient, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career in SaaS sales within a high-growth organization that values ownership, accountability, and continuous development.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

- Generate qualified sales opportunities through a combination of inbound lead follow-up and strategic outbound prospecting efforts.

- Engage prospective customers through phone, email, text, LinkedIn, and other personalized outreach methods to drive meaningful conversations.

- Schedule qualified product demonstrations for Account Executives.

- Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospect needs, business challenges, and operational goals within the aesthetics and wellness industry.

- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities by consistently executing outbound campaigns and follow-up activities.

- Develop a strong understanding of PatientNow’s products, value proposition, and industry landscape to effectively position solutions.

- Accurately document prospect interactions, activities, and pipeline updates within Salesforce and Outreach.io.

- Collaborate closely with marketing and sales leadership to improve lead conversion rates and overall sales effectiveness.

- Consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly activity and pipeline generation targets.

- Contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture through collaboration, feedback, and continuous improvement.

Competencies: To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following.

-
Adaptability - Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles. Measures self against standard of excellence. Recognizes and acts on opportunities. Sets and achieves challenging goals. Takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

-
Business Ethics – Inspires the trust of others. Keeps commitments. Treats people with respect. Upholds organizational values. Works with integrity and ethically.

-
Communications - Exhibits good listening and comprehension. Expresses ideas and thoughts in written form. Expresses ideas and thoughts verbally. Keeps others adequately informed. Selects and uses appropriate communication methods.

-
Continuous Learning - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses. Pursues training and development opportunities. Seeks feedback to improve performance. Shares expertise with others. Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills.

-
Problem Solving - Develops alternative solutions. Gathers and analyzes information skillfully. Identifies problems in a timely manner. Resolves problems in early stages. Works well in group problem solving situations.

-
Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities. Contributes to building a positive team spirit. Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views. Gives and welcomes feedback. Puts success of team above own interests.

Education/Experience:

- 1+ years of experience in sales development, business development, customer service, or a related customer-facing role preferred.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly.

- Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization skills.

- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.

- Coachable mindset with a willingness to learn modern sales methodologies and best practices.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively when engaging prospects.

- Comfortable handling high activity levels across calls, emails, and multi-channel outreach.

- Experience using Salesforce, Outreach.io, or similar CRM and sales engagement platforms preferred.

- SaaS, healthcare technology, or aesthetics industry experience preferred.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.

Why You’ll Thrive Here:
In this role, you’ll get to:

- Work at the intersection of innovation and impact, helping real-world practices grow and thrive in a rapidly expanding market;

- Collaborate with a talented, curious team that values experimentation, learning, and customer empathy;

- Be empowered to lead with autonomy while supported by strong leadership and product discipline; and

- Help modernize aesthetics software in an industry that’s ripe for transformation through innovative, AI-native technology.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit at a desk and work on a computer for prolonged periods.
The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

remote.title: Senior Clinical Data Manager
remote.description:
eClinical Solutions helps life sciences organizations around the world accelerate clinical development initiatives with expert data services and the elluminate Clinical Data Cloud – the foundation of digital trials. Together, the elluminate platform and digital data services give clients self-service access to all their data from one centralized location plus advanced analytics that help them make smarter, faster business decisions.
eClinical Solutions is committed to driving innovation in clinical trials through a better approach to data management and data analytics. We use the eClinical Solutions technology platform, elluminate, throughout the data management process to accelerate timelines for our clients and automate manual processes. We believe in a more agile approach to data management using our core technology elluminate - enabling our life sciences clients to proactively manage their clinical programs and make decisions.
You will make an impact:
As a Senior Clinical Data Manager (Sr. CDM) you will independently act as a study lead and are responsible for the oversight, maintenance, and management of clinical trial database(s) for assigned projects through the full data management process life cycle. You are viewed as the CDM expert and will serve as the primary liaison between eClinical personnel and Sponsor personnel. You will create and oversee the database design specifications, validation, maintenance/data cleaning, and closeout activities of project-specific clinical trial databases. As a Senior Clinical Data Manager, you may delegate tasks/responsibilities to multiple team members in multiple projects. You will provide ongoing project oversight to ensure proper planning and timely completion of high-quality Sponsor deliverables.
Accelerate your skills and career within a fast-growing company while impacting the future of healthcare.
Your day to day:

- Primary representative for eClinical Solutions and sponsor data management interaction

- Responsible for monitoring and ensuring adherence to study timelines and deliverables

- Accountable for the overall quality of data management activities and deliverables at the study or program level

- Ensure efficiency and consistency for data management tasks across programs

- Communicate with global study teams

- Participate in client study kickoff and closeout/lessons learned meetings

- Create materials for and present at Investigator Meetings

- Develop content and deliver Sponsor CRA and/or site training

- Delegate tasks, support and provide guidance to study data management team

- Oversee and/or develop data management documents including DMPs, eCRF Completion Guidelines, CRFs, and Help Text

- Oversee and/or Develop Internal System Testing (IST) plan for database/user roles/edit check specifications

- Participate in Internal System Testing (IST) on the database/user roles/edit check specifications

- Assist with preparation for implementation of a centralized data management platform for strategic data cleaning and reporting

- Utilization of centralized data management platform including graphical patient profiles and operational analytics

- Compile the sponsor UAT package

- Oversee and/or perform data review as documented in the Data Management Plan and Data Validation Specifications

- Oversee and/or perform manual review/QC checks as listed in the Data Validation Specifications exception listings and reporting tools

- Oversee and/or perform data review for overall consistency and accuracy

- Oversee and/or perform vendor data reconciliation (e.g., IVRS, laboratory data) with the clinical database

- Oversee and/or perform query processing/resolution

- Provide ongoing data management reports and metrics

- Oversee and/or develop specifications and collaborate with programming for programming and QC of manual listings, external data reconciliation, metrics and custom reports as needed throughout the study

- Define and develop specifications for database, programming and/or edit check changes as needed throughout the study

- Track data management issues and ensure follow up to resolution

- Identify data issues and/or data trends, communicate to the Clinical Data Management team and Sponsor, assist with development and implementation of action plan

- Maintain data management study documentation

- Perform steps pertaining to database freeze/lock and coordinate all related activities

- Ongoing evaluation of process and participate in process improvement

- Assist in the creation and review of SOPs, WIs, and training materials

- Mentor junior level staff and peers on all associated tasks within a study

- Participate in proposal defenses

- Perform other duties as requested by management

Take the first step towards your dream career. Here is what we are looking for in this role.
Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical/Biotechnology or higher in health-related field preferred

- 8+ years in Clinical Data Management experience preferred

- Knowledge of ICH/GCP guidelines, 21 CFR Part 11, clinical trial methodology

- Strong project management experience and project team leadership skills including work planning and work delegation

- Experience with EDC and performing data management activities

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Applications, specifically MS Project and MS Excel
