remote.title: Sr. Manager, Master Data Delivery
remote.description:
Senior Manager, Master Data Delivery
Towson, MD/ Remote based in the USA
Come build your career.
It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.
The Job:
As Senior Manager, Master Data Delivery, you are part of our Tools and Outdoor team with a focus on collection, cleansing, standardization, and maintenance of Product Master Data. You are responsible for gathering, cleaning, and loading existing data, maintaining data quality for Product Master Data, and serving as a key contact and trusted partner for the wider data community. You’ll get to:

- Own the delivery of high-quality Product Master Data as a business-critical data product by contributing to and executing in alignment with defined data quality standards.

- Lead the team’s day-to-day Product Master Data work, including data collection, cleansing, enrichment, maintenance, aggregation, validation, and issue resolution; meeting operational deadlines and service level agreements.

- Set team priorities supporting the Product Master Data Roadmap; break down and allocate work, monitor workload and delivery risks, and coach team members to support strong execution and performance.

- Serve as the team’s subject matter expert by analyzing complex data issues, identifying root causes, implementing solutions, and ensuring adherence to standards, business rules, and operating procedures.

- Devise solutions for data preparation based on limited information, adapt approach as issues are identified.

- Analyze and upgrade existing processes, norms, and approaches to Data Delivery, up to and including completely redesigning existing ways of working.

- Engage with business partners to report relevant, audience-specific updates up to leadership and out to project teams with conciseness, professionalism, and a focus on business outcomes.

- Partner with business stakeholders and IT to resolve data, process, and system issues, improve product information, and recommend practical enhancements.

- Lead small to mid-sized projects and maintain documentation, workflow guidance, and clear stakeholder communication to support continuous improvement and operational consistency.

- Utilize technical expertise in Generative AI, Data Modeling, SQL, Python, Alteryx or other data transformation or automation tools to enable the Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) process of datasets with up to 100k+ rows from multiple disparate data sources into Snowflake, Salsify, or other target systems.

- Build team capabilities in data democratization to easily answer ad hoc business questions about product data.

- Partner with Enterprise Data team to ensure Product Master Data is effectively leveraged for analytics, AI, and system integrations.

- Drive and support annual realignment of product hierarchies for business reporting.

The Person:
You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:

- Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Data Science, Marketing, or a similar field.

- 8+ years of experience in data analytics, business analysis, IT, business systems development, product management, or related field.

- A growth mindset, openness to feedback, excellent coaching skills, and a desire to supervise and develop a team.

- Ability to identify problems, break them down into deliverable tasks, and coach team members through delivery.

- Excellent business acumen, customer focus, and a desire to build a strong customer service organization that delivers valuable business outcomes.

- Motivated by consistently delivering high-quality work and being part of a high-performing team.

- Strong root-cause identification and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to translate business questions into data transformations and outputs.

- Drive to challenge existing processes with a process-improvement mindset, reimagining solutions leveraging a wide selection of AI tools.

- Demonstrated acumen in communicating complex information clearly to employees and stakeholders.

- Strong proficiency SQL, Python, JSON, Snowflake, Salsify or other PIM systems, automation tools, and Generative AI.

- Experience independently extracting, cleaning, transforming, validating and automating analysis of large complex datasets with 100k+ rows and multiple source systems.

- Experience improving accuracy and completeness through reusable workflows.

- This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship (H1B, OPT/CPT, TN etc)

The Details:
You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:

- Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.

- Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

And More:
We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:

- Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

- Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.

- Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.

- Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!
The Salary range for this position is $110,600.00 - $178,000.00

- This is the lowest to highest annual full-time salary range we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. The salary offered within the range may vary depending on multiple factors including job level, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience and in compliance with local wage requirements. Please note that salary is only one component of total rewards at Stanley Black & Decker. ​

- The salary range listed in this job posting reflects the range for the primary location specified. The salary range may vary for other locations.​

- The successful candidate may be eligible for annual merit increases. ​

- Medical, dental, life, vision, disability,401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being. ​

- Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tool sand other partner programs.

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.
Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.
Who We Are
We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.

And, of course, discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and products and well as discount programs for many other vendors and partners.

Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).

We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.

remote.description:
ABOUT HARDSUIT LABS
Founded in 2015 by industry veterans Andy Kipling and Russell Nelson, we are a Seattle based game developer and co-dev studio who were recently acquired by Keywords Studios in 2023. We believe that great games can only be built with great people and that great people thrive and do their best work in a healthy, collaborative, and positive work environment that values them. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace and building equity throughout the organization. At Hardsuit Labs, we are respectful and inclusive, we are problem solvers and efficiency champions, we are curious and collaborative, we are flexible and adaptable and most of all we are always looking to deliver excellence in the experiences and products that we craft!
As a studio we have built a reputation as an Unreal Engine focused development house, working in a multitude of genres and games, from support work and work for hire to original development. We have long-standing relationships with some of the largest gaming companies in the industry and are a certified developer across all major platforms.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Level Design | Mission Design | Gameplay Design
As part of Keywords Studios, we are gifted with the opportunity to partner with a variety of studios across the globe on all types of games and genres. If the idea of bringing your skills to bear upon an ever-changing landscape of games in collaboration with teams all over the world sounds exciting to you...well, continue reading my friend.

- Every partnership we engage with will bring a new set of specific needs, but the skills you will be flexing include:

- Collaborate with internal and external teams/disciplines to achieve end-user experience goals

- Conceptualization, documentation and ideation of levels, spaces, missions, and gameplay experiences

- Work with a variety of technologies, systems, and platforms

- Grey-boxing, pacing, layout beats, scripting, encounters, gameplay implementation

- Testing, debugging, level performance, streaming, and optimization

- Environmental storytelling, world building, tone, setting, art propping

- Manage and maintain work and documentation

- Actively contribute to the improvement of pipelines and the team around you

- Be a source of knowledge and mentorship to others

À PROPOS HARDSUIT LABS
Fondée en 2015 par les vétérans de l’industrie Andy Kipling et Russell Nelson, nous sommes un studio de développement de jeux et de codéveloppement basé à Seattle, récemment acquis par Keywords Studios en 2023. Nous croyons que les jeux exceptionnels ne peuvent être créés qu’avec d’excellentes personnes et que ces dernières peuvent s’épanouir et se dépasser dans un environnement de travail sain, accueillant et positif qui les valorise. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif, et en la promotion de l’équité à travers l’organisation. Chez Hardsuit Labs, nous sommes respectueux et inclusifs; nous sommes des solutionnistes de problèmes et des champions de l’efficacité; nous sommes curieux et collaboratifs; nous sommes flexibles et versatiles; et surtout, nous cherchons constamment à atteindre l’excellence dans les expériences et les produits que nous façonnons!
En tant que studio, nous avons bâti une réputation en tant que boîte de développement axée sur Unreal Engine, travaillant dans une multitude de genres et de jeux, en passant de l’assistance à la prestation de services, au développement de projets originaux. Nous entretenons des relations de longue date avec certaines des plus grandes compagnies de jeux vidéo du secteur et sommes un développeur certifié sur toutes les principales plateformes.
CE QUE VOUS FEREZ
Conception de niveaux | Conception de missions | Conception de mécaniques de jeu
Faisant partie de Keywords Studios, nous avons le privilège de collaborer avec une variété de studios à travers le monde sur tous les types de jeux et de genres. Si vous êtes stimulé(e) par l’idée de mettre vos compétences au profit d’un paysage vidéoludique en constante évolution, tout en collaborant avec des équipes aux quatre coins du monde... eh bien! continuez votre lecture.

- Chaque partenariat que nous entreprenons apporte son lot de besoins spécifiques, mais les compétences que vous serez appelé(e) à mettre à profit incluent :

- collaborer avec les équipes/disciplines internes et externes pour atteindre les objectifs liés à l’expérience utilisateur;

- conceptualisation, documentation et idéation des niveaux, des espaces, des missions et des expériences de jeu;

- travailler avec une variété de technologies, de systèmes et de plateformes;

- maquettage, rythme, moments clés du tracé, scriptage, combats et intégration des mécaniques de jeu;

- test, débogage, performance des niveaux, diffusion en continu et optimisation;

- narration environnementale, création d’univers, ton, décor, accessoires artistiques;

- gérer et maintenir le travail et la documentation;

- contribuer activement à l’amélioration des pipelines et de l’équipe qui vous entoure;

- être une source de connaissances et de mentorat pour les autres.

Requirements
WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 4+ years of experience working in professional production environments in game design, level design, and mission design

- Collaborator able to work across internal and external teams/disciplines as a team player

- Pro-active problem solver who will see problems through to resolution

- Excellent active communication skills and follow through

- Experience conceptualizing, developing, and shipping levels and missions end to end

- Good sense of 3D game space, pacing, flow, immersion, player motivation, and aesthetics

- Strong understanding and comfort with technical concepts, logic, and logic flow

- A strong understanding of Unreal Engine and its development environment

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with a range of game engines and tool sets

- Experience in other development roles - Production, Engineering, Art, QA

- Experience in developing networked games and cooperative experiences

- Capable with Maya / Max or 3D software equivalent

- Console development experience

- Un excellent esprit d’équipe et une capacité à collaborer avec différentes équipes et disciplines, tant à l’interne qu'à l’externe

EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.ABOUT THE COMPANY
Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.

In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.

Our company values guide our daily actions:

-
Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.

-
Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.

-
Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.

-
Driven: We deliver results in the right way.

-
Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.

STRATEGY
Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.
We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.
With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.

Recycling and Waste
We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

Environmental Solutions
Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.
Sustainability Innovation
Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.

Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

RECENT RECOGNITION

- CDP Discloser

- Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices

- Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies

- Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

- Great Place to Work

- Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

remote.title: ADHD Assessor for Children
remote.description:
Time commitment: Between 3-5 days per week (0.6-1 FTE) - our preference is for this to be an Employed position, but we will also consider Self-employed arrangements
Location: Remote
Reporting to: NeurodevelopmentalTeam Manager
About Paloma
In 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years for these assessments. Delayed assessments result in children being more likely to develop mental health conditions and fall behind in education. Furthermore, the much-needed pre/post-assessment support (outside of ADHD medications) is typically not funded by the NHS.
These long waits have built up due to increased recognition and understanding of neurodevelopmental conditions and a lack of investment and innovation within the NHS to meet the growing demand.
Mark and Darshak, with their 25 years of combined NHS experience, including building services that have treated over 1,000,000 patients in obesity & ophthalmology, founded Paloma to change this. Our mission is to make NHS autism and ADHD assessments and care accessible within 4 weeks of a GP referral, and, in turn, help every child achieve their potential.
As of May 2026, we have successfully reduced waits to 3 months by;

- Taking a product-first approach to redesign the care pathway to give families a more consumer-like experience of care

- Our in-house product, engineering and AI team building our own autism and ADHD specific electronic patient record and AI documentation tool to free clinicians from their significant documentation burden to re-focus on supporting families

- Investing in expanding the clinician workforce and upskilling them in new ways of working.

We are proud that Paloma is:

- Loved by families, with 4.9 out of 5 Trustpilot and Google ratings

- Care Quality Commission (CQC) registered and quality-focused

- Clinically-led, with a team of 130 people, including over 80 clinicians supporting families through their assessment journey. We are hiring 100+ more roles over the next 12 months.

- A community of passionate, mission-driven and innovative team members who challenge the status quo and test and learn from new ideas and approaches.

- Backed by leading healthcare investors Triple Point and Heal Capital

What’s next?

- Whilst we have reduced wait times, it is estimated that up to 500,000 children are still waiting for an NHS autism or ADHD assessment. We won’t rest until this comes down.

- We want to build new services to support families and children diagnosed with autism or ADHD who feel lost after their assessments when the NHS is no longer there for them.

The Opportunity
Are you an innovative clinician working in children’s ADHD assessments, excited to use software tools that enhance the prescriber and patient experience of care? This role is for you!
We are not a standard ADHD assessment service; we:

- Have built our own technology & AI tools to gather the required information from families, and support your documentation, so you can focus on children’s needs

- Have a Clinical Specialist, who is a senior clinician who works alongside you to ensure all of our ADHD assessments are multidisciplinary in line with NICE guidance.

- Offer an integrated prescribing service led by our Prescribing Team, ensuring families can get fast access to ADHD medications where required

This role will ensure we deliver a fantastic Children’s ADHD assessment service to families. If you have the appropriate skills, you can work across our Children’s Autism and Children's Dual Autism and ADHD Assessment pathways.
We commit to supporting your development and well-being, including:

- The Paloma Clinical Academy programme supports all clinicians at all stages of their careers to develop (e.g. to our Senior Assessor role) and cross-skill (e.g. in autism)

- Regular clinical supervision

- 1 protected day per month for assessor team training, Continuing Professional Development (CPD), and reflection.

- Quarterly development conversations with clear career progression pathways.

- Clear weekly timetables that support a role mix across appointments, administration, development, and team building.

About you
You are a registered nurse, speech and language therapist, occupational therapist, social worker or practitioner psychologist skilled in ADHD assessments.
You want to be part of an always-learning environment that embraces software and AI tools, and you will help us go further and faster with your positive and collaborative attitude.
Responsibilities:

- Deliver high-quality Children’s ADHD Neurodevelopmental Assessments

- Act in accordance with our Safeguarding Policy, including conducting a risk assessment where necessary.

- Keep up to date with the mandatory training, Continuing Professional Development and professional registration requirements of your professional background.

- Share ideas for continuing to improve Paloma’s software tools that ensure high-quality, safe, and efficient assessments

Qualifications and experience:
Required:

- By background, you are either a:

- NMC-registered Nurse

- HCPC Registered Speech and Language Therapist, Occupational Therapist, Arts Therapist, or Practitioner Psychologist (including Clinical Psychologists, Educational Psychologists and Counselling Psychologists)

- Social Work England Registered Social Worker

- You ideally have at least 1 year of experience in delivering Children’s ADHD assessments. At a minimum, we will consider 6 months of experience within a children’s ADHD assessment pathway. For Clinical Psychologists, we include pre-graduation experience within the 6 months of experience.

- Your children’s ADHD experience should include:

- Having a sound understanding of typical development through life stages, co-occurring conditions, and differentials.

- Have a good understanding of normal levels of attention, impulsivity, and hyperactivity in typically developing children and young people, and consider this within the cultural background of the individual being assessed.

- The ability to present findings which are client-centred and include strengths and needs.

- You can demonstrate good time management skills, including caseload management, and good parent and child communication skills

- Passing an enhanced DBS with barred list check, as you will be working with children

Desirable:

- Experience in conducting risk assessments within Neurodevelopmental assessments

- Safeguarding training to Level 3 and above

- Experience in Children’s Autism Assessments and Dual Assessments

Why join Paloma?
You will be part of a mission-driven organisation that’s transforming access to autism and ADHD care in England.
We offer:

- A strong and positive culture that prioritises staff well-being, transparency, and career development.

- £350 per completed assessment and family feedback.

Equality & Diversity
Paloma Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and throughout the application process. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic.
Accommodations
We’re glad to accommodate candidates who need adjustments throughout the hiring process. We encourage you to be open about the adjustments you need, so we can adapt our interview process accordingly.
Safer Recruitment & Pre-Employment Checks
Paloma Health ensures that supporting people to be safe is at the heart of our work and a key priority across all areas of the organisation. As part of our pre-employment checks, you will be asked to complete a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. Depending on your role within the business, this will be at either an Enhanced, Standard, or Basic level. We are committed to safer recruitment practices and expect all applicants to share our dedication to safeguarding. Our recruitment processes are designed to ensure we appoint individuals who align with our values and will help maintain a safe and supportive environment for everyone we work with.
Application process
Please apply via our website. We understand that applying for a new job requires significant effort, and we appreciate your time. We look forward to reviewing your application.
Join us and be part of our journey to revolutionise access to NHS autism and ADHD care!

Revisando los proyectos de los estudiantes y proporcionando retroalimentación detallada y constructiva dentro de las 24 horas posteriores a su entrega (esto requiere disponibilidad parcial y flexible durante los fines de semana).

The base salary range for this role is between $64,000 and $75,000/yr. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.
Why Talkspace?
Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?
Diversity
Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.
Equity
Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.
Inclusion
Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.
Belonging
Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

remote.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Neobank
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

remote.title: QA Lead / Quality Engineering Lead - AI-Native Quality Systems
remote.description:
About the Company
Zenara Health is a technology-driven mental health care company dedicated to transforming access and quality of mental wellness services. We combine AI-powered platforms with expert clinical care to deliver personalized, effective mental health solutions — connecting patients and providers through a seamless digital experience.
We're building multiple products across the clinical workflow — from AI-driven evaluations to care coordination — and moving fast. This is a startup, not a department.
About the Role
Read this carefully. If you're a manual tester looking for a comfortable QA role, stop here.
We're building AI-powered clinical software, and our quality function needs to operate at the same level of intelligence and autonomy as the products it tests. We don't need someone who writes test cases from Jira tickets. We need someone who designs quality systems.
Our QA function is ready to scale from strong foundations to systematic automation. You'll be the person who architects that scaling — building the test infrastructure, automation frameworks, and AI-augmented QA workflows that let quality grow without linear headcount.
The person we're looking for has probably managed a team of 3-8 QA testers at some point and had this thought: "Half this team could be replaced by good automation and smart test design." You're tired of babysitting manual testers. You want to build the machine instead of being the machine.
We're paying significantly above market for QA in India because we're not hiring a typical QA person. We're hiring someone who thinks about quality the way a systems architect thinks about infrastructure.
This Is Not a Traditional QA Role
This is a quality engineering role. You will:

- - Architect test automation from zero — Playwright-based E2E, API, and integration test suites across multiple healthcare products

- - Build AI-augmented QA — use Claude, Copilot, and AI tools to generate test cases, identify edge cases, and create self-healing test suites

- - Integrate QA into AI-assisted development workflows — shift-left testing that catches defects at the source, not the gate

- - Own the quality gate — if you don't trust it, it doesn't ship. You have release authority.

- - Design regression automation that maintains coverage as multiple products evolve simultaneously

- - Establish quality engineering culture — documentation, runbooks, test plans that aren't in anyone's head

What Your First 90 Days Look Like
Week 1-2: Audit all products. Map coverage gaps. Identify the highest regression risks. Pair with the current QA team to absorb domain knowledge and institutional context.
Month 1: Build the Playwright automation scaffold — CI-integrated, parallel execution, covering critical paths. Establish the QA runbook: how we test, when we test, what blocks a release.
Month 2-3: Attach AI-driven test generation to the framework. Build autonomous QA loops that feed back into development. Get to the point where coverage grows without linear human effort.
Ongoing: Own quality across everything. Context-switch between products in the same week. Pair with engineering on testability. Work directly with the founder and clinical team on healthcare-specific edge cases — billing, HIPAA compliance, clinical workflow validation.
What You'll Own (End-to-End)
1. Test Automation Architecture — Playwright (preferred) or Cypress E2E suites. API test automation (REST Assured, Postman-based, or custom). CI/CD pipeline integration. Parallel execution. Containerized test environments. Custom reporters.
2. Regression Automation — Systematic regression suites, versioned and updated every sprint. Not a spreadsheet. Not tribal knowledge. A living, automated safety net.
3. AI-Augmented Quality Engineering — Using AI tools to generate tests, create test data, identify edge cases from specs, and accelerate coverage. We're an AI-native company — our QA function must be AI-native too.
4. Healthcare Quality Assurance — HIPAA compliance testing, clinical workflow validation, medical billing edge cases, patient data privacy verification, audit trail testing.
5. Cross-Product Quality Ownership — Multiple healthcare SaaS products. One quality brain.
6. Release Certification — You define "release-ready." You block releases when quality is insufficient — with evidence. You raise risks early, clearly, and decisively.
Values & Vibe (Who You Are)

- You think of QA as a system design problem, not a checklist.

- You're excited by autonomous testing systems, AI-driven exploration, and replacing manual effort with intelligence. You design feedback loops, not just test suites.

- You're uncomfortable with manually writing hundreds of brittle test cases, QA that reacts instead of anticipates, and automation that breaks every sprint.

- You communicate like an engineer. Your bug reports tell a story: what happened, why it matters, how to reproduce, what the business impact is. Developers thank you for your bugs.

- You've blocked releases before and you'd do it again. Quality isn't negotiable.

- You don't wait to be asked. When you see a quality risk forming — in a spec, in a sprint, in a deployment — you surface it. Proactively. Loudly if needed.

- You use AI tools in your daily work already. If you haven't figured out how Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot accelerates quality engineering by now, you're behind.

What Success Looks Like

- - Playwright automation covers critical paths across all products

- - Regression suite runs in CI — zero manual regression passes for standard releases

- - No critical bugs reach production that were in scope of automated tests

- - QA runbook exists and the team follows it

- - You context-switch across multiple products in the same week without dropping quality

- - Release cadence has increased because QA is no longer a bottleneck

- - AI-assisted test generation is part of the daily workflow

- - Quality risks surface early — before they become production incidents

Schedule
Evening IST hours with 4–8 hours of overlap to US Pacific (9am–5pm PT). You propose the schedule that works for you — we care about overlap, not clock-in time. Flexibility for critical releases or incident response.
Requirements

- 4-8 years of experience in QA, SDET, or Quality Engineering, including a minimum of 2 years in roles such as QA Lead, QA Manager, SDET Lead, or Senior Quality Engineer, responsible for test strategy beyond mere execution.

- Test automation architecture—experience in designing and building test frameworks from the ground up rather than merely writing scripts within existing frameworks.

- Skilled in Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium—maintained advanced, production-level end-to-end test suites for over 2 years.

- API testing—proficient in automated REST API testing using tools such as REST Assured, Postman automation, or custom solutions. Capable of creating programmatic test suites that include authentication, error handling, and edge case coverage.

- JavaScript or TypeScript—ability to write, debug, and review test automation code competently.

- CI/CD integration—experienced in linking tests into deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar tools, with a background in shift-left testing.

- Git—familiarity with branching, pull requests, and conducting code reviews for test scripts.

- Test planning & strategy—capable of developing test plans based on product requirements, prioritizing them by business risk, and knowing what not to test.

- Docker/containerized test environments—ability to set up and maintain isolated test infrastructure.

- Strong proficiency in English communication—focus on asynchronous communication with clear written bug reports, test documentation, and release readiness notifications, while proactively identifying risks.

Strongly Preferred:

- Experience in managing or mentoring QA teams

- Familiarity with healthcare SaaS or compliance testing under HIPAA

- Expertise in performance testing using K6, JMeter, or Artillery

- SQL and database-level data integrity testing experience

- AI-assisted testing using LLMs for test generation, test data, and exploratory automation

- Familiarity with React or Next.js

- Experience with BDD/TDD methodologies

Nice to Have:

- Experience in security testing (understanding OWASP basics)

- Knowledge of FHIR/HL7 data validation

- Experience in accessibility testing (WCAG 2.1)

- Mobile/responsive web testing experience

- Experience in data pipeline or ETL testing

- Background in startup or high-growth environments

- Previous roles where QA influenced architectural decisions

Benefits

- Compensation ranging from ₹20–30 LPA depending on skills and experience

- Fully remote work opportunity available across India

- Equipment allowance provided

- Direct communication with the founder and technical team

Our network of hackers brings diverse expertise to uncover hidden weaknesses, adapting swiftly to evolving threats, even against zero-day exploits. We aim to create a new era of modern crowdsourced security that outpaces threat actors. Unleash the ingenuity of the hacker community with Bugcrowd, visit www.bugcrowd.com. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others.

Job Summary
At Bugcrowd, we handle application security assessment at an epic scale. As an Application Security Engineer (ASE) you will curate and manage the incoming security vulnerability submissions to some of the world’s biggest companies’ bug bounty programs. Here are just a few of the reasons why we are the best:

- A tenure at Bugcrowd often means you have worked on not only one company’s security program but potentially on hundreds.

- As an ASE at Bugcrowd you will be exposed to the Internet’s best security researchers and their cutting-edge security testing methodologies. Our ASEs quickly become technically fluent in obscure/complex XSS, SQLi, XXE, IDOR, SSTI, SSRF, and many other vulnerability types. There is no other organization that offers the learning opportunity that Bugcrowd does.

- You will be exposed to things outside of your comfort zone. We routinely run security programs for cars, IoT devices, embedded systems, mobile applications, and more!

- We have an awesome team and tons of perks. We’ve even been selected as one of “The 10 Coolest Security Startups Of 2016” by crn.com.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
An ASE is responsible for the ongoing triage and validation services of Bugcrowd managed programs. Under the direction of the Director of Technical Operations, you will take incoming submission data and curate it for validity, accuracy, and severity as well as communicate directly with Bugcrowd’s clients or researchers when additional information is required. ASEs also handle Incident Response – escalating and communicating about the highest severity bugs to clients. ASEs need to have strong knowledge of OWASP Top Ten type vulnerabilities. They also usually require a strong skill set in one scripting/development language, often to assist with the design or development of tooling for improving the triage/validation process. The ASE position is perfect for security professionals looking to take their skills to the next level.
Education, Experience, Skills, & Abilities

- Bachelor’s degree or previous security consulting experience

- Published and demonstrated passion for security assessment research

- High proficiency with Burp Suite (or any other interception proxy) and a working level of experience with other industry standard tools (nmap, sqlmap, anything included in Kali Linux)

- Ability to execute on individual projects but still contribute to the team

- Ability to complete tasks on time

- Strong organization, influencing, and communication skills

Remote - US
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.
Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud — managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.
But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking an: OEM & xPU Partnerships Lead!
About the Role
Backblaze recently closed a landmark, $300M+ TCV NeoCloud win — proof that the flywheel works. But it stalls without validated reference architectures embedded at the silicon and systems layer.
This role owns getting B2 designed-in at leading GPU/xPU silicon providers and the OEM/ODM hardware tier, so that every GPU cluster configured for AI inference or training has B2 as the default object storage layer. At the same time, you'll build out the storage tiering motion from flash-tier storage platforms to object storage on HDD with Backblaze. You are the person who makes Backblaze the storage answer before a customer ever talks to a sales rep.
This is a build role: some relationships and reference architectures already exist, and a meaningful part of the program is still being created as you run it. You'll need to be technically credible enough to lead a silicon-level architecture conversation, and commercially sharp enough to run the sales and strategic relationship side of the partnership.
What You'll Own
Designed-In at the Silicon Layer

- Establish and advance Backblaze B2 as a validated storage tier within leading GPU and AI data platform ecosystems — integrated, reference-architecture-certified.

- Drive "design-in" motions with major xPU and accelerator vendors to close competitive gaps in reference architecture positioning.

- Build relationships with emerging xPU vendors early enough to be designed into their validated stacks before competitive displacement occurs.

OEM & ODM Tier

- Own the joint go-to-market with leading OEM/ODM hardware manufacturers — turning their hardware deployments into B2-integrated solutions sold as complete infrastructure.

- Extend these relationships into the flash-tier storage space, building a clear tiering narrative from flash-tier storage platforms to object storage on HDD.

- Structure OEM agreements and co-sell motions that create pull-through B2 ARR from hardware-first deals. Build the commercial model — referral, resell, or embedded — for each OEM tier.

- Identify and close 2–3 new OEM/ODM partnerships per year that generate $10M+ in partner-influenced ARR within the first 6 months.

Turnkey Reference Architectures

- Deliver 5+ published, co-branded reference architectures by end of FY2026 — pairing GPU compute configurations with B2 as the validated storage layer.

- Work with the NeoCloud team and Developer Relations (Flamethrower) to produce technical validation content that serves both the partner and the end customer.

- Ensure reference architectures are submitted to and accepted by Tier-1 analyst firms.

Channel Sales & Commercial Execution

- Negotiate and structure commercial OEM terms — referral, resell, or embedded models — that convert designed-in positions into sourced, quota-bearing pipeline.

- Carry and deliver against an OEM-sourced pipeline and bookings target, running this program with the discipline of a channel sales motion, not just technical alliance management.

- Partner with Account Executives to convert OEM-designed ("powered by") positions into sourced pipeline and closed revenue.

Cross-Functional

- Feed product roadmap gaps — cold storage tier, archive — to Product & Engineering.

- Coordinate with Solutions Engineering so every OEM co-development produces a publishable, reusable reference asset.

Goal Accountability

- Contribute to the OEM-influenced bookings goal through designed-in positions and OEM-sourced pipeline.

- Deliver two flagship reference architectures — one with a leading silicon/GPU platform, one with a leading OEM/ODM hardware partner — as co-marketed technical validation.

- Convert designed-in positions at top target accounts into closed, OEM-sourced revenue.

The Right Fit
Required

- 10+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, or OEM/ODM business development — preferably in cloud infrastructure, storage, or AI systems.

- Existing relationships at major GPU/xPU silicon providers or leading server/storage OEMs — you know who owns the ecosystem programs and you can get a meeting.

- Track record of quota-carrying sales or channel sales performance, with experience negotiating commercial OEM terms such as referral, resell, or embedded agreements.

- Experience structuring and closing OEM agreements — referral, resell, embedded, or co-sell — with a track record of partner-influenced ARR.

- Technical fluency in AI/ML infrastructure: you understand GPU cluster architecture, storage tiering, accelerator software stacks, and how storage fits into training and inference workflows.

- Demonstrated ability to drive reference architecture co-development — from whiteboard to published, co-branded technical validation.

- Proficiency with Salesforce for partner pipeline tracking and forecasting.

Strongly Preferred

- Experience working inside or alongside a major GPU/xPU vendor's partner ecosystem program.

- Familiarity with S3-compatible object storage in AI data pipeline contexts (training data ingestion, checkpoint storage, inference output).

- Background at a cloud storage, IaaS, or AI infrastructure vendor — not a hyperscaler; we are explicitly the non-hyperscaler option.

- Existing relationships at emerging xPU vendors is a significant differentiator.

This Role Is Not For You If

- You need a mature partner program handed to you — this is a build role. The reference architecture playbook exists for one flagship deal; you are extending it across the OEM tier.

- You lead with slide decks instead of relationships — the first 90 days are relationship mapping and meeting cadences, not program documentation.

- You are not comfortable with technical conversations at the SE/architect level — OEM partners will disqualify you fast if you cannot hold the storage-in-AI-systems discussion.

Logistics

- Reports to: Head of Channel & Partnerships.

- Competitive compensation and 401K

- RSU grants for full-time employees

remote.title: Senior Director, Business Development Strategic Partner
Lead, Business Development & Licensing - Sureel AI
remote.description:
A little bit about our team

Sureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.

We are building the infrastructure that enables creators and rights holders to control how their work is used by AI, protect their rights, understand its use and value, and participate in new AI licensing models. We also provide AI companies and digital platforms with the systems they need to access rights, permissions, attribution, guardrails, reporting, and licensing infrastructure programmatically.

Acquired by Warner Music Group, Sureel operates as an independent, federated company, combining startup speed with the reach of a global music company.

Our commercial relationships sit at the heart of what we're building: with the AI companies and digital service providers (DSPs) who integrate our attribution infrastructure into their platforms, and with the rights holders whose works and interests that infrastructure protects. As Director, Business Development & Licensing, you'll own the business function across both sides of that equation, working closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners across the music, technology, and legal worlds. Your work will directly shape the commercial architecture of AI attribution at scale.

Your role

You will lead Sureel's business function, reporting to the CEO and two Co-Presidents. This is a senior, commercially focused role. When Sureel is negotiating with a service provider or a rights holder, you will own the business function of that negotiation.

You will also serve as Sureel's primary liaison with industry bodies such as DDEX and regulatory bodies such as WIPO where their activities relate to Sureel's business.

A key part of the role will be developing business models and modeling outcomes for charging clients, including DSPs and AI companies. A strong understanding of economics and music rights will be important.

Your objective is to structure agreements that increase adoption of Sureel's infrastructure, create repeatable commercial models, and establish frameworks that can scale across multiple rights holders, AI companies, and markets.

You will negotiate licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and the economic frameworks that determine how permissions through Sureel's technology translate into compensation. You will also oversee the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining what a commercially viable integration looks like and structuring the terms around it.

You'll work closely with Product and Client Relations. They will bring the product and partner perspectives, while you will lead the commercial structure and economics that support the business.

This is an opportunity to help define the business function of a company working in a new and evolving area, and to help shape how creators are compensated in the age of AI.

What you'll do:

- Own the business function for Sureel's negotiations, whether with AI companies, DSPs, other digital service providers, or rights holders, leading commercial strategy, deal structure, and terms from first conversation through signature.

- Negotiate the economics of platform integrations, including licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and frameworks that reflect the value of Sureel's technology alongside rights holders' catalog and distribution positions.

- Develop the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining commercial success and prioritizing opportunities based on enterprise value.

- Develop licensing and economic frameworks for an emerging category, using relevant AI and rights-technology transactions to inform agreements that can work across different partners and markets.

- Structure multi-stakeholder commercial arrangements among rights holders and industry participants, positioning Sureel's infrastructure as the mechanism for executing those agreements.

- Partner with Client Relations on rights-holder relationships, owning the commercial terms and deal economics while they lead the broader relationship and delivery.

- Work closely with Warner Music Group counterparts on commercial terms, licensing structures, and strategic priorities.

- Provide market intelligence on emerging technologies, competitive developments, licensing innovation, and deal dynamics across the AI and DSP landscape.

- Represent Sureel with industry and standards organizations, including DDEX, WIPO, and other initiatives shaping AI rights and licensing.

- Develop pricing and packaging for Sureel's platform, including enterprise fees, API and usage-based pricing, transaction fees, revenue share, licensing administration, analytics, and hybrid structures.

- Create repeatable commercial and licensing frameworks that can scale across partners rather than requiring every agreement to be built from scratch.

- Help structure how Sureel infrastructure is used in commercial agreements, including rights, permissions, guardrails, attribution, reporting, and economic obligations between rights holders and AI companies.

- Handle confidential and proprietary information, including deal terms, partner economics, and negotiations with discretion and integrity.

- Help shape emerging industry standards and licensing frameworks so they can be implemented programmatically and work with Sureel's architecture.

Who you are:

- You have deep experience structuring and negotiating commercial agreements in music, media, or technology, including licensing deals, platform integrations, revenue-share structures, or rights-technology transactions.

- You've owned the business side of negotiations with platforms, DSPs, technology companies, or rights holders and carried complex deals from term sheet through signature.

- You understand the economics of the music industry: how rights generate revenue, how licensing frameworks are built, and how value flows between platforms, intermediaries, and rights holders.

- You're comfortable with data and financial detail. You can model a revenue structure, pressure-test assumptions, and explain the business logic clearly to technical teams and senior counterparties.

- You can structure complex deals and find approaches that work for the different parties involved.

- You build trust quickly and can represent leadership in high-stakes negotiations, make judgment calls on terms, and know when to escalate.

- You communicate clearly in writing and in person and can stay calm in a fast-moving environment.

- You understand how pricing, licensing structures, technical standards, and ecosystem incentives can support platform adoption and durable commercial outcomes.

- You are interested in the music industry and enjoy working in a small, collaborative, startup-paced team.

We'd love it if you also had:

- Direct experience negotiating with AI companies, DSPs, or other digital service providers on licensing, integration, or commercial partnership terms.

- Experience working with artists, labels, publishers, or CMOs/PROs on the commercial side, or serving as a senior deal advisor to them.

- Experience across deal structuring and licensing, business development, commercial strategy, or partnerships.

- Involvement in industry licensing, standards, or policy initiatives shaping how AI and rights interact.

- Experience working directly with C-level executives on commercial strategy, negotiation preparation, and translating senior conversations into agreements.

- Experience developing commercial models for infrastructure, APIs, marketplaces, payments, rights technology, or other platforms where value is monetized across multiple layers of a transaction.

- Curiosity about the music and entertainment landscape and AI's impact on creators.

Sureel AI is an independent, federated company within Warner Music Group. We're committed to building a diverse team and to fair recognition for creators everywhere.

remote.description:
The Initial Closing Disclosure (ICD) Analyst plays a critical role in the mortgage loan process by preparing, reviewing, and verifying the accuracy of the Initial Closing Disclosures (ICD). This position ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies, ensuring borrowers receive accurate and timely disclosures of loan terms and costs. The ICD Analyst collaborates with internal teams such as loan processors, underwriters, and closing officers to resolve discrepancies and ensure smooth and timely loan closings.
Key Responsibilities

Preparation of Initial Closing Disclosures:

- Generate and review Initial Closing Disclosure (ICD) documents for accuracy and completeness in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

- Ensure that the ICD is sent to the borrower at least three business days prior to closing, adhering to TRID (TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure) regulations.

Data Review and Verification:

- Review loan terms, fees, taxes, and other financial data to ensure they are accurately reflected in the ICD.

- Cross-check all loan documentation to ensure alignment with underwriting conditions and customer information.

- Identify and resolve any discrepancies in loan documentation prior to issuing the ICD.

Compliance and Regulatory Adherence:

- Stay up to date with federal and state mortgage regulations (including TRID) to ensure all disclosures meet legal standards.

- Maintain detailed records of all issued ICDs and monitor timelines to ensure compliance with the three-day disclosure rule.

Collaboration with Internal Teams:

- Work closely with loan officers, underwriters, processors, and closing coordinators to ensure all necessary data is collected and accurately reflected in the ICD.

- Communicate with the loan origination team to address any borrower questions or concerns regarding the closing disclosure.

Quality Assurance and Reporting:

- Conduct quality control checks on all ICDs before submission to ensure there are no errors or omissions.

- Report any issues or trends regarding ICD errors or compliance risks to management for further review.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).

- Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and solve problems quickly.

- Familiarity with loan documentation, including closing disclosures, loan estimates, and underwriting terms.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage workflow efficiently.

Benefits

- HMO with free dependent

- Performance based Incentives

- Quarterly Company Events

- In-depth training for career growth

remote.title: Sr. Product Manager, Network Services
remote.description:
VGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization. Large banks, aspiring fintechs, and growing merchants embed our universal token vault into their technology stack to manage the complexities of payment data tokenization across processors and networks, open banking, card issuance, omnichannel loyalty, PCI compliance, payment orchestration, and more. We empower our clients and partners by tokenizing sensitive payment data, limiting compliance scope, and consolidating payments to unlock revenue and business opportunities.

VGS provides processor-agnostic tokenization solutions via secure universal token vaults, iframes, mobile SDKs, tokenization proxies, APIs, and data orchestration tooling to support payment acceptance, card issuance, PII and bank account tokenization, and other payments value-added services. Some of the use cases we enable include multi-processor Network Tokenization, Account Updater, payment orchestration, secure settlement file processing, 3DS, and Risk provider connectivity.

As Product Manager for Network Services, you will own our relationships with card networks and payment gateways. You will define new network capabilities, lead their integration into the VGS Credential Management Platform (CMP), and deliver them to customers through tokenization, account updater, wallets, Local Payment Methods and card-on-file services. This role requires end-to-end execution—from initial partner conversations to scaling capabilities across our entire customer base.

What you will be doing at VGS (Responsibilities)...

- Product Strategy & Network Relations: Define the technical roadmap for network integrations, partnering directly with major card networks and payment gateways to scope upcoming capabilities.

- Normalize Network Differences: Abstract network-specific quirks (e.g., real-time vs. batch updates, differing subscription models, unique event types) into a unified, predictable API experience for VGS customers regardless of the underlying network.

- API Design & Feature Specs: Define API interfaces, functional requirements, and webhook event models built for long-term durability, ensuring schema updates won't break existing customer integrations.

- Cross-Functional Execution: Partner directly with Engineering, Security, UX, and Legal to validate designs, translate complex network updates into execution plans, and guide features from early partner discussions through beta to general availability.

- Launch & Customer Enablement: Own customer onboarding, integration support, and implementation guides, partnering with engineering to deliver clear API documentation and developer tools.

- Data & Performance: Define and track platform KPIs: network integration cycle time, feature adoption rate across customers, API/webhook reliability (uptime, latency, error rate), and network SLA compliance, and write custom SQL queries to analyze usage patterns and inform product decisions.

What we are looking for from you (Requirements)...

- Experience: 7+ years in product management or digital product development with a strong focus on launching B2B platforms, developer APIs, or payments infrastructure.

- Technical Grounding: Ability to read network specifications, debate trade-offs with engineers, and design APIs/webhooks that scale smoothly.

- Data Proficiency: Hands-on with data and comfortable writing SQL queries to pull usage metrics, track adoption, and defend product decisions.

- Operational Leadership: A detail-oriented problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, leading execution even when scope or priorities are still evolving.

Nice to Have:

- Experience with authentication services, EMV, 3DS specifications.

- Background building cloud-native applications or high-throughput global platforms.

• Flexible work hours and flexible PTO

• Competitive health benefits

• VGS stock options

• 401k plan, with employer matching 4% and immediate vesting (available only for US employees)

• Life & disability insurance

• Pre-tax flexible spending accounts, dependent and healthcare FSA (available only for US employees)

This role also owns the build-out of AcuityMD's Value Consulting function — sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, and Product — to ensure every commercial conversation is grounded in a clear, defensible articulation of AcuityMD's ROI. Together, these functions build and improve the processes, tools, and frameworks that enable the Commercial and Revenue teams to scale efficiently while delivering an outstanding customer experience.
Responsibilities

- Build the value consulting capability from the ground up: value methodology, discovery frameworks, ROI and TCO models, executive business case templates, and self-serve tooling the field can run without you

- Engage on strategic deals, renewals, and EBRs where a deeper, data-backed value case is needed

- Consolidate and sharpen existing value tools (ROI calculators, value slide templates, the in-product Care Journeys ROI Calculator) into a single, scalable value framework

- Build a benchmark library and value proof pack tying ROI outputs to validated customer success stories

- Design and run enablement sessions to train AEs and CSMs on value-selling tools and methodology

Your Profile

- 5+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, private equity, corporate strategy or a similar analytical role

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, draw insights, and translate them into actionable strategies

- Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels

- Experience building value/ROI frameworks, business cases, or economic value assessments for enterprise buyers

- Excellent communication and presentation skills — able to articulate complex topics clearly and effectively, including to CFOs and economic buyers

- Entrepreneurial and self-directed — able to navigate ambiguity, take initiative, and build structure where none exists

- A track record of operating independently in a fast-paced, results-driven environment

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field

Nice to Haves

- Experience in a Go-To-Market Strategy, Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations, or Value/Solutions Engineering role

- Familiarity with SaaS business models and MedTech industry dynamics

- You have stood up a value consulting, value engineering, or business value function before

- MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative field

- Passion for healthcare innovation and improving patient access to medical technologies

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base Salary Range: $175,000-$215,000
You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position
We Offer:

-
Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).

-
Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.

-
Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.

-
Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.

-
Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.

-
Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.

-
Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.

-
Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:
The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.
We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.
The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.
We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.
In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.
