remote.title: Researcher, Locomanipulation
remote.description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
You’ll work on the perception and learning stack that lets Asimov do things in the real world.

What You'll Do

- Design and train perception and representation models for whole body control

- Contribute to our world model research (SSL, predictive representations)

- Evaluate models against actual robot performance

- Work across the locomotion, autonomy, and hardware teams to ship behaviors that hold up outside the lab

- Open-source what we can and help set the bar for how whole-body control is done in the open

- Track and apply ideas from the broader AI literature pool

What We Look For

- Computer vision foundations: solid grounding in computer vision, working with real (not just curated) visual data

- Representation learning: hands-on experience with self-supervised methods, e.g. contrastive learning, masked prediction, JEPA-style objectives, embeddings/encoders

- ML/LLM breadth: comfortable reading and applying ideas across LLMs and general ML, not siloed to robotics

- Has trained models before: real end-to-end experience, e.g. data pipelines, training runs, debugging, evaluation, not just papers

- Sim-to-real experience: has taken a model from simulation onto a physical robot and dealt with the gap firsthand.

- Fluency in Python or C++, and comfort living in a simulator (IsaacSim, MuJoCo, or similar)

Nice to Have

- Published or open-source work in locomanipulation, whole-body control, or sim-to-real transfer

- Experience with contact-rich or bimanual manipulation

- Familiarity with humanoid platforms and real-time control on embedded hardware

- Background in imitation learning, teleoperation, or large-scale robot data collection

Why Join Menlo
You will be part of a tight-knit team teaching a humanoid to do real physical work, not demos. You will have genuine ownership of the full stack of technologies that decides what Asimov can do in the world, and you will see your work run on real robots in weeks, not years. If you want locomanipulation to mean something beyond a benchmark, this is the place to build it.
A Note on AI
You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
Equal Opportunity and Accommodations
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

remote.description:
Business Development Representative
Turn strong, growing inbound demand into qualified pipeline — supported by targeted ABX outbound and the industry’s biggest events
There are a lot of security companies out there, but no one is doing what Nucleus is doing: giving security teams the ability to run the most effective vulnerability and exposure management program possible. Some of the largest enterprises and government agencies in the world run on our platform, and we’re growing fast. Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.
Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well — respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.
Why this role exists
This is a new seat created by growth — driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. You’ll also be joining a leader whose real strength is developing top-performing BDRs: structured onboarding, weekly coaching and mock calls, and a documented track record of promoting reps into account executive, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.
What you’ll do
Own inbound — this is the priority. Be the first, fast, credible response to the people raising their hands: demo requests, content and webinar leads, event follow-up, and trial interest. Qualify with real discovery — need, timing, environment, decision process — and convert genuine interest into meetings that stick. Speed and judgment both matter: our buyers are busy, and the first good conversation usually wins.
Support the ABX program with targeted outbound. Outbound here is deliberate, not a numbers game. You’ll work a defined set of high-value named accounts alongside Marketing and your AEs — using intent and account signals to time your outreach — so outbound reinforces the accounts we’ve collectively decided matter most.
Personalize everything, and use AI to do it well. Our buyers are technical and busy. You’ll write outreach and follow-up that sounds like a person who understands their world — and you’ll use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) every day to research faster and sharpen your messaging.
Run a clean process. Manage inbound routing, accounts, and follow-up in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and Gong — and partner closely with your AEs and Marketing to act on campaign signals fast.
Represent Nucleus at our biggest events. A few times a year, our BDRs are the front line at RSAC, Black Hat, the Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit, and other key events — proactively engaging people in and around our booth, qualifying on the spot, and booking high-quality meetings. Expect roughly 3–4 events a year, plus our annual company and sales kickoff.
Your first 90 days
We’ve run this playbook before, and we don’t leave ramp to chance:
First 30 days
By 60 days
By 90 days
Structured onboarding and product training. Learn our market, ICP, and the vulnerability and exposure management problems our buyers face. Shadow calls, run mock calls, and start handling live inbound with close coaching.
Owning inbound response and qualification for your patch, with outbound sequences live into your named ABX accounts. Weekly 1:1s and email-writing sessions to sharpen your craft.
Fully ramped and holding your own number — converting inbound into qualified meetings, supporting ABX outbound, and confident enough in the material to represent Nucleus in front of a security buyer.
What we’re looking for

- 2–4+ years in sales or business development — BDR/SDR, inside sales, or another customer-facing role. Experience handling real inbound volume with a high qualification bar is especially relevant.

- Sharp qualification instincts. You can tell a genuine opportunity from a tire-kicker quickly, and you protect your AEs’ calendars without dropping real interest on the floor.

- Outbound capability too. You can build and run a thoughtful, targeted sequence into a named account when it matters — not just work a queue.

- Cybersecurity or technical SaaS experience preferred. Holding a credible conversation with a security buyer is a meaningful advantage.

- Strong communication. Concise and credible in writing and on the phone with senior technical people.

- Comfortable in person. You genuinely enjoy meeting people face to face and can open a conversation with a stranger on a busy expo floor.

- AI-fluent. Using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude in your daily workflow is a requirement, not a bonus.

- Tech-savvy. Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Slack, Teams, and Zoom.

- Curious, resilient, and coachable. You want to be coached — this is a team where you’ll get real feedback and be expected to use it.

- Nice to have: selling into U.S. Federal, Defense, or State & Local government; an established cybersecurity network; a bachelor’s or associate degree.

If you have less experience than the range above but can show real results and genuine curiosity about security, we’d still like to hear from you. We hire for trajectory and coachability, not just years on a resume.
Why you should be excited

- The mission. We automate enterprise vulnerability and exposure management so security teams can prioritize and mitigate risk, at scale — working toward a world where remediation outpaces exploitation.

- Warm demand to work with. You’re not starting from zero. Inbound interest is real and growing, and your job is to make the most of it.

- The career path. A launchpad, run by a leader who builds and promotes top performers into AE, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.

- Nucleus believes “work is people”, and when our people succeed, our company succeeds.

As the VP of Customer Success for Coupa’s Invoice to Pay solutions, you will lead the strategic vision for customer adoption, transactional volume growth, and long-term partnership health for a key growth engine of the Coupa platform. You are the executive architect responsible for ensuring that our global customers move beyond implementation to achieve full-scale automation across our payments, banking, invoicing, and treasury solutions, unlocking economic value for both customers and Coupa.
What You'll Do:

- Lead the Customer Success teams focused on adoption of Invoice to Pay solutions, ensuring customers meet their success metrics across our payments, banking, invoicing, and treasury solutions.

- Own the Customer Success strategies that accelerate product adoption. Accountable for ensuring customers maximize their usage and transactional volume on the platform and Coupa maximizes transaction revenue and grows license revenue from our Invoice to Pay solutions.

- Act as an executive liaison to ensure our operational processes for our partner ecosystem are delivering for our customers, ensuring rapid onboarding and delivering for growth.

- Maintain a comprehensive view of the transaction revenue opportunity across the customer portfolio, using data-driven analysis to prioritize team focus and identify the highest-impact paths to growth.

- Act as a strategic advisor to CFOs, Treasurers, and CPOs at Fortune 500 companies, guiding them through the complexities of digital payment transformation, invoicing, and treasury management.

- Leverage AI and customer data insights to proactively identify revenue growth opportunities.

- Utilize AI-powered analytics to anticipate customer churn and prescribe proactive interventions to ensure continuous ROI and retention.

- Drive global customer adoption of Coupa’s AI-led innovations across our Invoice to Pay suite to demonstrate market leadership and “best-in-class” digital transformation.

- Serve as a market-credible executive sponsor for sales opportunities, key customer engagements, and escalations using deep domain expertise to validate our solutions’ value proposition.

- Forge a seamless link between Sales, Product, Partner, Delivery, and Support teams. You will ensure that customer feedback directly informs product roadmaps, keeping our innovation aligned with market demand.

- Mentor and scale a high-performing Customer Success organization. You will define the KPIs and operational rigor required to manage a global team.

- Support strategic relationships across the Invoice to Pay partner ecosystem, including banking partners, payment networks, and key payment/invoicing service partners, to accelerate customer onboarding, adoption, and transaction revenue.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

- 10+ years of Customer Success, Sales or Professional Services leadership in Fintech, Global Payments, Invoicing, or Treasury in an Enterprise SaaS context. Proven track record of leading post-sales customer facing organizations.

- Deep, specialized knowledge of the global payments and invoicing landscape, including ACH, Virtual Cards, Cross-Border FX Payments, Supplier Networks, e-Invoicing, and Working Capital solutions (Early Pay Discount programs and Supply Chain Financing programs).

- Experience navigating the organizational hurdles of moving from legacy ERP-initiated payments and invoicing to modern cloud-based systems.

- Demonstrated competency in utilizing AI to streamline executive reporting, automate complex cross-functional workflows, and accelerate the creation of strategic deliverables.

- Thorough understanding of the SaaS business model, with a focus on driving net retention, ARR, and transactional expansion.

- Familiarity with the Coupa ecosystem or competitive enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, Ariba, and others).

- Exceptional ability to translate technical complexities into clear, ROI-driven business outcomes.

- Ability to travel globally up to 25% of the time

remote.description:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role
We’re looking for an experienced Lead Talent Acquisition Partner to help scale Tailscale’s global Go-to-Market organization. This is a lead-level individual contributor role for a recruiter with deep GTM expertise, strong business acumen, and the ability to serve as a trusted advisor while delivering against complex and high-priority hiring needs.
You’ll partner closely with Talent Acquisition and GTM leadership to develop and execute recruiting strategies across Sales and other commercial functions. You’ll bring deep knowledge of GTM talent, market intelligence, and recruiting data to help shape hiring strategies, identify risks, and improve outcomes.
We’re looking for someone who understands how high-growth SaaS organizations build and evolve their commercial teams, particularly Sales, and can effectively advise and influence leaders while maintaining a high hiring bar and strong recruiting process.
Key Responsibilities
Lead GTM Recruiting Execution

- Own full-cycle recruiting for complex and high-priority GTM searches, with a strong emphasis on Sales, from intake through offer.

- Develop recruiting strategies aligned with business priorities, role requirements, talent availability, and market conditions.

- Build strong pipelines across competitive markets and geographies, partnering with Sourcers on targeted talent strategies.

- Manage multiple searches while delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience.

Serve as a GTM Talent SME

- Bring deep expertise in GTM organizations, talent markets, and commercial hiring to recruiting and talent discussions.

- Understand how different sales motions—including SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise, Strategic, Channel, and international—shape talent profiles and recruiting strategies.

- Provide actionable market intelligence, talent mapping, competitive insights, and candidate feedback to inform hiring decisions.

- Advise leaders on talent availability, hiring challenges, and tradeoffs based on market conditions and business needs.

Partner with GTM Leadership

- Build trusted relationships with GTM leaders and serve as a consultative advisor on hiring strategy, talent, and recruiting execution.

- Partner with leaders to define candidate profiles, establish effective interview processes, and translate hiring priorities into actionable recruiting plans.

- Contribute recruiting expertise to workforce and headcount planning in partnership with Talent Acquisition, Revenue Operations, Finance, and GTM leadership.

- Challenge assumptions and create accountability around hiring expectations, timely decision-making, interview quality, and candidate experience.

Use Data & Market Intelligence

- Bring expertise and comfort with recruiting data and market insights to identify pipeline trends, hiring risks, and opportunities to improve outcomes.

- Provide leaders with actionable insights on pipeline health, conversion, talent availability, competitive activity, and search progress.

- Recommend adjustments to profiles, locations, timelines, and recruiting strategies based on data and changing market conditions.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership and Operations to ensure recruiting data is accurate, actionable, and effectively used.

Partner Across Talent Acquisition

- Collaborate with Talent Acquisition leadership, Operations, Sourcers, and fellow Partners to execute GTM recruiting priorities and support evolving business needs.

- Share GTM market expertise, recruiting insights, and best practices across the Talent Acquisition team.

- Contribute to recruiting initiatives, tools, and process improvements that strengthen hiring effectiveness and scalability.

What We Are Looking For

- 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant GTM recruiting experience within high-growth SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, or technology companies.

- Deep experience recruiting Sales talent across levels, segments, and geographies, with broader exposure to functions such as Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, or Revenue Operations.

- Strong understanding of SaaS sales organizations and GTM motions, including SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise, Strategic, Channel, and international sales.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

remote.title: R - Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead
remote.description:
BRAZIL RESIDENTS ONLY.
Company Overview
At FoodChain ID, we are driven by our vision to make it easier to keep the food supply chain safe and transparent. As a global leader in food safety, compliance, and product innovation solutions, we support more than 30,000 companies across more than 100 countries with a comprehensive software platform that enables leading food manufacturers and retailers to manage compliance, risk, and efficiently access new markets and consumers as the New Food Economy continues to evolve.
Job Title: Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead
Reports To: Director, Product and Delivery Enablement
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full Time
Job Overview
The Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead works as part of the Product Management team supporting FoodChain ID's Enterprise Solutions portfolio, which includes Formulation for PLM, Compliance Analysis, and Recipes & Specifications. The role covers the two stretches of work that sit on either side of development: getting work ready to build, and getting built work ready to deliver.
On the front end, the role develops the epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that carry an idea into a development-ready state, working day to day with the Product Management team, which sets feature scope and prioritization. Doing this well means understanding the product domain deeply enough to write requirements engineering can build from without a second round of clarification.
On the back end, the role makes sure that what development delivers is ready for customers: owning release communication, producing and maintaining product documentation, and building the training and services enablement assets that Services, Support, and Sales need to put new functionality to work. Consistent use of AI tooling is expected, including building and refining agent skills that reduce the manual effort of keeping documentation and release content current as features ship.
Key Responsibilities
Requirements Definition and Development Readiness

- Develop epics, features, and user stories from product direction, customer input, and conversations with subject matter experts (SMEs), working under the direction of the Product Management team, which owns feature scope and prioritization.

- Author clear, testable acceptance criteria, and confirm shared understanding with engineering and QA before work is committed to a sprint.

- Conduct the upfront research and analysis that makes story-writing and refinement sessions productive, so that decisions rest on evidence.

- Work closely with SMEs, Services, and business partners to understand the product needs behind a request, and translate them into requirements a development team can build from.

- Review or create process and system flow maps documenting the business domain, including the business rules and logic needed to incorporate a process into the system.

- Identify and document story dependencies to support refinement and sequencing.

- Maintain a regular cadence for story definition, writing, review, and refinement, keeping a backlog of sufficient depth and readiness to support team velocity.

- Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos as the analyst closest to the requirements.

Delivery Coordination

- Track development progress against committed plans so that commercialization work is timed to when functionality will land.

- Raise scope changes, emerging gaps, and at-risk dates to the Product Management team early, with the specifics needed to make a decision.

- Review delivered functionality against acceptance criteria before it is considered ready for customers, and flag discrepancies.

- Contribute delivery and release content to the recurring account reporting and business reviews prepared by product leadership.

Release Communication

- Own release communication end to end: build and operate a repeatable process that captures release content as it is developed.

- Write release notes for every release, translating technical changes into language customers can act on, and publish them on a predictable cadence.

- Brief Services, Support, and Sales ahead of customer-visible changes so that internal teams are never behind the customer.

- Coordinate the timing of release communication with documentation and enablement updates so that customers and internal teams encounter a consistent picture.

Product Documentation

- Own the customer documentation portal as its primary author and editor, and keep published content aligned with shipped functionality.

- Drive documentation updates from the same source that drives release notes, so that both are produced from one pass through each release.

- Improve the structure and quality of existing documentation over time, prioritizing the areas where support escalations and customer questions indicate confusion.

- Establish and maintain standards for voice, structure, and depth so that content stays consistent as contributors change.

Training and Services Enablement

- Develop the training and enablement assets that accompany newly delivered functionality, including written guides, walkthroughs, and reference material for customer and internal audiences.

- Build the baseline materials, templates, and content standards that the Services team adapts and delivers for customer-specific training.

- Deliver internal enablement sessions for Services, Support, and Sales as significant functionality ships.

- Use support escalation and defect trends to identify where documentation or training gaps are generating avoidable customer friction, and close those gaps.

Implementation Templates and Standards

- Support the implementation templatization program led by the Director, Product and Delivery Enablement, which builds the out-of-the-box configuration, data, and documentation starting point that Services and customers deploy from.

- Own the documentation and content components of the standard package, and deliver assigned tasks within the program plan.

Launch Readiness and Adoption

- Maintain a launch readiness standard for customer-visible functionality, confirming that documentation, training assets, internal enablement, and release communication are complete before a release reaches customers.

- Track adoption of newly released functionality and report on it, so that the value of what we ship is visible.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

- Stories and acceptance criteria reach development ready to build, with clarification cycles the exception rather than the norm.

- Release notes publish on a predictable cadence for every release, and published documentation matches shipped functionality.

- No significant functionality reaches customers without documentation, training assets, and internal enablement in place.

- Services and Support are equipped to deliver customer training from materials they did not have to build themselves.

- Adoption of newly released functionality is measured and reported on a regular cadence.

Required Qualifications

- Three or more years of experience in business analysis, product management, product commercialization, or a comparable role on a software product team.

- Two or more years as a member of an Agile team, ideally as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Scrum Master.

- Demonstrated experience authoring user stories and acceptance criteria that a development team built from.

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and SMEs, and translating their needs into development-ready requirements.

- Demonstrated experience producing customer-facing content, such as product documentation, release notes, user guides, or training material.

- Strong written communication, with the range to write for developers, executives, and customers and adjust register accordingly.

- Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and of Agile and Kanban practices.

- Proficiency with development planning tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, and Confluence.

- Comfortable using AI tools to draft, review, and maintain content.

- Comfortable working with product usage or support data to produce straightforward adoption and quality reporting.

- Professional, customer-facing communication style, with the poise to lead a working session or enablement session.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience authoring User Stories using Gherkin acceptance criteria.

- Experience with enterprise SaaS products, cloud architectures, enterprise system implementations, and system integrations.

- Background in food technology, food science, or food compliance, or familiarity with PLM or related food-industry software.

- Experience owning product launch or commercialization readiness for a software product, including internal enablement of services or sales teams.

- Experience building or maintaining a customer-facing documentation site or knowledge base.

- Experience writing or configuring agent skills (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) for content maintenance or reporting.

- Experience translating UI/UX storyboards into development stories.

- Familiarity with product analytics or support ticket data, and comfort building straightforward reports.

Additional Information
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

remote.title: Principal Product Management, Growth
remote.description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

Principal Product Manager, Growth
About ZoomInfo

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute — you'll make things happen, fast.
The Opportunity
Own a Growth Portfolio and Set the Pattern the Rest of the Team Inherits
ZoomInfo built the industry's most sophisticated GTM data platform. The next frontier is turning every visitor into revenue without waiting on a human handoff — a coherent self-serve journey that activates a non-customer in minutes, converts consumption into upgrade, and routes high-intent signals back to sales when a human will close more than they distract.
You'll define the multi-quarter thesis on which channels compound, the operating rhythm the rest of the growth PM team inherits, and the ZoomInfo POV on how buyers discover us in an AI-first world.
The impact is immediate and compounding. Every signup you activate, every credit you cause to be consumed, every transaction, every PQL you route, every "buy more" event you trigger is revenue — and every operating pattern you set multiplies across the growth PM group. We've adopted a consumption-first monetization model and a unified entry-point thesis across the company, and we run weekly: if your hypothesis can't be falsified inside a sprint, it isn't a hypothesis. This is a rare opportunity to own a P&L-shaped surface with full air cover to ship fast, learn in public, re-pivot when the data turns — and to define the growth PM craft as ZoomInfo scales it.
What You'll Do
Own the Portfolio End-to-End
Take a portfolio-scope growth surface — and own it from first impression to revenue. Define the entry points, the activation milestones, the monetization moments, and the sales-assist signals across the channels that make up the portfolio. Drive the user experience across surfaces: landing, signup, in-product onboarding, empty states, upgrade modals, paywalls, lifecycle communication, and the agent-readable / LLM-discovery surfaces that are becoming primary. You own the funnel chart; you own the why behind every drop.
Set the Multi-Quarter Growth Thesis
Beyond weekly experiments, own 4-8 quarter bets on which channels compound and which retire. Publish a written POV on where PLG distribution is heading (LLM-first discovery, MCP-as-channel, agent-readable onboarding, partner-driven trials) and defend the sequencing to the exec team. Rebalance investment across the portfolio quarterly based on unit economics, not the loudest channel.
Run Experimentation as the Operating Rhythm — and Set the Rhythm for the Team
Ship 8-10 experiments per sprint. Pre-register the hypothesis, the metric, the success threshold, and — critically — the invalidation signal. Read results weekly, kill what doesn't work, double down on what does, and keep a written record so the team compounds learning instead of repeating it. Your rubric, your retro format, and your invalidation-signal standard become the template the rest of the Growth PM group inherits. Translate results into concrete changes: copy rewrites, schema tweaks, pricing changes, new flows, retired ones. Close the loop with engineering, design, and analytics inside the same week.
Design Self-Serve as a First-Class Path
Most users on your portfolio never speak to sales before they hit a "buy more" moment. Your in-product copy, paywall framing, empty states, activation paths, and upgrade triggers are the product. Apply growth-engineering rigor — credit economics, consumption pacing, signal routing, lifecycle messaging, intelligent gating — so the right offer lands in front of the right user at exactly the right moment. Hand high-intent users to sales with a clean signal; absorb low-intent users with a clean self-serve path.
Diagnose the Funnel With Data, Not Vibes
Data is your default tool, not a thing you ask analytics to do for you. You independently analyze the funnel, segment the cohort, find the leak, and propose the fix — then validate it with an experiment. You know when to trust a 5% lift and when to call it noise. Just as important: you know when to zoom out from a specific funnel drop to a portfolio-level rebalance, and can defend that call.
Shape the Monetization Mechanic
You'll design the credit economics of your portfolio: what's free, what's gated, what gets a "buy more" prompt, what triggers a PQL. You'll model the unit economics — credit cost, revenue per credit, upgrade rate, expansion rate — and you'll defend the pricing decisions in front of finance and sales leadership with the math.
Orchestrate Across Sales, Marketing, and CS
Self-serve doesn't mean alone. You'll route PQLs into the right hands (AE, SC, AM, or no one), partner with marketing on acquisition and lifecycle, and work with CS to understand why activated users churn before upgrade. You'll run the operating cadences that keep your portfolio aligned with the broader PLG portfolio without becoming a meeting machine.
Multiply the Team
Help hire and calibrate the Sr Growth PMs owning adjacent loops. Coach them into ownership. Your retro is their template; your experiment quality is their bar. Raise the craft of the whole Growth PM group as it scales.
Stay Honest About What's Working
Write retrospectives that name the wrong calls as cleanly as the right ones. Update your priors publicly when the data turns. Hold strong opinions weakly. The team that ships the most experiments isn't the team that's right the most — it's the team that updates the fastest.
What You'll Bring

- 8–12 years of product management experience, with 4+ years specifically in growth, PLG, or self-serve product roles

- Direct P&L ownership at portfolio scope — a loop or portfolio you've driven from $Y with your name on the number, not a feature inside someone else's loop

- Experience presenting to CEO / CRO / CFO / board on growth mechanics — the credit-economics deck, the funnel narrative, the "kill this bet" moment

- Track record of hiring, mentoring, or calibrating other growth PMs — comfortable being the bar

- You're a builder. You ship landing pages, signup flows, and in-product experiments — not specs that sit in Jira. You sit with designers and engineers, write copy, and prototype with code.

- AI-fluent with a public POV. You understand that LLMs are becoming a primary discovery surface. You have opinions — publishable ones — about agent-readable flows, MCP-as-distribution, GEO/AEO, and how an AI agent's recommendation impacts a funnel.

- Marketing-fluent. You hold your own with SEO, paid acquisition, content, and lifecycle marketing teams as a peer, not a consumer.

- Demonstrated track record of running structured experimentation (A/B tests, multivariate, holdouts, pre/post) at sprint cadence — including at cohort sizes where 50/50 doesn't have power

- Strong analytics fluency — comfortable in Snowflake without analyst hand-holding

- Working knowledge of consumption-based pricing, credit economics, freemium mechanics, and PQL frameworks

- B2B SaaS background; data, GTM, or sales-tech domain experience is a plus but not required

Who You Are
Core Competencies
Funnel Foundation. Expert-level understanding of full-funnel growth. You can reason about activation rates, time-to-value, retention curves, credit economics, upgrade triggers, and PQL signal quality with depth. You've owned a growth loop — or portfolio — in production. SQL and analytics fluency let you diagnose a funnel drop, prototype the fix, and validate it in the same week.
Portfolio Thinking. You reason about ToF (or an equivalent surface) as a portfolio of channels with different unit economics, decay curves, and compounding dynamics — not a single funnel. You rebalance investment quarterly based on where marginal dollars return the most, and you can defend the rebalance to leadership with the math.
Experimentation Discipline. You don't ship without a hypothesis. You pre-register the metric and the invalidation signal before the test runs. You read results honestly, kill losing variants without ego, and document learnings so the team compounds knowledge instead of relitigating settled questions. You know the difference between an experiment and a launch — and you can tell when each is the right move.
Category POV. You have a public, defensible point of view on where PLG distribution is heading — agent-readable surfaces, MCP-as-channel, GEO/AEO, LLM-first onboarding — grounded in benchmarks from peer companies (Clay, Linear, Vercel, Cursor, Notion), not just internal data. That POV shows up in the roadmap.
Distribution Mindset. Experience designing growth surfaces where sales teams, marketing teams, and self-serve users are simultaneously your customers. You measure success through revenue, consumption, and expansion velocity, not screens shipped. You understand growth economics: each additional entry point, freemium offer, or AI trial compounds in value through shared activation patterns, amortized acquisition costs, and recurring consumption network effects.
Operational Velocity. You read the funnel daily, not quarterly. You prototype emerging mechanics — paywalls, in-app prompts, lifecycle sequences — to understand their practical constraints before committing engineering time. You hold strong opinions weakly, updating your design assumptions as evidence accumulates, publicly, even when the prior thesis was your own.
Strategic Communication. You translate between funnel depth and business impact fluently. You can explain to the CEO why a credit pricing change is worth a quarter of work. You can communicate to engineers why a revenue constraint requires a "quiet release" in two weeks rather than a polished launch in three months. You influence without formal authority through forcing functions, falsifiable invalidation signals, and earned credibility.
Talent Leverage. You coach Sr PMs into full ownership of their loops. Your retro is their template. Your experiment quality is their bar. You help hire the next PMs on the team, and you calibrate — you know what "great" looks like at Sr level and you can articulate the gap to someone who isn't there yet.
Copy Instinct. Microcopy is part of your craft, not someone else's job. You can rewrite a paywall headline, an upgrade modal, an empty state, or an onboarding CTA on instinct — and defend the rewrite with PLG principles. You know when to ask content design for help and when to ship the rewrite yourself.
The Environment
Reporting, Pace & Impact
Reporting & Collaboration. Report to the VP Product, PLG. Peer to the Sr Directors of Marketing, Sales Operations, and Customer Success on the growth contracts (PQL routing, demand-gen alignment, credit economics). Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the engineering and design leaders building the underlying surfaces, the GTM leaders routing PQLs into sales, and a peer PM group covering monetization, lifecycle, viral, onboarding, and analytics. Regular exposure to the CEO, CRO, CMO, and CFO — you own those conversations at your level.
Pace & Problems. Fast-moving teams that understand the space. Weekly experimentation cadence layered under 4-quarter portfolio bets. Expect interesting problems: How do we win activation in a user's first 60 seconds? When should two trial flows become one? How do we expose enough value to convert without giving away the platform? Job Description:
The Senior Training and Development Specialist provides advanced technical knowledge and analysis of specialized GIS, HQIIS, Army real-property applications, and the associated operational environment. The position performs senior-level geospatial-systems analysis, develops technical and instructional documentation, delivers virtual and onsite training, and provides implementation advice addressing complex GIS and real-property problems.
The Senior Training and Development Specialist supports the development, updating, conversion, and delivery of the Army’s GIS-RP training program. The position helps installation real-property and IGI&S personnel understand processes, workflows, analytical tools, policies, information-system relationships, reconciliation requirements, audit-related activities, ArcGIS Pro mapping workflows, AIGP capabilities, and local implementation practices.
Primary Duties:

- Update existing GIS-RP Training Modules 101 through 104 as new guidance or policy is released.

- Develop and maintain associated instructor, participant, reference, and presentation materials.

- Convert Modules 101 through 104 into a self-paced instructional format.

- Develop advanced GIS-RP training modules addressing complex research and actions needed to identify discrepancies among GFEBS/PRIDE, HQIIS, and IGI&S data.

- Develop a self-paced GIS-RP fundamentals course for new real-property and GIS specialists.

- Develop short, searchable GIS-RP Tips and Tricks videos, each approximately two to five minutes, with associated digital tags.

- Deliver regularly scheduled virtual GIS-RP training.

- Virtually support the DCS G-4 Real Property Workshop.

- Support the establishment of ArcGIS Pro desktop mapping templates that installation real-property and IGI&S personnel can jointly use and modify.

- Assist installation personnel in developing internal training plans and local Real Property/GIS Management SOPs.

- Support OCONUS installation training through virtual review meetings addressing findings from quarterly analyses.

- Provide technical documentation, implementation guidance, and senior-level subject-matter advice concerning GIS, HQIIS, real property, and associated operational processes.

- Coordinate with management analysts, GIS specialists, software quality personnel, business-intelligence analysts, and project leadership to verify the technical accuracy and consistency of instructional products.

- Deliver draft virtual and onsite training materials no later than 15 business days before scheduled training and final materials no later than five days before scheduled training.

- Prepare training documentation and presentation products in Microsoft Word and PowerPoint formats.

- Support meeting notes, monthly status reporting, annual reporting, and other required documentation related to training activities.

- Advanced technical knowledge of specialized GIS applications.

- Advanced technical knowledge of HQIIS.

- Advanced technical knowledge of Army real-property applications and operational environments.

- Experience performing high-level geospatial-systems analysis.

- Experience developing technical and instructional documentation.

- Experience delivering training involving complex technical or operational subject matter.

- Experience providing implementation advice concerning complex GIS problems.

- Senior-level subject-matter expertise sufficient to support effective implementation.

- Experience and knowledge across key tasks and high-impact assignments.

- Demonstrated understanding of DoD and Army real-property and IGI&S policy and guidance.

- Demonstrated understanding of the most recently published DCS G-4 IGI&S QAPs.

remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Location: This position may be performed remotely with travel to the Boston area as needed, and an expected 20–30% travel to CDMO sites, particularly during validation campaigns, critical investigations, and health authority inspections.
The Opportunity
Praxis is hiring a Manager, Analytical Sciences to play a key role in ensuring the analytical readiness and ongoing quality of Praxis’ commercial portfolio. You’ll own and support analytical strategy across commercial manufacturing, helping ensure testing is executed in accordance with regulatory commitments while advancing lifecycle management of approved products.
You’ll partner closely with CDMOs supporting small molecule drug substance and drug product manufacturing, with responsibility for analytical methods, control strategies, data integrity, inspection readiness, and continuity of supply. Success in this role will require strong scientific judgment, a hands-on approach, and the ability to identify risks early and work cross-functionally to develop practical solutions.
Primary Responsibilities

- Execute analytical strategies for commercial products, ensuring methods, specifications, and control strategies remain compliant and fit for purpose.

- Lead method transfer, validation, and lifecycle management activities, identifying risks and driving resolution.

- Support analytical activities for PPQ, CPV, commercial manufacturing, and stability programs, ensuring data quality and regulatory compliance.

- Review and approve analytical documentation, including protocols, reports, specifications, method validations, CoAs, raw data, chromatographic integrations, and audit trails.

- Manage analytical activities at CDMOs, ensuring compliant, timely deliverables that support product release, supply continuity, and inspection readiness, including on-site support during critical campaigns and inspections.

- Lead or support analytical investigations involving OOS/OOT results, deviations, and CAPAs, performing root cause analysis and supporting quality decisions.

- Assess analytical risks associated with manufacturing, supply chain, and process changes, ensuring appropriate impurity controls and lifecycle management strategies.

- Contribute to regulatory submissions, post-approval changes, Annual Product Reviews (APR/PQRs), and health authority responses.

The Healthcare Career Advancement Program (H-CAP) is a national labor/management organization that promotes innovation and quality in healthcare career education. Our mission is to transform healthcare workforce development and to support highly-trained, highly-valued professionals to better meet the need for quality care in a rapidly changing industry. We are committed to fostering value in healthcare careers, and to helping employers recruit and retain the best-trained professionals, to meet their needs and the needs of our communities.

Through this RFP, H-CAP seeks a contractor to support its Registered Apprenticeship portfolio, including healthcare-based outreach and recruitment, program development, implementation support, stakeholder engagement, materials development, and related educational activities.

Partner Education

- Conduct informational sessions in a variety of formats for various stakeholders.

- Plan and implement not less than (5) meetings of 10 or more stakeholders who want to learn more about Registered Apprenticeship Programs

Program Development

- Recruit not less than 25 employers who want to begin new registered apprenticeship programs or expand upon existing programs.

- Provide support including identifying apprenticeable occupations, creating standards, and working to get standards approved, and

- Support he creation of multi-employer apprenticeship programs

Communications and Marketing Support

- Support the creation of materials that support Registered Apprenticeship outreach.

- Work with H-CAP’s Data and Communications team to amplify Registered Apprenticeship promotional and marketing efforts as directed by H-CAP leadership.

Grant Compliance, Tracking, and Reporting

- Track deliverables to ensure compliance with grant and contract obligations.

- Enter accurate and timely data into a variety of tracking systems.

- Gather data and write reports on progress.

4. Preferred Qualifications and Experience
Industry Contacts and Background

- Possess deep knowledge and experience working with healthcare employers and stakeholders on workforce development issues

- Ability to reach out to healthcare care consortia, certifying bodies, industry associations, etc. and connect with them on the need for creating Registered Apprenticeship Programs

- Knowledge of the healthcare industry and workforce development.

- Knowledge of Registered Apprenticeship and the Registered Apprenticeship System.

- Experience with post-secondary education and adult education programs.

Project Management and Coordination

- A minimum of 5 years of project management experience.

- Excellent project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently.

- Experience working in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

Communication and Presentation

- Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.

- Ability and comfort presenting to a variety of audiences using a mix of methods, including virtual and in-person formats.

Labor-Management and Stakeholder Engagement

- Work experience or familiarity with union or labor-management environments.

- Existing connections with stakeholders such as healthcare employers, industry associations, unions, labor-management organizations, workforce boards, and education partners.

5. Proposal Requirements
Proposals should include: (1) a cover letter; (2) a resume with description of the proposer’s qualifications and relevant experience; (3) a summary of how the proposer will identify and recruit employers and stakeholders who will commit to starting registered apprenticeship programs; including the amount of hours per week the proposer is able to commit to the project, and (4) references from comparable projects or clients if requested.
6. Evaluation Criteria
H-CAP will evaluate proposals based on demonstrated experience with Registered Apprenticeship, healthcare workforce development, labor-management partnerships, project management capacity, quality of proposed approach, ability to meet deliverables, cost reasonableness, and references.
7. Anticipated Timeline
H-CAP anticipates selecting a contractor following review of submitted proposals and may invite finalists for interviews. H-CAP will accept proposals through September 30, 2026. H-CAP will then review each RFP and selection should be completed by November 15, 2026.
8. Submission Instructions
Proposals should be submitted electronically through the H-CAP Hiring Portal.

FormFactor is seeking an experienced Business Process & Continuous Improvement Lead to accelerate high-priority cross-functional transformation initiatives. As a core member of FORM Enterprise Transformation Group, this role will work alongside business leaders and subject-matter experts to map current-state processes, identify root causes, design scalable future-state workflows, implement improvements, and embed the ownership and operating mechanisms required to sustain results.
This is a hands-on delivery role, not a documentation or facilitation-only position. The successful candidate will combine structured problem solving, process design, controls, change adoption, data fluency, and implementation discipline across people, process, data, decision rights, operating cadence, and enabling technology.
Key Responsibilities:
End-to-End Process Transformation

- Lead current-state discovery through interviews, process walkthroughs, data review, gemba observation, and end-to-end process mapping.

- Identify root causes, bottlenecks, rework, unclear ownership, control gaps, data issues, and cross-functional handoff breakdowns.

- Design practical and scalable future-state processes aligned with business outcomes.

- Define roles, decision rights, handoffs, standard work, controls, operating cadence, escalation paths, and performance measures.

- Develop sequenced implementation roadmaps that balance urgency, business continuity, and long-term scalability.

Continuous Improvement and Implementation

- Plan and facilitate focused improvement workshops, root-cause reviews, kaizens, and design sessions.

- Apply FormFactor 4C, Lean, Six Sigma, value-stream mapping, risk analysis, process design, and other methods selectively based on the problem.

- Convert workshop outputs into implementable actions, owners, milestones, measures, and follow-through mechanisms.

- Work directly with business teams to implement new workflows, management systems, controls, documentation, and routines.

- Lead pilots and rapid prototypes, measure results, and refine solutions before scale-up.

Governance, Adoption, and Sustainment

- Establish clear process ownership, control points, decision rights, escalation thresholds, and accountability mechanisms.

- Ensure improvements include appropriate documentation, training, communication, adoption, and reinforcement plans.

- Partner with the transformation analyst and functional data owners to establish dashboards and operating reviews.

- Assess whether revised processes are operating as designed and coordinate corrective action where outcomes fall short.

- Prepare structured handoff packages that transfer ownership, measures, standard work, and ongoing improvement responsibility to the function.

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Partner with business and operational subject-matter experts who provide domain knowledge and ultimately own adoption.

- Collaborate with Finance, IT, data, operations, commercial, quality, supply chain, and other functions to integrate process, data, controls, and technology requirements.

- Translate business needs into clear process and functional requirements for technical teams.

- Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels and surface unresolved barriers and decisions promptly.

- Build reusable process-improvement methods, standards, and lessons learned.

Key Deliverables:

- Current-state and future-state end-to-end process maps

- Root-cause analyses, gap assessments, and risk / control evaluations

- Role charters, decision rights, handoffs, standard work, and operating cadences

- Pilot and implementation plans with milestones, owners, and measures

- Training, adoption, sustainment, and handoff packages

- Reusable process-improvement methods and templates

Preferred Qualifications & Experiences:

- Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

- 8+ years of experience in business process improvement, operational excellence, business transformation, industrial engineering, internal controls, quality, supply chain, or related roles.

- Demonstrated success mapping and redesigning complex end-to-end processes across multiple functions.

- Hands-on experience implementing process changes, not only recommending or documenting them.

- Strong facilitation, structured problem-solving, analytical, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

- Working knowledge of process governance, decision rights, controls, metrics, change adoption, and sustainment.

- Semiconductor, semiconductor equipment, electronics, capital equipment, high-mix manufacturing, service, or logistics experience.

- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt, BPM, change-management, internal-controls, or related certification.

- Experience with SIOP / IBP, capacity planning, manufacturing processes, supply chain, service operations, or technology transfer.

- Experience using process-mining, workflow, analytics, automation, modeling, or visualization tools.

- Experience working with ERP, CRM, planning, manufacturing execution, data warehouse, or reporting platforms.

What Success Looks Like:
Success means complex cross-functional processes become simpler, clearer, more scalable, and more reliable. Improvements are implemented in the business, supported by defined owners, decision rights, controls, data, metrics, and operating routines, and continue to perform after FORM Enterprise Transformation Group exits the engagement.

remote.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Finance
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The ideal candidate brings direct experience in radiology scheduling, understands diagnostic modalities, and excels at driving complete scheduling workflows.
Schedule & Shift Flexibility

-
Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)

-
Primary Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (US Eastern Standard Time)

-
Future Coverage Flexibility: Candidates should possess schedule flexibility to potentially transition into or provide coverage for a future 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM EST evening shift as practice operational needs expand.

VA's Top 3 Daily Tasks

-
Patient Scheduling & Active Outreach: Contact patients with unscheduled imaging orders, execute persistent follow-up, and book appointments across all diagnostic modalities.

-
Inbound & Outbound Phone Support: Manage steady call volume from patients and referring offices, answer scheduling inquiries, and conduct appointment confirmation calls.

-
Worklist & Queue Management: Monitor pending scheduling queues, website requests, voicemails, cancellations, and rescheduling needs to maintain optimal schedule utilization.

Core Responsibilities

-
Diagnostic Imaging Scheduling: Book, reschedule, and confirm appointments across all core modalities (MRI, CT, Ultrasound, Mammography, X-Ray, and DEXA) using approved prep guidelines.

-
Order & Patient Intake Verification: Ensure required medical orders, patient demographics, and referring provider details are complete prior to scheduling; confirm basic insurance details and flag authorization needs for the billing team.

-
Worklist Ownership: Manage website leads, cancellation lists, and unscheduled orders—logging every contact attempt, outcome, and follow-up note accurately in the system.

-
Communication & Coordination: Communicate professionally with referring provider offices to request missing clinical info or incomplete orders; guide patients through basic exam preparations.

-
Departmental Routing: Efficiently route insurance, prior authorization, billing, medical record, and clinical triage requests to the appropriate internal departments.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

-
U.S. Healthcare Practice Background: Minimum 2+ years of healthcare scheduling or front-office administrative experience supporting a U.S. medical practice.

-
Radiology & Modality Knowledge: Direct knowledge of diagnostic imaging modalities (MRI, CT, Ultrasound, X-Ray, DEXA, Mammography), including contrast vs. non-contrast exam matching and screening protocols.

-
Schedule Flexibility: Ability to work standard EST business hours AND willingness to cover or transition to a 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM EST evening shift as needed.

-
Communication & Demeanor: Outstanding verbal and written English skills; warm, patient phone presence with ability to support elderly, anxious, or frustrated callers.

-
Worklist Ownership: Demonstrated ability to manage open task queues independently with meticulous documentation habits.

-
Remote Workspace Setup: A quiet, private, HIPAA-compliant home workspace equipped with a reliable computer setup, high-speed internet, and a clear, noise-canceling headset.

Nice-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications

-
Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English and Spanish.

-
Radiology Information System (RIS) Experience: Hands-on experience using CIVIE RIS or a comparable healthcare scheduling/RIS platform.

-
Insurance & Authorization Awareness: Familiarity with basic eligibility verification or radiology prior authorization workflows.

You are a dependable, thorough healthcare virtual assistant who views scheduling as an essential patient-care task. You combine clinical communication skills with active worklist management to ensure no order is left pending and every patient receives timely care.

remote.title: Cloud Infra Automation Engineer

Cloud Infra Automation Engineer
Senior Azure Infrastructure Automation Engineer
Infrastructure-as-Code • Platform Engineering • AI-Enabled Self-Service

Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Azure Infrastructure Automation Engineer to help us mature and extend how infrastructure is delivered across our organization. We already have a working Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) framework and a meaningful library of Terraform modules in place—this role is about taking that foundation to the next level: expanding our module coverage, refining and hardening the existing environment, and building a new AI-enabled self-service layer on top.

The central mission is to make infrastructure self-service. You will grow our standardized, opinionated Terraform module library and expose it through an AI-enabled developer experience—so that engineers can describe what they need and have compliant, production-ready infrastructure generated for them automatically, with our standards and guardrails baked in. If you are excited about Terraform at scale, platform engineering, and applying modern AI tooling to real infrastructure problems, this role is for you.

What You'll Work On

- Expanding the module library – building on our existing Terraform modules to broaden coverage across our Azure estate, standardizing patterns and ensuring security, naming, tagging, and policy guardrails are built in by default.

- Refining the existing IaC framework – hardening and improving our current Terraform and Terragrunt environment for maintainability, consistency, and quality, with stronger linting, validation, testing, and CI/CD.

- An AI-enabled self-service experience (the new build) – an IaC MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and configured agent skills so that developers using Claude Code or GitHub Copilot can interrogate our approved modules and standards, understand the “rules of the road,” and automatically build the infrastructure their projects need.

- Automated governance – change-management automation integrated with ServiceNow, plus developer-facing workflows and golden paths delivered through .

Key Responsibilities

- Refine, harden, and extend our existing IaC framework using Terraform and Terragrunt, improving consistency, maintainability, and quality across environments.

- Expand and standardize our existing Terraform module library, authoring additional modules to broaden Azure coverage, with secure defaults, consistent naming/tagging, and embedded policy guardrails.

- Establish and enforce IaC quality standards using TFLint and policy-as-code, including linting, validation, automated testing, and pre-merge checks.

- Build the AI-assisted self-service platform: stand up and maintain an IaC MCP server and author the agent skills/context that encode our standards, so developers can use Claude Code or GitHub Copilot to query approved modules and generate compliant infrastructure for their projects.

- Automate change management by integrating IaC deployment pipelines with ServiceNow (change requests, approvals, CMDB updates) to keep delivery fast while staying audit-ready.

- Design and implement self-service workflows, scaffolding, and golden paths through and other developer-portal/automation tooling.

- Build and maintain CI/CD and GitOps pipelines for infrastructure delivery.

- Write and maintain supporting automation in PowerShell, Python, and Bash.

- Manage identity, access, and authentication patterns through Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including RBAC and least-privilege design for the platform.

- Partner with development teams to remove provisioning bottlenecks, gather feedback on the self-service experience, and continuously improve it.

- Help grow and mentor the platform team as it scales, championing platform-engineering and self-service principles across the organization.

- Ensure infrastructure and automation are secure, reliable, and compliant with organizational policies and best practices.

Required Skills & Experience

- Mastery-level Terraform and Terragrunt for Infrastructure-as-Code, including authoring reusable modules and managing infrastructure at scale.

- Hands-on experience with TFLint and IaC quality tooling—linting, validation, automated testing, and enforcing standards across a codebase.

- Deep Azure expertise across IaaS and PaaS services and the surrounding ecosystem.

- Proven track record designing standardized, reusable module libraries and opinionated IaC patterns that other teams build on.

- Strong scripting and automation skills in PowerShell, Python, and Bash.

- Solid experience with CI/CD and GitOps workflows for infrastructure delivery.

- Working knowledge of identity, access, and authentication using Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and RBAC.

- A genuine platform-engineering mindset—you care about developer experience and building safe, easy self-service for others.

- Ability to design secure, scalable, and resilient automation solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, or otherwise exposing tools and data to AI coding assistants.

- Familiarity with Claude Code and/or GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted development workflows, including configuring agent skills, context, or guardrails.

- Hands-on experience with or another Internal Developer Portal (e.g., Backstage).

- Experience automating change management with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.

- Policy-as-code experience (e.g., OPA/Conftest, Sentinel, Azure Policy) and IaC security scanning (Checkov, tfsec/Trivy).

- Infrastructure testing experience (e.g., Terratest, native Terraform tests).

- Familiarity with Kubernetes / AKS and container orchestration.

- Experience with configuration management and orchestration tooling (e.g., Ansible).

- Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and incident-response practices.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across multiple teams.

Certifications (Preferred)

- HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (or Terraform Authoring & Operations Professional)

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

- Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

- Other relevant cloud, automation, or security certifications are a plus.

Why Join Us

- A high-ownership role: you'll help take an established IaC platform to the next level and lead the build-out of our AI-enabled self-service layer.

- Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and cutting-edge AI tooling—building something genuinely new.

- Real impact: your work directly shapes how every engineering team ships infrastructure.

- A forward-thinking engineering culture focused on automation, innovation, and continuous improvement.
