Work Model: Remote
Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)
Compensation: $35–$50 per hour
About the Company
TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.
The Opportunity
This is a design engineering internship, which means the same person decides how something should work and then builds it. You will take ideas that arrive as a sentence or a rough sketch and turn them into interfaces people actually use, owning the visual and interaction decisions along the way rather than waiting for a spec.
We care about craft here in a way that is easy to claim and harder to do: spacing, hierarchy, typography, and the small interaction details that make a product feel considered. Because the team is small and the surface is still being shaped, your judgment about how something should feel carries real weight, and you will see the result in front of users quickly.
Responsibilities

- Design and build product surfaces end to end, from low-fidelity idea to shipped interface.

- Own layout, typography, hierarchy, and interaction detail across the surfaces you build.

- Implement in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, working with the backend services behind each surface.

- Build and extend shared components so the product stays visually consistent as it grows.

- Make interfaces work well across screen sizes and states, including the empty and error ones.

Requirements

- Strong taste for product design, interaction design, and visual detail.

- Experience building with React, Next.js, TypeScript, or similar frontend tools.

- Comfort working from low-fidelity ideas and turning them into usable interfaces.

- Strong understanding of layout, typography, hierarchy, and responsive design.

- Has shipped design or frontend projects, whether independently, in class, or through prior work.

- Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.

remote.description:
Job Title: Researcher, Western and Northern Europe
Department: Programs, Europe & Central Asia (ECA)

Office Location: Remote, Europe-based
Workspace Designation: Remote

Closing Date: September 10, 2026
Organization Overview:
Founded in 1981, the Committee to Protect Journalists (“CPJ”) is an independent, non-profit organization defending journalists worldwide without regard to their political ideology. Through its work to safeguard journalists, CPJ protects the rights of all people to have access to diverse and independent sources of information. For over four decades, CPJ has helped win the early release of imprisoned journalists, secure convictions in journalist murders, and enable legal reform in countries where free expression has deteriorated. CPJ’s widely cited database and reports have raised global awareness of attacks on press freedom. Learn more about CPJ’s fight to defend freedom of the press here
At CPJ, we are dedicated to upholding values of equity and free expression in both our internal operations and external endeavors. As a global organization headquartered in the United States, we aspire to build a diverse workplace and foster an inclusive and welcoming environment. We strive for our people to be representative of the global community on which we report and to equip them with the opportunities and resources they need to learn and succeed.
Job Summary:
The Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) is hiring a Researcher - Western and Northern Europe (WNE) to join our Europe and Central Asia program. The position reports to the Program Coordinator, ECA, and is responsible for monitoring, researching, documenting, and responding to attacks on the press and other issues impacting press freedom in the region. The Researcher also supports the development of regional and sub-regional strategy, initiates and produces expert analysis on the region, represents CPJ publicly when required, and supports the program’s journalism assistance efforts.
This role requires a strong background in media, press freedom, and human rights in the ECA region, excellent research and writing skills, a solid understanding of journalistic standards, and the ability to work independently and proactively across the region. The Researcher collaborates with team members and other departments, following CPJ’s established guidelines and frameworks.
This position is based in the Europe/Central Asia region and will be hired via an Employer of Record.
Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

- Monitor, document and respond to press freedom abuses throughout the ECA region, with a focus on Western and Northern Europe.

- Maintain and build relationships with journalists, human rights organisations, policymakers and other regional stakeholders.

- Propose, direct and conduct research on press freedom issues in the ECA region.

- Develop and execute advocacy strategies to advance press freedom in ECA, in coordination with Program Coordinator and Regional Director.

- Initiate and write reports, advocacy documents, engaging social media content and other materials on press freedom issues in the region.

- Review and assess requests for assistance from journalists in the region, in coordination with the Emergencies team.

- Represent CPJ at conferences and meetings with authorities, journalists, partners, policymakers and other stakeholders.

- Collaborate with CPJ’s global teams, including Advocacy, Research, and Assistance, to ensure coordinated organizational impact.

- Provide translation of interviews, documents, and other materials between English and relevant local languages, as needed.

- Perform other duties within the scope of CPJ’s research and advocacy mandate as requested by the Program Coordinator or Regional Director.

Qualifications & Competencies:
Required:

- Minimum of five years experience in researching, reporting, and publishing on global human rights and politics, or equivalent experience in advocacy and humanitarian assistance.

- Strong understanding of Europe and Central Asia issues, including media and human rights.

- Excellent English writing and reporting skills.

- Proficiency in at least one other language relevant to the position.

- Excellent interpersonal, organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.

- Significant experience working with governments and other policymakers.

- Knowledge and skill in using social media tools effectively.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, and Drive, with basic working knowledge of its tools and functionalities.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong commitment to press freedom.

- Capacity to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred:

- Knowledge of additional regional languages is desirable.

- Strong networks of regional contacts.

- Expertise in online/digital harms.

- Experience of policy development.

- Multimedia and data journalism experience.

- Experience supporting trauma‑related or journalist assistance cases.

Physical Requirements:
This position’s physical demands reflect work in a typical office setting. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
Work Location:
This position is located in Europe and is classified as fully remote. Availability to work and attend meetings on the US Eastern time zone as needed is required.
Compensation:
Compensation for this position will be based on experience, skills, and location. As a point of reference, the expected salary range for this position if hired in the UK is 45,700 - 51,500 GBP. Specific compensation rates will be determined based upon candidate location in order to align with local market conditions and cost of living differences.

remote.title: Sales Operations Manager, Channel & Partnerships
remote.description:
About the Revenue Operations Team
The OpenSesame Revenue Operations team is the operational backbone and growth catalyst of the company, enabling our Go-To-Market teams to sell, serve, and scale with clarity and confidence. We design the systems, processes, and insights that turn strategy into execution and ensure revenue flows efficiently from first conversation to renewal.
We partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partners, Finance, and Legal to remove friction, enforce smart governance, and create a consistent, high-quality customer experience. Our work blends data, process, technology, and judgment to help the business move faster, without cutting corners.
What makes our Revenue Operations team unique:

- We embrace automation and AI to reduce manual work, surface insights faster, and scale best practices.

- We invest deeply in operational excellence and continuous improvement, balancing speed with discipline.

- We are systems thinkers and problem solvers, motivated by making complex processes simpler and more scalable.

- We measure success by business outcomes — deal velocity, forecast accuracy, won revenue and customer experience.

- We operate with an owner’s mindset, taking accountability for results, not just activity.

- We do the right thing, even when it requires tough conversations or slowing down a deal to protect the business.

- We communicate with clarity and credibility, serving as trusted advisors to GTM teams and leadership.

- We believe the best results come from tight collaboration and shared learning, supporting one another through peer problem-solving, documentation, and knowledge-sharing so the entire organization gets better together.

About the Sales Operations Manager, Channel & Partnerships role:
The Sales Operations Manager, Channel & Partnerships is the operational partner responsible for helping OpenSesame scale its partner business with greater clarity, efficiency, accountability, and predictability.
This role partners closely with Strategic Partner Managers, Partner Development, the Partner Program Manager, Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Legal, Enablement, Marketing, and Product to improve how partner-sourced, partner-influenced, reseller, OEM, referral, and co-sell motions operate from partner lead submission through quote-to-cash.
This is a manager-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. The role requires manager-level judgment, strong business partnership, analytical depth, and the ability to influence change through process, data, systems, automation, and AI-enabled workflows. This is not a reporting-only role or a tactical support desk. The right person will diagnose partner process friction, improve tool adoption, clarify ownership, strengthen partner attribution, and turn messy data into actionable insights that help the partner business grow.
Success in this role means partner leaders trust the data, Partner Sales Managers have clear operating views, partners submit leads through the right platform, quote-to-cash processes are understood, and leadership can clearly see what is working, what is at risk, and where to focus next.
Performance Objectives
Within 30 Days: Understand, Diagnose, and Prioritize

- Build a deep understanding of OpenSesame’s partner ecosystem, including reseller, OEM, referral, partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and co-sell motions.

- Establish strong relationships with Partner Sales Managers, Partner Development, the Partner Program Manager, Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Legal, Enablement, Marketing, Product, and RevOps.

- Audit current partner lead submission, routing, attribution, opportunity management, handoff, reporting, and quote-to-cash processes.

- Assess adoption and utilization of key partner tools and workflows, including Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, Gong, Looker, ZoomInfo, Clay, and related GTM systems.

- Identify friction points impacting partner lead submission, partner visibility, SPM productivity, reporting accuracy, quote-to-cash execution, and forecast confidence.

- Deliver a current-state assessment with prioritized recommendations, including quick wins and longer-term operating improvements.

Within 60 Days: Improve Process, Visibility, and Adoption

- Refine partner lead and opportunity workflows to improve routing accuracy, attribution, pipeline visibility, and accountability.

- Establish clearer standards for partner lead submission through Euler, including required fields, SLAs, review process, ownership, and follow-up expectations.

- Improve use of Crossbeam to support account mapping, overlap analysis, co-sell opportunity identification, partner prioritization, and joint pipeline visibility.

- Build or improve reporting views for Partner Sales Managers, Partner Development, Partner Program leadership, Sales leadership, Finance, and RevOps.

- Partner with Business Systems to scope CRM, Euler, Crossbeam, and workflow improvements that reduce manual work and improve data quality.

- Identify automation or AI-enabled opportunities to streamline partner operations, improve lead hygiene, summarize partner performance, or surface pipeline risk faster.

- Align with Enablement and the Partner Program Manager on internal and partner-facing communication, training, and adoption reinforcement.

Beyond 90 Days: Scale Partner Operations and Strategic Impact

- Own ongoing operational health across partner lead submission, attribution, opportunity management, reporting, and quote-to-cash workflows.

- Build durable reporting that helps leadership understand partner pipeline quality, conversion, revenue contribution, account overlap, and growth opportunities.

- Surface insights on partner performance, partner fit, source quality, deal velocity, conversion, attribution, and partner profitability.

- Support Partner Development with data-backed insights to identify, prioritize, and evaluate potential new partners.

- Support Partner Sales Managers with clear views into partner account activity, pipeline, performance, whitespace, and expansion opportunities.

- Partner with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Sales to improve operational clarity across OEM and reseller quote-to-cash processes.

- Drive measurable improvements in tool adoption, workflow efficiency, partner lead compliance, reporting accuracy, and partner pipeline visibility.

- Be viewed by Partner leadership as a trusted operating partner who brings clarity, urgency, and practical solutions.

Ongoing Responsibilities
Partner Pipeline, Attribution & Rules of Engagement

- Own operational visibility into partner-sourced, partner-influenced, reseller, OEM, referral, and co-sell pipeline.

- Improve partner lead submission, routing, tracking, and attribution across Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, and related systems.

- Support and operationalize partner attribution rules, including source, influence, referral, reseller, OEM, and co-sell motions.

- Help maintain partner rules of engagement, including lead submission requirements, ownership, AE/SPM handoff expectations, response SLAs, conflict resolution, and exception handling.

- Identify attribution gaps, duplicate submissions, unclear ownership, inconsistent crediting, stale opportunities, or missing partner data.

Partner Tool Adoption, Automation & AI

- Drive adoption of partner tools and workflows by making processes clear, useful, and easy to follow for internal teams and external partners.

- Diagnose friction across Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, reporting, handoffs, and quote-to-cash workflows.

- Partner with Business Systems, Analytics, and Enablement to scope, test, and roll out system or workflow improvements.

- Identify opportunities to use automation and AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and surface insights faster.

- Explore use cases such as partner performance summaries, lead quality checks, account overlap insights, partner QBR prep, pipeline risk alerts, quote-to-cash prompts, and executive reporting.

Reporting, Analytics & Strategic Insights

- Build and maintain reporting that helps Partner leadership understand what is working, what is at risk, and where to focus.

- Analyze partner pipeline, conversion, sales cycle, win rates, deal velocity, source quality, attribution, account overlap, and revenue contribution.

- Support partner QBRs, business reviews, annual planning, and performance discussions with clear, data-backed insights.

- Translate messy or incomplete data into executive-ready recommendations: what changed, why it changed, what is at risk, and what action is recommended.

Partner Program, Planning & Growth Support

- Support the Partner Program Manager with operational infrastructure for partner tiers, program rules, incentives, enablement, compliance, and performance measurement.

- Support Partner Development with analysis to identify and prioritize prospective partners based on fit, account overlap, market opportunity, and revenue potential.

- Support Partner Sales Managers in managing and expanding partner relationships through account visibility, pipeline insights, partner activity reporting, and process clarity.

- Build visibility across the partner lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, enablement, activation, pipeline creation, revenue contribution, and expansion.

Quote-to-Cash & Cross-Functional Operations

- Build operational understanding of quote-to-cash requirements across OEM, reseller, referral, and other partner motions.

- Partner with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, Business Systems, and Sales to clarify requirements, reduce friction, and improve handoffs.

- Improve visibility into partner deal economics, including discounts, reseller margins, referral fees, OEM terms, payment obligations, and revenue recognition considerations where applicable.

- Translate business needs into clear requirements for process, reporting, systems, and enablement improvements.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.
We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.
Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.
We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.
Location: This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary.
Performance Driven: We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.
Compensation: On-target earnings for this role range between $135,000 and $150,000 per year, depending on experience, which includes base salary and variable incentive compensation based on performance. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience.
Benefits: Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.
Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.
Pay Transparency: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.
CPRA (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

remote.title: Healthcare Billing & Patient Care Coordinator
remote.description:
Healthcare Billing & Patient Care Coordinator
Position Type: Part-Time with Full-Time Opportunity
Schedule:

- Monday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EDT, with a 1-hour unpaid break

- Wednesday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM EDT

- Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EDT, with a 1-hour unpaid break

Current Weekly Hours: 20 hours per week
Salary: $5–$7 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote
About the Practice
Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare practice focused on providing highly personalized and patient-centered care. The practice places a strong emphasis on creating a supportive, compassionate experience for patients while maintaining efficient clinical and administrative workflows.
Because the practice works closely with patients throughout their care journey, the ideal candidate will understand that successful healthcare administration involves more than completing paperwork—it also requires empathy, accuracy, responsiveness, and proactive coordination.

We are seeking an experienced and compassionate Healthcare Billing & Patient Care Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based healthcare practice. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong medical billing and prior authorization expertise with excellent patient communication and healthcare administrative skills.
The role supports both healthcare administration and patient coordination, including prior authorizations, insurance verification, billing, patient intake, scheduling, and follow-ups. The ideal candidate combines strong billing and insurance knowledge with a warm, trauma-informed approach to patient care. This is a part-time role with an opportunity to transition to full-time between November and January.
Key Responsibilities
Prior Authorizations & Medical Billing

- Manage prior authorizations (PAs) on a rolling basis to help ensure patients receive timely access to services.

- Review patient charts and relevant documentation to identify and complete required prior authorizations.

- Handle weekly medical billing, ensuring services and information are accurately reviewed before submission.

- Verify billing information and submit claims through the appropriate clearinghouse.

- Assist with denied claims, investigate issues, and support appropriate follow-up and resolution.

- Maintain accurate documentation of authorization and billing activities.

Insurance Verification & Claims Support

- Conduct accurate and timely insurance eligibility and benefits verification.

- Work primarily with Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) insurance processes.

- Review coverage information and identify potential authorization, eligibility, or billing issues before services are provided.

- Assist with insurance-related patient inquiries when appropriate.

- Apply knowledge of U.S. healthcare insurance requirements and workflows to minimize billing delays and denials.

- Rhode Island healthcare experience or knowledge is an advantage but not required.

Patient Screening & Intake Coordination

- Respond to new patient inquiries and conduct initial screenings.

- Review patient information to help determine whether prospective patients meet the practice's intake criteria.

- Schedule qualified patients for new patient intake appointments.

- Coordinate consultations for individuals who require additional assessment before moving forward.

- Ensure patient information and intake documentation are complete and accurately entered into the appropriate system.

Patient Follow-Up & Care Coordination

- Conduct outbound follow-up calls to maintain appropriate contact with patients throughout their care journey.

- Communicate with patients using a warm, compassionate, and trauma-informed approach.

- Assist with appointment scheduling, rescheduling, inquiries, and post-treatment follow-ups.

- Help ensure patients understand next steps and receive timely communication from the practice.

- Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when discussing sensitive patient information.

Virtual Reception & Administrative Support

- Answer incoming patient calls professionally and compassionately.

- Monitor and manage voicemail messages and ensure appropriate follow-up.

- Coordinate schedules and maintain accurate patient records.

- Support day-to-day administrative workflows to keep the practice organized and responsive.

- Identify inefficiencies or gaps in existing healthcare administrative processes and proactively recommend improvements based on previous experience.

Typical Day
A typical day may include reviewing patient charts for prior authorization requirements and new patient intakes, verifying insurance coverage, reviewing and submitting billing through the clearinghouse, managing scheduling, and responding to patient inquiries.
Phone volume is relatively manageable, with approximately four calls per week currently focused primarily on appointment booking and patient inquiries. This allows the role to maintain a strong focus on billing, prior authorizations, insurance, and administrative workflows.
Systems & Tools
Experience with the following is helpful, although direct experience with every platform is not required:

-
PracticeQ – EHR/practice management

-
Office Ally – Medical billing and clearinghouse

-
Availity – Insurance eligibility, authorization, and payer workflows

Requirements
Experience Requirements

- Strong previous experience with U.S. healthcare billing and insurance workflows is required.

- Hands-on experience processing prior authorizations is required.

- Strong knowledge of insurance verification, eligibility, benefits, claims, and denied claims.

- Familiarity with Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) processes is highly preferred.

- Experience working with U.S.-based healthcare practices in a remote or virtual capacity is preferred.

- Experience with behavioral health or mental health practices is a strong advantage.

- Rhode Island healthcare or insurance experience is helpful but not required.

- Experience using PracticeQ, Office Ally, Availity, or similar EHR, billing, clearinghouse, and insurance platforms is preferred.

- A medical degree or active clinical license is not required for this position.

What We're Looking For
Our strongest candidates will bring expertise in three key areas:

-
Prior Authorizations & Billing – You can confidently manage PAs, insurance verification, billing submissions, and claims-related issues with minimal supervision.

-
Healthcare Workflows – You understand how the administrative side of a U.S. healthcare practice operates and can identify opportunities to make processes more efficient.

-
Patient Management – You are comfortable handling patient intake, scheduling, inquiries, follow-ups, and post-treatment communication with professionalism and empathy.

You should also:

- Have a trauma-informed, compassionate approach when communicating with patients.

- Be comfortable speaking with individuals who may be dealing with sensitive or difficult circumstances.

- Be proactive rather than waiting for every task to be assigned.

- Be capable of using your previous healthcare administrative experience to recommend better workflows or solutions when appropriate.

- Demonstrate excellent attention to detail, especially when working with insurance, billing, authorizations, and patient records.

- Be organized and capable of managing multiple administrative priorities independently.

Basic Requirements

- Must be highly proficient in spoken and written English, with clear and professional communication skills.

- Must have relevant U.S. healthcare administrative experience.

- Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance background check before onboarding.

- Must be available for virtual video meetings with the camera on when required.

- Must maintain patient confidentiality and follow appropriate healthcare privacy and security practices.

Technical Requirements

- Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.

- Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).

- Audio: Noise-canceling headset.

- Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.

- Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

-
Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.

-
Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.

-
HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.

-
Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.

-
Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.

-
Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.

-
Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.

-
Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

remote.location: Remote — Kenya, South Africa, United Kingdom
remote.description:
Our Vision & Mission
We believe in a world where everyone, regardless of their country’s wealth or frontiers, enjoys access to medicines and healthcare when they need it. We work tirelessly to provide access to medicinces to those in LMIC's.
Who We Are:Accelerating access to medicines for all
Imagine a world where critical medicines are within reach, affordable, and synonymous with quality, no matter where you are. Axmed is building the digital infrastructure that is transforming access to medicines and health products across growth markets.
About the Position:
We have a bold ambition that will impact the lives of billions of patients. We are looking for an exceptional communications leader to make sure the world knows it and convince the relevant stakeholders to join our mission. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a builder and operator. This role comes with significant autonomy, direct access, and an equal high bar for ownership and impact. You will have the mandate to shape how Axmed shows up in the world. You will own our communications strategy, creative ambition, narrative, brand presence, thought leadership, and external visibility.
This is a sleeves-up, hands-on, high-energy role. We expect roughly 70–80% of this role to be hands-on execution, supported by strong strategic judgment and ruthless prioritisation. You will set the strategy and personally bring much of it to life: writing, editing, publishing, building decks, shaping campaigns, developing executive content, briefing agencies and partners, improving our digital presence, testing new formats and channels, using data to understand what works, and continuously shipping.
The mandate is simple: make Axmed impossible to ignore among the audiences that matter to our mission and growth.
The Person We’re Looking For:
You are passionate about what you do and an unusually strong communicator and exceptionally skilled storyteller who combines strategic judgment with very high execution capacity.
You can zoom out far enough to shape a company narrative and zoom in close enough to obsess over a headline, slide, caption, sentence, or call to action.
You thrive in fast-paced, tech-first environments and are comfortable operating without a large team, large budget, or elaborate process. Faced with ambiguity, you create clarity. You would rather test a strong idea, learn from the response and improve it than spend weeks perfecting a communications plan nobody sees. You have worked in healthcare before and are intellectually curious enough to become genuinely expert in the subjects Axmed has a right to lead on.
You should bring:

- Extreme ownership, pace, curiosity, resourcefulness, and attention to detail.

- Exceptional writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling ability.

- A strong instinct for what makes an idea interesting, credible, distinctive, and shareable.

- Experience building communications, brand, content, or thought leadership in a fast-moving startup.

- The ability to translate technical or complex subject matter into communication that senior stakeholders can quickly understand.

- Experience working directly with CEOs or senior executives on thought leadership and external positioning.

Build and run Axmed's external communications engine.

Make important Axmed moments land.

Looking for opportunities to work for a rapidly growing company? Candidates should have excellent communication skills, willing to learn on the job, and be highly reliable.
There are a wide variety of project openings available representing some of the most recognizable brands in the world. Schedules vary by site and program; however, we can usually find something that works for everyone.
This is an entry-level position that offers on the job paid training. While prior contact center experience isn’t required, experience in customer service, tech support, inside sales or back-office support is a plus.
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.
Our entry-level Contact Center Representatives are responsible for the following tasks:

- Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues

- Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks

- Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade

- Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

- High school diploma or equivalent

- Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills

-
Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.

Backend: Golang

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

remote.title: Content Producer (12-Month Fixed-Term Employment Contract)
remote.description:
Monstercat, now part of Create Music Group, is one of electronic music's most influential independent record labels, leading the movement towards artist sustainability. Founded in Waterloo, Canada in 2011, Monstercat has since expanded its global footprint with staff in Vancouver, Los Angeles, and Toronto. Championing a roster of world-renowned artists including Marshmello, Alan Walker, Kaskade, Koven, DIESEL (aka Shaquille O’Neal), WHIPPED CREAM, Monstercat celebrated over 20 Billion streams in 2023 with five releases a week across its Uncaged, Instinct, and Silk brands. The label has topped radio and streaming charts worldwide, offering a diverse range of genres across bass, dance, pop, house, chill, electronic, and more. Beyond recorded music, Monstercat channels the undeniable power of its brand into live events, ecommerce, gaming partnerships, digital collectibles, and sync deals. Backed by passionate employees, driven artists, and the dedication of fans worldwide, Monstercat proves that independent labels have the ability to reshape and reimagine the music industry landscape.

Job Summary

Monstercat is building a high-velocity content engine across unbranded culture pages on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — channels designed to reach new audiences organically through trending, genre-relevant content.

The Content Producer owns this channel network end-to-end: creating content at volume, identifying and launching new channels where opportunity exists, and acting as a key executional partner to the digital marketing team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who lives and breathes internet culture, moves fast, and can turn ideas into polished clips the same day.

This position is a fixed-term contract through June 30, 2027, with the possibility of conversion to a full-time role contingent on business needs.

Responsibilities

Content Production

- Create and publish short-form video content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) at high volume across multiple culture page accounts

- Edit clips, trailers, and highlight packages using tools like CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or equivalent

- Source and repurpose catalog audio and video assets to fit trending formats quickly

- Maintain a consistent posting cadence across all active channels with minimal direction

- Support content output across frontline releases

Channel Strategy & Growth

- Proactively monitor TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube for emerging trends, formats, and niche communities relevant to Monstercat genres

- Identify and pitch new channel opportunities — propose concepts, target audiences, and content formats before being asked

- Launch and manage new unbranded culture pages from zero, including handle setup, visual identity, and early posting strategy

- Track channel performance and iterate on content direction based on retention, reach, and growth data

Digital Marketing Support

- Respond to ad hoc content requests from the Digital Marketing Manager with quick turnaround

- Support release windows by creating timely, on-format content that amplifies new drops across culture channels

- Coordinate with the Creator Network team to share formats, assets, and posting strategies

- Feed performance insights back to the broader marketing team to inform campaign decisions

- Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

- 2+ years creating short-form video content professionally or with a demonstrable track record of growth

- Proficiency with at least one editing tool — CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or equivalent

- Deep familiarity with TikTok and Instagram as platforms: how the algorithms work, what drives retention, what formats are trending

- Ability to produce polished, publish-ready content independently — no hand-holding on execution

- Strong taste and an intuitive sense of what resonates in electronic music, dance, and internet culture spaces

- Self-starter mentality: you spot the opportunity and act on it before being asked

Nice to Have

- Experience running unbranded or niche content pages (culture pages, fan pages, genre accounts)

- Familiarity with Monstercat or dance music broadly.

- Experience with AI-assisted content tools (e.g. auto-captioning, generative B-roll, voiceover tools)

- Understanding of Spotify streaming metrics and how social content drives algorithmic performance

- Basic knowledge of Meta Business Manager or TikTok Business Center for managing multiple accounts

Pay Scale

- $60,000 - 70,000 (CAD) per year

- The final compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

Job Summary
As a Web Developer supporting the VA's National Training and Support Program (NTSP) Quality and Data Informatics initiative, you will design, develop, modernize, and maintain SharePoint, Internet, and Intranet websites that serve VA staff, stakeholders, and Veterans across the federal healthcare ecosystem. You will play a critical role in ensuring digital content is accessible, compliant, and performant in alignment with VA standards and federal regulations. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, self-directed web developer who thrives in a structured federal contracting environment and takes pride in delivering inclusive, Section 508-compliant digital experiences that support the VA mission.
Primary Responsibilities
Design, develop, modernize, and maintain SharePoint, Internet, and Intranet websites in support of NTSP program operations and VA stakeholder needs. Conduct comprehensive website assessments and develop management plans, design templates, and visual mockups to guide site development and continuous improvement. Establish and maintain website user groups and access permissions, ensuring appropriate role-based controls and governance in alignment with VA security policies. Perform website coding and prepare digital content for posting in full compliance with Section 508 accessibility standards, the VA Style Guide, and applicable copyright and release documentation requirements. Monitor and report on website performance across accessibility, quality assurance, and search engine optimization (SEO) dimensions, implementing improvements as needed. Support the structured transition of website maintenance responsibilities to Government personnel at task order conclusion, including documentation, knowledge transfer sessions, and handoff materials.
Minimum Qualifications
Minimum of 4 years of relevant web development experience, including design, development, and maintenance of SharePoint and web-based platforms (a BA/BS degree may be substituted with 7 total years of relevant experience). BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Web Development, or a related field required; 3 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of degree. Prior experience working with federal agencies, VA programs, or other government healthcare clients strongly preferred; familiarity with VA digital standards and federal web governance frameworks is a plus. Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and successfully complete a VA background investigation as required for system access. Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship. Demonstrated proficiency with Section 508 accessibility standards, web content management best practices, and the ability to produce compliant, VA Style Guide–aligned digital content.
Desired Qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Power Platform tools including Power Automate and PowerApps for workflow automation and low-code application development in a federal environment. • Proficiency with data and reporting tools such as SQL, Power BI, SSMS, Azure Data Studio, TOAD, SSIS, and/or SSRS to support data-informed web and informatics solutions. • Familiarity with Python scripting for automation, data processing, or web-related tasks within a VA or federal healthcare context. • Prior experience supporting knowledge transfer and website transition activities at the conclusion of a federal task order or contract period of performance. • Understanding of VA or federal health informatics data standards and how web platforms support quality and data-driven program reporting.

JOB TITLE: Cloud Engineer II (Linux)
GOVERNMENT AGENCY: DHS ICE - OSDSS

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.
We are seeking a Cloud Engineer II with strong Linux administration and DevOps experience to support cloud-based IT infrastructure for DHS/ICE in a secure, mission-driven environment. This role analyzes functional business and technical requirements, implements specifications, and identifies and resolves problems within existing systems while supporting the design, implementation, and enhancement of new and existing systems. The Cloud Engineer II participates in continuous analysis for performance, process, and security improvements, and contributes to the development and build of next-generation IT systems.
The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience supporting and securing cloud-based systems in AWS and Azure, administering UNIX/Linux systems at scale, and developing with DevOps tools such as Ansible. This role is responsible for understanding the needs of the customer and the realities of FedRAMP-available IT products, and for translating those needs into requirements that can be implemented by the architecture and engineering team using COTS products. Experience with system engineering in one or more areas — including computer languages, operating systems, or DevOps — is essential.
If you are passionate about secure cloud infrastructure and enjoy working in a collaborative, high-performance team environment, we encourage you to apply.
Responsibilities
RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage cloud-based IT system infrastructure and processes.

- Provide second-level problem diagnosis and resolution of issues.

- Support the implementation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of customer IT systems.

- Operate master consoles to monitor the performance of networks and computer systems.

- Coordinate computer network access and use.

- Coordinate with other engineering groups to ensure proper network operation and subnets.

- Perform Linux administration support activities.

- Develop, code, test, and debug new Ansible Playbooks and recipes, or enhancements to existing software.

- Analyze system scans and remediate findings and POA&Ms.

- Coordinate configuration changes, installs, and upgrades with application owners — including planning, scheduling, status reporting, and adherence to company change control procedures.

- Lead third-party team coordination, communication, and audit review of installed environments and processes.

- Create and maintain support documentation and written procedures for routine and non-routine tasks.

- Supervise junior staff, as assigned.

Qualifications
REQUIRED:

- Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in installation, configuration, and administration of UNIX/Linux based systems in a large environment.

- Experience supporting and securing cloud-based systems in AWS and Azure.

- Experience with implementation and configuration of Kion.

- Experience requesting and installing secure certificates, enabling Global Security using LDAP registry, and setting up SSO using SPNEGO and SAML.

- Good UNIX shell scripting skills, with exposure to emerging DevOps tools such as Ansible.

- Ability to evaluate new products and technologies and provide recommendations to enhance the current environment.

- Advanced troubleshooting skills, including analyzing log and trace files, opening service requests, collecting documentation, working with vendors, and driving problem resolution.

- Strong knowledge of security standards and hardening requirements such as DHS 4300A, DoD STIG, and FISMA requirements.

- Able to work and interact with others in a structured team environment.

- Ability to work with all levels of staff within and outside of IT and outside the organization.

- Self-starter able to work independently but comfortable working in a team environment; requires limited supervision and strong time management skills.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, including a demonstrated ability to communicate technical issues to a nontechnical audience.

- Independent problem solver with strong troubleshooting, decision-making, and analytical skills.

- Accuracy and attention to detail, with strong organizational skills.

- Flexibility and adaptability to handle competing work demands; dependable and flexible when necessary.

- Ability to obtain and maintain a DHS Public Trust clearance.

DESIRED:

- Certifications in AWS, Azure, Ansible, or other DevOps stack technologies.
WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Candidate must be able to function in general office environment.

Mission of Role/Position Summary:
The Contracts Administrator is responsible for the administration of the full contract lifecycle, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and company policies. This role serves as a key business partner to internal stakeholders by reviewing, drafting, negotiating, monitoring, and managing contracts while identifying and mitigating contractual risks. The Contracts Administrator supports strategic business growth by improving contract processes, maintaining contract governance standards, and ensuring efficient execution and administration of commercial, government, subcontractor, and vendor agreements.
Tasks, Duties, and Responsibilities:
Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the following essential functions:

- Administer the complete contract lifecycle from pre-award activities through closeout, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements and company policies.

- Draft, review, negotiate, and administer commercial, government, subcontractor, consultant, and vendor agreements.

- Analyze contract terms and conditions to identify risks, obligations, compliance requirements, and business impacts.

- Partner with legal counsel and business leaders to resolve contractual issues and negotiate acceptable terms.

- Maintain contract records, files, amendments, certifications, and supporting documentation within contract management systems.

- Monitor contract performance milestones, deliverables, reporting requirements, option years, renewals, and contract modifications.

- Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local procurement regulations and applicable contractual requirements.

- Review Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Quote (RFQ), Requests for Proposal (RFP), Sources Sought notices, and solicitation amendments.

- Support proposal development activities by reviewing compliance requirements and contractual provisions.

- Coordinate execution of non-disclosure agreements, teaming agreements, subcontract agreements, and consulting agreements.

- Track and manage certificates of insurance, business registrations, representations and certifications, and organizational qualifications required for contract performance.

- Develop and maintain internal contract administration procedures, templates, and best practices.

- Provide contract guidance and training to internal stakeholders, project managers, and operational teams.

- Monitor subcontractor and vendor compliance with contractual requirements.

- Assist with audits, contract reviews, compliance assessments, and document requests.

- Prepare reports and metrics related to contract status, obligations, modifications, and performance.

- Support emergency management consulting operations and client engagements as required.

- Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

- Strong knowledge of contract administration principles and contract lifecycle management.

- Ability to review, interpret, and negotiate contract terms and conditions.

- Knowledge of commercial contracting and government contracting processes.

- Understanding of contract risk assessment and mitigation strategies.

- Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, and state/local procurement regulations preferred.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including professional correspondence and contract documentation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple contracts and deadlines simultaneously.

- Proficiency with contract management systems and Microsoft Office applications.

- Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating across departments.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
May have lead responsibilities within projects or small teams depending on function with senior level support.
Expected Hours of Work:
Schedule may vary. Work on evenings and weekends may be required. Dependability and punctuality are paramount.
Travel Requirements:

- Up to 25% travel is expected for this position.

- Must be willing to travel and deploy to client sites for extended periods of time.

Physical Demands:

- Mobility required on-site with clients.

- Sitting or standing for hours at a time.

- Ability to work at a computer for extended periods of time if needed.

- Ability to manipulate up to 25 lbs. repetitively throughout the day and as needed.

Working Environment:

- Emergency management personnel may work in an office or home environment or be deployed to the field which may require working outdoors in adverse weather conditions.

- Work may be on-site with clients ex: EOC, hospital, debris sites or local government buildings.

- All AC Disaster Consulting (ACDC) positions are remote work site positions with the home location agreed upon at time of hire.

- If the remote work site locations change, ACDC Human Resources must be made aware, and leadership needs to approve any site changes for business registration and payroll tax purposes.

Workplace Health & Safety:
We are committed to fostering a safe and healthy workplace. Employees are expected to champion a culture of safety by complying with all health and safety policies and procedures, completing required training, identifying and reporting hazards, exercising sound judgment, and taking reasonable care to protect the health and safety of themselves, their colleagues, clients, and the communities we serve.
Requirements
Experience/Education Required:

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Contract Management, Legal Studies, Public Administration, Finance, or a related field.

- 3-5 years of experience in legal support, grants administration, or government contracting.

- 3-5 years of experience managing contracts throughout the entire contract lifecycle, including drafting, reviewing, and administering commercial and/or government contracts.

- 3-5 years of experience supporting negotiations and contract modifications.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and contract management databases.

Experience/Education Preferred:

- Certified Commercial Contracts Manager (CCCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or related certification.

- Experience working with federal, state, or local government contracts.

- Experience within emergency management, disaster recovery, consulting, engineering, or professional services industries.

- Knowledge of FAR, Uniform Guidance, FEMA programs, grants management, and compliance requirements.

- Master's degree, MBA, Paralegal, or Juris Doctor (JD) preferred.

remote.title: Teamleiter CRM / E-Mail Marketing (d/w/m)
remote.description:
Wir wachsen schneller, als unsere Betreuungsstruktur mitkommt. Aktuell hängen zu viele Entscheidungen an zu wenigen Köpfen — und unsere Account Manager:innen brauchen jemanden, der sie führt, nicht nur jemanden, der über ihnen steht.
Deshalb bauen wir die Ebene der Key Account Manager aus. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Team und ein eigenes Kundenportfolio — und gestaltest mit, wie Betreuung bei MAILODY in Zukunft funktioniert.
Wir sagen offen dazu: Diese Rolle ist gerade die anspruchsvollste im Unternehmen. Du bekommst Druck von oben (Wachstumsziele) und von unten (ein Team, das sich erst einspielt). Wir wissen das, wir lassen dich damit nicht allein — aber wir tun auch nicht so, als wäre es bequem.
Aufgaben
Führung

- Du führst 3–5 Account Manager:innen fachlich und disziplinarisch.

- Du führst wöchentliche 1:1s nach klarer Struktur (Fortschritt / Probleme / Pläne) und verantwortest die Gesundheit deines Teams.

- Du entwickelst deine Leute aktiv weiter — Schulungen, Feedback, strukturierte Einarbeitung.

Kunden

- Du verantwortest Entwicklung und Ergebnis deines eigenen Kundenportfolios (Richtwert 6–8 Accounts, ausschließlich unsere anspruchsvollsten Kunden). Das Tagesgeschäft liegt bei deinen AMs.

- Du bist geschätzter Ansprechpartner auf der Senior-Entscheiderebene deiner Kunden und platzierst Themen aktiv in Kunden-Calls.

- Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, entscheidest die Gegenmaßnahmen für dein Team und drehst gefährdete Accounts zurück in Wachstum.

Fachlichkeit & Prozesse

- Du bist die fachliche Rückfallebene deines Teams — Klaviyo- und CRM-Architektur beherrschst du in der Breite.

- Du coachst deine AMs fachlich und baust ihre Fähigkeiten auf, statt nur Fragen zu beantworten.

- Du ownst einen unternehmensweiten Prozess rund um unsere Mitarbeitenden (z. B. Onboarding oder Offboarding).

- Du stimmst Standards mit den anderen Key Account Managern ab und teilst Learnings aktiv.

Qualifikation

- Mindestens 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM; davon idealerweise ein Teil in einer Agentur oder im E-Commerce.

- Tiefe Praxis in Klaviyo oder einem vergleichbaren System (Braze, Emarsys, Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Du hast komplexe Set-ups selbst gebaut, nicht nur begleitet.

- Erste Führungs- oder Mentoring-Erfahrung— du hast schon einmal Verantwortung für die Arbeit anderer getragen. Das muss nicht disziplinarisch gewesen sein.

- Sicherheit im Kundenkontakt auf Entscheiderebene— du hast schon mit Geschäftsführung oder Marketingleitung auf Augenhöhe gesprochen.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich.

- Wohnsitz in Deutschland(steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlich zwingend).

Und was wir uns wünschen, aber nicht voraussetzen: Du gibst Feedback direkt und nimmst es genauso an. Du fragst nach dem Warum hinter den Zahlen eines Kunden. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand einen Prozess gibt.
Das ist nichts für dich, wenn …

- … du Führung als Beförderung siehst und nicht als eigenes Handwerk, das man lernen muss.

- … du Dinge lieber selbst machst, als sie abzugeben und jemanden dabei besser zu machen.

- … du eine fertige Struktur erwartest. Wir bauen sie gerade — mit dir.

- … du unangenehme Gespräche aufschiebst. Ein Teil dieser Rolle besteht daraus.

- … du im Homeoffice Struktur von außen brauchst. Wir arbeiten vollständig remote.

Benefits

- Ein Team, das dir gehört — und die Freiheit, es zu formen.

- Klarheit über deinen eigenen Weg: Wir haben eine ausformulierte Level-Matrix. Du siehst schwarz auf weiß, was auf deinem Level erwartet wird und was der nächste Schritt ist.

- Halbjährliche Entwicklungsgespräche mit echtem Feedback statt Formularen. Gehalt wird bei uns nach System vergeben, nicht nach Verhandlungsgeschick.

- Führungskräfte-Ausbildung mit einem externen Coach, der Führungsteams bei Meta und in mehreren Scale-ups aufgebaut hat.

- 100 % remote, überall in Deutschland — plus regelmäßige Team-Offsites und Workations.

- MacBook, bei Bedarf zusätzliche Hardware.

- 50 € monatliche Sachbezugskarte nach der Probezeit.

Sechs Sätze, an denen wir uns messen lassen — auch als Führungskraft:
Be confident.
We don't need all the answers to start, just the grit to find them first.
Be curious.
Let's be obsessed to find the ‚Why‘ to unlock the ‚How‘.
Keep growing.
Treat yourself like brilliant software: ship a new upgrade every month.
Be accountable.
Openness over cosiness. We own our words.
Act entrepreneurial.
Don't just do tasks: own real business impact.
Over-deliver where it matters.
Promise what's possible. Then challenge these boundaries.

remote.title: Business Development Executive
remote.description:
About Virtualitics:
Virtualitics is the category leader in AI-native readiness applications for defense, government, and critical infrastructure. Founded on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL, we are led by scientists, strategists, and servicemembers united by a single mission: to solve the world’s most complex, mission-critical challenges with AI.
Our Readiness AI solutions deliver operational certainty — giving leaders and operators a clear picture of what’s ready, what’s at risk, and what to do next. By identifying risks early, diagnosing root causes, and recommending prioritized actions with transparent, explainable AI, we help organizations move from data complexity to decision advantage.
Behind that impact is relentless innovation. Inventors at heart, we hold 15+ U.S. patents and are leading the shift toward agent-driven readiness. But what truly sets us apart is our culture — relentless about results, grounded in transparency, and driven by compassion for the mission and the people it serves.
If you’re motivated by impact, inspired by technical depth, and ready to build AI that performs where it matters most — you’ll find your mission here.
Our team is excited to find our next Business Development Executive to join the company.
What you will be doing:

- Daily Lead Generation: Cold calling, emailing, sending LinkedIn InMail, requesting referrals, doing Social outreach, searching SAM.gov and GovWin, etc.

- Collaborating with Account Executives to plan sales outreach strategies

- Researching Accounts and potential contacts.

- Qualifying leads and scheduling calls with prospective clients

- Effectively communicate the value proposition of our products to clients and be able to react to objections and competitive questions

- Documenting all relevant customer information and conversations into Salesforce

- Meet or exceed weekly metrics and quarterly KPI’s

- Attending & leading industry events for prospecting and market research

What we are looking for:
We’re excited to announce that we’re growing our sales team for the Public Sector at Virtualitics! We’re on the lookout for a driven and proactive Business Development Executive (BDE) with experience and passion for generating business within the public sector to join our dynamic sales force. If you’re enthusiastic about building relationships, driving sales, and thriving in a fast-paced setting, we’d love to have you on board!
In your role as a BDE at Virtualitics, you will be essential in discovering and qualifying new sales leads to the top of our Sales funnel. You’ll connect with potential customers, assess their needs, and showcase our products and services in an engaging way. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual who wants to play a key role in the growth of an innovative company.
What are our preferred requirements:

- 2+ years of experience in an inside sales role doing daily prospecting, cold calling, emailing, requesting referrals, and additional lead generation activities

- Experience selling into the Federal

- Bachelor's degree from a competitive university or equivalent experience

- Experience working with Salesforce.com or similar CRM

- Solid understanding of how the government operates, including procurement policies and procedures, and experience working with federal agencies and contractors.

- Natural comfort engaging with senior executive stakeholders and advisory board members routinely.

- Experience in AI / Data Analytics & defense technology (ideally SaaS) sales environment.

- Prior track record of achieving or exceeding sales quotas

- MAJOR BONUS – Experience selling analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or enterprise applications and technology

What are some valued skills:

- Brings creativity, passion, and energy to their work

- You are a results-oriented individual who is excited by a high-performance culture

- Team player with the ability to contribute to a fast-paced, collaborative environment

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- The ability to jump between different projects and quickly understand value props for each new client

- Enjoys a positive “can do” environment

What we offer you:
At Virtualitics, you’ll join a high-performance team of scientists, strategists, and servicemembers building AI that operates in the world’s most demanding environments. The problems we solve matter — and so does the opportunity to grow while solving them.
You’ll have meaningful ownership from day one, with the ability to accelerate your career alongside a company scaling rapidly in national security and critical infrastructure.

remote.title: Associate Director, Accounting
remote.description:
Precision for Medicine is a Clinical Research Organisation. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas.
As our company continues we grow we are seeking an Associate Director, Accounting to join our growing team.
In this role you will own general ledger accounting processes for all P&L/BS accounts, ensure accounting policies are documented and training materials maintained. You will have ownership of both Treasury and AP functions in addition to General ledger accounting for multiple business units, for multiple legal entities.
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

- Review JE's prepared by the Accounting Manager/Senior accountant as needed. Prepare complex GL entries as required.

- Review AP spend and cash flow forecasts to ensure reasonable and cash flow needs are appropriate. Approve AP invoices for processing and may assist with cash management ACH/wire submission/approvals as needed.

- Review balance sheet account reconciliations for SGA costs across multiple business units including Payroll liabilities, ROU asset/depreciation, Fixed assets/depreciation, intercompany reconciliations, insurance, prepaids etc. May prepare complex account reconciliations as needed.

- Finalize corporate SGA budgets and forecasts on a consolidated basis and determine accurate allocation method to various business units for management review. Provide corporate departments with actual to budget spend analysis commentary (IT/HR/Recruiting etc.) to assist with managing corporate spend.

- Train and mentor staff, ensure process documentation for accounting thresholds/adjustments and new GAAP standards is shared with the business to ensure accurate accounting and understanding of financial reporting. Prepare team training sessions at least bi-annually to develop the team. Continue to identify areas for improvement. Integrate new business acquisitions and initiate new projects as needed. Monitor emerging US GAAP standards or practices which may impact operations and reporting. Assist with data gathering and implementation of GAAP standards to be adopted.

- Review Financial results for efficiencies - Establish internal controls to minimize risk of payment errors, duplicate payments or fraud and work with the GL accounting team to implement needed controls.

- Review vendor spend (top 10) and customer spend/aging analysis periodically. Perform assessment of ability to consolidate vendors to improve cost management periodically.

- Review of customer contracts to ensure consistent application of revenue recognition policies in accordance with US GAAP (ASC 606) as needed.

- Review audit support prepared by team prior to providing to external auditors (audit/tax) to ensure appropriate to meet their request. Review and finalize any required accounting memos on policies prior to providing to auditors. Prepare complex audit schedules as needed. Support local statutory audit needs as required. Point person to manage PBC requests and follow up on any audit issues identified.

- Ensure full compliance with local statutory accounting and reporting requirements. Provide oversight for the preparation, review, and submission of statutory financial statements in accordance with local GAAP and regulatory timelines.
Serve as a primary point of contact for the local accounting & tax partners.

- Assist with strategic initiatives of the business as needed (system implementations, integrations, acquisitions etc.)

The ideal candidate will have:
Minimum Education & Experience:

- Bachelor’s degree with a minimum concentration accounting or finance; Accounting Designation preferred (CPA)

- Experience of managing multiple legal entities within EMEA

- A minimum of 12+ years relevant experience

- Or equivalent combination of education, professional training and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job.

Preferred Education & Experience (optional):

- Computerised Ledger System experience (e.g. Infor)

- Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills

- Strong MS Office literacy e.g. Word, PowerPoint, Excel

- Proven critical thinking, analytical, interpretative and problem-solving skills

- Detail-oriented professional with ability to handle complex reporting while meeting company deadlines, sometimes with short turnaround times and competing priorities.

- Ability to process and analyse large volumes of qualitative and quantitative information

- Strong knowledge of GAAP, financial regulations, and accounting best practices, including a knowledge of US and international accounting standards.

- Meaningful experience partnering with executive leadership

- Proficient English language skills to communicate effectively with local teams, auditors, and regulatory authorities

- Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills, and an ability to build credibility with external and internal stakeholders

- Work experience from a Pharma Services organization or Clinical Research Organization preferred

- Professional that thrives in a dynamic, past pace, high growth environment

- Willingness to extend yourself and assist/mentor other more junior team members. Ability to function well in team oriented environment

- Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a track record of developing teams and fostering strong cross-functional relationships.

Precision for Medicine's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.
We are a people focussed CRO with a supportive and collaborative environment which promotes work life balance and encourages team development.
We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground-breaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day.

remote.title: Medical Review Officer (MRO)
remote.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.JOB DESCRIPTION:
WORKING AT ABBOTT:
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

- Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

- Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan.

- An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution

- Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree

- A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

- A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

THE OPPORTUNITY:
The MRO, a licensed physician, supports the Medical Director in overseeing Toxicology - Workplace Services. This role is responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance, providing clinical leadership, and contributing to the strategic direction of occupational medicine and drug testing programs.
The position directly supports management of the MRO-A team, nursing staff, and support personnel, and plays a key role in budget oversight, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement (including regulatory agencies, internal leadership, and external partners). This role reports to the Medical Director and operates within a highly collaborative environment.
WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

- Leads and supports the management of physicians and cross-functional support staff within Medical Affairs, delivering occupational medicine and drug testing services.

- Reviews and interprets drug test results, including determining legitimate medical explanations in accordance with federal regulations.

- Ensures compliance with specimen collection procedures, chain-of-custody requirements, and recordkeeping standards.

- Supports and, as appropriate, conducts fitness-for-duty evaluations, including DOT FMCSA-certified driver medical exams.

- Provides insights into industry trends and evolving regulatory requirements, aligning program strategy with organizational objectives.

- Develops, implements, and continuously improves policies and procedures to ensure high-quality, evidence-based, and compliant occupational health services.

- Supports oversight of quality assurance programs, including adverse event reporting and safety monitoring activities.

- Maintains expert knowledge of applicable federal regulations and occupational medicine guidelines.

- Contributes to budget planning, resource allocation, and operational efficiency initiatives.

- Coordinates regulatory reporting and ensures the timely and accurate submission of required documentation.

- Maintains all required licensure, certifications, and continuing education to support role responsibilities.

Onboarding & Training

- The selected candidate will be expected to complete an on-site onboarding and training period in Kansas City during the first 90 days to ensure successful integration with the team and business.

- Following the onboarding period, the candidate will be expected to travel to Kansas City on a regular, as-needed basis to support business priorities, key initiatives, and leadership engagement.

QUALIFICATIONS:

- MD or DO with an active, unrestricted medical license; ability and willingness to obtain additional state licenses as required.

- Board-certified or board-eligible; Occupational and Environmental Medicine certification preferred.

- Current Medical Review Officer (MRO) certification (AAMRO or MROCC).

- Current DOT FMCSA Certified Medical Examiner (CDME) certification, or willingness to obtain certification upon hire.

- Minimum of 10 years of clinical experience, including occupational medicine and knowledge of substance use disorders.

- Minimum of 5 years of experience serving as a certified MRO, with demonstrated knowledge of applicable regulations.

- Strong knowledge of federal regulations and occupational health guidance.

- Demonstrated leadership, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant clinical/operational systems.

- Experience providing testimony, depositions, or serving as an expert witness preferred.

- Active participation in the ODAPC listserv required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Prior leadership or people management experience in healthcare, corporate health, or regulatory environment.

- Experience partnering with HR, Legal, or Compliance functions.

- Strong data analysis and reporting experience to support quality and operational decision-making.

- Experience in business operations, including budgeting and program management.

APPLY NOW:
Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:
Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.
Connect with us at , on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal

Job Title: Coordonnateur(trice) des services de projets en laboratoire/Laboratory Project

Job Contract Type: Full-time
